english: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof.

english: You will mention the message from Yahweh no more, for every man’s own word has become his message; for you have perverted the words of the living God, of Yahweh of Armies, our God.

english: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.

english: You shall put them on Aaron your brother, and on his sons with him, and shall anoint them, and consecrate them, and sanctify them, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office.

english: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

english: She said, “Let it be as you have said.” She sent them away, and they departed. Then she tied the scarlet line in the window.

english: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.

english: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.

english: and the border went out to the side of Ekron northward; and the border extended to Shikkeron, and passed along to Mount Baalah, and went out at Jabneel; and the goings out of the border were at the sea.

english: Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, “Hilkiah the priest has delivered a book to me.” Then Shaphan read it before the king.

english: When I look, there is no man, even among them there is no counselor who, when I ask, can answer a word.

english: Therefore you go, and read from the scroll which you have written from my mouth, Yahweh’s words, in the ears of the people in Yahweh’s house on the fast day. Also you shall read them in the ears of all Judah who come out of their cities.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Ka ɗauki naɗaɗɗen littafi mai girma ka yi rubutu a kai da alƙalami kurum, Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.

hausa: ba kamar bawa kuma ba, sai dai fiye da bawa, a matsayin ƙaunataccen ɗan’uwa. Shi ƙaunatacce ne sosai a gare ni amma a gare ka ya ma fi zama ƙaunatacce, kamar mutum da kuma kamar ɗan’uwa a cikin Ubangiji.
english: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

english: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.

english: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.

english: I cut off the three shepherds in one month; for my soul was weary of them, and their soul also loathed me.

english: Now I know that Yahweh is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly.”

english: “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?

english: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.

english: He walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him; and his heart was not perfect with Yahweh his God, as the heart of David his father.

english: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.

english: When I heard this thing, I tore my garment and my robe, and pulled the hair out of my head and of my beard, and sat down confounded.

english: The dream was doubled to Pharaoh, because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

english: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.

hausa: Amma sai su yi ta yin masa zaƙin baki, suna masa ƙarya da harsunansu;
english: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.

hausa: “Kaitonku, malaman dokoki da Farisiyawa, munafukai! Kukan wanke bayan kwaf da kwano, amma a ciki, cike suke da zalunci da sonkai.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.

hausa: Kakannin-kakannin nan kuma nasu ne, Kiristi kuma, ta wurin zamansa mutum, na kabilarsu ne. Yabo ya tabbata ga Allah har abada, shi da yake bisa kome! Amin.
english: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.

hausa: A rubuce yake cewa, “Na gaskata; saboda haka na yi magana.” Da wannan ruhun bangaskiya ne mu ma muka gaskata, saboda haka muke magana.
english: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also believe, and therefore we also speak,

hausa: Saboda haka cikin fushina na ba ku sarki, kuma cikin hasalata na ɗauke shi.
english: I have given you a king in my anger, and have taken him away in my wrath.

hausa: Ba a ƙara yin yaƙi ba sai a shekara ta talatin da biyar ta mulkin Asa.
english: There was no more war to the thirty-fifth year of Asa’s reign.

hausa: Ina biyayya da farillanka, gama ina ƙaunarsu ƙwarai.
english: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.

hausa: Adamu, Set, Enosh,
english: Adam, Seth, Enosh,

hausa: “ ‘Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa fushina da hasalata za su kwarara a wannan wuri, a kan mutum da dabba, a kan itatuwan fili da a kan amfanin gona, za su yi ta kuna, ba kuwa za a kashe ba.
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, my anger and my wrath will be poured out on this place, on man, on animal, on the trees of the field, and on the fruit of the ground; and it will burn and will not be quenched.”

hausa: Musa ya miƙa hannunsa a bisa tekun, da wayewar gari kuwa teku ya koma wurinsa na dā. Masarawa suka yi ƙoƙari su gudu, sai Ubangiji ya tura su cikin teku.
english: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to its strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it. Yahweh overthrew the Egyptians in the middle of the sea.

hausa: Na tattake al’ummai cikin fushina; cikin hasalata kuma na sa sun bugu na kuma zub da jininsu a ƙasa.”
english: I trod down the peoples in my anger and made them drunk in my wrath. I poured their lifeblood out on the earth.”

hausa: “Uba, in ka yarda, ka ɗauke mini wannan kwaf, amma ba nufina ba, sai dai naka.”
english: saying, “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.”

hausa: Wata rana, sai wani masanin dokoki ya miƙe tsaye don yă gwada Yesu. Ya tambaya ya ce, “Malam, me zan yi don in gāji rai madawwami?”
english: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

hausa: Sa’an nan aka ɗaga murfin dalman, a ciki kuwa ga mace zaune!
english: and behold, a lead cover weighing one talent was lifted up—and there was a woman sitting in the middle of the ephah basket.”

hausa: Ta ce, “Ba kowa, ranka yă daɗe.” Sai Yesu ya ce, “Haka ni ma ban hukunta ki ba. Ki tafi, ki daina rayuwar zunubi.”
english: She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”

hausa: Kuma ya ce, “Ina da roƙo guda ɗaya, cewa kowannenku ya ba ni ’yan kunne daga rabon ganima.” (Al’adar mutanen Ishmayel ce su sa ’yan kunnen zinariya.)
english: Gideon said to them, “I do have a request: that you would each give me the earrings of his plunder.” (For they had golden earrings, because they were Ishmaelites.)

hausa: Yahudawa suka ɗauki nawayar kafa al’adar cewa su, da zuriyarsu, da dukan waɗanda suka haɗa hannun da su, za su kiyaye waɗannan kwanaki biyu, kowace shekara yadda aka tsara, a kuma lokacin da aka keɓe dominsu.
english: the Jews established and imposed on themselves, on their descendants, and on all those who joined themselves to them, so that it should not fail that they would keep these two days according to what was written and according to its appointed time every year;

hausa: Asa ya yi abin da yake daidai a gaban Ubangiji, kamar yadda kakansa Dawuda ya yi.
english: Asa did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, as David his father did.

hausa: Ya bi bayan mutumin Allah. Ya same shi yana zama a ƙarƙashin itace oak, sai ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Kai ne mutumin Allah wanda ya zo daga Yahuda?” Ya amsa, “Ni ne.”
english: He went after the man of God, and found him sitting under an oak. He said to him, “Are you the man of God who came from Judah?” He said, “I am.”

hausa: Berota da Sibrayim (wadda take a iyaka tsakanin Damaskus da Hamat), har zuwa Hazer-Hattikon, wadda take a iyakar Hauran.
english: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim (which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath), to Hazer Hatticon, which is by the border of Hauran.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ai, na yi wa duniya magana a fili. Na kuma sha yin koyarwa a majami’u ko kuma a haikali inda Yahudawa duka sukan taru. Ban taɓa faɗin kome a ɓoye ba.
english: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.

hausa: Gileyad nawa ne, Manasse kuma nawa ne; Efraim shi ne hular kwanona, Yahuda kuma sandar mulkina.
english: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.

hausa: Ku tuna fa, dā ku bayi ne a Masar, sai ku lura, ku bi waɗannan ƙa’idodi.
english: You shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt. You shall observe and do these statutes.

hausa: Sai ga Bowaz ya iso daga Betlehem ya gai da masu girbi, “Ubangiji yă kasance tare da ku!” Sai suka amsa, “Ubangiji yă albarkace ka!”
english: Behold, Boaz came from Bethlehem, and said to the reapers, “May Yahweh be with you.” They answered him, “May Yahweh bless you.”

hausa: “Bugu da ƙari, ka faɗa wa mutanen cewa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ga shi na sa a gabanku hanyar rai da hanyar mutuwa.
english: “You shall say to this people, ‘Yahweh says: “Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.

hausa: Aka kuma kira shi Mizfa, domin ya ce, “Ubangiji yă sa ido tsakanin ni da kai sa’ad da muka rabu da juna.
english: and Mizpah, for he said, “Yahweh watch between me and you, when we are absent one from another.

hausa: Dawuda da mutanensa suka zauna a Gat tare da Akish. Kowa ya kasance tare da iyalinsa. Dawuda kuwa yana tare da matansa biyu. Ahinowam daga Yezireyel da Abigiyel matar Nabal da ya mutu daga Karmel.
english: David lived with Achish at Gath, he and his men, every man with his household, even David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess and Abigail the Carmelitess, Nabal’s wife.

hausa: Yaran Amram su ne, Haruna, Musa da Miriyam. ’Ya’yan Haruna maza su ne, Nadab, Abihu, Eleyazar da Itamar.
english: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

hausa: Kowa marar azanci ne, marar ilimi; kowane maƙerin zinariya zai sha kunya saboda gumakansa. Siffofinsa ƙarya ne; ba su da numfashi a cikinsu.
english: Every man has become brutish and without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his engraved image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

hausa: Suka yi zubin zobai huɗu na zinariya don tebur ɗin, sai suka ɗaura su a kusurwoyi huɗu inda ƙafafu huɗun suke.
english: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.

hausa: A kan dukan tsaunukan nan na hamada masu hallakarwa za su zo, gama takobin Ubangiji zai ci daga wannan iyaka ƙasa zuwa wancan; ba wanda zai zauna lafiya.
english: Destroyers have come on all the bare heights in the wilderness; for the sword of Yahweh devours from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land. No flesh has peace.

hausa: in kuma kuka ɗauki lokaci kuka ƙosar da mayunwata kuka kuma biya bukatun waɗanda suke shan tsanani, sa’an nan ne haskenku zai haskaka cikin duhu darenku kuma zai zama kamar tsakar rana.
english: and if you pour out your soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will rise in darkness, and your obscurity will be as the noonday;

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, shi da ya kafa rana don tă yi haske a yini shi da ya sa wata da taurari su yi haske da dare, shi da yake dama teku don raƙuman ruwansa su yi ruri Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ne sunansa.
english: Yahweh, who gives the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, who stirs up the sea, so that its waves roar— Yahweh of Armies is his name, says:

hausa: Na kasance kamar ɗan rago marar faɗa wanda aka kai mayanka; ban gane cewa sun ƙulla mini maƙarƙashiya, suna cewa, “Bari mu lalatar da itacen duk da ’ya’yansa; bari mu datse shi daga ƙasar masu rai, har da ba za a ƙara tunawa da sunansa ba.”
english: But I was like a gentle lamb that is led to the slaughter. I didn’t know that they had devised plans against me, saying, “Let’s destroy the tree with its fruit, and let’s cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.”

hausa: Gawar Yezebel zai zama kamar juji a ƙasa, a fili, a Yezireyel, har ba wanda zai iya cewa, ‘Wannan Yezebel ce.’ ”
english: and the body of Jezebel will be as dung on the surface of the field on Jezreel’s land, so that they won’t say, “This is Jezebel.”’”

hausa: Ko a kan gadonsa ma yana shirya mugunta; yakan sa kansa ga aikata zunubi kuma ba ya ƙin abin da ba shi da kyau.
english: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.

hausa: Suka tā da murya suka ce, “Wannan muryar wani allah ne, ba ta mutum ba.”
english: The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”

hausa: Ya sa wurin ajiye fitilan a Tentin Sujada ɗaura da teburin a gefen kudu na tabanakul
english: He put the lamp stand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.

hausa: “Amma ya ƙi. A maimako, sai ya je ya sa aka jefa shi a kurkuku, har yă biya bashin.
english: He would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due.

hausa: Wannan ya faru ne, don a cika maganar annabi Ishaya cewa, “Ubangiji, wa ya gaskata saƙonmu, ga wa kuma aka bayyana hannun ikon Ubangiji?”
english: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”

hausa: Na duba, sai na ga guguwa ta taso daga arewa babban hadari cike da walƙiya kewaye da haske mai haske sosai. Tsakiyar wutar ta yi kamar ƙarfe mai cin wuta balbal,
english: I looked, and behold, a stormy wind came out of the north: a great cloud, with flashing lightning, and a brightness around it, and out of the middle of it as it were glowing metal, out of the middle of the fire.

hausa: Kowa na ƙoƙari ya sami farin jini wurin mai mulki, kuma kowa na so a ce shi abokin mutumin nan mai yawan kyauta ne.
english: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.

hausa: domin na sani na kusa in ajiye shi a gefe, yadda Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi ya nuna mini a sarari.
english: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.

hausa: Ku tuna da abin da Ubangiji Allahnku ya yi wa Miriyam a hanya, bayan kun fito Masar.
english: Remember what Yahweh your God did to Miriam, by the way as you came out of Egypt.

hausa: Ba Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ne ya ƙudura cewa wahalar mutane ta zama mai kawai don wuta ba, cewa al’ummai su gajiyar da kansu a banza ba?
english: Behold, isn’t it from Yahweh of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya kore mana dukan Amoriyawa, waɗanda suke zaune a ƙasar. Don haka mu ma za mu bauta wa Ubangiji, gama shi ne Allahnmu.”
english: Yahweh drove out from before us all the peoples, even the Amorites who lived in the land. Therefore we also will serve Yahweh; for he is our God.”

hausa: Sa’an nan suka ce, “Bari mu kira yarinyar mu tambaye ta game da zancen.”
english: They said, “We will call the young lady, and ask her.”

hausa: Amma duk da wannan ƙarin wulaƙancin da ake yi musu, su kuwa sai daɗa riɓaɓɓanya suke ta yi. Sai tsoron Isra’ilawa ya ƙaru a zuciyar Masarawa,
english: But the more they afflicted them, the more they multiplied and the more they spread out. They started to dread the children of Israel.

hausa: Ya tuɓe mahaifiya mahaifiyarsa Ma’aka daga matsayinta na mahaifiyar sarauniya, gama ta gina ƙazantaccen ginshiƙin Ashera. Asa ya yanke ginshiƙin, ya kuma ƙone shi a Kwarin Kidron.
english: He also removed Maacah his mother from being queen, because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah. Asa cut down her image and burned it at the brook Kidron.

hausa: Zai kuma karɓi zakan hatsinku da na inabinku yă ba shugabannin fadarsa da sauran masu hidimarsa.
english: He will take one tenth of your seed and of your vineyards, and give it to his officers and to his servants.

hausa: Yehowash sarkin Isra’ila ya kama Amaziya sarkin Yahuda, ɗan Yowash, ɗan Ahaziya, a Bet-Shemesh. Sa’an nan Yehowash ya tafi Urushalima ya rushe katangar Urushalima daga Ƙofar Efraim har zuwa Ƙofar Kusurwa, ratarta ta kai wajen ƙafa ɗari shida.
english: Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah, at Beth Shemesh and came to Jerusalem, then broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

hausa: kada kuma su yi musu sata, sai dai su nuna za a iya amince da su sosai, don ta kowace hanya su sa koyarwa game da Allah Mai Cetonmu ta zama abin ɗaukan hankali.
english: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.

hausa: Ku dawo gare shi ku da kuka yi masa babban tayarwa, ya Isra’ilawa.
english: Return to him from whom you have deeply revolted, children of Israel.

hausa: Me mutum zai samu daga aikin da ya yi duka, da irin ɗawainiyar da ya sha a kan yin aikin a duniya?
english: For what does a man have of all his labor and of the striving of his heart, in which he labors under the sun?

hausa: Sai sarkin ya miƙe tsaye a inda yake, ya sabunta alkawari a gaban Ubangiji, don yă bi Ubangiji yă kiyaye umarnansa, ƙa’idodinsa da kuma farillansa da dukan zuciyarsa da kuma dukan ransa, ya kuma yi biyayya da kalmomin alkawarin da aka rubuta a cikin wannan littafi.
english: The king stood in his place and made a covenant before Yahweh, to walk after Yahweh, and to keep his commandments, his testimonies, and his statutes with all his heart and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book.

hausa: Waɗanda suke aikata abin da yake daidai sukan shiga da salama; sukan huta yayinda suka kwanta cikin kabari.
english: He enters into peace. They rest in their beds, each one who walks in his uprightness.

hausa: in kuwa aka faɗa muku wannan, to, dole a bincika sosai. In kuwa gaskiya ne, aka kuma tabbatar cewa wannan abin ƙyama ya faru a cikin Isra’ila,
english: and you are told, and you have heard of it, then you shall inquire diligently. Behold, if it is true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is done in Israel,

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa mutumin da yake saye da lilin, “Ka shiga cikin da’irorin da suke ƙarƙashin kerubobi. Ka cika hannuwanka da garwashin wuta wanda yake tsakanin kerubobin ka kuma watsar da su a kan birnin.” Yayinda nake dubawa, sai ya shiga.
english: He spoke to the man clothed in linen, and said, “Go in between the whirling wheels, even under the cherub, and fill both your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.” He went in as I watched.

hausa: To, fa, Yerobowam ya aiki mayaƙa su zagaya daga baya, domin yayinda yake a gaban Yahuda, sai ’yan kwanto su kasance a bayansu.
english: But Jeroboam caused an ambush to come about behind them; so they were before Judah, and the ambush was behind them.

hausa: wanda yake kamar ango mai fitowa daga rumfarsa, kamar gwani ɗan wasan da yake farin ciki yă yi tsere.
english: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.

hausa: Za a yi ranar da matsara za su tā da murya a kan tuddan Efraim su ce, ‘Ku zo, bari mu haura Sihiyona, zuwa wurin Ubangiji Allahnmu.’ ”
english: For there will be a day that the watchmen on the hills of Ephraim cry, ‘Arise! Let’s go up to Zion to Yahweh our God.’”

hausa: Suka ƙone wurinka mai tsarki ƙurmus; suka ƙazantar da mazaunin Sunanka.
english: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.

hausa: Haka ma in kuna cikin jin daɗinku, musamman lokacin da kuke bukukkuwanku, kamar Bikin Sabon Wata da dai kowane Bikinku, za ku hura waɗannan kakaki lokacin da kuke miƙa hadayunku na ƙonawa, da hadayunku na salama, za su kuma zama muku abin tunawa a gaban Allahnku. Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.”
english: “Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God. I am Yahweh your God.”

hausa: Gama in wani ya zo wurinku yana wa’azin wani Yesu dabam da wanda muka yi wa’azinsa, ko kuma in kun karɓi wani ruhu dabam da wanda kuka karɓa, ko wata bishara dabam da wadda kuka karɓa, ya nuna kun yarda da su ke nan cikin sauƙinkai.
english: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit which you didn’t receive, or a different “good news” which you didn’t accept, you put up with that well enough.

hausa: Saboda haikalinka a Urushalima sarakuna za su kawo maka kyautai.
english: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you.

hausa: Sa’ad da na komo da su daga al’ummai na kuma tattara su daga ƙasashen abokan gābansu, zan nuna kaina mai tsarki ta wurinsu a gaban al’ummai masu yawa.
english: when I have brought them back from the peoples, gathered them out of their enemies’ lands, and am shown holy among them in the sight of many nations.

hausa: Sai suka iso wani wurin da ake kira Golgota (wanda yake nufin Wurin Ƙoƙon Kai).
english: When they came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull,”

hausa: Sa’ad da Ubangiji ya umarci mutumin da yake saye da lilin cewa, “Ka ɗibi wuta daga cikin tsakanin da’irorin, daga tsakanin kerubobin,” sai mutumin ya shiga ya tsaya kusa da da’irar.
english: It came to pass, when he commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, “Take fire from between the whirling wheels, from between the cherubim,” that he went in and stood beside a wheel.

hausa: Bayan ya karɓa, sai halittu huɗun nan masu rai da kuma dattawan nan ashirin da huɗu suka fāɗi ƙasa a gaban Ɗan Ragon. Kowannensu yana da garaya kuma suna riƙe da kaskon zinariya cike da turare, waɗanda suke addu’o’in tsarkaka.
english: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

hausa: “Ka kafa tabanakul, da Tentin Sujada, a kan rana ta fari ga watan fari.
english: “On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Suka miƙa ’ya’yansu maza da mata hadaya ta wuta. Suka yi duba, suka yi sihiri suka kuma ba da kansu ga mugunta a gaban Ubangiji; suka sa ya yi fushi.
english: They caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

hausa: su marasa hankali ne, marasa bangaskiya, marasa ƙauna, marasa tausayi.
english: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;

hausa: Saboda haka ka faɗa musu, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa da yake kun ci nama da jini a cikinsa kuka kuma bauta wa gumakanku kuka zub da jini, kuna gani za ku mallaki ƙasar?
english: Therefore tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “You eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes to your idols, and shed blood. So should you possess the land?

hausa: “Mun tarar da wannan mutum fitinanne ne, yana tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye a tsakanin Yahudawa ko’ina a duniya. Shi shugaban ɗarikar Nazarawa
english: For we have found this man to be a plague, an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.

hausa: Ki kasa kunne! Masu tsaronki sun tā da muryoyinsu; tare sun yi sowa ta farin ciki. Sa’ad da Ubangiji ya komo Sihiyona, za su gan shi da idanunsu.
english: Your watchmen lift up their voice. Together they sing; for they shall see eye to eye when Yahweh returns to Zion.

hausa: Saboda haka mutanen Dan suka aika jarumawa guda biyar daga Zora da Eshtawol don su leƙi asirin ƙasar su kuma bincike ta. Waɗannan mutanen sun wakilci dukan kabilar. Suka ce musu, “Ku je, ku bincike ƙasar.” Mutanen suka shiga ƙasar tudu ta Efraim suka zo gidan Mika, inda suka kwana.
english: The children of Dan sent five men of their family from their whole number, men of valor, from Zorah and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land and to search it. They said to them, “Go, explore the land!” They came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, and lodged there.

hausa: Kome a busasshiyar ƙasa da yake numfashi a hancinsa ya mutu.
english: All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.

hausa: Saboda haka Mowabawa za su yi kuka mai zafi, za su yi kuka mai zafi tare saboda Mowab. Ku yi makoki ku kuma yi baƙin ciki saboda ƙosai da kuka riƙa ci a Kir Hareset.
english: Therefore Moab will wail for Moab. Everyone will wail. You will mourn for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth, utterly stricken.

hausa: A shekara ta goma sha biyu ta Yoram ɗan Ahab, sarkin Isra’ila, Ahaziya ɗan Yehoram, sarkin Yahuda ya fara mulki.
english: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.

hausa: Sa’ad da shugabannin kekunan yaƙin suka ga Yehoshafat, suka yi tsammani, suka ce, “Tabbatacce wannan shi ne sarkin Isra’ila.” Saboda haka suka juye don su yaƙe shi, amma sa’ad da Yehoshafat ya yi ihu,
english: When the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, they said, “Surely that is the king of Israel!” and they came over to fight against him. Jehoshaphat cried out.

hausa: Yesu ya ce masa, “Ka bar matattu su binne matattunsu, amma kai, ka je ka yi shelar mulkin Allah.”
english: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce God’s Kingdom.”

hausa: Zuwa ga dattawan da suke cikinku, ina roƙo a matsayin ɗan’uwanku dattijo, mashaidin shan wahalar Kiristi wanda kuma shi ma zai sami rabo cikin ɗaukakar da za a bayyana.
english: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:

hausa: Mai yiwuwa Ubangiji Allahnka zai ji maganganun sarkin yaƙin da maigidansa, sarkin Assuriya, ya aika don yă zagi Allah mai rai, ya kuma tsawata masa saboda maganganun da Ubangiji Allahnka ya ji. Saboda haka ka yi addu’a saboda raguwar da suke da rai.”
english: It may be Yahweh your God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to defy the living God, and will rebuke the words which Yahweh your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.’”

hausa: “Ka yi labule goma sha ɗaya na gashin akuya da za ka rufe tabanakul.
english: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.

hausa: Gama Allah ba ya nuna bambanci.
english: For there is no partiality with God.

hausa: Sauran baƙin suka fara ce wa juna, “Wane ne wannan, wanda har yake gafarta zunubai?”
english: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”

hausa: Kuɗin da aka same su a rashin gaskiya yakan ɓace da sauri, amma duk wanda ya tara kuɗi kaɗan-kaɗan za su yi ta ƙaruwa.
english: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.

hausa: Dukiyar masu arziki yakan zama mafakar birninsu, amma talauci shi ne lalacin matalauci.
english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

hausa: Annabawanki mahaukata ne mutanenki masu cin amana ne. Firistocinki suna ƙazantar da Wurin Mai Tsarki suna kuma keta dokoki.
english: Her prophets are arrogant and treacherous people. Her priests have profaned the sanctuary. They have done violence to the law.

hausa: Sa’an nan Filistiyawa suka fizge shi, suka ƙwaƙule idanunsa suka gangara da shi zuwa Gaza. Da suka daure shi da sarƙoƙin tagulla, sai aka sa shi yana niƙa a kurkuku.
english: The Philistines laid hold on him and put out his eyes; and they brought him down to Gaza and bound him with fetters of bronze; and he ground at the mill in the prison.

hausa: Ya kafa shi a matsayin ƙa’ida domin Yusuf sa’ad da ya fito daga Masar. Muka ji yaren da ba mu fahimta ba.
english: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.

hausa: (“ ‘Waɗannan su ne bukukkuwan da Ubangiji ya kafa, waɗanda za ku yi a matsayin tsarkakakkun taro, don kawo hadayun da aka yi da wuta ga Ubangiji, hadayu na ƙonawa da hadayu na hatsi, sadaka da kuma hadayu na sha, da ake bukata kowace rana.
english: “‘These are the appointed feasts of Yahweh which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh, a burnt offering, a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day—

hausa: sai karar ƙaho ya yi ta ƙaruwa. Sa’an nan Musa ya yi magana, murya Allah kuwa ta amsa masa.
english: When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.

hausa: Gama a wannan begen ne muka sami ceto. Amma begen da ake gani ba bege ba ne sam. Wa yake begen abin da ya riga ya samu?
english: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, kai ne mai iko har abada; kursiyinka ya dawwama cikin dukan zamani.
english: You, Yahweh, remain forever. Your throne is from generation to generation.

hausa: Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ‘Zan kawo masifa a kansu wadda ba za su iya tsere mata ba. Ko da yake suna kuka gare ni, ba zan saurare su ba.
english: Therefore Yahweh says, ‘Behold, I will bring evil on them which they will not be able to escape; and they will cry to me, but I will not listen to them.

hausa: Haka kuma bayan cimar, ya ɗauki kwaf, yana cewa, “Wannan kwaf ne sabon alkawari a jinina; ku yi wannan, a duk sa’ad da kuke sha, don tunawa da ni.”
english: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”

hausa: Ku zama tsarkakakke gare ni, gama Ni Ubangiji, mai tsarki ne, na kuma keɓe ku daga al’ummai don ku zama nawa.
english: You shall be holy to me, for I, Yahweh, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that you should be mine.

hausa: Kash, da ceton Isra’ila zai fito daga Sihiyona mana! Sa’ad da Allah ya sāke arzuta mutanensa, bari Yaƙub yă yi farin ciki Isra’ila kuma yă yi murna!
english: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

hausa: Ba ka ba da ni ga abokin gāba ba amma ka sa ƙafafuna a wuri mai sarari.
english: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.

hausa: A gabansu duniya takan girgiza, sararin sama kuma yakan jijjigu, rana da wata su yi duhu, taurari kuma ba sa ba da haske.
english: The earth quakes before them. The heavens tremble. The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.

hausa: Ya kawo ku da kuma dukan ’yan’uwanku Lawiyawa kusa da shi, amma yanzu kuna ƙoƙari ku karɓi aikin firist.
english: and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? Do you seek the priesthood also?

hausa: Gama ba za mu iya daina yin magana game da abin da muka gani muka kuma ji ba.”
english: for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”

hausa: Idan wani mutum ya taɓa abu marar tsarki, ko mutum ne, ko dabba ce, ko wani abu na banƙyama, ya kuma ci naman hadaya ta salama ga Ubangiji, za a fid da mutumin daga cikin mutanensa.’ ”
english: When anyone touches any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean animal, or any unclean abomination, and eats some of the meat of the sacrifice of peace offerings which belong to Yahweh, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

hausa: Sa’an nan na ɗauki kayan zunubin da kuka yi, wato, gunkin ɗan bijimi, na ƙone shi da wuta, na farfashe shi, na niƙa shi liɓis, sai da ya zama kamar ƙura mai laushi, na zubar da ƙurar a cikin ruwan rafin da yake gangarowa daga dutse.
english: I took your sin, the calf which you had made, and burned it with fire, and crushed it, grinding it very small, until it was as fine as dust. I threw its dust into the brook that descended out of the mountain.

hausa: Saboda haka manyan firistoci suka ƙulla su kashe Lazarus shi ma,
english: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,

hausa: Jimillar maza daga mutanen Gad 45,650 ne.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Nauyin zinariya da Solomon yake samun kowace shekara, talenti 666 ne.
english: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred sixty-six talents of gold,

hausa: Goliyat ya tsaya ya tā da murya wa hafsoshin Isra’ila ya ce, “Me ya sa kuka fito kuna layi don yaƙi? Ni ba Bafilistin ba ne? Ku kuma ba bayin Shawulu ba ne? Ku zaɓi waninku yă zo nan.
english: He stood and cried to the armies of Israel, and said to them, “Why have you come out to set your battle in array? Am I not a Philistine, and you servants to Saul? Choose a man for yourselves, and let him come down to me.

hausa: Miklot shi ne mahaifin Shimeyam. Su ma sun zauna kusa da danginsu a Urushalima.
english: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

hausa: Kada ka ƙara ga maganarsa, in ba haka ba zai tsawata maka ya kuma nuna kai maƙaryaci ne.
english: Don’t you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.

hausa: Amma ba kowa ne ya san wannan ba. Har yanzu, waɗansu mutane sun saba da tunani cewa gumaka ainihi ne, saboda haka sa’ad da suka ci irin abincin nan, sukan ɗauka cewa kamar an miƙa wa ga gunki ne, kuma da yake lamirinsu ba ƙarfi, yakan ƙazantu.
english: However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

hausa: “Ko ɓauna zai yarda yă zauna a wurin sa wa dabbobi abinci? Zai tsaya a ɗakin dabbobinka da dare?
english: “Will the wild ox be content to serve you? Or will he stay by your feeding trough?

hausa: Yakan zaunar da matar da ba haihuwa a gidanta ta zama kamar mahaifiyar ’ya’ya mai farin ciki. Yabi Ubangiji.
english: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah!

hausa: Duhu ne zai zama rana a Tafanes sa’ad da na karye ikon Masar; a can ƙarfin da take fariya zai ƙare. Za a rufe ta da gizagizai ƙauyukanta kuma za su tafi bauta.
english: At Tehaphnehes also the day will withdraw itself, when I break the yokes of Egypt there. The pride of her power will cease in her. As for her, a cloud will cover her, and her daughters will go into captivity.

hausa: Ƙari a kan waɗanda aka kashe a yaƙi, Isra’ilawa suka kashe Bala’am ɗan Beyor da takobi don yana duba.
english: The children of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, with the sword, among the rest of their slain.

hausa: Amma in bai saurare ka ba, ka je tare da mutum ɗaya ko biyu, domin ‘a tabbatar da kowace magana a bakin shaidu biyu ko uku.’
english: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

hausa: Na tuna da azabata da kuma sintiri, da na yi ta yi da ɗacin rai.
english: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Yaya mulkin Allah yake? Da me zan kwatanta shi?
english: He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya kira ɗaya daga cikin mutanensa ya ce, “Je ka kashe shi!” Haka kuwa ya buge shi, ya kuwa mutu.
english: David called one of the young men and said, “Go near, and cut him down!” He struck him so that he died.

hausa: Ta kira mijinta ta ce, “Ina roƙonka ka aika mini da ɗaya daga cikin bayi da kuma jaka, don in yi sauri in je wurin mutumin Allah in dawo.”
english: She called to her husband and said, “Please send me one of the servants, and one of the donkeys, that I may run to the man of God and come again.”

hausa: “In duniya ta ƙi ku, ku san cewa ta fara ƙin na ne.
english: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.

hausa: Da ya isa Galili, sai mutanen Galili suka marabce shi. Sun ga duk abin da ya yi a Urushalima a lokacin Bikin Ƙetarewa, gama su ma sun kasance a can.
english: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.

hausa: Ka san mahaifinka da mutanensa mayaƙa ne, suna cikin fushi kamar mugun beyar da aka ƙwace mata ’ya’ya. Ban da haka ma, mahaifinka gogagge ne a yaƙi; ba zai kwana da rundunar ba.
english: Hushai said moreover, “You know your father and his men, that they are mighty men, and they are fierce in their minds, like a bear robbed of her cubs in the field. Your father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.

hausa: In mutanen Masar ba su haura sun yi sujada ba, ba za su sami ruwan sama ba. Ubangiji zai kawo masu bala’in da ya aika wa al’umman da ba su haura sun yi Bikin Tabanakul ba.
english: If the family of Egypt doesn’t go up and doesn’t come, neither will it rain on them. This will be the plague with which Yahweh will strike the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.

hausa: Dutsena a ƙasar da dukiyarku na ƙasar da dukan arzikinku za a ba da su ganima, tare da masujadanku na kan tuddai, saboda zunubi ko’ina a ƙasarku.
english: My mountain in the field, I will give your substance and all your treasures for a plunder, and your high places, because of sin, throughout all your borders.

hausa: Suka ajiye makaman Shawulu a cikin haikalin gumakan Ashtarot. Suka kafa gawarsa a kan katanga Bet-Shan.
english: They put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth, and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth Shan.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya ƙwaƙule idanun Zedekiya, ya kuma sa masa ƙuƙumi, aka kai shi Babilon inda aka sa shi a kurkuku har ran da ya mutu.
english: He put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison until the day of his death.

hausa: Yanzu da Ubangiji Allahnku ya ba ’yan’uwanku hutu kamar yadda ya yi alkawari, sai ku koma gidajenku a ƙasar da Musa bawan Ubangiji ya ba ku a Urdun.
english: Now Yahweh your God has given rest to your brothers, as he spoke to them. Therefore now return and go to your tents, to the land of your possession, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave you beyond the Jordan.

hausa: gama ba zai ɗauki kome tare da shi sa’ad da ya mutu ba, darajarsa ba za tă gangara tare da shi ba.
english: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.

hausa: ko kuma a danne wa mutum hakkinsa a gaban Maɗaukaki,
english: to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High,

hausa: Ya yi ƙaton kwano mai suna Teku na zubin ƙarfe, mai siffar da’ira, awonsa kamu goma ne daga da’ira zuwa da’ira tsayinsa kuma kamu biyar. Ya ɗauki magwaji mai tsawo kamu talatin ya auna shi kewaye.
english: Also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim. It was round, five cubits high, and thirty cubits in circumference.

hausa: Saboda haka dole kowannenku yă bar yin ƙarya, yă kuma riƙa faɗa wa maƙwabcinsa gaskiya, gama dukanmu gaɓoɓi jiki ɗaya ne.
english: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, Allahn da yake ramuwa, Ya Allah wanda yake ramuwa, ka haskaka.
english: Yahweh, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.

hausa: gama a wannan rana za a yi kafara dominku, don a tsarkake ku. Sa’an nan a gaban Ubangiji, za a tsarkake ku daga dukan zunubanku.
english: for on this day shall atonement be made for you, to cleanse you. You shall be clean from all your sins before Yahweh.

hausa: Saboda haka ya kore su.
english: So he drove them from the judgment seat.

hausa: Dukan waɗannan albarku za su sauko muku, su zama naku, in kuka yi biyayya ga Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.

hausa: Don haka ya tambayi Yesse ya ce, “Su ke nan ’ya’yan maza da kake da su?” Yesse ya ce, “Har yanzu akwai ɗan autan, amma yana kiwon tumaki.” Sama’ila ya ce, “Ka aika yă zo, ba za mu zauna ba sai ya iso.”
english: Samuel said to Jesse, “Are all your children here?” He said, “There remains yet the youngest. Behold, he is keeping the sheep.” Samuel said to Jesse, “Send and get him, for we will not sit down until he comes here.”

hausa: Da leɓunana na ba da labarin dukan dokokin da suka fito bakinka.
english: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji ya yi tsaro a wannan dare, domin yă fitar da su daga Masar, a wannan dare, dole dukan Isra’ilawa su yi tsaro, don su girmama Ubangiji, cikin dukan tsararraki masu zuwa.
english: It is a night to be much observed to Yahweh for bringing them out from the land of Egypt. This is that night of Yahweh, to be much observed by all the children of Israel throughout their generations.

hausa: A watan tara ne sarki kuwa yana zaune a gidansa na rani, wuta kuwa tana ci a kasko a gabansa.
english: Now the king was sitting in the winter house in the ninth month, and there was a fire in the brazier burning before him.

hausa: Saboda haka na buɗe bakina, ya kuma ba ni littafin in ci.
english: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat the scroll.

hausa: na ɗaga kaina na duba sai ga wani mutum tsaye sanye da rigar lilin, ya yi ɗamara da zinariya zalla daga Ufaz kewaye da ƙugunsa.
english: I lifted up my eyes and looked, and behold, there was a man clothed in linen, whose waist was adorned with pure gold of Uphaz.

hausa: Duk wanda ya ji kunyata, da na kalmomina a wannan zamani na fasikanci da zunubi, Ɗan Mutum ma zai ji kunyarsa lokacin da ya shiga cikin ɗaukakar Ubansa, tare da tsarkakan mala’iku.”
english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”

hausa: Zan yi gāba da su. Ko da yake sun fito daga wuta, wuta za tă cinye su. Kuma sa’ad da na yi gāba da su, za ku san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.
english: I will set my face against them. They will go out from the fire, but the fire will still devour them. Then you will know that I am Yahweh, when I set my face against them.

hausa: Yowab ya ga cewa an ja masa dāgār yaƙi gaba da baya; saboda haka sai ya zaɓi waɗansu shahararrun sojoji cikin Isra’ila, ya sa su gabza da Arameyawa.
english: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel and put them in array against the Syrians.

hausa: Yana gama magana, sai ga ’ya’yan sarki maza suka shigo suna kuka da ƙarfi. Sarki ma da dukan bayinsa suka yi kuka mai zafi.
english: As soon as he had finished speaking, behold, the king’s sons came, and lifted up their voices and wept. The king also and all his servants wept bitterly.

hausa: Amma yanzu, ina roƙonka ka gafarta zunubinsu, in ba haka ba, to, ka shafe ni daga littafin da ka rubuta.”
english: Yet now, if you will, forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written.”

hausa: Yehoshafat ya ce, “Maganar Ubangiji tana tare da shi.” Saboda haka sarkin Isra’ila da Yehoshafat da kuma sarkin Edom suka tafi wurin Elisha.
english: Jehoshaphat said, “Yahweh’s word is with him.” So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

hausa: Zuriyar Yehonadab ɗan Rekab sun yi biyayya da umarnin da kakansu ya ba su, amma waɗannan mutane ba su yi mini biyayya ba.’
english: The sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father which he commanded them, but this people has not listened to me.”’

hausa: Yehohiyakim yana da shekara ashirin da biyar sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima shekara goma sha ɗaya. Ya yi abin da yake mugu a gaban Ubangiji Allahnsa.
english: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. He did that which was evil in Yahweh his God’s sight.

hausa: sa’ad da ya kafa gizagizai a bisa ya kuma kafa maɓulɓulan zurfafa daram,
english: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,

hausa: Sai Natan ya ce wa Batsheba, mahaifiyar Solomon, “Ki san cewa Adoniya, ɗan Haggit, ya zama sarki ba tare da sanin ranka yă daɗe, sarkinmu Dawuda ba?
english: Then Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, “Haven’t you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith reigns, and David our lord doesn’t know it?

hausa: Da a ce kai ɗan’uwa ne gare ni, wanda nonon mahaifiyata sun shayar! Da in na same ka a waje, na sumbace ka, babu wanda zai rena ni.
english: Oh that you were like my brother, who nursed from the breasts of my mother! If I found you outside, I would kiss you; yes, and no one would despise me.

hausa: “Saboda haka zan ƙwace hatsina sa’ad da ya nuna, da sabon ruwan inabina sa’ad da ya ƙosa. Zan karɓe ulu nawa da lilina, da take niyya ta rufe tsiraicinta.
english: Therefore I will take back my grain in its time, and my new wine in its season, and will pluck away my wool and my flax which should have covered her nakedness.

hausa: An sayo dawakan Solomon daga Masar da kuma daga dukan sauran ƙasashe.
english: They brought horses for Solomon out of Egypt and out of all lands.

hausa: Sai wuta ta fito daga wurin Ubangiji ta cinye mutane 250 da suke miƙa hadaya da turare.
english: Fire came out from Yahweh, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.

hausa: Benahiya ɗan Yehohiyada ne shugaban Keretawa da Feletiyawa, wato, sojoji masu gadin Dawuda, sa’an nan ’ya’yan Dawuda maza su ne mashawartan sarki.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief ministers.

hausa: An dai rubuta waɗannan ne don ku gaskata Yesu ne Kiristi, Ɗan Allah kuma ta wurin gaskatawa ku sami rai a cikin sunansa.
english: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.

hausa: ko ’yar’uwarsa da ba tă riga ta yi aure ba, wadda take dogara gare shi, da yake ba ta da miji, saboda ita zai iya ƙazantar da kansa.
english: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband; for her he may defile himself.

hausa: “Yadda ka taimaki marar ƙarfi! Yadda ka ceci marar ƙarfi!
english: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: wanda yake ƙulla mugunta da ruɗu a cikin zuciyarsa, kullum yana tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye
english: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.

hausa: Dukan mutanen da suka rage daga Hittiyawa, Amoriyawa, Ferizziyawa, Hiwiyawa da Yebusiyawa (waɗannan mutane ba Isra’ilawa ba ne),
english: As for all the people who were left of the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of Israel—

hausa: Zan yi hukunci a kansa da annoba da kuma zub da jini; zan yi ruwa mai yawa da ƙanƙara da kibiritu mai cin wuta a kansa da a kan sojojinsa da kuma a kan al’ummai masu yawa da suke tare da shi.
english: I will enter into judgment with him with pestilence and with blood. I will rain on him, on his hordes, and on the many peoples who are with him, torrential rains with great hailstones, fire, and sulfur.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa na yi alkawari da kakanni-kakanninku sa’ad da na fitar da su daga Masar, daga ƙasar bauta. Na ce,
english: “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says: ‘I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage, saying:

hausa: Yesu ya ce musu, “Tabbatacce, na san za ku faɗa mini karin maganan nan, ‘Likita, warkar da kanka! Ka kuma yi abin da muka ji ka yi a Kafarnahum, a nan garinka.’ ”
english: He said to them, “Doubtless you will tell me this proverb, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.’”

hausa: Su karnuka ne masu kwaɗayi; ba su taɓa ƙoshi. Su makiyaya ne marasa ganewa; duk sun nufi inda suka ga dama, kowa yana nemar wa kansa riba.
english: Yes, the dogs are greedy. They can never have enough. They are shepherds who can’t understand. They have all turned to their own way, each one to his gain, from every quarter.

hausa: Aikin adalci zai zama salama; tasirin adalci zai zama natsuwa da tabbaci har abada.
english: The work of righteousness will be peace, and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.

hausa: “Ka sha gabana zuwa Gilgal. Lalle zan gangara wurinka domin in miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa da hadayu na salama. Sai ka jira ni kwana bakwai sai na zo wurinka na kuma gaya maka abin da za ka yi.”
english: “Go down ahead of me to Gilgal; and behold, I will come down to you to offer burnt offerings and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings. Wait seven days, until I come to you and show you what you are to do.”

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Sai bokaye suka ce wa Fir’auna, “Wannan fa da hannun Allah a ciki.” Amma zuciyar Fir’auna ta taurare, bai kuwa saurara ba, kamar dai yadda Ubangiji ya riga ya faɗa.
english: Then the magicians said to Pharaoh, “This is God’s finger;” but Pharaoh’s heart was hardened, and he didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.

hausa: Tekun ya tsaya a kan bijimai goma sha biyu, uku na fuskantar arewa, uku na fuskantar yamma, uku na fuskantar kudu, uku kuma na fuskantar gabas. Tekun ya zauna a kansu, kuma ƙarfafun bayansu suna wajen tsakiya.
english: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, three looking toward the west, three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east; and the sea was set on them above, and all their hindquarters were inward.

hausa: Sa’ad da ka rabu da ni yau, za ka sadu da mutum biyu kusa da kabarin Rahila a Zelza, a yankin Benyamin. Za su ce maka, ‘An sami jakunan da ka fita nema, yanzu haka mahaifinka ya bar damuwa kan jakunan ya koma damuwa a kanka, yana cewa, yaya zan gan ɗana?’
english: When you have departed from me today, then you will find two men by Rachel’s tomb, on the border of Benjamin at Zelzah. They will tell you, ‘The donkeys which you went to look for have been found; and behold, your father has stopped caring about the donkeys and is anxious for you, saying, “What shall I do for my son?”’

hausa: Saboda haka Yesu ya sāke cewa, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, ni ne ƙofar tumakin.
english: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.

hausa: Duk wanda yake abokin ɓarawo abokin gāban kansa ne; yana jin sa yana ta rantsuwa, amma bai isa ya ce kome ba.
english: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.

hausa: Yusuf ya kuma tanada wa mahaifinsa da kuma ’yan’uwansa da dukan gidan mahaifinsa, abinci bisa ga yawan ’ya’yansu.
english: Joseph provided his father, his brothers, and all of his father’s household with bread, according to the sizes of their families.

hausa: Kome da aka keɓe daga tsarkakakku hadayun da Isra’ilawa suka miƙa wa Ubangiji, na ba ka, da kai da ’ya’yanka maza da mata a matsayin zaunannen rabo. Wannan madawwamin alkawarin gishiri ne a gaban Ubangiji dominka da zuriyarka.”
english: All the wave offerings of the holy things which the children of Israel offer to Yahweh, I have given you and your sons and your daughters with you, as a portion forever. It is a covenant of salt forever before Yahweh to you and to your offspring with you.”

hausa: Ka juye bakin takobinsa ba ka kuma taimake shi a cikin yaƙi ba.
english: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.

hausa: A can za su tā da murya su ce, ‘Fir’auna sarkin Masar mai yawan surutu ne kawai; ya bar zarafi ya wuce masa.’
english: They cried there, ‘Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he has let the appointed time pass by.’

hausa: Ya shugabanci Isra’ila shekara ashirin da uku sa’an nan ya mutu, aka kuma binne shi a Shamir.
english: He judged Israel twenty-three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.

hausa: Yaya kuka kāsa gane cewa ba zancen burodi nake yi ba? Sai dai ku yi hankali da yistin Farisiyawa da Sadukiyawa.”
english: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

hausa: Nan da nan Yesu ya sa almajiran su shiga jirgin ruwa su sha gabansa, su haye zuwa ɗayan hayin, yayinda shi kuma yă sallami taron.
english: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

hausa: Kai ne ka bubbuɗe maɓulɓulai da rafuffuka; ka busar da koguna masu ruwa.
english: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.

hausa: Saboda haka sa’ad da kai mutum kurum, kana ba su laifi, duk da haka kana aikata abubuwan nan, kana tsammani za ka tsere wa hukuncin Allah ne?
english: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?

hausa: A haka ya gina haikalin ya kuma gama shi, ya jinƙe shi da manyan katakai da kuma katakan al’ul.
english: So he built the house and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka ce wa Dawuda, “Duba ga Filistiyawa suna yaƙi da mutanen Keyila, suna kwashe musu hatsi a masussukai.”
english: David was told, “Behold, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah, and are robbing the threshing floors.”

hausa: “Ka gaya wa Isra’ilawa su keɓe waɗansu birane su zama biranen mafaka kamar yadda na umarce ku ta wurin Musa,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Assign the cities of refuge, of which I spoke to you by Moses,

hausa: Muna ka da masu gardama da kowane tunanin ɗaga kai da yake kafa kansa gāba da sanin Allah, muna kuma jan hankalin kowa ga bautar Kiristi.
english: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,

hausa: Duk kun ga wannan ku da kanku saboda haka me ya sa kuke maganganun nan marasa ma’ana?
english: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?

hausa: Salamar Allah, wadda ta wuce dukan fahimta, za tă tsai da zukatanku da tunaninku cikin Kiristi Yesu.
english: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

hausa: Gama ba bambanci tsakanin mutumin Yahuda da mutumin Al’ummai, Ubangijin nan ɗaya shi ne Ubangijin kowa yana kuma ba da albarka a yalwace ga duk masu kira gare shi,
english: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.

hausa: Za a iya ɗaukan waɗannan al’amura a matsayin misali, domin matan nan suna misalta alkawura biyu ne. Alkawari ɗaya daga Dutsen Sinai ne yana kuma haihuwar ’ya’yan da za su zama bayi. Hagar ke nan.
english: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.

hausa: A busa ƙaho a Sihiyona, a yi shelar azumi mai tsarki, a kira tsarkakan taro.
english: Blow the trumpet in Zion! Sanctify a fast. Call a solemn assembly.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Shaiɗan, “Daga ina ka fito?” Shaiɗan ya amsa wa Ubangiji ya ce, “Daga yawo a duniya ina kai da kawowa a cikinta.”
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

hausa: Saboda haka a rana ɗaya annobarta za su cim mata, mutuwa, makoki da kuma yunwa. Wuta zai cinye ta, gama Ubangiji Allah mai girma ne, wanda yake shari’anta ta.
english: Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire, for the Lord God who has judged her is strong.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Efa’al maza su ne, Eber, Misham, Shemed (wanda ya gina Ono da Lod tare da ƙauyukan kewayensu),
english: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;

hausa: Yayinda kowannensu ya tsaya a inda yake kewaye da sansanin, dukan Midiyawa suka fito da gudu, suna kuka yayinda suke gudu.
english: They each stood in his place around the camp, and all the army ran; and they shouted, and put them to flight.

hausa: A bayan garin, ka auna kamu dubu biyu a wajen gabas, kamu dubu biyu a wajen yamma, kamu dubu biyu wajen kudu, da kuma kamu dubu uku wajen arewa, a bar garin a tsakiya. Za su kasance da wannan a matsayin wurin kiwo na garuruwan.
english: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the middle. This shall be the pasture lands of their cities.

hausa: In kuma na yi abin da ba na son yi, na yarda da cewa dokar aba ce mai kyau.
english: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.

hausa: Da ta duba sai ga sarki, tsaye kusa da ginshiƙi, bisa ga al’ada. Hafsoshi da masu busa suna tsaye kusa da sarki, dukan mutanen ƙasar kuma suna farin ciki suna busa ƙahoni. Sai Ataliya ta keta tufafinta ta tā da murya tana cewa, “Kai! Wannan cin amana ne! Ai, wannan cin amana ne!”
english: and she looked, and behold, the king stood by the pillar, as the tradition was, with the captains and the trumpets by the king; and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew trumpets. Then Athaliah tore her clothes and cried, “Treason! Treason!”

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya nuna mini maƙera guda huɗu.
english: Yahweh showed me four craftsmen.

hausa: Waɗansu daga cikin taron suka ɗau kururuwa suna ce abu kaza, waɗansu kuma suna ce abu kaza, da yake shugaban ƙungiyar sojan ya kāsa samun ainihin tushen maganar saboda yawan hayaniyar, sai ya yi umarni a kai Bulus barikin soja.
english: Some shouted one thing and some another, among the crowd. When he couldn’t find out the truth because of the noise, he commanded him to be brought into the barracks.

hausa: Bari Allah na bege yă cika ku da matuƙar farin ciki da salama yayinda kuke dogara gare shi, domin ku yalwata cikin bege ta wurin ikon Ruhu Mai Tsarki.
english: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.

hausa: Sai na ji yawan waɗanda aka sa musu hatimi. Su 144,000 daga dukan kabilan Isra’ila.
english: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:

hausa: A lokacin waɗanda Ubangiji ya kashe za su kasance a ko’ina, daga wannan bangon duniya zuwa wancan. Ba za a yi kuka dominsu, ba za a tattara su don a binne ba, amma za su zama kamar juji da an tsiba a ƙasa.
english: The slain of Yahweh will be at that day from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth. They won’t be lamented. They won’t be gathered or buried. They will be dung on the surface of the ground.

hausa: Suka rera waƙar yabo da godiya ga Ubangiji, suna cewa, “Shi nagari ne; ƙaunarsa kuwa ga Isra’ila har abada ce.” Dukan jama’a kuwa suka yabi Ubangiji da murya mai ƙarfi, domin an aza harsashin ginin gidan Ubangiji.
english: They sang to one another in praising and giving thanks to Yahweh, “For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever toward Israel.” All the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised Yahweh, because the foundation of Yahweh’s house had been laid.

hausa: Saboda haka, Musa, Haruna da shugabannin Isra’ila, suka ƙidaya dukan Lawiyawa kabila-kabila da kuma iyali-iyali.
english: All those who were counted of the Levites whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel counted, by their families and by their fathers’ houses,

hausa: Allah ne ya ba ni ƙarfi, ya kuma mai da hanyata cikakkiya.
english: God is my strong fortress. He makes my way perfect.

hausa: “ ‘Ku kiyaye dukan farillaina da kuma dukan dokokina, ku kuma bi su. Ni ne Ubangiji.’ ”
english: “‘You shall observe all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them. I am Yahweh.’”

hausa: “Ina ruwanka da mu, Yesu Banazare? Ka zo ne don ka hallaka mu? Na san wane ne kai, Mai Tsarki nan na Allah!”
english: saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”

hausa: Na ragargaza su har ba za su iya tashi ba; sun fāɗi a ƙarƙashin ƙafafuna.
english: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.

hausa: Amma duk wanda ya yi mūsun sani na a gaban mutane, ni ma zan yi mūsun saninsa a gaban Ubana da yake cikin sama.
english: But whoever denies me before men, I will also deny him before my Father who is in heaven.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka ce wa juna, “Ba mu yi abin kirki ba. Wannan rana ce ta albishiri amma muka yi shiru; in kuwa mun bari har gari ya waye, to, fa, wata masifa za tă fāɗo mana. Bari mu tafi nan take mu faɗa a fadan sarki.”
english: Then they said to one another, “We aren’t doing right. Today is a day of good news, and we keep silent. If we wait until the morning light, punishment will overtake us. Now therefore come, let’s go and tell the king’s household.”

hausa: da ba don Ubangiji ya kasance a gefenmu ba sa’ad da aka auka mana,
english: if it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, when men rose up against us,

hausa: Daga kwandon burodi marar yisti, wanda yake gaban Ubangiji, ka ɗauki dunƙule ɗaya, da waina da aka yi da mai, da kuma ƙosai.
english: and one loaf of bread, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before Yahweh.

hausa: Amma ungozomomin nan masu tsoron Allah ne, ba su kuwa aikata abin da sarkin Masar ya gaya musu ba; suka bar jarirai maza su rayu.
english: But the midwives feared God, and didn’t do what the king of Egypt commanded them, but saved the baby boys alive.

hausa: Zafin jikinsa kaɗai yake ji yana kuka wa kansa ne kaɗai.”
english: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”

hausa: Zan kai damuwata wurinsa in yi gardama da shi.
english: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

hausa: Ya shirya wuri mai tsarki na ciki can cikin haikali don yă sa akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji a can.
english: He prepared an inner sanctuary in the middle of the house within, to set the ark of Yahweh’s covenant there.

hausa: Ya kuma ce musu, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, waɗansu da suke tsattsaye a nan ba za su mutu ba, sai sun ga mulkin Allah ya bayyana da iko.”
english: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see God’s Kingdom come with power.”

hausa: Shirayin ƙofar ta fuskanci filin waje; tana da zāne-zānen adon itatuwan dabino a madogaranta, matakai takwas kuwa sun haura zuwa wajenta.
english: Its posts were toward the outer court. Palm trees were on its posts on this side and on that side. The ascent to it had eight steps.

hausa: Ya saukar da masu mulki daga gadajen sarautarsu amma ya ɗaukaka ƙasƙantattu.
english: He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Ka ki dukan waɗanda suka kauce daga ƙa’idodinka, gama yaudararsu banza ne.
english: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.

hausa: A’a, sai dai a zuba sabon ruwan inabi a sababbin salkuna.
english: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.

hausa: Duk wanda ya mai da hankali ga umarni yakan yi nasara, kuma mai albarka ne wanda yake dogara ga Ubangiji.
english: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in Yahweh is blessed.

hausa: Sama’ila ya rasu, sai dukan Isra’ila suka taru suka yi makoki saboda shi. Suka binne shi a gidansa a Rama. Sai Dawuda ya gangara zuwa cikin Jejin Faran.
english: Samuel died; and all Israel gathered themselves together and mourned for him, and buried him at his house at Ramah. Then David arose and went down to the wilderness of Paran.

hausa: A wannan rana za a rera wannan waƙa a ƙasar Yahuda. Muna da birni mai ƙarfi; Allah yake ceton katanga da kuma kagarunta.
english: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.

hausa: Amma Farisiyawa suka fita suka ƙulla shawara yadda za su kashe Yesu.
english: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.

hausa: Rizfa ’yar Aiya ta ɗauki tsumma ta yi wa kanta shimfiɗa a kan dutse. Tun daga farkon girbi har ruwa damina ya sauko a kan gawawwakin, ba tă yarda tsuntsayen sama su taɓa su da rana ko mugayen namun jeji da dare ba.
english: Rizpah the daughter of Aiah took sackcloth and spread it for herself on the rock, from the beginning of harvest until water poured on them from the sky. She allowed neither the birds of the sky to rest on them by day, nor the animals of the field by night.

hausa: Ga abin da sarki ya ce kada ku bar Hezekiya ya ruɗe ku. Ba zai cece ku ba!
english: The king says, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you; for he will not be able to deliver you.

hausa: Za su gaishe ka, su ba ka burodi biyu, kai kuwa sai ka karɓa.
english: They will greet you and give you two loaves of bread, which you shall receive from their hand.

hausa: Amma tare da kai akwai gafartawa, saboda haka ake tsoronka.
english: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.

hausa: Ƙaunar da yake yi muku ya ƙaru ƙwarai, duk sa’ad da yake tunawa da biyayyarku duka, da kuma irin yawan bangirman da kuka nuna masa lokacin da kuka karɓe shi.
english: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.

hausa: Ya ƙone ƙasusuwan firistocin gumaka a kan bagaden da a dā suke miƙa hadayunsu, ta haka ya tsabtacce Yahuda da Urushalima.
english: He burned the bones of the priests on their altars, and purged Judah and Jerusalem.

hausa: Bayan muka yi ’yan kwanaki da dama a can, sai wani annabin da ake kira Agabus ya gangaro daga Yahudiya.
english: As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.

hausa: A ranar Allah ya yi kaca-kaca da Yabin, sarkin Kan’ana a gaban Isra’ila.
english: So God subdued Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel on that day.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yesu yake koyarwa ya ce, “Ku lura da malaman dokoki. Sukan so yin tafiya a manyan riguna, a kuma dinga gaishe su a wuraren kasuwanci.
english: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,

hausa: Da Musa ya miƙa hannunsa a bisa teku, sai Ubangiji ya tura teku baya da iskar gabas mai ƙarfi duk dare, ya maishe shi busasshiyar ƙasa. Ruwa ya rabu,
english: Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and Yahweh caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.

hausa: Kada ka bar Littafin Dokokin nan yă rabu da bakinka, sai dai ka yi ta tunani game da shi dare da rana, don ka lura, ka yi duk abin da aka rubuta a ciki, ta haka ne za ka yi nasara cikin duk abin da za ka yi.
english: This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.

hausa: “Duk da haka, Mafi Ɗaukaka ba ya zama a gidajen da mutane suka gina. Kamar yadda annabi ya faɗi cewa,
english: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,

hausa: Saboda haka fa, maganar Ubangiji gare su za tă zama, Yi ka kuma yi, yi ka kuma yi, mulki akan mulki, mulki a kan mulki; nan kaɗan, can kaɗan, domin su tafi su kuma fāɗi da baya, su ji rauni a kuma kama su da tarko, a kai su zaman bauta.
english: Therefore Yahweh’s word will be to them precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little; that they may go, fall backward, be broken, be snared, and be taken.

hausa: Da yana yafa irin, sai waɗansu suka fāɗi a kan hanya, tsuntsaye suka zo suka cinye su.
english: As he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuke cikin wahala saboda waɗannan abubuwan da suka same ku nan gaba, to, sai ku juyo ga Ubangiji Allahnku, ku kuma yi masa biyayya.
english: When you are in oppression, and all these things have come on you, in the latter days you shall return to Yahweh your God and listen to his voice.

hausa: Da Balak ya ji cewa Bala’am yana zuwa, sai ya fito, ya tarye shi a garin Mowabawa da suke a iyakar Arnon, a ƙarshen yankinsa.
english: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him to the City of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is in the utmost part of the border.

hausa: Ba da kakanninmu ba ne Ubangiji ya yi wannan alkawari, amma da mu ne, da dukanmu waɗanda muke da rai a yau.
english: Yahweh didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.

hausa: Aka kasance da hadayun ƙonawa a yalwace, tare da kitsen hadayun salama da hadayun sha da suke tafe da hadayun ƙonawa. Saboda haka aka sāke kafa hidimar haikalin Ubangiji.
english: Also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings and with the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of Yahweh’s house was set in order.

hausa: An hana mugaye haskensu, hannun da suka ɗaga an karya shi.
english: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.

hausa: Shi kuwa ya tafi wurin mahaifinsa ya ce, “Babana.” Shi kuma ya amsa “I, ɗana, wane ne?”
english: He came to his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am. Who are you, my son?”

hausa: za ka mutu cikin salama. Yadda mutane suka ƙuna wutar jana’iza don girmama kakanninka, sarakunan da suka riga ka, haka za su ƙuna wuta don girmama da kuma makokinka suna cewa, “Kaito, ya maigida!” Ni kaina na yi wannan alkawari, in ji Ubangiji.’ ”
english: You will die in peace; and with the burnings of your fathers, the former kings who were before you, so they will make a burning for you. They will lament you, saying, “Ah Lord!” for I have spoken the word,’ says Yahweh.”

hausa: “In ka yi tsere da mutane a ƙafa suka kuma gajiyar da kai, yaya za ka yi gasa da dawakai? In ka yi tuntuɓe a lafiyayyiyar ƙasa, ƙaƙa za ka yi a kurmin Urdun?
english: “If you have run with the footmen, and they have wearied you, then how can you contend with horses? Though in a land of peace you are secure, yet how will you do in the pride of the Jordan?

hausa: Sa’ad da za ka dawo, ka zo mini da alkyabbar da na bari a wurin Karbus a Toruwas, da kuma naɗaɗɗun littattafaina, tun ba ma fatun nan masu rubutu ba.
english: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.

hausa: Da suka gan shi, sai suka yi masa sujada, amma waɗansu suka yi shakka.
english: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Yeter maza su ne, Yefunne, Fisfa da Ara.
english: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.

hausa: Amma kai, ya Ubangiji, za a ɗaukaka har abada.
english: But you, Yahweh, are on high forever more.

hausa: Lawiyawa za su karanta wa dukan mutanen Isra’ila da babbar murya su ce,
english: With a loud voice, the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel,

hausa: sai ya mayar da wannan amsa wa Esta cewa, “Kada ki yi tsammani cewa don kina a cikin gidan sarki, ke kaɗai cikin dukan Yahudawa za ki tsira.
english: Then Mordecai asked them to return this answer to Esther: “Don’t think to yourself that you will escape in the king’s house any more than all the Jews.

hausa: Hadaya ce ta laifi, ya yi laifi na abin da ya yi marar kyau ga Ubangiji.”
english: It is a trespass offering. He is certainly guilty before Yahweh.”

hausa: Sai shugabannin masu aikin gandu suka fita suka gaya wa mutanen Isra’ila, “Ga abin da Fir’auna ya ce, ‘Ba zan ƙara ba ku tattaka ba.
english: The taskmasters of the people went out with their officers, and they spoke to the people, saying, “This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I will not give you straw.

hausa: Ada ta haifi wa Isuwa, Elifaz. Basemat kuma ta haifa masa Reyuwel.
english: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.

hausa: Sa’ad da Bitrus ya zo Antiyok, na tsawata masa ido da ido don laifinsa a fili yake.
english: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

hausa: kuma in cikin gaskiya da adalci ka rantse, ‘Muddin Ubangiji yana raye,’ to al’ummai za su sami albarka ta wurinsa kuma a cikinsa za su ɗaukaka.”
english: and you will swear, ‘As Yahweh lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness. The nations will bless themselves in him, and they will glory in him.”

hausa: Saboda haka Yehu ya kashe duk waɗanda suka rage na iyalin Ahab a Yezireyel, tare da dukan fadawansa da aminansa da firistocinsa, ba a bar masa kowa ba.
english: So Jehu struck all that remained of Ahab’s house in Jezreel, with all his great men, his familiar friends, and his priests, until he left him no one remaining.

hausa: Ina da waɗansu tumaki da ba na wannan garken ba ne. Dole ne in kawo su su ma. Za su saurari muryata, za su kasance garke guda ɗaya, makiyayi guda kuma.
english: I have other sheep which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

hausa: A ranan nan Isra’ilawa suka yi ta kashe Filistiyawa daga Mikmash har zuwa Aiyalon. Bayan haka gajiya ta kama su sosai saboda yunwa.
english: They struck the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon. The people were very faint;

hausa: (Musa kuwa mutum ne mai tawali’u ƙwarai, mafi tawali’u fiye da kowane mutum a duniya.)
english: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.

hausa: Wannan ce birnin murnanku, birnin nan na tun dā wadda ƙafafunta suka kai ta zama a ƙasashe masu nesa?
english: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her far away to travel?

hausa: Yayinda mutane suke ta yin ƙaura zuwa gabas, sai suka sami fili a Shinar, suka zauna a can.
english: As they traveled east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.

hausa: Hiwiyawa, Arkiyawa, Siniyawa,
english: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

hausa: Aikin gaskiya zai zauna a hamada adalci kuma zai zauna a ƙasa mai taƙi.
english: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness; and righteousness will remain in the fruitful field.

hausa: ɗan Yowanan, ɗan Resa, ɗan Zerubbabel, ɗan Sheyaltiyel, ɗan Neri,
english: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

hausa: Amma da Mowabawa suka isa sansanin Isra’ila, sai Isra’ilawa suka taso suka auka musu har sai da suka gudu. Isra’ilawa kuwa suka kai musu hari, suka karkashe Mowabawa.
english: When they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites, so that they fled before them; and they went forward into the land attacking the Moabites.

hausa: Bet-Feyor, gangaren Fisga da Bet-Yeshimot,
english: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, Beth Jeshimoth,

hausa: Ko da yake kuna ba da godiya da kyau, amma wancan mutumin da yake tare da ku bai ginu ba.
english: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

hausa: Ashe bai kamata ka dogara ga Allahnka ba, amincinka kuma yă zama begenka?
english: Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?

hausa: Bayan ta ba shi ya sha, sai ta ce, “Zan ɗebo wa raƙumanka ruwa su ma, har sai sun gama sha.”
english: When she had finished giving him a drink, she said, “I will also draw for your camels, until they have finished drinking.”

hausa: Na ba da umarni aka kuma yi bincike, aka tarar cewa wannan birni ya daɗe yana yi wa sarakuna tawaye, an yi tashin hankali a birnin.
english: I decreed, and search has been made, and it was found that this city has made insurrection against kings in the past, and that rebellion and revolts have been made in it.

hausa: Na ci gaba a cikin Yahudanci fiye da yawancin Yahudawan da suke tsarana, na kuma yi ƙwazo ƙwarai ga bin al’adun kakannina.
english: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

hausa: Zan aika da mugayen namun jeji a kanku, za su kuwa kashe ’ya’yanku, su hallaka shanunku, su rage yawanku, ku zama kaɗan. Wannan zai sa a rasa mutane a kan hanyoyinku.
english: I will send the wild animals among you, which will rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number. Your roads will become desolate.

hausa: Zuriyar Benyamin bisa ga kabilansu, daga Bela, kabilar Belawa; daga Ashbel, kabilar Ashbelawa; daga Ahiram, kabilar Ahiramawa;
english: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;

hausa: ku kuma kiyaye umarnan Ubangiji da kuma ƙa’idodinsa da nake ba ku a yau don amfaninku ba?
english: to keep Yahweh’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?

hausa: Ya kuma gina shirayi ta sarauta, da ya kira Zauren Adalci, inda zai riƙa yin shari’a, ya kuma rufe dukan daɓensa da itacen al’ul daga ƙasa har sama.
english: He made the porch of the throne where he was to judge, even the porch of judgment; and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor.

hausa: Zan kafa zuriyarsa har abada, kursiyinsa muddin sammai suna nan.
english: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

hausa: farat ɗaya, cikin ƙyaftawar ido, da busan ƙaho na ƙarshe. Gama za a busa ƙaho, za a tā da matattu da jiki irin da ba ya ruɓewa, za a kuma sauya kamanninmu.
