english: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

hausa: Na’omi fa ta koma daga Mowab tare da Rut mutuniyar Mowab, surukarta, suka kai Betlehem a lokacin da ake fara girbin sha’ir.
english: So Naomi returned, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter-in-law, with her, who returned out of the country of Moab. They came to Bethlehem in the beginning of barley harvest.

hausa: A miƙa hadayar da aka yi da wuta, mai daɗin ƙanshi ga Ubangiji, hadaya ta ƙonawa ta bijimai guda sha uku, raguna biyu, da ’yan raguna goma sha huɗu, bana ɗaya-ɗaya, dukansu marasa lahani.
english: You shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect;

hausa: Da ba su gan shi ba, sai suka koma Urushalima nemansa.
english: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.

hausa: Anab, Eshtemo, Anim,
english: Anab, Eshtemoh, Anim,

hausa: Na tuna da dokokinka na tun dā, ya Ubangiji, na kuwa sami ta’aziyya a cikinsu.
english: I remember your ordinances of old, Yahweh, and have comforted myself.

hausa: Ya aikata mugunta a gaban Ubangiji yadda mahaifinsa ya yi. Bai bar aikata zunuban Yerobowam ɗan Nebat, wanda ya sa Isra’ila suka yi ba.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as his fathers had done. He didn’t depart from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin.

hausa: Ka juyo, ya Ubangiji, ka cece ni; ka cece ni saboda madawwamiyar ƙaunarka.
english: Return, Yahweh. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.

hausa: Na yi tambaya na ce, “Mene ne waɗannan suke zuwa yi?” Ya amsa ya ce, “Waɗannan ne ƙahonin da suka watsar da Yahuda har ba wanda yake iya ɗaga kansa, amma maƙeran sun zo don su tsorata su su kuma saukar da ƙahonin ƙasashen nan waɗanda suka ɗaga ƙahoninsu gāba da ƙasar Yahuda don su warwatsa ta.”
english: Then I asked, “What are these coming to do?” He said, “These are the horns which scattered Judah, so that no man lifted up his head; but these have come to terrify them, to cast down the horns of the nations that lifted up their horn against the land of Judah to scatter it.”

hausa: ɗan Metusela, ɗan Enok, ɗan Yared, ɗan Mahalalel, ɗan Kainan,
english: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,

hausa: Mawaƙa sun bi umarnan sarki, a kan abin da za su yi kowace rana.
english: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.

hausa: Na tabbata haka ne, na kuwa san zan wanzu in zauna tare da ku duka, domin ku ci gaba, bangaskiyarku tana sa ku farin ciki,
english: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,

hausa: Firistoci ba su yi tambaya, ‘Ina Ubangiji ba.’ Waɗanda suke amfani da doka ba su san ni ba; shugabanni suka yi mini tawaye. Annabawa suka yi annabci ta wurin Ba’al, suna bin gumakan banza.
english: The priests didn’t say, ‘Where is Yahweh?’ and those who handle the law didn’t know me. The rulers also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal and followed things that do not profit.

hausa: Sai mutanen Isra’ila, firistoci, Lawiyawa da kuma sauran waɗanda suka dawo daga bauta suka yi bikin keɓe gidan Allah, cike da farin ciki.
english: The children of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the rest of the children of the captivity, kept the dedication of this house of God with joy.

hausa: Daga teburin da yake a gaban Yusuf aka riƙa ɗibar rabonsu ana kai musu, amma rabon Benyamin ya yi biyar ɗin na kowannensu. Suka kuwa sha, suka yi murna tare da shi.
english: He sent portions to them from before him, but Benjamin’s portion was five times as much as any of theirs. They drank, and were merry with him.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ku juya ga masu duba, ko ku nemi shawarar bokaye, gama za ku ƙazantu ta wurinsu. Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: “‘Don’t turn to those who are mediums, nor to the wizards. Don’t seek them out, to be defiled by them. I am Yahweh your God.

hausa: Kowace rana, Yesu yakan je haikalin ya yi koyarwa, da kowace yamma kuma, ya je ya kwana a kan tudun da ake kira Dutsen Zaitun.
english: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.

hausa: Yanzu kuna da sarki a matsayin shugaba, ni kuwa na tsufa har da furfura, yarana maza kuma suna tare da ku. Na yi shugabancinku tun ina yaro.
english: Now, behold, the king walks before you. I am old and gray-headed. Behold, my sons are with you. I have walked before you from my youth to this day.

hausa: Sarki Isra’ila ya bi, ya kuma sha ƙarfin dawakan da keken yaƙin, ya kashe Arameyawa da yawa.
english: The king of Israel went out and struck the horses and chariots, and killed the Syrians with a great slaughter.

hausa: Kabilar Kohat su ne, Amramawa da Izharawa da Hebronawa da Uzziyelawa; waɗannan su ne kabilar Kohatawa.
english: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites. These are the families of the Kohathites.

hausa: Ba sa shan wata wahalar da sauran mutane ke sha; ba su da damuwa irin na ’yan adam.
english: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.

hausa: Duk wanda yake sata, sai yă daina sata, dole kuma yă yi aiki, yă yi wani abu mai amfani da hannuwansa, don yă sami abin da zai iya raba da masu bukata.
english: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

hausa: Ku zubar da gunkin maraƙinku, ya Samariya! Fushina yana ƙuna a kansu. Sai yaushe za su rabu da gumaka?
english: Let Samaria throw out his calf idol! My anger burns against them! How long will it be until they are capable of purity?

hausa: sai ya aika a kira Isra’ilawa duka, dattawansu, shugabanninsu, alƙalansu, da manyan ma’aikatansu, ya ce musu, “Na tsufa, shekaruna kuwa sun yi yawa,
english: Joshua called for all Israel, for their elders and for their heads, and for their judges and for their officers, and said to them, “I am old and well advanced in years.

hausa: A ranar Sabuwar Wata zai miƙa ɗan bijimi, ’yan raguna guda shida da kuma rago guda, dukansu marasa lahani.
english: On the day of the new moon it shall be a young bull without defect, six lambs, and a ram. They shall be without defect.

hausa: Ba wanda ya iya tanka masa, daga wannan rana kuwa ba wanda ya sāke yin karambanin yin masa wata tambaya.
english: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.

hausa: In muka ce ba mu da zunubi, muna ruɗin kanmu ne, gaskiya kuwa ba ta cikinmu.
english: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

hausa: Ko kuwa in kun ba da littafin ga wani wanda ba zai iya karantawa ba, kuka kuma ce, “Karanta wannan, muna roƙonka,” zai amsa ya ce, “Ban iya karatu ba.”
english: and the book is delivered to one who is not educated, saying, “Read this, please;” and he says, “I can’t read.”

hausa: Za ku yi haka kuma a rana ta bakwai ga watan domin duk wanda ya yi zunubai ba da gangan ba ko ta wurin rashin sani; saboda haka sai ku yi kafara domin haikalin.
english: So you shall do on the seventh day of the month for everyone who errs, and for him who is simple. So you shall make atonement for the house.

hausa: Sa’ad da magana ta kai Masar, za su razana da jin labari daga Taya.
english: When the report comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre.

hausa: Ku kawo dukan zakka cikin gidan ajiya, don a kasance da abinci a gidana. Ku gwada ni a wannan ku ga, ko ba zan buɗe taskokin sama in zubo muku albarka mai yawa, wadda har ba za ku rasa wurin sa ta ba, in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house, and test me now in this,” says Yahweh of Armies, “if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there will not be enough room for.

hausa: Sai Absalom yă ce masa, “Ga shi, ƙararka daidai ne, tana kuma da gaskiya, sai dai ba wakilin sarkin da zai ji ka.”
english: Absalom said to him, “Behold, your matters are good and right; but there is no man deputized by the king to hear you.”

hausa: Babu wani abu cikin dukan halittar da yake ɓoye daga fuskar Allah. Kowane abu a buɗe yake yana kuma a shimfiɗe a idanun wanda dole mu ba da lissafi a gare shi.
english: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.

hausa: Abin da yake shiga bakin mutum ba ya ƙazantar da shi, sai dai abin da yake fitowa daga bakinsa, shi ne yake ƙazantar da shi.”
english: That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa da dukan Isra’ilawa suka tashi daga Makkeda zuwa Libna, suka kai mata hari.
english: Joshua passed from Makkedah, and all Israel with him, to Libnah, and fought against Libnah.

hausa: A matsayina na mai bin Ubangiji Yesu na tabbata ƙwarai cewa babu abincin da yake marar tsabta don kansa. Amma in wani ya ɗauka wani abu marar tsabta ne, to, a gare shi marar tsabta ne.
english: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

hausa: saƙaƙƙun riguna na sawa don hidima cikin wuri mai tsarki da tsarkakakkun riguna na Haruna firist, da riguna don ’ya’yansa maza lokacin da suke aiki a matsayin firistoci.”
english: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons—to minister in the priest’s office.’”

hausa: “Ka yi tebur da itacen ƙirya, tsawonsa kamu biyu, fāɗinsa kamu ɗaya, tsayinsa kuma kamu ɗaya da rabi.
english: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Its length shall be two cubits, and its width a cubit, and its height one and a half cubits.

hausa: Amma Farisiyawa da malaman dokoki suka yi gunaguni, suna cewa, “Wannan mutum yana karɓan ‘masu zunubi,’ kuma yana ci tare da su.”
english: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”

hausa: Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku; ku bi ƙa’idodina ku kuma kula ku kiyaye dokokina.
english: I am Yahweh your God. Walk in my statutes, keep my ordinances, and do them.

hausa: Dawuda ya tambayi mutanen da suke tsaye kusa da shi ya ce, “Me za a yi wa wanda ya kashe Bafilistin nan, ya kuma cire wannan kunya daga Isra’ila? Wane ne wannan bafilistin marar kaciya da yake kalubalantar rundunar yaƙi na Allah mai rai?”
english: David spoke to the men who stood by him, saying, “What shall be done to the man who kills this Philistine and takes away the reproach from Israel? For who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living God?”

hausa: Amma masu tawali’u za su gāji ƙasar su kuma zauna da cikakkiyar salama.
english: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

hausa: Zan rushe katangar da kuka shafe da farar ƙasa zan baje ta har ƙasa saboda tushenta zai tsaya tsirara. Sa’ad da ta fāɗi, za a hallaka ku a cikinta; kuma za ku san cewa ni ne Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: So I will break down the wall that you have plastered with whitewash, and bring it down to the ground, so that its foundation will be uncovered. It will fall, and you will be consumed in the middle of it. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.

hausa: “Sau uku a shekara za ku yi mini biki.
english: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.

hausa: Na kira bawana, amma bai amsa ba, ko da yake na roƙe shi da bakina.
english: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.

hausa: Da Dawuda ya koma gida don yă sa wa gidansa albarka, sai Mikal ’yar Shawulu ta fito don tă tarye shi, sai ta ce, “Tabbas sarkin Isra’ila ya fiffita kansa yau, ya tuɓe a gaban bayinsa ’yan mata, kamar yadda duk marar kunya yakan yi!”
english: Then David returned to bless his household. Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, “How glorious the king of Israel was today, who uncovered himself today in the eyes of his servants’ maids, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovers himself!”

hausa: Duk mai kunnen ji, yă ji abin da Ruhu yake faɗa wa ikkilisiyoyi. Duk wanda ya ci nasara, zan ba shi ikon ci daga itacen rai, da yake cikin aljannar Allah.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of my God.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka kawo sarakunan nan wurin Yoshuwa, ya kira dukan Isra’ilawa ya ce wa shugabannin rundunoni waɗanda suke tare da shi, “Ku zo nan ku taka wuyan sarakunan nan.” Sai suka zo suka taka wuyansu.
english: When they brought those kings out to Joshua, Joshua called for all the men of Israel, and said to the chiefs of the men of war who went with him, “Come near. Put your feet on the necks of these kings.” They came near, and put their feet on their necks.

hausa: Ubangiji yana da ƙarar da zai kawo a kan Yahuda; zai hukunta Yaƙub bisa ga hanyoyinsa zai sāka masa bisa ga ayyukansa.
english: Yahweh also has a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his deeds he will repay him.

hausa: Saboda haka Sama’ila ya ɗauko ƙahon nan da yake da mai ya shafe Dawuda a gaban ’yan’uwansa. Daga wannan rana kuwa ruhun Ubangiji ya sauko wa Dawuda da iko. Sai Sama’ila ya koma Rama.
english: Then Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the middle of his brothers. Then Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up and went to Ramah.

hausa: Za ka naɗe su kamar mayafi, kamar riga za su sauya. Amma kai ba za ka canja ba, shekarunka kuma ba za su taɓa ƙarewa ba.”
english: You will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years won’t fail.”

hausa: Gama duk wanda ya ɗaukaka kansa, za a ƙasƙantar da shi, duk kuma wanda ya ƙasƙantar da kansa, za a ɗaukaka shi.
english: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

hausa: A ƙarshe, shi da kansa ya tashi ya tafi Rama. Ya bi ta babban rijiyar ruwan Seku. A can ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Ina Sama’ila da Dawuda suke?” Suka ce, “Suna cikin Nayiwot a Rama.”
english: Then he also went to Ramah, and came to the great well that is in Secu: and he asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” One said, “Behold, they are at Naioth in Ramah.”

hausa: Kome ya faru, ku yi zaman da ya cancanci bisharar Kiristi. Ta haka, ko na zo na gan ku, ko ban zo ba, in ji labari cewa kun tsaya da ƙarfi a cikin ruhu ɗaya, kuna fama kamar mutum ɗaya saboda bangaskiyar bishara
english: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

hausa: Na yi tunani a raina na ce, “Duba, na yi girma, na kuma ƙaru da hikima fiye da duk wanda ya taɓa mulki a bisa Urushalima kafin ni; na ɗanɗana hikima mai yawa da kuma ilimi.”
english: I said to myself, “Behold, I have obtained for myself great wisdom above all who were before me in Jerusalem. Yes, my heart has had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.”

hausa: Saboda haka Irmiya ya kira Baruk ɗan Neriya, yayinda Irmiya yake fadar dukan waɗannan maganganun da Ubangiji ya faɗa masa, Baruk ya rubuta su a littafin.
english: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah; and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all Yahweh’s words, which he had spoken to him, on a scroll of a book.

hausa: kwanon zinariya ɗaya mai nauyin shekel goma, cike da turaren hayaƙi;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

hausa: Wannan zancen kaciya ya taso domin waɗansu ’yan’uwan ƙarya sun shiga cikinmu domin su yi leƙe a kan ’yancin da muke da shi a cikin Kiristi Yesu, su kuma mai da mu bayi.
english: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage,

hausa: Tawa ta ƙare, saboda raunin da aka yi mini! Raunina ba mai warkewa ba ne! Duk da haka na ce wa kaina, “Wannan ciwona ne, dole kuma in jure da shi.”
english: Woe is me because of my injury! My wound is serious; but I said, “Truly this is my grief, and I must bear it.”

hausa: Sa’ad da suka yi kusa da Urushalima, suka zo Betfaji da Betani wajen Dutsen Zaitun, sai Yesu ya aiki biyu daga cikin almajiransa,
english: When they came near to Jerusalem, to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples

hausa: Asirce sai ya aiki manzanni wajen Abimelek, yana cewa, “Ga’al ɗan Ebed da ’yan’uwansa sun zo Shekem suna kuma zuga birnin sun tayar maka.
english: He sent messengers to Abimelech craftily, saying, “Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem; and behold, they incite the city against you.

hausa: Na yi farin ciki ƙwarai sa’ad da waɗansu ’yan’uwa suka zo suka yi zance game da yadda kake da aminci ga gaskiyan nan da kuma yadda kake cin gaba cikin gaskiyan nan.
english: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka yi makoki a kan Fir’auna sarkin Masar ka faɗa masa. “ ‘Kai kamar zaki ne a cikin al’ummai; kai kamar dodon ruwa a cikin tekuna kana ɓullowa cikin rafuffukanka, kana gurɓata ruwa da ƙafafunka kana kuma dama rafuffuka.
english: “Son of man, take up a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and tell him, ‘You were likened to a young lion of the nations; yet you are as a monster in the seas. You broke out with your rivers, and troubled the waters with your feet, and fouled their rivers.’”

hausa: Sa’ad da Ishaku ya daɗe a can, sai Abimelek sarkin Filistiyawa ya duba daga taga ya ga Ishaku yana rungumar matarsa Rebeka.
english: When he had been there a long time, Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was caressing Rebekah, his wife.

hausa: ko da yake a ranar kun shuka su, kuka sa su yi girma, da safe kuma sa’ad da kuka shuka su, kuka sa suka yi toho suka yi fure, duk da haka girbin ba zai zama kome ba a ranar cuta da zafin da ba ta da magani.
english: In the day of your planting, you hedge it in. In the morning, you make your seed blossom, but the harvest flees away in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.

hausa: Yesu ya zazzaga dukan garuruwa da ƙauyuka, yana koyarwa a majami’unsu, yana wa’azin labari mai daɗi na mulkin yana kuma warkar da kowace irin cuta da rashin lafiya.
english: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

hausa: Sa’ad da lokaci ya yi da za tă haihu, ashe, tagwaye ’yan maza ne suke cikinta.
english: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.

hausa: amma da adalci zai yi wa masu bukata shari’a, da gaskiya zai yanke shawarwari saboda matalautan duniya. Kamar sanda zai bugi duniya da maganar bakinsa; da numfashin leɓunansa zai yanke mugaye.
english: but he will judge the poor with righteousness, and decide with equity for the humble of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; and with the breath of his lips he will kill the wicked.

hausa: Ta haka aka sa Dokar ta zama jagorarmu zuwa ga Kiristi don mu sami kuɓuta ta wurin bangaskiya.
english: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

hausa: Kada su bar kome daga cikinsa yă kai safe, ko a karye ƙashinsa. Sa’ad da suke Bikin Ƙetarewa, dole su kiyaye dukan ƙa’idodinsa.
english: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone of it. According to all the statute of the Passover they shall keep it.

hausa: Sai ya yi labule mai ruwan shuɗi, da shunayya, da garura, da lilin mai kyau, ya kuma ƙunshi hotunan kerubobin da aka saƙa a cikinsa.
english: He made the veil of blue, purple, crimson, and fine linen, and ornamented it with cherubim.

hausa: Allah ya yi haka domin a tsararraki masu zuwa yă nuna yalwar alherinsa da ya wuce misali, an bayyana alheransa da ya yi mana ta wurin Kiristi Yesu.
english: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Ɗan mutum, za ka shari’anta Ohola da Oholiba? To, sai ka kalubalance su da ayyukansu masu banƙyama,
english: Yahweh said moreover to me: “Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.

hausa: A ranar shari’a, Sarauniyar Kudu za tă tashi tsaye tare da wannan zamani, ta yanke wa wannan zamani hukunci, domin ta zo daga ƙarshen duniya ta saurari hikimar Solomon, ga shi kuwa, shi wanda ya fi Solomon girma, na nan.
english: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.

hausa: Yakan sa in kwanta a makiyaya mai ɗanyar ciyawa, yakan bi da ni kusa da ruwaye marar hayaniya,
english: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

hausa: Tun daga wannan ranar ne mutanen Isra’ila suka shiga gāba da gidan Dawuda har wa yau.
english: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.

hausa: A miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa da ’yan bijimai biyu, rago ɗaya da ’yan raguna bakwai, bana ɗaya-ɗaya don daɗin ƙanshi ga Ubangiji.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi tsawa daga sama; muryar Mafi Ɗaukaka ya yi kāra.
english: Yahweh also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.

hausa: Ya ce mini, “Ka ga wannan, ɗan mutum? Ƙaramin abu ne gidan Yahuda su yi abubuwan banƙyamar da suke yi a nan? Dole ne su cika ƙasar da rikici su kuma ci gaba da tsokane ni in yi fushi? Dube su suna tsokanata!
english: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here? For they have filled the land with violence, and have turned again to provoke me to anger. Behold, they put the branch to their nose.

hausa: Sa’an nan Musa da Isra’ilawa suka rera wannan waƙa ga Ubangiji suka ce, “Zan rera waƙa ga Ubangiji gama an ɗaukaka shi ƙwarai. Doki da mahayinsa ya jefa su cikin teku.
english: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to Yahweh, and said, “I will sing to Yahweh, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.

hausa: “Saboda haka, ’yan’uwana, ina so ku san cewa ta wurin Yesu ana sanar muku da gafarar zunubi.
english: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins;

hausa: Ushirin gaba ɗaya na garken shanu, da na tumaki, kowane kashi ɗaya bisa goma na dabbar da ta wuce ƙarƙashin sandan mai kiwo, za tă zama mai tsarki ga Ubangiji.
english: All the tithe of the herds or the flocks, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to Yahweh.

hausa: Da Sanballat mutumin Horon da Tobiya wakilin ƙasar Ammon suka ji cewa wani ya zo domin yă ƙarfafa zaman lafiyar mutanen Isra’ila, sai suka damu ƙwarai.
english: When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite servant heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly, because a man had come to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.

hausa: Saboda haka, kamar yadda yake a rubuce cewa, “Duk wanda yake taƙama, ya yi taƙama a cikin Ubangiji.”
english: that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”

hausa: Haka ma Horiyawa, a dā sun zauna a Seyir, amma zuriya Isuwa suka kore su. Suka hallaka Horiyawa da suke kafinsu, suka kuma zauna a wurinsu, kamar dai yadda Isra’ila ta yi a ƙasar da Ubangiji ya ba su a matsayin mallaka.)
english: The Horites also lived in Seir in the past, but the children of Esau succeeded them. They destroyed them from before them, and lived in their place, as Israel did to the land of his possession, which Yahweh gave to them.)

hausa: Kuma saboda yalwa madarar da suke bayarwa, zai kasance da madarar da zai sha. Dukan waɗanda suka rage a ƙasar za su sha madara da zuma.
english: It shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter, for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left within the land.

hausa: Ba zai sāke zama mai arziki ba, dukiyarsa ba za tă dawwama ba, abin da ya mallaka kuma ba zai bazu a ƙasar ba.
english: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.

hausa: Kowane mutum gani yake shi mai ƙauna marar ƙarewa ne, amma ina? Da ƙyar ka sami amintacce mutum guda.
english: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?

hausa: Mallakarsu ta yi yawa ƙwarai da ba za su iya zauna tare ba; gama ƙasar da suke zaune a ciki ba za tă ishe su su biyu ba saboda dabbobinsu.
english: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.

hausa: manufofinka da girma suke, ayyukanka kuma masu girma ne. Idanunka suna a buɗe ga dukan hanyoyin mutane; kakan sāka wa kowa gwargwadon halinsa yadda ya dace.
english: great in counsel, and mighty in work; whose eyes are open to all the ways of the children of men, to give everyone according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings;

hausa: Suka yi wa bagaden raga, tagulla kuma don yă sa shi a tsakiya.
english: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.

hausa: Wannan Haruna da Musa ne, waɗanda Ubangiji ya yi musu magana ya ce, “Ku fitar da Isra’ilawa daga Masar ɓangare-ɓangare.”
english: These are that Aaron and Moses to whom Yahweh said, “Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies.”

hausa: Ba mu da ’yancin ci da sha ne?
english: Have we no right to eat and to drink?

hausa: Amma ni ban ɗauki raina a bakin kome ba, in dai zan iya gama tserena in kuma kammala aikin da Ubangiji Yesu ya ba ni aikin shaida bisharar alherin Allah.
english: But these things don’t count; nor do I hold my life dear to myself, so that I may finish my race with joy, and the ministry which I received from the Lord Jesus, to fully testify to the Good News of the grace of God.

hausa: Saboda haka Musa ya ƙidaya su duka, kamar yadda maganar Ubangiji ta umarta.
english: Moses counted them according to Yahweh’s word, as he was commanded.

hausa: Duk mai wannan bege a cikinsa yakan tsarkake kansa, kamar yadda shi Kiristi yake da tsabta.
english: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

hausa: Yanzu me kake jira? Ka tashi, a yi maka baftisma, a wanke zunubanka, ta wurin kira bisa ga sunansa.’
english: Now why do you wait? Arise, be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.’

hausa: In an sami dabbar, ko saniya, ko jaki, ko tunkiya da ya sata da rai a hannunsa, dole ɓarawon yă biya taran da za a ci shi, sau biyu na kowane ɗaya.
english: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.

hausa: Mutumin da ba shi da Ruhu, ba ya yarda da abubuwan da suka fita daga Ruhun Allah, domin wauta ce a gare shi. Ba kuwa zai fahimce su ba, domin ta Ruhu ne ake fahimtarsu.
english: Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him; and he can’t know them, because they are spiritually discerned.

hausa: Amma ga mutanen da aka washe aka kuma kwashe ganima, an yi wa dukansu tarko a cikin rammuka ko kuma an ɓoye su cikin kurkuku. Sun zama ganima, babu wani da zai kuɓutar da su; an mai da su ganima, ba wanda zai ce, “Mayar da su.”
english: But this is a robbed and plundered people. All of them are snared in holes, and they are hidden in prisons. They have become captives, and no one delivers, and a plunder, and no one says, ‘Restore them!’

hausa: Yaya zan iya la’anta waɗanda Allah bai la’anta ba? Yaya zan tsine waɗanda Ubangiji bai tsine ba?
english: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom Yahweh has not defied?

hausa: Haka zai kasance a ƙarshen zamani. Mala’iku za su zo su ware masu mugunta daga masu adalci
english: So it will be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,

hausa: Ben-Abinadab, shi ne a Nafot Dor (ya auri Tafat ’yar Solomon);
english: Ben Abinadab, in all the height of Dor (he had Taphath, Solomon’s daughter, as wife);

hausa: Allah ne ya yi mu domin wannan, ya kuma ba mu Ruhu a matsayin abin ajiya, yana kuma tabbatar da abin da zai zo nan gaba.
english: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

hausa: Mutum mai muguwar zuciya ba ya cin gaba; duk wanda yake da harshen ruɗu kan shiga wahala.
english: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.

hausa: Kai da ’ya’yanka maza da bayinka za ku riƙa yin masa noma, ku kuma kawo hatsin, don jikan maigidanka yă sami abinci. Mefiboshet kuma, jikan maigidanka, zai riƙa ci a teburina.” (Ziba kuwa yana da ’ya’ya maza goma sha biyar da kuma bayi ashirin.)
english: Till the land for him—you, your sons, and your servants. Bring in the harvest, that your master’s son may have bread to eat; but Mephibosheth your master’s son will always eat bread at my table.” Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

hausa: Zai yanka ɗan ragon a tsattsarkan wuri inda ake yanka hadaya don zunubi da hadaya ta ƙonawa. Gama yadda hadaya ta zunubi ta firist ne, haka hadaya domin laifi ma, hadaya ce mafi tsarki.
english: He shall kill the male lamb in the place where they kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the place of the sanctuary; for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering. It is most holy.

hausa: Amma Isra’ilawa suka ce wa Ubangiji, “Mu dai mun yi zunubi. Ka yi da mu abin da ka ga dama, amma muna roƙonka ka cece mu a yanzu.”
english: The children of Israel said to Yahweh, “We have sinned! Do to us whatever seems good to you; only deliver us, please, today.”

hausa: Da yawa za su zo a cikin sunana, suna cewa, ‘Ni ne shi.’ Za su kuwa ruɗi mutane da yawa.
english: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and will lead many astray.

hausa: Ya yi girma kamar dashe marar ƙarfi, kamar saiwa kuma daga ƙeƙasasshiyar ƙasa. Ba shi da kyan gani ko wani makamin da zai ja hankalinmu, babu wani abin da yake da shi da zai sa mu yi sha’awarsa.
english: For he grew up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of dry ground. He has no good looks or majesty. When we see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.

hausa: Da suka isa wurin Yesu, sai suka roƙe shi sosai, suka ce, “Wannan mutum, ai, ya dace a yi masa haka,
english: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,

hausa: Bari Ubangiji yă sa kowannenku ta sami hutu a gidan wani miji.” Sa’an nan ta sumbace su suka kuma yi kuka da ƙarfi
english: May Yahweh grant you that you may find rest, each of you in the house of her husband.” Then she kissed them, and they lifted up their voices, and wept.

hausa: Nan take, ya bi ta kamar saniyar da za a kai mayanka, kamar wawa zuwa wurin da za a ba shi horo
english: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Ubangiji yă sawwaƙe, in yi sha! Ba jinin mutanen da suka tafi a bakin ransu ba ne?” Dawuda kuwa bai sha ruwan ba. Irin abubuwan da jarumawa ukun nan suka yi ke nan.
english: He said, “Be it far from me, Yahweh, that I should do this! Isn’t this the blood of the men who risked their lives to go?” Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.

hausa: Sai Musa ya yi wa Isra’ilawa magana, suka kuwa kai mai saɓon waje da sansani, suka jajjefi shi da duwatsu. Isra’ilawa suka yi yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: ’Yan’uwan matalauci sukan guje shi, balle abokansa, su ma za su guje shi. Ko da yake matalaucin yana binsu yana roƙo, ba zai sam su ba.
english: All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.

hausa: Ka ɗauke abokaina na kurkusa daga gare ni ka sa na zama abin ƙyama a gare su. An kange ni, ba yadda zan kuɓuta
english: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.

hausa: In kuwa za ku ɗaukaka kanku a kaina kuna ɗauka wahalar da nake sha domin na yi laifi ne,
english: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,

hausa: in na yi mugunta ga wanda yake zaman lafiya da ni ko kuwa ba da wani dalilin cuci abokin gābana,
english: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),

hausa: Muna ƙauna, domin ya ƙaunace mu da farko.
english: We love him, because he first loved us.

hausa: Amma aka sa hankulansu suka dushe, gama har yă zuwa yau akwai lulluɓin nan a duk sa’ad da ake karatun tsohon alkawari. Ba a kawar da shi ba, sai a cikin Kiristi ne kaɗai ake kawar da shi.
english: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.

hausa: “Saboda haka na bashe ta ga kwartayenta, Assuriyawa, waɗanda ta yi ta kai da kawowa a cikinsu.
english: “Therefore I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians on whom she doted.

hausa: Suka dai yi ƙoƙari su tsoratar da mu, suna cewa, “Hannuwansu za su rasa ƙarfin yin aiki, ba kuwa za su ƙare aikin ba.” Amma na yi addu’a na ce, “Yanzu, ya Allah, ka ƙarfafa hannuwana.”
english: For they all would have made us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened from the work, that it not be done.” But now, strengthen my hands.

hausa: Kashegari, wato, bayan Ranar Shirye-shirye, sai manyan firistoci da Farisiyawa, suka je wurin Bilatus.
english: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,

hausa: Yanzu mun gane cewa ka san kome ba sai wani ya tambaye ka ba. Wannan ya sa muka gaskata ka fito daga Allah.”
english: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”

hausa: Mutum ɗaya daga kowace kabila wanda yake shugaban danginsa, zai taimake ku.
english: With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.

hausa: Duk waɗanda suke ƙarƙashin bauta, ya kamata su ɗauki iyayengijinsu a kan sun cancanci girmamawa matuƙa, don kada a ɓata sunan Allah da kuma koyarwarmu.
english: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.

hausa: gama sun cinye Yaƙub suka lalatar da ƙasar zamansa.
english: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce wa almajiransa, “Saboda haka, ina faɗa muku, kada ku damu game da rayuwarku, abin da za ku ci, ko kuma game da jikinku, abin da za ku yafa.
english: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “I, haka yake yadda ka faɗa. Sai dai ina gaya muku duka, nan gaba, za ku ga Ɗan Mutum zaune a hannun dama na Mai Iko, yana kuma zuwa a kan gizagizan sama.”
english: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”

hausa: Kada a iske yisti a cikin mallakarku a dukan ƙasarku har kwana bakwai. Kada ku bar wani nama na hadayar da kuka yi a yammancin ranar farko, yă kwana har safe.
english: No yeast shall be seen with you in all your borders seven days; neither shall any of the meat, which you sacrifice the first day at evening, remain all night until the morning.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, ka yi annabci a kan Gog ka ce, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ina gāba da kai, ya Gog, babban sarkin Meshek da Tubal.
english: “You, son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against you, Gog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal.

hausa: ‘Tun ran da na fitar da mutanena Isra’ila daga Masar, ban zaɓi wani birni a cikin wata kabilar Isra’ila a gina haikali domin Sunana yă kasance a can ba, amma na zaɓi Dawuda yă yi mulkin mutanena Isra’ila.’
english: ‘Since the day that I brought my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house, that my name might be there; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.’

hausa: Suka tashi daga Fi Hahirot, suka ratsa cikin teku zuwa hamada, bayan sun yi tafiya kwana uku a cikin Hamadan Etam, sai suka yi sansani a Mara.
english: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.

hausa: A can gabana kuwa ga ɗaukakar Allah na Isra’ila, kamar a wahayin da na gani a fili.
english: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the appearance that I saw in the plain.

hausa: Wanda yake lura da sashen don wata na biyu shi ne Dodai mutumin Ahowa; Miklot ne shugaban sashensa. Akwai mutane 24,000 a sashensa.
english: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite and his division, and Mikloth the ruler; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

hausa: Ina kogon zakokin nan yake yanzu, inda suka ciyar da ’ya’yansu, inda zaki da zakanya sukan shiga, da ’ya’yansu, ba mai damunsu
english: Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion and the lioness walked with the lion’s cubs, and no one made them afraid?

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi daidai yadda ya yi wa zuriyar Isuwa waɗanda suka zauna a ƙasar Seyir, sa’ad da ya hallaka Horiyawa a gabansu. Su kuma suka kore su, suka zauna a wurinsu. Har wa yau, zuriyar Isuwa ne suke zama a can.
english: as he did for the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and they succeeded them, and lived in their place even to this day.

hausa: Lot ya ɗaga idanunsa sama ya dubi kwarin Urdun, sai ya ga kwarin yana da ciyawa mai kyau ƙwarai sai ka ce lambun Ubangiji, kamar ƙasar Masar, wajajen Zowar. (Wannan fa kafin Ubangiji yă hallaka Sodom da Gomorra.)
english: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before Yahweh destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of Yahweh, like the land of Egypt, as you go to Zoar.

hausa: Sa’an nan Rebeka ta ɗauki riguna mafi kyau na Isuwa babban ɗanta, waɗanda take da su a gida ta sa wa ƙaramin ɗanta Yaƙub.
english: Rebekah took the good clothes of Esau, her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob, her younger son.

hausa: Duk mutumin Isra’ilan da ya yanka sa, ɗan rago ko akuya a sansani ko waje da shi
english: Whatever man there is of the house of Israel who kills a bull, or lamb, or goat in the camp, or who kills it outside the camp,

hausa: In wani yana da arziki, ya kuma ga ɗan’uwansa cikin rashi, bai kuwa taimake shi ba, anya, ƙaunar Allah tana a cikinsa kuwa?
english: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?

hausa: Wane ne wannan mai zuwa daga Edom, daga Bozra, saye da jajjayen rigunarsa? Wane ne wannan, sanye cikin daraja, tafe cikin girmar ƙarfinsa? “Ni ne, mai magana cikin adalci, mai ikon ceto.”
english: Who is this who comes from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? Who is this who is glorious in his clothing, marching in the greatness of his strength? “It is I who speak in righteousness, mighty to save.”

hausa: babu tsiro a duniya kuma ganyaye ba su tsira a busasshiyar ƙasa ko ba, gama Ubangiji Allah bai aiko da ruwan sama a kan duniya ba tukuna, babu kuma wani mutumin da zai nome ƙasar,
english: No plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for Yahweh God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,

hausa: Elishama, Eliyada da Elifelet, su tara ne duka.
english: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Shaiɗan, “To, shi ke nan, duk abin da yake da shi yana hannunka, amma kada ka taɓa shi, shi kansa.”
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Behold, he is in your hand. Only spare his life.”

hausa: Game da annabawa kuwa, Zuciyata ta karai; dukan ƙasusuwana suna kaɗuwa. Na zama kamar wanda ya bugu, kamar mutumin da ruwan inabi ya sha kansa, saboda Ubangiji da kuma maganarsa mai tsarki.
english: Concerning the prophets: My heart within me is broken. All my bones shake. I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine has overcome, because of Yahweh, and because of his holy words.

hausa: Ya kuma karɓi alamar kaciya, hatimin adalcin da yake da shi ta wurin bangaskiya tun yana marar kaciya. Saboda haka fa, ya zama mahaifin dukan waɗanda suka gaskata domin su ma a lasafta su masu adalci ne, ba tare da an yi musu kaciya ba.
english: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.

hausa: Kaburburansu za su ci gaba da zama gidajensu har abada, Can za su kasance har zamanai marasa ƙarewa, ko da yake sun ba wa filaye sunayen kansu.
english: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.

hausa: Ka daure ni, ya kuma zama shaida; yadda na rame sai ƙasusuwa, wannan ya sa ake gani kamar don ni mai zunubi ne shi ya sa.
english: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.

hausa: Kada ka ji tsoro, ya Yaƙub bawana, gama ina tare da kai,” in ji Ubangiji. “Ko da na hallaka dukan al’ummai sarai inda na kora ka, ba zan hallaka ka sarai ba. Zan hore ka amma da adalci kaɗai; ba zan bar ka ba hukunci ba.”
english: Don’t be afraid, O Jacob my servant,” says Yahweh, “for I am with you; for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have driven you, but I will not make a full end of you, but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.”

hausa: Dukan mutanen Isra’ila suka tattaru a gaban Sarki Solomon a lokacin biki, a watan Etanim, wato, wata na bakwai.
english: All the men of Israel assembled themselves to King Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.

hausa: Uzza, Faseya, Besai,
english: the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,

hausa: to, ku ji maganar Ubangiji, ya raguwar Yahuda. Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa, ‘In kun ƙudura ku tafi Masar kuka kuma tafi kun zauna a can,
english: now therefore hear Yahweh’s word, O remnant of Judah! Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘If you indeed set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to live there,

hausa: An yi katangar da yasfa, birnin kuma da zinariya zalla, yana kuma ƙyalli kamar madubi.
english: The construction of its wall was jasper. The city was pure gold, like pure glass.

hausa: Nan da nan bakinsa ya buɗe harshensa kuma ya saku, sai ya fara magana yana yabon Allah.
english: His mouth was opened immediately and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.

hausa: Za a ba da shi ga Al’ummai, za su yi masa ba’a, su zage shi, su tofa masa miyau,
english: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.

hausa: Suka yi sallama, suna tambaya ko Siman wanda aka sani da suna Bitrus yana zama a can.
english: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.

hausa: Amma kurciyar ba tă sami inda za tă sa ƙafafunta ba gama akwai ruwa a dukan doron ƙasa, saboda haka ta komo wurin Nuhu a jirgi. Ya miƙa hannunsa ya ɗauko kurciyar ya shigar da ita wurinsa a cikin jirgi.
english: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned into the ship to him, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship.

hausa: Zai sa hadari yă danne ni yă ƙara mini ciwona ba dalili.
english: For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause.

hausa: In akwai matalauci a cikin ’yan’uwanku, a duk wani daga cikin biranen da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku, kada ku taurara zuciya, ko ku ƙi saki hannu ga ɗan’uwanku matalauci.
english: If a poor man, one of your brothers, is with you within any of your gates in your land which Yahweh your God gives you, you shall not harden your heart, nor shut your hand from your poor brother;

hausa: Za ku raba ta daidai a cikinsu. Gama na ɗaga hannu na rantse zan ba da ita ga kakanninku, wannan ƙasa za tă zama gādonku.
english: You shall inherit it, one as well as another; for I swore to give it to your fathers. This land will fall to you for inheritance.

hausa: In kuka karya alkawarin Ubangiji Allahnku wanda ya umarce ku, in kuka je kuka bauta wa waɗansu alloli, kuka rusuna musu, fushin Ubangiji zai sauko a kanku, za ku kuwa hallaka da sauri daga ƙasan nan mai kyau da ya ba ku.”
english: when you disobey the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he commanded you, and go and serve other gods, and bow down yourselves to them. Then Yahweh’s anger will be kindled against you, and you will perish quickly from off the good land which he has given to you.”

hausa: Hanan ɗan Ma’aka, Yoshafat mutumin Mit,
english: Hanan the son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,

hausa: Gama Kiristi bai shiga wani wuri tsattsarka da mutum ya yi ba, wanda yake hoto ne kawai na gaskataccen, a’a sama kanta ya shiga, domin yă bayyana a gaban zatin Allah a yanzu saboda mu.
english: For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;

hausa: “ ‘Ku yi mini bagaden ƙasa, ku kuma miƙa mini hadaya ta ƙonawa da hadaya ta salama, za ku hadayar da tumakinku da awakinku da shanu. Duk inda na sa a girmama sunana, zan zo wurinku, in sa muku albarka.
english: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you.

hausa: Amma ba su saurare ni ba don sun kangare kamar kakanninsu, waɗanda ba su amince da Ubangiji Allahnsu ba.
english: Notwithstanding, they would not listen, but hardened their neck like the neck of their fathers who didn’t believe in Yahweh their God.

hausa: Yawan waɗanda suka ci kuwa, maza dubu huɗu ne, ban da mata da yara.
english: Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.

hausa: Firistocin da suke Lawiyawa, tabbatacce dukan kabilar Lawi, ba za su sami rabo ko gādo tare da Isra’ila ba. Za su yi rayuwa a kan hadayun da aka kawo wa Ubangiji da wuta ne, gama wannan ne gādonsu.
english: The priests and the Levites—all the tribe of Levi—shall have no portion nor inheritance with Israel. They shall eat the offerings of Yahweh made by fire and his portion.

hausa: Bayan ya faɗa haka, sai ya ƙara ce musu, “Abokinmu Lazarus ya yi barci, amma za ni in tashe shi.”
english: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”

hausa: Kakan nuna ƙauna ga dubbai amma kakan hukunta ’ya’ya saboda laifin ubanninsu a bayansu. Ya mai girma da kuma Allah mai iko, wanda sunansa ne Ubangiji Maɗaukaki,
english: You show loving kindness to thousands, and repay the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them. The great, the mighty God, Yahweh of Armies is your name:

hausa: “Waɗannan su ne ƙa’idodi domin mutumin da yake da cuta a lokacin tsabtaccewarsa, sa’ad da aka kawo shi ga firist.
english: “This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought to the priest,

hausa: Dawuda ya sa aka kira dukan shugabannin Isra’ila su taru a Urushalima, shugabannin kabilu, manyan hafsoshin ɓangarorin hidimar sarki, manyan hafsoshin dubu-dubu da manyan hafsoshin ɗari-ɗari, da kuma shugabanni masu lura da dukan mallaka da dabbobin da suke na sarki da kuma ’ya’yansa maza, tare da fadawa, jarumawa da kuma dukan mayaƙa masu kwarjini.
english: David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, the captains of the companies who served the king by division, the captains of thousands, the captains of hundreds, and the rulers over all the substance and possessions of the king and of his sons, with the officers and the mighty men, even all the mighty men of valor, to Jerusalem.

hausa: Mazuga yana zuga da ƙarfi don yă ƙone dalma da wuta, amma tacewa yana tafiya a banza; ba a fitar da mugaye.
english: The bellows blow fiercely. The lead is consumed in the fire. In vain they go on refining, for the wicked are not plucked away.

hausa: Me yake nufi da ya ce, ‘Za ku neme ni, amma ba za ku same ni ba,’ da kuma ‘Inda nake, ba za ku iya zuwa ba’?”
english: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me;’ and ‘Where I am, you can’t come’?”

hausa: “Ka ɗauki abin ɗamara da ka sayo, wanda ka ɗaura, ka tafi yanzu zuwa Fera ka ɓoye shi a cikin kogon dutse.”
english: “Take the belt that you have bought, which is on your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a cleft of the rock.”

hausa: Ya ku zuriyar Ibrahim bawansa, Ya ku ’ya’yan Yaƙub, zaɓaɓɓensa.
english: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

hausa: Ya ce, “Saurara, Sarki Yehoshafat da dukan waɗanda suke zama a Yahuda da Urushalima! Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce muku, ‘Kada ku ji tsoro ko ku fid da zuciya saboda wannan babbar runduna. Gama yaƙin ba naku ba ne, amma na Allah.
english: and he said, “Listen, all Judah, and you inhabitants of Jerusalem, and you, King Jehoshaphat. Yahweh says to you, ‘Don’t be afraid, and don’t be dismayed because of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God’s.

hausa: Solomon ya ƙaunaci Ubangiji ta wurin yin tafiya bisa ga farillan mahaifinsa Dawuda, sai dai ya miƙa hadayu, ya kuma ƙone turare a wuraren nan na bisa tuddai.
english: Solomon loved Yahweh, walking in the statutes of David his father, except that he sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

hausa: Tsibirai sun gan shi suka kuma ji tsoro; iyakokin duniya sun yi rawar jiki. Suka kusato suka kuma zo gaba;
english: The islands have seen, and fear. The ends of the earth tremble. They approach, and come.

hausa: Yanzu birnin ya zama babu kowa a ciki, birnin da a dā yake cike da mutane! Yanzu birnin ya zama kamar gwauruwa, wadda a dā babba ce ita a cikin ƙasashe! Ita da take sarauniya a cikin larduna yanzu ta zama baiwa.
english: How the city sits solitary, that was full of people! She has become as a widow, who was great among the nations! She who was a princess among the provinces has become a slave!

hausa: A bisa waɗannan za su shimfiɗa jan zane, su rufe su da fatun shanun teku, su kuma zura masa sandunansa.
english: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

hausa: “A ranan nan zan sa shugabannin Yahuda su zama kamar tukunyar wuta a tarin itacen wuta; kamar harshen wuta a dammunan hatsi. Za su ƙone dukan mutanen da suke kewaye da su hagu da dama, amma babu abin da zai taɓa mutanen Urushalima.
english: In that day I will make the chieftains of Judah like a pan of fire among wood, and like a flaming torch among sheaves. They will devour all the surrounding peoples on the right hand and on the left; and Jerusalem will yet again dwell in their own place, even in Jerusalem.

hausa: Sai annabi Haggai ya ce, “ ‘Haka yake da wannan mutane da kuma wannan al’umma a gabana,’ in ji Ubangiji. ‘Duk abin da suke yi da kuma dukan abin da suke miƙawa ƙazantattu ne.
english: Then Haggai answered, “‘So is this people, and so is this nation before me,’ says Yahweh; ‘and so is every work of their hands. That which they offer there is unclean.

hausa: Kada ku yi kamar yadda muke yi a nan yau, yadda kowa yake yin abin da ya ga dama.
english: You shall not do all the things that we do here today, every man whatever is right in his own eyes;

hausa: Amma ga Isra’ilawan da suke zama a garuruwan Yahuda kuwa, Rehobowam ya ci gaba da mulki a kansu.
english: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

hausa: Suka kuma ba da kuɗi ga kafintoci da magina don su sayi sassaƙaƙƙun duwatsu, da katakai don yin tsaiko da tankar ginin da sarakunan Yahuda suka bari yă fāɗi ya zama kango.
english: They gave it to the carpenters and to the builders to buy cut stone and timber for couplings, and to make beams for the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.

hausa: Da ’yan matan suka komo wurin Reyuwel mahaifinsu, sai ya tambaye su ya ce, “Yaya kuka dawo da wuri yau?”
english: When they came to Reuel, their father, he said, “How is it that you have returned so early today?”

hausa: A can kuma za ku yi farin ciki a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku, ku da ’ya’yanku maza da mata, da bayinku maza da mata, da kuma Lawiyawa daga biranenku, waɗanda ba a ba su rabo ba, ba su kuma da gādo na kansu.
english: You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God—you, and your sons, your daughters, your male servants, your female servants, and the Levite who is within your gates, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you.

hausa: Dabbar da na gani ta yi kamar damisa, amma tana da ƙafafu kamar na beyar, bakinta kuma ya yi kamar na zaki. Macijin nan ya ba wa dabbar ƙarfinsa da gadon sarautarsa da kuma ikonsa mai girma.
english: The beast which I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.

hausa: Sai Bala’am ya furta abin da Allah ya faɗa masa ya ce, “Balak ya kawo ni daga Aram, sarkin Mowab ya kawo ni daga gabashin duwatsu. Ya ce, ‘Zo, ka la’anta mini Yaƙub; zo, ka tsine Isra’ila.’
english: He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East. Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, defy Israel.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yehoshafat da jama’arsa suka je kwasar ganima, sai suka sami shanu masu yawan gaske, da kayayyaki, da tufafi, da abubuwa masu daraja, waɗanda suka yi ta kwasa har suka gaji. Kwana uku suka yi suna kwasar ganimar saboda yawanta.
english: When Jehoshaphat and his people came to take their plunder, they found among them in abundance both riches and dead bodies with precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away. They took plunder for three days, it was so much.

hausa: Kun zo ga Yesu, mai yin sulhu na sabon alkawari, da kuma ga jinin da aka yayyafa wanda yake magana mafi kyau fiye da jinin Habila.
english: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.

hausa: Sun haura hanyar zuwa Luhit, suna kuka mai zafi yayinda suke tafiya; a hanyar da ta gangara zuwa Horonayim suna kuka a kan hallakar da aka ji.
english: For they will go up by the ascent of Luhith with continual weeping. For at the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distress of the cry of destruction.

hausa: Za a sāke kafa hukunci a kan adalci, kuma dukan masu adalci a zuciya za su bi shi.
english: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.

hausa: Bari masu ce mini, “Allah yă ƙara!” Su juye baya saboda kunyansu.
english: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”

hausa: An yi duhu ƙwarai, har ba ka iya gani, shi ya sa ambaliyar ruwa ta rufe ka.
english: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.

hausa: Sai sarki ya kira dukan dattawan Yahuda da Urushalima.
english: The king sent, and they gathered to him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.

hausa: Sa’ad da ba su da shi, sai su tattara shi; sa’ad da ka buɗe hannunka, sukan ƙoshi da abubuwa masu kyau.
english: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka yi shaidar suka kuma yi shelar maganar Ubangiji, sai Bitrus da Yohanna suka koma Urushalima, suna wa’azin bishara a ƙauyukan Samariya masu yawa.
english: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.

hausa: kamar gaggafar da take yawo a kan sheƙarta tana rufe ’ya’yanta, ta buɗe fikafikanta don tă kwashe su tă ɗauke su a kafaɗunta.
english: As an eagle that stirs up her nest, that flutters over her young, he spread abroad his wings, he took them, he bore them on his feathers.

hausa: Tamar, surukar Yahuda, ta haifa masa Ferez da Zera. Yahuda ya haifi ’ya’ya maza biyar ne.
english: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

hausa: Sa’an nan Shawulu ya aika saƙo wurin Yesse cewa, “Ka bar Dawuda yă yi mini hidima domin ina jin daɗinsa ƙwarai.”
english: Saul sent to Jesse, saying, “Please let David stand before me, for he has found favor in my sight.”

hausa: Bayan Dawuda ya gama miƙa hadayu na ƙonawa da hadayu na salama, sai ya albarkaci mutane a cikin sunan Ubangiji.
english: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in Yahweh’s name.

hausa: Ubangiji Allahnmu ne da kansa ya fitar da iyayenmu daga Masar, daga ƙasar bauta, ya yi manyan abubuwan al’ajabi, a idanunmu. Ya kiyaye mu cikin dukan hanyar da muka bi, da cikin ƙasashen da muka ratsa;
english: for it is Yahweh our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who did those great signs in our sight, and preserved us in all the way in which we went, and among all the peoples through the middle of whom we passed.

hausa: Zai rushe kucu-kucu kamar tukunyar yumɓu, ya ragargaje ƙaf har cikin gutsattsarinsa ba za a sami ko ɗan katanga don ɗiba garwashin wuta ko a ɗiba ruwa daga tanki ba.”
english: He will break it as a potter’s vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing, so that there won’t be found among the broken pieces a piece good enough to take fire from the hearth, or to dip up water out of the cistern.”

hausa: Duba, duhu ya rufe duniya duhu mai kauri kuma yana bisa mutane, amma Ubangiji ya taso a kanki ɗaukakarsa kuma ya bayyana a bisanki.
english: For behold, darkness will cover the earth, and thick darkness the peoples; but Yahweh will arise on you, and his glory shall be seen on you.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Mene ne sunanka?” Sai ya amsa ya ce, “Sunana Lejiyon, wato, ‘Tuli,’ domin muna da yawa.”
english: He asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”

hausa: Firistoci, da Lawiyawa, da matsaran ƙofofi, da mawaƙa, da ma’aikatan haikali tare da waɗansu mutane da kuma sauran mutanen Isra’ila, suka zauna a garuruwansu. Da wata na bakwai ya zo, Isra’ilawa kuwa sun riga sun zauna a garuruwansu,
english: So the priests, the Levites, the gatekeepers, the singers, some of the people, the temple servants, and all Israel lived in their cities. When the seventh month had come, the children of Israel were in their cities.

hausa: Matsaran kuma kowa da makaminsa a hannu, suka tsaya kewaye da sarki, kusa da bagade da kuma haikali, daga gefen kudu zuwa gefen arewa na haikalin.
english: The guard stood, every man with his weapons in his hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, along by the altar and the house, around the king.

hausa: ’Ya’yan itacena sun fi zinariya zalla; amfanin gonar da nake bayar ya fi azurfa mafi kyau.
english: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.

hausa: Da suka rera waƙa, sai suka fita, suka tafi Dutsen Zaitun.
english: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

hausa: Ku ji wannan hayaniya daga birni, ku ji surutu daga haikali! Amon Ubangiji ne yana sāka wa abokan gābansa abin da ya dace da su.
english: A voice of tumult from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of Yahweh that repays his enemies what they deserve.

hausa: Ba zai karɓi duk wata biya ba; zai ƙi cin hanci, kome yawansu.
english: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.

hausa: Da hucin numfashin hancinka ruwaye suka tattaru. Ruwaye masu kwararowa, suka tsaya kamar bango; ruwaye na zurfafa suka daskare a tsakiyar teku.
english: With the blast of your nostrils, the waters were piled up. The floods stood upright as a heap. The deeps were congealed in the heart of the sea.

hausa: Amma in Ubangiji ya yarda zan zo wurinku ba da daɗewa ba. Sa’an nan zan bincike ko masu wannan yawan ɗagan kan nan suna da wani iko.
english: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.

hausa: Duk mutumin da bai tsaya a kan koyarwar Kiristi ba, amma ya yi ƙari a kanta, mutumin nan ba shi da Allah. Amma wanda ya tsaya a kan koyarwar Kiristi, yana da Uban da kuma Ɗan.
english: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

hausa: “Da gaske ne, ya Ubangiji, cewa sarakunan Assuriya sun hallakar da waɗannan al’ummai da ƙasashensu.
english: Truly, Yahweh, the kings of Assyria have laid waste the nations and their lands,

hausa: Kabilar Gershonawa za su yi sansani ta fuskar yamma, a bayan tabanakul.
english: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.

hausa: Yayinda suke kuka a kanki kuwa, za su yi makoki dominki suna cewa, “Wa ya taɓa yin shiru kamar Taya, kewaye da teku?”
english: In their wailing they will take up a lamentation for you, and lament over you, saying, ‘Who is there like Tyre, like her who is brought to silence in the middle of the sea?’

hausa: Dole a bar wutar tă ci gaba da ci a bisa bagade; kada tă mutu.
english: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.

hausa: Da ya ci gaba daga wurin, sai ya shiga majami’arsu,
english: He departed from there and went into their synagogue.

hausa: Suka yi shuka a gonaki suka dasa inabi suka kuma girbe amfani gona;
english: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.

hausa: Dare da rana muna addu’a da himma domin mu sāke ganinku, mu kuma ba ku abin da kuka rasa a bangaskiyarku.
english: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

hausa: Fir’auna ya aiki mutane su bincika, sai suka tarar babu dabba guda ta Isra’ilawan da ta mutu. Duk da haka zuciyar Fir’auna ta taurare, bai kuwa bar mutanen su tafi ba.
english: Pharaoh sent, and, behold, there was not so much as one of the livestock of the Israelites dead. But the heart of Pharaoh was stubborn, and he didn’t let the people go.

hausa: Waɗansu ’yan’uwansu Kohatawa ne suke lura da shiryawa burodin da ake kaiwa a tebur a kowane Asabbaci.
english: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.

hausa: Efafaras naku, mai hidimar Kiristi Yesu, yana gaisuwa. Kullum yana addu’a dominku sosai, don ku san cikakken abin da Allah yake so ku yi don kuma ku yi shi cikakke.
english: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

hausa: Hittiyawa, Ferizziyawa, Refahiyawa,
english: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,

hausa: Tun daga wannan rana Shawulu ya zaunar da Dawuda tare da shi, bai bar shi ya koma gidan mahaifinsa ba.
english: Saul took him that day, and wouldn’t let him go home to his father’s house any more.

hausa: Sai Ishaku ya gina bagade a can, ya kuma kira bisa sunan Ubangiji. A can ya kafa tentinsa, a can kuma bayinsa suka haƙa wata rijiya.
english: He built an altar there, and called on Yahweh’s name, and pitched his tent there. There Isaac’s servants dug a well.

hausa: Ba mu saurari bayinka annabawa ba, waɗanda suka yi magana a sunanka ga sarakunanmu da masu mulkinmu da iyayenmu, da kuma dukan mutanen ƙasa.
english: We haven’t listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.

hausa: Sai wani wanda ya tsira, ya zo ya faɗa wa Abram mutumin Ibraniyawa. Abram kuwa yana zama kusa da manyan itatuwan Mamre, Mamre mutumin Amoriyawa ne ɗan’uwan Eshkol da Aner, su kuwa abokan Abram ne.
english: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. At that time, he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner. They were allies of Abram.

hausa: “Ni Ubangiji nakan bincike zuciya in gwada tunani, don in sāka wa kowane mutum bisa ga halinsa, bisa ga ayyukansa.”
english: “I, Yahweh, search the mind. I try the heart, even to give every man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his doings.”

hausa: Saboda haka Yaƙub ya ce wa gidansa da kuma dukan waɗanda suke tare da shi, “Ku zubar da baƙin allolin da kuke da su, ku tsarkake kanku, ku kuma canja tufafinku.
english: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.

hausa: “Je ka, nan take, zuwa Zarefat na Sidon, ka zauna a can. Na umarci wata gwauruwa a can tă ciyar da kai.”
english: “Arise, go to Zarephath, which belongs to Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to sustain you.”

hausa: Biyu na kowane irin tsuntsu, kowace irin dabba da kuma kowace irin halitta mai rarrafe a ƙasa, za su zo wurinka domin a bar su da rai.
english: Of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort will come to you, to keep them alive.

hausa: Abdon, Zikri, Hanan,
english: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,

hausa: Murhun bagaden kamu huɗu ne, akwai ƙahoni guda huɗu sun miƙe sama daga murhun.
english: The upper altar shall be four cubits; and from the altar hearth and upward there shall be four horns.

hausa: Mujiyar hamada da mujiya mai kuka za su mallake ta; babban mujiya da hankaka za su yi sheƙa a can. Allah zai miƙe a kan Edom magwajin bala’i da ma’aunin kango.
english: But the pelican and the porcupine will possess it. The owl and the raven will dwell in it. He will stretch the line of confusion over it, and the plumb line of emptiness.

hausa: Duk wanda yake danne matalauta don yă azurta kuma duk wanda yake kyauta ga mawadata, dukansu kan talauta.
english: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.

hausa: “Tabbatacce idanun Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka suna a kan mulkin nan mai zunubi. Zan hallaka shi daga fuskar duniya, duk da haka ba zan hallaka gidan Yaƙub ƙaƙaf ba,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: Behold, the eyes of the Lord Yahweh are on the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the surface of the earth, except that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Eli yakan sa wa Elkana da matarsa albarka, yă ce, Ubangiji yă ba ka waɗansu ’ya’ya ta wurin matan nan, maimakon wanda ta roƙa daga Ubangiji, ta kuma ba da shi ga Ubangiji. Bayan haka sai su koma gida.
english: Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, “May Yahweh give you offspring from this woman for the petition which was asked of Yahweh.” Then they went to their own home.

hausa: Kamar barewar da ake farautarta kamar tumaki marasa makiyayi, haka nan kowane mutum zai koma ga mutanensa, kowane mutum zai gudu zuwa ƙasarsa.
english: It will happen that like a hunted gazelle and like sheep that no one gathers, they will each turn to their own people, and will each flee to their own land.

hausa: Ina ƙaunar waɗanda suke ƙaunata, kuma waɗanda suke nemana sukan same ni.
english: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.

hausa: Gayus, mai masauƙina, mai kuma saukar da dukan ’yan Ikkilisiya, yana gaishe ku. Erastus, mai bi da ayyukan jama’ar gari, da kuma ɗan’uwanmu Kwartus, suna gaishe ku.
english: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.

hausa: “ ‘Amma duk wanda ya cinye ku za a cinye shi; dukan abokan gābanku za su tafi zaman bauta. Waɗanda suka washe ku su ma za a washe su; dukan waɗanda suka mai da ku ganima su ma zan mai da su ganima.
english: Therefore all those who devour you will be devoured. All your adversaries, everyone of them, will go into captivity. Those who plunder you will be plunder. I will make all who prey on you become prey.

hausa: Allah ya faɗa game da dabbobin Negeb cewa, Ta cikin ƙasa mai wahala da mai hatsari inda zakoki da zakanya, inda macizai masu dafi da macizai masu tashi sama suke, jakadu na ɗaukan arzikinsu a kan jakuna, dukiyarsu a kan raƙuma, zuwa ƙasan nan marar riba,
english: The burden of the animals of the South. Through the land of trouble and anguish, of the lioness and the lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they carry their riches on the shoulders of young donkeys, and their treasures on the humps of camels, to an unprofitable people.

hausa: Gama shi kansa shi ne salamarmu, shi ne ya kawo ƙungiyoyi biyu suka zama ɗaya, ya kuma rushe katangan nan ta ƙiyayya wadda ta raba mu.
english: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,

hausa: Za a yi musu sakamako da muguntar da suka yi. A ra’ayinsu jin daɗi shi ne a yi annashuwa da rana tsaka. Su ƙazamai ne marasa kunya, suna cike da jin daɗin sha’awace-sha’awacensu yayinda suke cin biki tare da ku.
english: receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and defects, reveling in their deceit while they feast with you;

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, dubi yadda abokan gābana suna tsananta mini! Ka yi jinƙai ka kuma ɗaga ni daga ƙofofin mutuwa,
english: Have mercy on me, Yahweh. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,

hausa: Sai Yonatan ya ce wa Dawuda, “Na yi rantse da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila cewa war haka jibi, zan yi ƙoƙari in ji daga mahaifina, idan ya yi magana mai kyau game da kai, zan gaya maka.
english: Jonathan said to David, “By Yahweh, the God of Israel, when I have sounded out my father about this time tomorrow, or the third day, behold, if there is good toward David, won’t I then send to you and disclose it to you?

hausa: Kwana bakwai za ku ci burodi marar yisti, a kan rana ta bakwai kuma za ku yi biki ga Ubangiji.
english: Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day shall be a feast to Yahweh.

hausa: Ya shafe babban zauren da fir, ya kuma rufe shi da zinariya mai kyau; ya yi masa ado da zāne-zānen itatuwan dabino da kuma jerin zāne-zāne.
english: He made the larger room with a ceiling of cypress wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and ornamented it with palm trees and chains.

hausa: Saboda gidan Ubangiji Allahnmu, zan nemi wadatarki.
english: For the sake of the house of Yahweh our God, I will seek your good.

hausa: Sun kafa gumakansu na banƙyama a cikin haikalina wanda ake kira da sunana, sun kuwa ƙazantar da shi.
english: But they set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

hausa: Farillanka masu banmamaki ne; saboda haka nake yin biyayya da su.
english: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.

hausa: “Ɗan’uwa zai ci amanar ɗan’uwansa, a kuma kashe shi, Uba ma zai yi haka da ɗansa; ’ya’ya za su tayar wa iyayensu, su kuma sa a kashe su.
english: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

hausa: kayayyakin sinnamon da kayan yaji, na turaren wuta, mur da turare, na ruwan inabi da man zaitun, na gari mai laushi da alkama; shanu da tumaki; dawakai da kekunan doki, da jikuna da kuma rayukan mutane.
english: and cinnamon, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, and people’s bodies and souls.

hausa: A cikin girman ikonsa Allah ya zama kamar riga a jikina; ya shaƙe ni kamar wuyan rigata.
english: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.

hausa: Arfakshad ne mahaifin Shela. Shela kuma shi ne mahaifin Eber.
english: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka sāke yin mugayen ayyuka a gaban Ubangiji, saboda haka ya ba da su a hannun Filistiyawa shekara arba’in.
english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight; and Yahweh delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.

hausa: “ ‘Daga kashegarin Asabbaci, ranar da kuka kawo dami don hadaya ta kaɗawa, ku ƙirga cikakku makoni bakwai.
english: “‘You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering: seven Sabbaths shall be completed.

hausa: A shekara ta talatin da takwas ta Asa sarkin Yahuda, Ahab ɗan Omri ya zama sarkin Isra’ila, ya kuma yi mulki a Samariya a kan Isra’ila, shekara ashirin da biyu.
english: In the thirty-eighth year of Asa king of Judah, Ahab the son of Omri began to reign over Israel. Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty-two years.

hausa: “La’ananne ne mutumin da bai yi na’am da kalmomin wannan doka ta wurin aikata su ba.” Sai dukan mutane su ce, “Amin!”
english: ‘Cursed is he who doesn’t uphold the words of this law by doing them.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’”

hausa: gabas da Urdun, cikin dukan ƙasar Gileyad (yankin Gad, da na Ruben, da na Manasse), daga Arower wajen Kwarin Arnon ya ratsa Gileyad zuwa Bashan.
english: from the Jordan eastward, all the land of Gilead, the Gadites, and the Reubenites, and the Manassites, from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, even Gilead and Bashan.

hausa: Ƙasar ta haɗa da ƙasar kan tudu, filayen arewanci, Araba, gangaren Dutse, da jejin, da kuma Negeb, wato, ƙasashen Hittiyawa, Amoriyawa, Kan’aniyawa, Ferizziyawa, Hiwiyawa, da Yebusiyawa.
english: in the hill country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the South; the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:

hausa: Ina gode wa Allahna a kowane lokacin da na tuna da ku.
english: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

hausa: Ko cikinku ma mutane za su taso su karkatar da gaskiya don su jawo wa kansu almajirai.
english: Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.

hausa: ina koya maka gaskiya da kalmomin da za ka dogara a kai, saboda ka iya ba da amsa daidai ga duk wanda ya aike ka?
english: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?

hausa: Sai Uriya ya ce wa Dawuda, “Akwatin Alkawari, da Isra’ila, da Yahuda suna zama cikin tentuna, kuma maigidana Yowab da mutanen ranka yă daɗe suna a sansani a fili. Yaya zan je gidana in ci in sha in kuma kwana da matata? Muddin kana a raye, ba zan yi irin wannan abu ba!”
english: Uriah said to David, “The ark, Israel, and Judah, are staying in tents; and my lord Joab and the servants of my lord are encamped in the open field. Shall I then go into my house to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? As you live, and as your soul lives, I will not do this thing!”

hausa: duwatsu sun gan ka sai suka ƙame. Ruwaye masu hauka sun yi ta fantsamawa; zurfafa suka yi ruri suka tā da raƙuman ruwansu sama.
english: The mountains saw you, and were afraid. The storm of waters passed by. The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high.

hausa: A kan dukan rufi a Mowab da kuma a dandalin jama’a babu wani abu sai kuka gama na karye Mowab kamar tulun da babu mai so,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: On all the housetops of Moab, and in its streets, there is lamentation everywhere; for I have broken Moab like a vessel in which no one delights,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “Ku tattambaya a cikin al’ummai. Wa ya taɓa jin irin wannan abu? Budurwa Isra’ila ta yi mugun abu mafi banƙyama.
english: Therefore Yahweh says: “Ask now among the nations, ‘Who has heard such things?’ The virgin of Israel has done a very horrible thing.

hausa: Ibrahim ya amsa ya ce, “Ɗana, Allah kansa zai tanada ɗan ragon hadayar ƙonawa.” Sai su biyu suka ci gaba da tafiya.
english: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.

hausa: Zuriyar Zebulun bisa ga kabilansu, daga Sered, kabilar Seredawa; daga Elon kabilar Elonawa; daga Yaleyel; kabilar Yaleyewa.
english: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

hausa: Fir’auna ya ce, “Ubangiji ya taimaka bisa ga niyyarku, amma matanku da ƙanananku ba za su tafi ba! A fili yake kuna da niyyar mugunta.
english: He said to them, “Yahweh be with you if I let you go with your little ones! See, evil is clearly before your faces.

hausa: Za a lissafta hadayarku kamar hatsin da aka sussuka daga masussuka, ko ruwan inabi daga wurin matsewar inabi.
english: Your wave offering shall be credited to you, as though it were the grain of the threshing floor, and as the fullness of the wine press.

hausa: Yawan rundunan masu hawan dawakan nan mutum miliyon ɗari biyu ne. Na ji adadinsu.
english: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. I heard the number of them.

hausa: A wannan rana birane biyar a Masar za su yi yaren Kan’ana su kuma miƙa kai cikin yarjejjeniya ga Ubangiji Maɗaukaki. Za a ce da ɗayansu Birnin Hallaka.
english: In that day, there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to Yahweh of Armies. One will be called “The city of destruction.”

hausa: Sai Ayuba ya amsa,
english: Then Job answered,

hausa: Sai ya koma Nazaret tare da su, yana yi musu biyayya. Mahaifiyarsa kuma ta riƙe dukan waɗannan abubuwa a zuciyarta.
