english: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

hausa: To, don me aka kawo Doka? An yi ƙari da Doka ne don fitowa da laifi fili har kafin na zuriyan nan ya zo, wanda aka yi wa alkawarin, an ba da doka ta wurin mala’iku ne, aka kuma danƙa ta a hannun matsakanci.
english: Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

hausa: Da aka yi mata baftisma tare da iyalin gidanta, sai ta gayyace mu zuwa gidanta. Ta ce, “In kun amince ni mai bi ce cikin Ubangiji, sai ku zo ku sauka a gidana.” Sai ta kuwa rinjaye mu.
english: When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, “If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house and stay.” So she persuaded us.

hausa: Bari ɗaukakar Ubangiji ta dawwama har abada; bari Ubangiji yă yi farin ciki cikin aikinsa,
english: Let Yahweh’s glory endure forever. Let Yahweh rejoice in his works.

hausa: A maimakon tagulla zan kawo zinariya, azurfa kuma a maimakon baƙin ƙarfe. A maimakon katako zan kawo tagulla, baƙin ƙarfe kuma a maimakon duwatsu. Zan sa salama ta zama gwamnarki adalci kuma mai mulkinki.
english: For bronze I will bring gold; for iron I will bring silver; for wood, bronze, and for stones, iron. I will also make peace your governor, and righteousness your ruler.

hausa: Zinariya, azurfa, tagulla, baƙin ƙarfe, kuza, darma
english: However the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

hausa: Duk mai tsoron Ubangiji yana da zaunannen mafaka, kuma ga ’ya’yansa zai zama mafaka.
english: In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.

hausa: Labule na gefe ɗaya na ƙofar, kamu goma sha biyar ne, da sanduna guda uku da rammukansu,
english: the hangings for the one side were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three;

hausa: duki, buga zaɓi, kowace irin shirwa,
english: the red kite, the falcon, the kite of any kind,

hausa: Sarkin Babilon kuwa ya kashe su a Ribla a ƙasar Hamat. Haka aka tafi da mutanen Yahuda bautar talala, daga ƙasarta.
english: The king of Babylon struck them, and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.

hausa: “Wannan shi ne ƙarshen batun. Ni, Daniyel na damu ƙwarai da irin tunanina, kuma fuskata ta rikice, amma na riƙe batun a zuciyata.”
english: “Here is the end of the matter. As for me, Daniel, my thoughts troubled me greatly, and my face was changed in me; but I kept the matter in my heart.”

hausa: Shanunku da jakunanku da suke huɗar gonakinku za su ci harawa mafi kyau, wanda an sheƙe shi da babban cokali mai yatsu da kuma babban cokali.
english: The oxen likewise and the young donkeys that till the ground will eat savory feed, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fork.

hausa: Amma in mahaifinta ya hana ta, sa’ad da ya ji game da shi, to, ba wani daga cikin alkawari ko rantsuwar da ta yi zai tabbata; Ubangiji kuwa zai gafarta mata domin maihaifinta ya hana ta.
english: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. Yahweh will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.

hausa: da Harif, da Anatot, da Nebai,
english: Hariph, Anathoth, Nobai,

hausa: Sai na umarci Lawiyawa su tsarkake kansu su kuma tafi su yi tsaron ƙofofi don a kiyaye ranar Asabbaci da tsarki. Ka tuna da ni saboda wannan shi ma, ya Allahna, ka nuna mini jinƙai bisa ga madawwamiyar ƙaunarka.
english: I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the Sabbath day. Remember me for this also, my God, and spare me according to the greatness of your loving kindness.

hausa: Al’amudan nan biyu, na girgije da na wuta, ba su daina yi wa jama’a jagora ba.
english: the pillar of cloud by day, and the pillar of fire by night, didn’t depart from before the people.

hausa: Ƙuri’a ta shida ta fāɗa a kan kabilar Naftali, bisa ga iyalansu.
english: The sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali, even for the children of Naphtali according to their families.

hausa: Sun daga muryoyinsu, sun yi sowa ta farin ciki; daga yamma sun furta darajar Ubangiji.
english: These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of Yahweh. They cry aloud from the sea.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne ƙa’idodi da kuma dokokin da za ku lura, ku kuma kiyaye a ƙasar da Ubangiji, Allahn kakanninku, yake ba ku don ku ci gādonta, muddin kuna zama a ƙasar.
english: These are the statutes and the ordinances which you shall observe to do in the land which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has given you to possess all the days that you live on the earth.

hausa: Sane da abin da suke zance, sai Yesu ya ce, “Ku masu ƙarancin bangaskiya, don me kuke magana da junanku a kan ba ku zo da burodi ba?
english: Jesus, perceiving it, said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, because you have brought no bread?

hausa: Suka ba shi ɗan gasasshen kifi,
english: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.

hausa: Ba shakka duk wanda bai yi biyayya da dokokin Allahnka ba, da kuma dokokin sarki ba dole a yanke masa hukuncin kisa, ko hukuncin kora, ko hukuncin raba shi da mallakarsa, ko kuma hukuncin kulle shi a kurkuku.
english: Whoever will not do the law of your God and the law of the king, let judgment be executed on him with all diligence, whether it is to death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.

hausa: Yayinda nake dawowa daga Faddan Aram, cikin baƙin cikina Rahila ta rasu a ƙasar Kan’ana yayinda muke kan hanya, ’yar rata daga Efrata. Saboda haka na binne ta a can kusa da hanya zuwa Efrata” (wato, Betlehem).
english: As for me, when I came from Paddan, Rachel died beside me in the land of Canaan on the way, when there was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and I buried her there on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).”

hausa: Abokaina ƙaunatattu, in zukatanmu ba su ba mu laifi ba, muna da ƙarfin halin tsayawa a gaban Allah ke nan.
english: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

hausa: A tā da tuta a kan tudun da yake mai fili, ka tā da murya gare su; ka ɗaga hannu ka ba su alama don su shiga ƙofofi masu alfarma.
english: Set up a banner on the bare mountain! Lift up your voice to them! Wave your hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

hausa: “Sai maigidan ya kira wannan bawa. Ya ce, ‘Kai mugun bawa, na yafe duk bashin da nake binka domin ka roƙe ni.
english: Then his lord called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.

hausa: Aka haifa wa Absalom ’ya’ya uku maza da ’ya mace guda. Sunanta Tamar, ta kuwa zama kyakkyawan mace ƙwarai.
english: Three sons were born to Absalom, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar. She was a woman with a beautiful face.

hausa: Ka guji wawa, gama ba za ka sami sani a leɓunansa ba.
english: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.

hausa: Yana da kyau mutum yă sha wuya tun yana yaro.
english: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Issakar. Aka rubuta sunayen dukan maza ɗaya-ɗaya da suka kai shekara ashirin ko fiye da suka isa shiga soja, bisa ga iyalansu da kabilarsu da take a rubuce.
english: Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

hausa: Suka tafi, suka kuwa tarar da wani ɗan jaki a waje, a titi, daure a ƙofar gida. Suna cikin kunce shi ke nan,
english: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.

hausa: kafin ya yi duniya ko gonaki ko wata ƙurar duniya.
english: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

hausa: Zan kuma tanada wa mutanena Isra’ila wuri, in kuma dasa su yadda za su kasance da gida kansu ba tare da an ƙara damunsu ba. Mugayen mutane ba za su ƙara wahalshe su kamar dā ba,
english: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not afflict them any more, as at the first,

hausa: Sa’ad da mutanen garin suka fito suka yaƙi Yowab, sai waɗansu mutane daga sojojin Dawuda suka mutu; Uriya mutumin Hitti ma ya mutu.
english: The men of the city went out and fought with Joab. Some of the people fell, even of David’s servants; and Uriah the Hittite died also.

hausa: Sai ta sa wa jakar sirdi ta ce wa bawanta, “Yi ta kora mini jakar, kada ka sassauta, sai na faɗa maka.”
english: Then she saddled a donkey, and said to her servant, “Drive, and go forward! Don’t slow down for me, unless I ask you to.”

hausa: Sai mutanen suka tashi suka nufi Sodom, Ibrahim kuwa ya yi musu rakiya, ya yi bankwana da su.
english: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Abraham went with them to see them on their way.

hausa: “Ashe, dokarmu takan hukunta mutum ba tare da an fara ji daga bakinsa game da abin da yake yi ba?”
english: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”

hausa: Ta yaya ne darajarku ba tă kai ta sauran ikkilisiyoyi ba, ko kuwa don dai ban nawaita muku ba ne? Ku gafarta mini wannan laifi!
english: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

hausa: Isra’ilawa kuwa suka yi yadda Yoshuwa ya umarce su. Suka ɗauki duwatsu guda goma sha biyu bisa ga yawan kabilan Isra’ila, yadda Ubangiji ya gaya wa Yoshuwa; suka tafi da su masauƙinsu, a can suka ajiye su.
english: The children of Israel did as Joshua commanded, and took up twelve stones out of the middle of the Jordan, as Yahweh spoke to Joshua, according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel. They carried them over with them to the place where they camped, and laid them down there.

hausa: Ƙa’ida dai za tă zama ɗaya ga duk wanda ya yi laifi ba da gangan ba, ko shi ɗan ƙasa ne, ko kuma baƙon da yake zama a cikinku.
english: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them.

hausa: Saboda haka na ba shi Masar a matsayin lada don ƙoƙarinsa domin shi da sojojinsa sun yi wannan domina ne, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: I have given him the land of Egypt as his payment for which he served, because they worked for me,’ says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Sukan dawo da yamma, suna wage haƙora kamar karnuka, suna yawo a birni.
english: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.

hausa: ko Bulus ko Afollos ko Kefas ko duniya ko rai ko mutuwa ko abubuwa na yanzu ko na nan gaba, ai, duka naku ne,
english: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,

hausa: “La’ananne ne shi wanda yake sake a yin aikin Ubangiji! La’ananne ne wanda ya janye takobinsa daga zub da jini!
english: “Cursed is he who does the work of Yahweh negligently; and cursed is he who keeps back his sword from blood.

hausa: Amma ina gaya muku, duk wanda ya dubi mace, sa’an nan ya yi sha’awarta a zuci, ya riga ya yi zina ke nan da ita a zuciyarsa.
english: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.

hausa: shi wanda ya dubi duniya, sai ta razana, wanda ya taɓa duwatsu, sai suka yi hayaƙi.
english: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

hausa: Za ka zauna lafiya, domin akwai bege; za ka duba kewaye da kai ka huta cikin kwanciyar rai.
english: You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.

hausa: Jimillar maza daga mutanen Ruben 46,500 ne.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

hausa: Sa’an nan shugabannin Yahuda za su ce a cikin zukatansu, ‘Mutanen Urushalima suna da ƙarfi domin Ubangiji Maɗaukaki shi ne Allahnsu.’
english: The chieftains of Judah will say in their heart, ‘The inhabitants of Jerusalem are my strength in Yahweh of Armies their God.’

hausa: kana riƙe da bangaskiya da kuma lamiri mai kyau. Gama waɗansu mutane, saboda ƙin kasa kunne ga lamirinsu, suka lalatar da bangaskiyarsu.
english: holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,

hausa: Suka tashi daga Almon Dibilatayim, suka yi sansani a duwatsun Abarim, kusa da Nebo.
english: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

hausa: Zabura Dutsen da magina suka ƙi ya zama mai amfani;
english: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

hausa: Ka yi sandunan da itacen ƙirya, ka dalaye su da zinariya, da sandunan ne za ku riƙa ɗaukan teburin.
english: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.

hausa: A kowane gefe na mashigin da Yonatan ya so yă bi zuwa wurin Filistiyawa, akwai hawa mai tsawo, ana kira ɗaya Bozez, ɗayan kuma ana kira Senet.
english: Between the passes, by which Jonathan sought to go over to the Philistines’ garrison, there was a rocky crag on the one side and a rocky crag on the other side; and the name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.

hausa: Ta tashi ta shiga tare da ’ya’yanta maza, suka kulle ƙofa. ’Ya’yanta suka kawo mata tuluna, ita kuma tana ɗurawa.
english: So she went from him, and shut the door on herself and on her sons. They brought the containers to her, and she poured oil.

hausa: Ku lura don kada ku yi hasarar aikin da kuka yi, sai dai ku sami cikakken lada.
english: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

hausa: Ba zai kula da alloli iyayensa ba ko wanda mata suke sha’awa, balle ma yă ga darajar wani allah, amma zai ɗaukaka kansa gaba da su duka.
english: He won’t regard the gods of his fathers, or the desire of women, or regard any god; for he will magnify himself above all.

hausa: Duk da haka bai bar kansa babu shaida ba. Ya nuna alheri ta wurin ba ku ruwan sama da kuma amfanin gona a lokutansu; ya ba ku abinci mai yawa ya kuma cika zukatanku da farin ciki.”
english: Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness.”

hausa: Saboda haka ya nuna musu, suka kuwa hallaka birnin, suka bar mutumin da dukan iyalinsa da rai.
english: He showed them the entrance into the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man and all his family go.

hausa: in kuwa aka yi haka ba da gangan ba, kuma da rashin sani, sai duk jama’a su miƙa ɗan bijimi don hadaya ta ƙonawa mai daɗin ƙanshi ga Ubangiji, tare da ƙayyadadden hadaya ta gari, da hadaya ta sha, da kuma bunsuru na hadaya don zunubi.
english: then it shall be, if it was done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, with its meal offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.

hausa: Sa’an nan za ka san cewa Ni Ubangiji na ji duk abubuwan banzan da ka faɗa a kan duwatsun Isra’ila. Ka ce, “An mai da su kango an kuma ba mu su mu cinye.”
english: You will know that I, Yahweh, have heard all your insults which you have spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, ‘They have been laid desolate. They have been given to us to devour.’

hausa: Ya fitar da su daga Masar ya kuma yi ayyukan da abubuwan banmamaki a Masar, a Jan Teku, da kuma cikin hamada har shekara arba’in.
english: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.

hausa: Dawuda, sanye da efod lilin, ya yi ta rawa a gaban Ubangiji da dukan ƙarfinsa,
english: David danced before Yahweh with all his might; and David was clothed in a linen ephod.

hausa: An ƙera mahaɗai da rassa wurin ajiye fitila a haɗe. Da ƙerarriyar zinariya aka yi wurin ajiye fitilar da dukan komensa a haɗe.
english: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.

hausa: Muka kuma tambaye su sunayensu don mu rubuta mu sanar da kai waɗanda suke shugabanninsu.
english: We asked them their names also, to inform you that we might write the names of the men who were at their head.

hausa: Abigiyel ita ce mahaifiyar Amasa, wanda mahaifinsa shi ne Yeter mutumin Ishmayel.
english: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

hausa: Sa’ad da abokan gāban Yahuda da na Benyamin suka ji cewa waɗanda suka dawo daga bauta suna gina haikalin Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila
english: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity were building a temple to Yahweh, the God of Israel,

hausa: da kuma dukan sarakunan arewa, nesa da kuma kusa, bi da bi, dukan mulkokin duniya. Bayan dukansu kuma, sai sarkin Sheshak ma yă sha.
english: and all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the world, which are on the surface of the earth. The king of Sheshach will drink after them.

hausa: gama “Allahnmu wuta ne mai cinyewa.”
english: for our God is a consuming fire.

hausa: Gama zan ba ku kalmomi, da hikima waɗanda ba ko ɗaya daga cikin maƙiyanku, za su iya tsayayya da ku, ko su ƙaryata.
english: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.

hausa: “ ‘Zan ba ku salama a ƙasar, za ku kuwa kwanta, kuma babu wani da zai tsorata ku. Zan kori mugayen namun jeji daga ƙasar, takobi kuma ba zai ratsa cikin ƙasarku ba.
english: “‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

hausa: Sa’ad da mutanen Yabesh Gileyad suka sami labarin abin da Filistiyawa suka yi wa Shawulu.
english: When the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul,

hausa: Gama rana ta zo da za a hallaka Filistiyawa a kuma datse dukan waɗanda suka ragu waɗanda za su iya taimakon Taya da Sidon. Ubangiji yana gab da hallaka Filistiyawa, raguwa daga bakin tekun Kaftor.
english: because of the day that comes to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper who remains; for Yahweh will destroy the Philistines, the remnant of the isle of Caphtor.

hausa: “Ba mai ƙuna fitila sa’an nan ya ɓoye ta a cikin tulu, ko kuma ya sa ta a ƙarƙashin gado ba. A maimakon haka, yakan sa ta a kan wurin ajiye fitila, saboda mutane masu shigowa su ga haske.
english: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Ta Dawuda. Zabura. Waƙa. Bari Allah yă tashi, bari a watsar da abokan gābansa; bari maƙiyansa su gudu a gabansa.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.

hausa: talauci kuwa zai zo kamar ’yan hari rashi kuma kamar ɗan fashi.
english: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya tambaye su ya ce, “Me ya kamata a yi bisa ga doka, a ranar Asabbaci, a aikata alheri, ko a aikata mugunta, a ceci rai, ko a yi kisa?” Amma suka yi shiru.
english: He said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good or to do harm? To save a life or to kill?” But they were silent.

hausa: Ya tuna da ƙaunarsa da kuma amincinsa ga gidan Isra’ila; dukan iyakar duniya sun ga ceton Allahnmu.
english: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

hausa: Solomon ya tsarkake sashen tsakiya na filin da yake gaban haikalin Ubangiji, a can ya miƙa hadayun ƙonawa da kitsen hadayun salama domin bagaden tagullar da ya yi ba zai iya ɗaukan hadayun ƙonawa, hadayun hatsi da kuma ɓangarori na kitsen ba.
english: Moreover Solomon made the middle of the court that was before Yahweh’s house holy; for there he offered the burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat.

hausa: Tsoron Ubangiji yakan kai ga rai. Sa’an nan mutum ya sami biyan bukata, ba abin da zai cuce shi.
english: The fear of Yahweh leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.

hausa: Zan kawo ku cikin hamadar al’ummai a can kuwa, fuska da fuska, zan hukunta ku.
english: I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples, and there I will enter into judgment with you face to face.

hausa: Babban shugaban Lawiyawa shi ne Eleyazar ɗan Haruna, firist. An naɗa shi a kan waɗanda suke kula da wuri mai tsarki.
english: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary.

hausa: Yayinda kuke shuki a shekara ta takwas, za ku kasance da raguwa hatsi na shekarar da ta wuce, za ku kuma ci gaba da ci daga gare shi har girbin shekara ta tara yă shigo.
english: You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits from the old store until the ninth year. Until its fruits come in, you shall eat the old store.

hausa: Saratu ta ji tsoro, don haka sai ta yi ƙarya ta ce, “Ban yi dariya ba.” Ya ce, “A’a, kin yi dariya.”
english: Then Sarah denied it, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” for she was afraid. He said, “No, but you did laugh.”

hausa: Gama ba waninmu da yake rayuwa wa kansa kaɗai, kuma ba waninmu da kan mutu don kansa kaɗai.
english: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

hausa: Aka yi wa labulen ƙofar filin Tentin Sujada ado na ɗinki da na shuɗi, da na shunayya, da na jan zare, da na lallausan lilin, aikin gwaninta. Tsawonsa kamu ashirin, kuma kamar yadda labulen filin Tentin Sujada suke, tsayinsa kamu biyar ne,
english: The screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. Twenty cubits was the length, and the height along the width was five cubits, like the hangings of the court.

hausa: Sai ya tā da murya ya ce, “Maza, yi sauri kada ka tsaya.” Yaron ya ɗauko kibiya ya kawo wa maigidansa.
english: Jonathan cried after the boy, “Go fast! Hurry! Don’t delay!” Jonathan’s boy gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.

hausa: Yesu ya kama hannun makahon ya kai shi bayan ƙauyen. Bayan ya tofa miyau a idanun mutumin, ya kuma ɗibiya masa hannuwansa, sai ya tambaye shi ya ce, “Kana iya ganin wani abu?”
english: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.

hausa: Duk wanda ya yi ƙoƙari yin musu lahani, wuta za tă fito daga bakunansu ta cinye abokan gābansu. Haka ne duk mai niyyar yin musu lahani zai mutu.
english: If anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone desires to harm them, he must be killed in this way.

hausa: Solomon ya kasance da wuraren ajiye dawakai dubu huɗu don dawakai da kekunan yaƙi, yana da dawakai dubu goma sha biyu waɗanda ya ajiye a biranen kekunan yaƙi da kuma tare da shi a Urushalima.
english: Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen that he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king at Jerusalem.

hausa: “A lokacin ɗaukar cikin garken, na taɓa yin mafarki inda na ga bunsuran da suke barbara da garken, masu dabbare-dabbare, ko babare-babare, ko masu zāne-zāne ne.
english: During mating season, I lifted up my eyes, and saw in a dream, and behold, the male goats which leaped on the flock were streaked, speckled, and grizzled.

hausa: Ban da wannan duka ma, tsakaninmu da kai, akwai wani babban rami da aka yi, yadda waɗanda suke son ƙetarewa daga nan zuwa wurinku, ba za su iya ba, kuma ba mai iya ƙetarewa daga wurinku zuwa wurinmu.’
english: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’

hausa: Daga sa’a ta shida har zuwa sa’a ta tara na rana, duhu ya rufe dukan ƙasar.
english: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

hausa: Allah na salama yă kasance tare da ku duka. Amin.
english: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

hausa: Suka kuma yi filin Tentin Sujada. Suka yi labulanta na gefen kudu da lallausan lilin, tsawonsu kamu ɗari,
english: He made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, one hundred cubits;

hausa: Za ka ɗauki bijimi na hadaya don zunubi ka ƙone shi a sashen da aka shirya na haikalin a wani wuri waje da wuri mai tsarki.
english: You shall also take the bull of the sin offering, and it shall be burned in the appointed place of the house, outside of the sanctuary.

hausa: Ya aikata abin da yake daidai a gaban Ubangiji, sai dai ba kamar kakansa Dawuda ba. A kome dai ya bi gurbin mahaifinsa Yowash.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, yet not like David his father. He did according to all that Joash his father had done.

hausa: Yesu ya ba wa almajiransa wani misali, don yă koya musu yadda ya kamata su dinga yin addu’a kullum, ban da fasawa.
english: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up,

hausa: Na bayyana ka a gare su, zan kuma ci gaba da bayyana ka domin ƙaunar da ka yi mini ta kasance a cikinsu ni ma in kasance a cikinsu.”
english: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”

hausa: Amma dukan Isra’ila da Yahuda suka ƙaunaci Dawuda gama yana bin da su a yaƙe-yaƙensu.
english: But all Israel and Judah loved David; for he went out and came in before them.

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Yehohiyakim ya riƙa biyan Fir’auna Neko azurfa da zinariyar da ya umarta. Don yă yi haka sai ya riƙa karɓar azurfa da zinariya daga mutanen ƙasar, kowa bisa ga ƙarfinsa.
english: Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh. He exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, from everyone according to his assessment, to give it to Pharaoh Necoh.

hausa: Ku juyo daga mugunta ku yi alheri; sa’an nan za ku zauna a ƙasar har abada.
english: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa da dukan Isra’ilawa suka tashi daga Libna zuwa Lakish; suka yi shiri suka kai mata hari.
english: Joshua passed from Libnah, and all Israel with him, to Lachish, and encamped against it, and fought against it.

hausa: Sai wanda yake cikin ɗaki ya amsa ya ce, ‘Kada ka dame ni. An riga an kulle ƙofa, da ni da yarana kuwa mun kwanta, ba zan iya tashi in ba ka kome ba.’
english: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?

hausa: Waƙar haurawa. Waɗanda suke dogara ga Ubangiji suna kama da Dutsen Sihiyona, wanda ba ya jijjiguwa amma dawwammame ne har abada.
english: A Song of Ascents. Those who trust in Yahweh are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.

hausa: kuma duk mai son zama shugaba, dole yă zama bawanku,
english: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,

hausa: Ubangiji kuma zai kawo muku kowane irin ciwo da masifar da ba a rubuta a cikin wannan Littafin Doka ba, har sai an hallaka ku.
english: Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, Yahweh will bring them on you until you are destroyed.

hausa: amma wanda ba ya zama tare da ku na ɗinɗinɗin, da kuma wanda aka ɗauki hayansa, ba zai ci ba.
english: A foreigner and a hired servant shall not eat of it.

hausa: domin Ibrahim ya yi mini biyayya ya kuma kiyaye umarnaina, ƙa’idodina da kuma dokokina.”
english: because Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my requirements, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.”

hausa: ta kuwa haifi ɗanta na fari. Ta nannaɗe shi a zane ta kuma kwantar da shi cikin wani kwami, don ba su sami ɗaki a masauƙi ba.
english: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.

hausa: Ka amsa mini in za ka iya; ka yi shirin fuskanta ta.
english: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.

hausa: Aka ƙwace akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji. Aka kuma kashe ’ya’yan Eli biyu, Hofni da Finehas.
english: God’s ark was taken; and the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, were slain.

hausa: Hallaka! Hallaka! Zan hallaka shi! Ba za a maido da shi ba sai ya ga ainihin mai shi; gare shi zan bayar da shi.’
english: I will overturn, overturn, overturn it. This also will be no more, until he comes whose right it is; and I will give it.”’

hausa: Sarki Solomon ya aika zuwa Taya aka kuma kawo Huram,
english: King Solomon sent and brought Hiram out of Tyre.

hausa: “ ‘Girka, Tubal da Meshek sun yi kasuwanci da ke; sun sayi kayanki suka biya da bayi da kuma abubuwan da aka yi da tagulla.
english: “‘“Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your traders. They traded the persons of men and vessels of bronze for your merchandise.

hausa: A sa gishiri a dukan hadayunku na hatsi. Kada a rasa sa gishirin alkawari na Allahnku a hadayunku na hatsi, a sa gishiri a dukan hadayunku.
english: Every offering of your meal offering you shall season with salt. You shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be lacking from your meal offering. With all your offerings you shall offer salt.

hausa: In ya rasa gashin goshinsa yana kuma da sanƙo a goshinsa, shi tsarkakakke ne.
english: If his hair has fallen off from the front part of his head, his forehead is bald. He is clean.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne mutanen da Ubangiji ya umarta su raba gādo ga Isra’ilawa a ƙasar Kan’ana.
english: These are they whom Yahweh commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

hausa: A lokaci Ahab ne, Hiyel mutumin Betel ya sāke gina Yeriko. Ya kafa tushensa a bakin ran ɗan farinsa Abiram, ya kuma kafa ƙofofinsa a bakin ran autansa Segub, bisa ga maganar Ubangiji da ya yi ta wurin Yoshuwa ɗan Nun.
english: In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho. He laid its foundation with the loss of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates with the loss of his youngest son Segub, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.

hausa: Wannan ya sa Yahudawa suka yi tambaya suka ce, “Zai kashe kansa ne? Shi ya sa yake cewa, ‘Inda za ni, ba za ku iya zuwa ba’?”
english: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”

hausa: Ruhu Mai Tsarki kuma ya sauko masa a wata siffa, kamar kurciya. Sai murya ta fito daga sama, ta ce, “Kai ne Ɗana, wanda nake ƙauna, kai ne kuma kana faranta mini zuciya ƙwarai.”
english: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”

hausa: Na sa al’ummai suka yi rawar jiki da jin ƙarar fāɗuwarsa sa’ad da na yi ƙasa da shi zuwa kabari tare da waɗanda suka gangara rami. Sai dukan itatuwan Eden, zaɓaɓɓu da kuma mafi kyau na Lebanon, dukan itatuwan da aka yi musu banruwa, sun ta’azantu a ƙarƙashin ƙasa.
english: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to Sheol with those who descend into the pit. All the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the lower parts of the earth.

hausa: A wannan dare, Allah ya zo wurin Bala’am ya ce, “Da yake waɗannan mutane sun zo su tafi da kai, to, ka tafi tare da su, sai dai ka yi abin da na ce ka yi ne kaɗai.”
english: God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, “If the men have come to call you, rise up, go with them; but only the word which I speak to you, that you shall do.”

hausa: Yaron Dan shi ne, Hushim.
english: The son of Dan: Hushim.

hausa: Bayan Ishaku ya gama sa masa albarka, Yaƙub yana fita daga mahaifinsa ke nan, sai ga ɗan’uwansa Isuwa ya dawo daga farauta.
english: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

hausa: Dukan fadawan nan naka za su zo wurina, suna fāɗi a gabana suna cewa, ‘Ka fita, kai da dukan jama’arka!’ Sa’an nan zan fita.” Daga nan sai Musa ya fita daga gaban Fir’auna a husace.
english: All these servants of yours will come down to me, and bow down themselves to me, saying, “Get out, with all the people who follow you;” and after that I will go out.’” He went out from Pharaoh in hot anger.

hausa: Sa’ad da fadawan Fir’auna suka gan ta kuwa, sai suka yabe ta wajen Fir’auna, aka kuwa kawo ta cikin fadarsa.
english: The princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.

hausa: Sarki ne da mashawartansa guda bakwai suka aike ka don ka je ka ga halin da Yahuda da Urushalima suke ciki game da dokokin Allahnka, waɗanda suke a hannunka.
english: Because you are sent by the king and his seven counselors to inquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of your God which is in your hand,

hausa: Saboda haka sarki ya sāke aika mahayin doki na biyu. Sa’ad da ya isa wurinsu sai ya ce, “Ga abin da sarki ya ce, ‘Lafiya?’ ” Yehu ya ce, “Ina ruwanka da zancen lafiya? Ka shiga layi.”
english: Then he sent out a second on horseback, who came to them and said, “The king says, ‘Is it peace?’” Jehu answered, “What do you have to do with peace? Fall in behind me!”

hausa: Ƙuri’a ta biyu ta fāɗa a kan kabilar Simeyon, bisa ga iyalansu. Ƙasarsu ta gādo tana cikin yankin Yahuda.
english: The second lot came out for Simeon, even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families. Their inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.

hausa: A wata na goma sha bakwai sai Ishmayel ɗan Netaniya, ɗan Elishama, wanda yake mai jinin sarauta yake kuma ɗaya daga cikin hafsoshin sarki, ya zo tare da mutum goma wurin Gedaliya ɗan Ahikam a Mizfa. Yayinda suke ci tare a can,
english: Now in the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal offspring and one of the chief officers of the king, and ten men with him, came to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they ate bread together in Mizpah.

hausa: Zai sa wuta wa haikalan allolin Masar; zai ƙone haikalansu yă kuma kwashe allolinsu bayi. Kamar yadda makiyayi yakan yafa mayafinsa kewaye da shi, haka zai yafa Masar kewaye da kansa ya kuma tashi a wurin babu abin da ya same shi.
english: I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt. He will burn them, and carry them away captive. He will array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd puts on his garment; and he will go out from there in peace.

hausa: Amma yanzu Ubangiji ya ce, “Cikin shekara uku, kamar yadda bawan da aka bautar da shi bisa ga yarjejjeniya zai lissafta, haka za a mai da daraja da kuma dukan yawan mutanen Mowab abin reni, daga ɗumbun mutanenta, ’yan kaɗan ne kaɗai za su ragu, za su kuma zama marasa ƙarfi.”
english: But now Yahweh has spoken, saying, “Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble.”

hausa: Sai muryar da na ji daga sama ta sāke magana da ni ta ce, “Tafi, ka karɓi naɗaɗɗen littafin da yake a buɗe a hannun mala’ikan da yake tsaye bisa teku da ƙasa.”
english: The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”

hausa: Ya ci gaba, “Abin da yake fitowa daga mutum ne yake ƙazantar da shi.
english: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.

hausa: Ku mayar da rigarsa a fāɗuwar rana saboda yă sami abin rufuwa. Yin haka zai sa yă gode muku, za a kuma ɗauka wannan a matsayin aikin adalci da kuka yi a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: You shall surely restore to him the pledge when the sun goes down, that he may sleep in his garment and bless you. It shall be righteousness to you before Yahweh your God.

hausa: “Ina da dama in yi kome,” sai dai ba kome ba ne yake da amfani. “Ina da dama in yi kome” sai dai ba abin da zai mallake ni.
english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.

hausa: Yayinda suke a babban dutse a Gibeyon, Amasa ya zo don yă tarye su. Yowab kuwa yana sanye da doguwar rigar soja, a ɗamarar da ya sha kuwa akwai wuƙa a cikin kube. Da ya zo gaba sai wuƙar ta zāre daga kube ta fāɗi.
english: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Joab was clothed in his apparel of war that he had put on, and on it was a sash with a sword fastened on his waist in its sheath; and as he went along it fell out.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Na ji mutane da yawa suna raɗa cewa, “Razana ta kowace fuska! Mu kai kararsa! Bari mu kai kararsa!” Dukan abokaina suna jira in yi tuntuɓe, suna cewa, “Mai yiwuwa a ruɗe shi; sai mu yi nasara a kansa mu ɗau fansa a kansa.”
english: For I have heard the defaming of many: “Terror on every side! Denounce, and we will denounce him!” say all my familiar friends, those who watch for my fall. “Perhaps he will be persuaded, and we will prevail against him, and we will take our revenge on him.”

hausa: Shawulu bai ce kome ba a ranar domin ya yi tsammani wataƙila wani abu ya faru da Dawuda ya mai da shi marar tsarki, tabbatacce ba shi da tsarki.
english: Nevertheless Saul didn’t say anything that day, for he thought, “Something has happened to him. He is not clean. Surely he is not clean.”

hausa: Sarauniyar Sheba za tă tashi a ranar shari’a tare da wannan zamani, tă kuwa hukunta shi; don ta zo daga ƙarshen duniya, ta saurari hikimar Solomon, yanzu kuwa ga wanda ya fi Solomon girma a nan.
english: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came again to me, saying,

hausa: ya sa zuriyarsu su mutu a cikin al’ummai ya kuma watsar da su cikin dukan ƙasashe.
english: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.

hausa: Ubangiji yana yin kome domin amfaninsa, har ma da mugaye domin ranar masifa.
english: Yahweh has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.

hausa: Gwauruwa wadda ba ta da kowa da zai taimake ta, za tă sa zuciyarta ga Allah, tana roƙo da addu’o’i dare da rana gare shi don taimako.
english: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.

hausa: Duk mai kunne ji, bari yă ji.
english: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.

hausa: Sai sarki ya aika a kawo Shimeyi, ya ce masa, “Ban sa ka rantse da sunan Ubangiji, na kuma ja maka kunne cewa, ‘A ranar da ka kuskura ka bar nan ka tafi wani wuri, ka tabbata za ka mutu ba’? A lokacin ka ce mini, ‘Abin da ka faɗa yana da kyau. Zan kuwa kiyaye.’
english: The king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, “Didn’t I adjure you by Yahweh and warn you, saying, ‘Know for certain that on the day you go out and walk anywhere else, you shall surely die’? You said to me, ‘The saying that I have heard is good.’

hausa: Sarkin Babilon kuma ya kwashe dukan mayaƙa dubu bakwai, ƙarfafu, shiryayyu don yaƙi, da masu sana’a, da maƙera dubu ɗaya, ya kai Babilon.
english: All the men of might, even seven thousand, and the craftsmen and the smiths one thousand, all of them strong and fit for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

hausa: “Sa’ad da ka faɗa wa waɗannan mutane wannan duka suka kuma tambaye ka, ‘Me ya sa Ubangiji ya ƙaddara irin wannan babban masifa a kanmu? Wace mugunta muka yi? Wane zunubi muka aikata wa Ubangiji Allahnmu?’
english: It will happen, when you tell this people all these words, and they ask you, ‘Why has Yahweh pronounced all this great evil against us?’ or ‘What is our iniquity?’ or ‘What is our sin that we have committed against Yahweh our God?’

hausa: Addinin da Allah Ubanmu ya yarda da shi a matsayin mai tsabta da kuma marar aibi shi ne, a kula da marayu da gwauraye cikin damuwoyinsu, a kuma kiyaye kai daga lalacin da duniya take sa wa.
english: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

hausa: Yahza, Kedemot, Mefa’at,
english: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,

hausa: saboda haka ba za ku ƙara ganin wahayin ƙarya ba, ko ku yi duba. Zan ceci mutanena daga hannuwanku. A sa’an nan za ku san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.’ ”
english: Therefore you shall no more see false visions nor practice divination. I will deliver my people out of your hand. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.’”

hausa: Gama sun ji su suna magana da waɗansu harsuna suna kuma yabon Allah. Sai Bitrus ya ce,
english: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,

hausa: Firist da ya miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa domin wani, zai iya ajiye fatar wa kansa.
english: The priest who offers any man’s burnt offering shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.

hausa: Kaito saboda wannan rana! Gama ranar Ubangiji ta kusa, za tă zo kamar hallaka daga wurin Maɗaukaki.
english: Alas for the day! For the day of Yahweh is at hand, and it will come as destruction from the Almighty.

hausa: Fuska mai fara’a takan kawo farin ciki ga zuciya, kuma labari mai daɗi na kawo lafiya ga ƙasusuwa.
english: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.

hausa: Duba, sarki zai yi mulki cikin adalci masu mulki kuma su yi mulki da adalci.
english: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in justice.

hausa: Mutumin da yake tsammani ya san abu, sanin da yake da shi bai isa ba.
english: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.

hausa: Kada kuma ka rantse da kanka, domin ba za ka iya mai da ko gashi ɗaya yă zama fari ko baƙi ba.
english: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.

hausa: da ginshiƙai kewaye da filin tare da rammuka da turaku da igiyoyinsu.
english: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.

hausa: Suna ƙyamata suna guduna; suna tofa mini miyau a fuska.
english: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ba san ni ba, Filibus, duk da daɗewan nan da na yi tare da ku? Duk wanda ya gan ni, ai, ya ga Uban. Yaya za ka ce, ‘Ka nuna mana Uban’?
english: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, Mai Fansa da kuma Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila gare shi wanda al’ummai suka rena suka kuma ki, ga bawan masu mulki. “Sarakuna za su gan ka su kuma miƙe tsaye, sarakuna za su gani su kuma rusuna, saboda Ubangiji, wanda yake mai aminci, Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila, wanda ya zaɓe ka.”
english: Yahweh, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, says to him whom man despises, to him whom the nation abhors, to a servant of rulers: “Kings shall see and rise up, princes, and they shall worship, because of Yahweh who is faithful, even the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you.”

hausa: Ishaku ya kawo ta cikin tentin mahaifiyarsa Saratu, ya kuma auri Rebeka. Ta haka ta zama matarsa, ya kuwa ƙaunace ta; Ishaku kuma ya ta’azantu bayan rasuwar mahaifiyarsa.
english: Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife. He loved her. So Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.

hausa: “Maganata ba wuta ba ce,” in ji Ubangiji, “kuma kamar gudumar da kan ragargaza dutse?
english: “Isn’t my word like fire?” says Yahweh; “and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces?

hausa: Sa’an nan suka yarda suka karɓe shi a cikin jirgin ruwan, nan da nan kuwa jirgin ya kai gaɓar da za su.
english: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.

hausa: Kada ku haɗa kai da mutanen nan da suke zama cikinku; ba ruwanku da sunayen allolinsu, kada ku rantse da su. Kada kuwa ku bauta musu ko kuwa ku rusuna musu.
english: that you not come among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow down yourselves to them;

hausa: Shawulu ya rantse mata da Ubangiji. Ya ce, “Muddin Ubangiji yana a raye, ba za a hukunta ki a kan wannan ba.”
english: Saul swore to her by Yahweh, saying, “As Yahweh lives, no punishment will happen to you for this thing.”

hausa: gama a can masu kamunmu suka sa mu yi waƙoƙi, masu ba mu azaba suka nema waƙoƙin farin ciki; suka ce, “Ku rera mana ɗaya daga cikin waƙoƙin Sihiyona!”
english: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”

hausa: Ba wani da zai iya ceton ran wani ko yă ba wa Allah kuɗin fansa saboda shi,
english: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.

hausa: “ ‘Ku ƙirga asabbatai bakwai na shekaru bakwai, sau bakwai. Gama asabbatai bakwai na shekaru bakwai za su yi daidai da shekaru arba’in da tara.
english: “‘You shall count off seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and there shall be to you the days of seven Sabbaths of years, even forty-nine years.

hausa: Yonatan bai san cewa mahaifinsa ya sa mutane suka yi rantsuwa ba. Sai ya sa gindin sandan da yake hannunsa a saƙar zuma, ya kai bakinsa. Nan da nan sai ya ji ƙarfin jiki ya zo masa.
english: But Jonathan didn’t hear when his father commanded the people with the oath. Therefore he put out the end of the rod that was in his hand and dipped it in the honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes brightened.

hausa: Da yamman wannan rana, sai makware suka rufe dukan sansani, da safe kuma sai ga raɓa ta kewaye sansani.
english: In the evening, quail came up and covered the camp; and in the morning the dew lay around the camp.

hausa: “Gare ku, ya mutane, nake kira; na tā da muryata ga dukan ’yan adam.
english: “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.

hausa: Ya ku ’ya’yana ƙaunatattu, ina sāke shan wahalar naƙudarku, har sai Kiristi ya kahu a cikinku.
english: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—

hausa: Amma Zadok firist, Benahiya ɗan Yehohiyada, annabi Natan, Shimeyi, Reyi da kuma matsara na musamman na Dawuda ba su bi Adoniya ba.
english: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and the mighty men who belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.

hausa: Gama hikimar duniyan nan, wauta ce a gaban Allah, kamar yadda yake a rubuce cewa, “Yakan kama masu hikima a cikin makircinsu”;
english: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”

hausa: Ban da haka kuma, na zo ne in faɗa in kuma hallaka wannan ƙasa ba tare da Ubangiji ba? Ubangiji kansa ya faɗa mini in tasar wa wannan ƙasa in kuma hallaka ta.’ ”
english: Have I come up now without Yahweh against this land to destroy it? Yahweh said to me, “Go up against this land, and destroy it.”’”

hausa: Ba su ji ƙishi ba sa’ad da ya bishe su a cikin hamada; ya sa ruwa ya malalo dominsu daga dutse; ya tsage dutse ruwa kuwa ya kwararo.
english: They didn’t thirst when he led them through the deserts. He caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them. He also split the rock and the waters gushed out.

hausa: Ku gai da Maryamu wadda ta yi muku aiki tuƙuru.
english: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

hausa: Da Shawulu ya juya zai bar Sama’ila, sai Allah ya canja wa Shawulu zuciya, alamun nan kuwa suka cika a ranar.
english: It was so, that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel, God gave him another heart; and all those signs happened that day.

hausa: Ga abin da za ku ci gaba da faɗa wa annabi, ‘Mece ce amsar Ubangiji gare ka?’ Ko kuwa ‘mene ne Ubangiji ya faɗa?’
english: You will say to the prophet, ‘What has Yahweh answered you?’ and, ‘What has Yahweh spoken?’

hausa: “ ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa a rufe ƙofa ta fili na can cikin da take fuskantar gabas ranaku shida na aiki, amma a ranar Asabbaci da kuma a ranar ganin Sabuwar Wata a buɗe ta.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “The gate of the inner court that looks toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the Sabbath day it shall be opened, and on the day of the new moon it shall be opened.

hausa: A can ku sa Zadok firist, da annabi Natan su shafe shi sarki a bisa Isra’ila. Ku busa ƙaho, ku kuma yi ihu, kuna cewa, ‘Ran Sarki Solomon yă daɗe!’
english: Let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel. Blow the trumpet, and say, ‘Long live King Solomon!’

hausa: Sai almajiran suka ce wa juna, “Shin, ko wani ya kawo masa abinci ne?”
english: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”

hausa: Ku rabu da kowane irin ɗacin rai, haushi da hasala, faɗa da ɓata suna, ku rabu da kowace irin ƙeta.
english: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.

hausa: ya kuma kawo bunsuru ɗaya domin hadaya don zunubi;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Amma in ya sāke bayyana a rigar, ko a tariyar zaren, ko a kayan da aka saƙa, ko a kayan da aka yi da fatar, to, yana yaɗuwa ke nan, kuma dole a ƙone duk abin da yake da cutar rigar da wuta.
english: and if it appears again in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in anything of skin, it is spreading. You shall burn what the plague is in with fire.

hausa: Ya Ubangiji Allahnmu, ka amsa musu; ka kasance wa Isra’ila Allah mai gafartawa, ko da yake ka hukunta ayyukansu marasa kyau.
english: You answered them, Yahweh our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.

hausa: ’Ya’ya maza masu zaluntarku za su zo suna rusunawa a gabanki; dukan waɗanda suka rena ki za su rusuna a ƙafafunki su kuma ce da ke Birnin Ubangiji, Sihiyona na Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila.
english: The sons of those who afflicted you will come bowing to you; and all those who despised you will bow themselves down at the soles of your feet. They will call you Yahweh’s City, the Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

hausa: in suka yi addu’a ko roƙo ta wurin wani daga cikin mutanenka Isra’ila, kowa ya san wahalar zuciyarsa, ya kuma buɗe hannuwansa yana fuskantar wannan haikali,
english: whatever prayer and supplication is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, who shall each know the plague of his own heart, and spread out his hands toward this house,

hausa: Kash, ga hayaniyar al’ummai masu yawa suna hayaniya kamar rurin teku! Kash, ga fushin mutane suna ruri kamar rugugi kamar manyan ruwaye!
english: Ah, the uproar of many peoples who roar like the roaring of the seas; and the rushing of nations that rush like the rushing of mighty waters!

hausa: Ya aikata mugunta a gaban Ubangiji yadda Yehohiyakim ya yi.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

hausa: Ka je wurin Fir’auna da safe, yayinda za shi kogi. Ka jira a bakin Nilu don ka sadu da shi, ka ɗauki sandan nan da ya canja zuwa maciji a hannunka.
english: Go to Pharaoh in the morning. Behold, he is going out to the water. You shall stand by the river’s bank to meet him. You shall take the rod which was turned to a serpent in your hand.

hausa: Don mene ne kake mantawa da mu koyaushe? Me ya sa ka yashe mu da jimawa?
english: Why do you forget us forever, and forsake us for so long a time?

hausa: Bari yă biya maka bukatan ranka yă kuma sa dukan shirye-shiryenka su yi nasara.
english: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.

hausa: kin gina wa kanki ɗakunan sama da gidajen tsafi a kowane dandali.
english: “that you have built for yourselves a vaulted place, and have made yourselves a lofty place in every street.

hausa: Na tuna su sosai, sai kuma na ji ba daɗi a raina.
english: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.

hausa: Sa’an nan zai ɗauki bunsurai biyu yă miƙa su a gaban Ubangiji a ƙofar Tentin Sujada.
english: He shall take the two goats, and set them before Yahweh at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Za a shirya wannan gurasa a gaban Ubangiji kowane Asabbaci, a madadin Isra’ilawa a matsayin madawwamin alkawari.
english: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before Yahweh continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.

hausa: Ka saki fushinka, ka dubi dukan wani mai girman kai ka wulaƙanta shi.
english: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya umarce shi ya ce, “Kada ka gaya wa kowa, amma ka tafi ka nuna kanka ga firist, ka kuma miƙa hadayu da Musa ya umarta, saboda tsarkakewarka ta zama shaida a gare su.”
english: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

hausa: Zai kuma aiko muku da ruwan sama don shuki a ƙasa, kuma abincin da zai fito daga gona zai zama mai albarka da kuma mai yawa. A wannan rana shanu za su yi kiwo a wadatacciyar makiyaya.
english: He will give the rain for your seed, with which you will sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground will be rich and plentiful. In that day, your livestock will feed in large pastures.

hausa: Ku gaskata ni sa’ad da na ce ina cikin Uba, Uba kuma yana cikina. Ko kuwa ku gaskata ni saboda ayyukan banmamakin su kansu.
english: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

hausa: Shekaru arba’in ka riƙe su a cikin hamada; ba su rasa kome ba, rigunansu ba su yage ba, ƙafafunsu kuwa ba su kumbura ba.
english: “Yes, forty years you sustained them in the wilderness. They lacked nothing. Their clothes didn’t grow old, and their feet didn’t swell.

hausa: Me ya sa aka haife ni, aka tanada nono na sha na rayu?
english: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?

hausa: Gama tabbatacce, ya Ubangiji, kakan albarkaci adalai; kakan kewaye su da tagomashinka kamar garkuwa.
english: For you will bless the righteous. Yahweh, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.

hausa: “Ku ji ni, ku da kuka san abin da yake daidai, ku mutanen da kuke da dokata a zukatanku. Kada ku ji tsoron ba’ar da mutane suke yi ko ku firgita saboda zargin da suke yi.
english: “Listen to me, you who know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law. Don’t fear the reproach of men, and don’t be dismayed at their insults.

hausa: Gideyon ya aiki manzanni zuwa dukan ƙasar tudu ta Efraim cewa, “Ku gangaro ku yaƙi Midiyawa ku ƙwace ruwan Urdun gaba da su har zuwa Bet-Bara.” Saboda haka aka kira dukan mutanen Efraim suka ƙwace ruwan Urdun har zuwa Bet-Bara.
english: Gideon sent messengers throughout all the hill country of Ephraim, saying, “Come down against Midian and take the waters before them as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan!” So all the men of Ephraim were gathered together and took the waters as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan.

hausa: Sai Musa ya kira Mishayel da Elzafan, ’ya’yan Uzziyel kawun Haruna, ya ce musu, “Ku zo nan; ku ɗauki ’yan’uwanku waje da sansani, daga gaban wuri mai tsarki.”
english: Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, “Draw near, carry your brothers from before the sanctuary out of the camp.”

hausa: Don me ka kawo jama’ar Ubangiji a wannan hamada, don mu da dabbobinmu mu mutu a nan ke nan?
english: Why have you brought Yahweh’s assembly into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our animals?

hausa: Saboda haka sai Dawuda ya tafi can tare da matansa biyu, Ahinowam daga Yezireyel da Abigiyel gwauruwar Nabal mutumin Karmel.
english: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

hausa: Yanzu ku tsaya nan zan yi fito-na-fito da ku da shaida a gaban Ubangiji kan dukan ayyuka masu alherin da Ubangiji ya aikata saboda ku da kakanninku.
english: Now therefore stand still, that I may plead with you before Yahweh concerning all the righteous acts of Yahweh, which he did to you and to your fathers.

hausa: “Lokacin da mugun ruhu ya fita daga mutum, sai ya bi ta wuraren da ba mutane, yana neman hutu, amma ya kāsa samu, sai ya ce, ‘Zan koma gidan da na bari.’
english: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’

hausa: Sai mutanen suka fita suka dawo da rassa suka kuma yi wa kansu bukkoki a bisa rufin ɗakunansu, a cikin filaye, a shirayin gidan Allah, da ciki dandalin da yake kusa da Ƙofar Ruwa, da kuma a dandalin da yake a Ƙofar Efraim.
english: So the people went out and brought them, and made themselves temporary shelters, everyone on the roof of his house, in their courts, in the courts of God’s house, in the wide place of the water gate, and in the wide place of Ephraim’s gate.

hausa: A rigarsa da kuma a cinyarsa akwai wannan suna a rubuce, Sarkin sarakuna da Ubangijin iyayengiji.
english: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.”

hausa: Sai Iliya ya tuɓe rigarsa, ya nannaɗe ya bugi ruwan Urdun da shi. Sai ruwan ya dāre gida biyu, suka haye a busasshiyar ƙasa.
english: Elijah took his mantle, and rolled it up, and struck the waters; and they were divided here and there, so that they both went over on dry ground.

hausa: Yoshuwa ya ce, “Ku buɗe bakin kogon ku kawo mini sarakunan nan guda biyar.”
english: Then Joshua said, “Open the cave entrance, and bring those five kings out of the cave to me.”

hausa: Aka bayyana kwarin teku, tushen duniya suka tonu. A tsawatawar Ubangiji, da numfashinsa mai ƙarfi daga hancinsa.
english: Then the channels of the sea appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare by Yahweh’s rebuke, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

hausa: sai ya tambaye, su ya ce, “Kun karɓi Ruhu Mai Tsarki sa’ad da kuka gaskata?” Suka amsa suka ce, “A’a, ba mu ma san akwai Ruhu Mai Tsarki ba.”
english: He said to them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed?” They said to him, “No, we haven’t even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”

hausa: Ubangiji kaɗai ya jagorance shi; babu wani baƙon gunkin da yake tare da shi.
english: Yahweh alone led him. There was no foreign god with him.

hausa: “Wannan zai zama alama a gare ka, ya Hezekiya, “Bana, za ku ci amfanin gonar da ya tsira da kansa, baɗi kuma amfanin gonar da ya tsiro daga na bara. Amma a shekara ta uku, za ku yi shuki, ku kuma girbe, ku dasa gonakin inabi, ku kuma ci ’ya’yansa.
english: “This will be the sign to you: This year, you will eat that which grows of itself, and in the second year that which springs from that; and in the third year sow and reap, and plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

hausa: Saboda haka ’yan’uwana, ku ma kun mutu ga dokar ta wurin jikin Kiristi, domin ku zama na wani, gare shi wanda aka tashe shi daga matattu, don mu ba da amfani ga Allah.
english: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might produce fruit to God.

hausa: Shi ne abin yabonku; shi ne Allahnku, wanda ya aikata muku waɗancan manya abubuwa banmamaki masu banrazanar da kuka gani da idanunku.
english: He is your praise, and he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things which your eyes have seen.

hausa: Sai Ishaya ya ce wa Hezekiya, “Ka ji kalmar Ubangiji.
english: Isaiah said to Hezekiah, “Hear Yahweh’s word.

hausa: Kada ka ce, “Zan rama wannan abin da aka yi mini!” Ka dogara ga Ubangiji, zai kuwa fisshe ka.
english: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for Yahweh, and he will save you.

hausa: Zan rurrushe dukan masujadanku, in yanke bagadanku na turare, in yi tarin gawawwakinku a kan gumakanku, zan kuma yi ƙyamarku.
english: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul will abhor you.

hausa: Amma zai zama da lafiya ga duk waɗanda suka hukunta masu laifi, kuma babban albarka zai zo a kansu.
english: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and a rich blessing will come on them.

hausa: Kuma duk wanda ya rantse da haikali, ya rantse ne da shi da kuma wanda yake zaune a cikinsa.
english: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by him who has been living in it.

hausa: Ban da dukan sauran ayyukanku na banƙyama, kun kawo baƙi marasa kaciya a zuciya da jiki a wurina mai tsarki, kun kuma ƙazantar da haikalina yayinda kuke miƙa mini abinci, kitse da kuma jini, kun kuma karya alkawarina.
english: in that you have brought in foreigners, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in my sanctuary, to profane it, even my house, when you offer my bread, the fat and the blood; and they have broken my covenant, to add to all your abominations.

hausa: Ɗakunan da suke can ƙasa suna da ƙofar shiga a wajen gabas in za a shiga cikinsu daga filin da yake waje.
english: From under these rooms was the entry on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court.

hausa: Daga kan duwatsu na gan su, daga bisa kan tuddai na hange su. Na ga mutane da suke zaune su kaɗai ba sa ɗauki kansu ɗaya da al’ummai ba.
english: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be listed among the nations.

hausa: Daga Toruwas muka tashi zuwa teku muka kuma shiga jirgin ruwa muka miƙe kai tsaye zuwa Samotiras, kashegari kuma muka nufi Neyafolis.
english: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;

hausa: Me ya sa kai da mutanenka za ku mutu saboda takobi, yunwa da annoba waɗanda Ubangiji ya yi barazana wa duk al’ummar da ba za tă bauta wa sarkin Babilon ba?
english: Why will you die, you and your people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as Yahweh has spoken concerning the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

hausa: Ubangiji ya buɗe taskar makamansa ya fitar da makaman fushinsa, gama Maɗaukaki Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana da aikin da zai yi a ƙasar Babiloniyawa.
english: Yahweh has opened his armory, and has brought out the weapons of his indignation; for the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, has a work to do in the land of the Chaldeans.

hausa: Yehohiyada ya zaɓi mata biyu dominsa, yana kuma da ’ya’ya maza da ’ya’ya mata.
english: Jehoiada took for him two wives, and he became the father of sons and daughters.

hausa: Zai ɗauki tsuntsu mai rai ya tsoma shi tare da itacen al’ul, jan ƙyalle da kuma hizzob cikin jinin tsuntsun da aka yanka a bisa ruwa mai kyau.
english: As for the living bird, he shall take it, the cedar wood, the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water.

hausa: Saboda haka kada ku saurari annabawanku, masu dubanku, masu fassarar mafarkanku, bokayenku ko masu maitancinku waɗanda suke ce muku, ‘Ba za ku bauta wa sarkin Babilon ba.’
english: But as for you, don’t listen to your prophets, to your diviners, to your dreams, to your soothsayers, or to your sorcerers, who speak to you, saying, “You shall not serve the king of Babylon;”

hausa: Masu gadin Shawulu a Gebiya da take a Benyamin suka duba sai ga rundunar Filistiyawa a warwatsewa ko’ina.
english: The watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked; and behold, the multitude melted away and scattered.

hausa: Zan fāɗa masa sa’ad da yake cikin gajiya da karayar zuciya. Zan firgita shi, mutanen da suke tare da shi kuwa za su gudu. Sarki ne kaɗai zan kashe
english: I will come on him while he is weary and exhausted, and will make him afraid. All the people who are with him will flee. I will strike the king only,

hausa: Za a raba kowane gādo bisa ga rabo tsakanin manyan da ƙanana ƙungiyoyi.”
english: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”

hausa: “Kai kuma ɗan mutum, a ranar da zan ɗauke musu kagararsu, farin cikinsu da darajarsu, abin da idanunsu ke jin daɗin gani, abin da yake faranta musu zuciya, da kuka ’ya’yansu maza da mata,
english: “You, son of man, shouldn’t it be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their heart—their sons and their daughters—

hausa: “Shin, ƙasar ba za tă yi rawan jiki saboda wannan ba, kuma duk masu zama a cikinta ba za su yi makoki ba? Ƙasar duka za tă hau ta sauka kamar Nilu; za a dama ta sa’an nan ta nutse kamar kogin Masar.
english: Won’t the land tremble for this, and everyone mourn who dwells in it? Yes, it will rise up wholly like the River; and it will be stirred up and sink again, like the River of Egypt.

hausa: Zan baza namanka a kan duwatsu in kuma cika kwaruruka da gawarka.
english: I will lay your flesh on the mountains, and fill the valleys with your height.

hausa: Attajiranta masu fitina ne; mutanenta kuma maƙaryata ne harsunansu kuwa suna yaudara.
english: Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their speech.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka sa jeri huɗu na duwatsu masu daraja a bisansa. A jeri na farko akwai yakutu, da tofaz, da zumurrudu;
english: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;

hausa: “A ranan nan za a buɗe maɓulɓulan ruwa zuwa gidan Dawuda da mazaunan Urushalima, don a tsarkake su daga zunubi da rashin tsabta.
english: “In that day there will be a fountain opened to David’s house and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness.

hausa: Sa’an nan ’ya’yan Yaƙub maza suka bi kan gawawwakin, suka washe arzikin birni saboda an ɓata ’yar’uwarsu.
english: Jacob’s sons came on the dead, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.

hausa: Shawulu ya tafi birnin Amalek ya yi kwanto a kwari.
english: Saul came to the city of Amalek, and set an ambush in the valley.

hausa: Sa’ad da Irmiya ya gama faɗa wa mutane dukan maganar Ubangiji Allahnsu, duk abin da Ubangiji ya aike shi ya faɗa musu,
english: When Jeremiah had finished speaking to all the people all the words of Yahweh their God, with which Yahweh their God had sent him to them, even all these words,

hausa: Sai ta cafke shi a riga, ta ce, “Zo ka kwana da ni!” Amma ya bar rigarsa a hannunta, ya gudu ya fita daga gidan.
english: She caught him by his garment, saying, “Lie with me!” He left his garment in her hand, and ran outside.

hausa: Da lokacin Bikin Ƙetarewa na Yahudawa ya yi kusa, sai Yesu ya haura zuwa Urushalima.
english: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

hausa: ba zan yi da Urushalima da siffofinta yadda na yi da Samariya da gumakanta ba?’ ”
english: shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?

hausa: Sai na ga matattu, babba da yaro tsaye a gaban kursiyin, aka kuma buɗe littattafai. Aka buɗe wani littafi, wanda yake shi ne littafin rai. Aka yi wa matattu shari’a bisa ga abin da suka aikata yadda yake a rubuce a cikin littattafai.
english: I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.

hausa: Da kekunan yaƙi dubu ɗaya da ɗari biyu da kuma mahayan dawakai dubu haɗe da mayaƙan Libiyawa, Sukkatawa da kuma Kushawa waɗanda suka wuce ƙidaya suka zo tare da shi daga Masar,
english: with twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen. The people were without number who came with him out of Egypt: the Lubim, the Sukkiim, and the Ethiopians.

hausa: Wannan ita ce ranar da Ubangiji ya yi; bari mu yi farin ciki mu kuma yi murna a cikinta.
english: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

hausa: A wannan rana Ubangiji zai miƙa hannunsa sau na biyu don yă maido da raguwar da ta rage na mutanensa daga Assuriya, daga Masar ta Ƙasa, daga Masar ta Bisa, daga Kush, daga Elam, daga Babiloniya, daga Hamat da kuma daga tsibiran teku.
english: It will happen in that day that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

hausa: A Mawon, akwai wani mutum wanda yake da dukiya a Karmel, mutumin mai arziki ne ƙwarai. Yana da awaki dubu ɗaya, da tumaki dubu uku waɗanda yake wa aski a Karmel.
english: There was a man in Maon whose possessions were in Carmel; and the man was very great. He had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats; and he was shearing his sheep in Carmel.

hausa: da sauran mutane waɗanda mai girma Osnaffar ya kwaso, ya zaunar da su cikin birnin Samariya da sauran wurare na Kewayen Kogin Yuferites.
english: and the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Osnappar brought over and settled in the city of Samaria, and in the rest of the country beyond the River, and so forth, wrote.

hausa: Umarnin gaskiya yana a bakinsa, ba a kuma sami wani ƙarya a leɓunansa ba. Ya yi tafiya tare da ni cikin salama da adalci, ya kuwa juyo da mutane masu yawa daga zunubi.
english: The law of truth was in his mouth, and unrighteousness was not found in his lips. He walked with me in peace and uprightness, and turned many away from iniquity.

hausa: Wawancin mace a bayyane yake; ba ta da ɗa’a kuma ba ta da sani.
english: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.

hausa: “Ku tattaru ku zo; ku taru, ku masu gudun hijira daga al’ummai. Masu jahilci ne waɗanda suke ɗaukan gumakan katakai suna yawo, waɗanda suke addu’a ga allolin da ba za su cece su ba.
english: “Assemble yourselves and come. Draw near together, you who have escaped from the nations. Those have no knowledge who carry the wood of their engraved image, and pray to a god that can’t save.

hausa: Da yamman rana ta goma sha huɗu ga wata, lokacin da suke a Gilgal a filin Yeriko, Isra’ilawa suka yi Bikin Ƙetarewa.
english: The children of Israel encamped in Gilgal. They kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month at evening in the plains of Jericho.

hausa: A cikin dukan addu’o’ina dominku duka, nakan yi addu’a da farin ciki kullum
english: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,

hausa: Amasa kuwa bai lura da wuƙar da take hannun Yowab ba, Yowab kuwa ya soke shi da wuƙar a ciki, hanjinsa suka zube ƙasa. Ba tare da ƙarin suƙa ba, Amasa ya mutu. Sa’an nan Yowab da ɗan’uwansa Abishai suka fafari Sheba ɗan Bikri.
english: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand. So he struck him with it in the body and shed out his bowels to the ground, and didn’t strike him again; and he died. Joab and Abishai his brother pursued Sheba the son of Bichri.

hausa: don a raunana masarautar, kada tă ƙara tashi, amma ta tsaya dai kan cika yarjejjeniyarsa.
english: that the kingdom might be brought low, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.

hausa: Su ne maginan tukwane waɗanda suka zauna a Netayim da Gedera; sun zauna a can suka kuma yi wa sarki aiki.
english: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work.

hausa: Amma ku kawo mini ƙaramin ɗan’uwanku domin in san cewa ku ba ’yan leƙen asiri ba ne, amma mutane ne masu gaskiya. Sa’an nan zan mayar muku da ɗan’uwanku, ku kuma iya yin sana’a a ƙasar.’ ”
english: Bring your youngest brother to me. Then I will know that you are not spies, but that you are honest men. So I will deliver your brother to you, and you shall trade in the land.’”

hausa: Yawan shugabannin iyali a bisa jarumawa sun kai 2,600.
english: The whole number of the heads of fathers’ households, even the mighty men of valor, was two thousand six hundred.

hausa: Bayan da Musa ya gangara wurin mutane, ya tsarkake su, sai suka wanke tufafinsu.
english: Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.

hausa: Mugu abokin gāba yakan kama su duka da ƙugiya, yă jawo su waje da abin kamun kifinsa, yă tattara su cikin ragarsa, ta haka yakan yi murna da farin ciki.
english: He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.

hausa: “ ‘In wani ya ci tsarkakakken abinci cikin kuskure, dole yă maido wa firist hadayar, yă kuma ƙara kashi ɗaya bisa biyar na tamanin abin.
english: “‘If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.

hausa: Mutanen suka ci, suka ƙoshi. Daga baya, almajiran suka tattara gutsattsarin da suka rage cike da kwanduna bakwai.
english: They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

hausa: Ku aiki ɗaya daga cikinku yă kawo ɗan’uwanku; za a sa sauranku a kurkuku, saboda a gwada maganarku a ga ko gaskiya ce kuke faɗi. In ba haka ba, to, da ran Fir’auna, ku ’yan leƙen asiri ne!”
english: Send one of you, and let him get your brother, and you shall be bound, that your words may be tested, whether there is truth in you, or else by the life of Pharaoh surely you are spies.”

hausa: zan tattara dukan al’ummai in kuma kawo su Kwarin Yehoshafat Can zan yi musu shari’a game da gādona, mutanena Isra’ila, gama sun warwatsar da mutanena a cikin al’ummai sun kuma raba ƙasata.
english: I will gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat; and I will execute judgment on them there for my people, and for my heritage, Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations. They have divided my land,

hausa: Bai kuwa shiga sama domin yă yi ta miƙa kansa a kai a kai, yadda babban firist yake shiga Wuri Mafi Tsarki kowace shekara da jinin da ba nasa ba.
english: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,

hausa: Sa’ad da Maryamu ta kai inda Yesu yake, ta kuma gan shi, sai ta fāɗi a gabansa ta ce, “Ubangiji, da kana nan, da ɗan’uwana bai mutu ba.”
english: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”

hausa: Sa’an nan girgije ya rufe Tentin Sujada sai ɗaukakar Ubangiji ta cika tabanakul.
english: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and Yahweh’s glory filled the tabernacle.

hausa: daga cikin hasken kasancewarsa gizagizai suka yi gaba, da ƙanƙara da kuma walƙiya.
english: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.

hausa: Da Sama’ila ya kai wurinsa, sai Shawulu ya ce, “Ubangiji yă albarkace ka, na aikata umarnin Ubangiji.”
english: Samuel came to Saul; and Saul said to him, “You are blessed by Yahweh! I have performed the commandment of Yahweh.”

hausa: Kaiton wanda yake cewa mahaifinsa, ‘Me ka manta?’ Ko kuwa ga mahaifiyarsa, ‘Me kin haifa?’
english: Woe to him who says to a father, ‘What have you become the father of?’ or to a mother, ‘What have you given birth to?’”

hausa: ’Ya’yan Yada maza, ɗan’uwan Shammai su ne, Yeter da Yonatan. Yeter ya mutu babu yara.
english: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.

hausa: Sun shiga Ayiyat; sun bi ta Migron; sun adana tanade-tanade a Mikmash.
english: He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.

hausa: Amma in muna tafiya cikin haske, yadda yake cikin haske, muna da zumunci da juna ke nan, kuma jinin Yesu, Ɗansa, yana tsarkake mu daga dukan zunubi.
english: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.

hausa: Suka yi ihu suka ce, “Me ya haɗa ka da mu, Ɗan Allah?” Ka zo ne nan don ka ji mana kafin lokaci yă yi?
english: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”

hausa: Bari fiffitawata tă zo daga gare ka; bari idanunka su ga abin da yake daidai.
english: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Elifaz maza su ne, Teman, Omar, Zefo, Gatam da Kenaz.
english: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

hausa: sa’ad da suka ga rayuwarku mai tsabta da kuma na ladabi.
english: seeing your pure behavior in fear.

hausa: A gefen kudu, wanda yake da tsawon kamu 4,500, zai kasance da ƙofofi uku, ƙofar Simeyon, ƙofar Issakar da ƙofar Zebulun.
english: “At the south side four thousand five hundred reeds by measure, and three gates: the gate of Simeon, one; the gate of Issachar, one; the gate of Zebulun, one.

hausa: ’Ya’yan itacen adali itacen rai ne, kuma duk mai samun rayuka mai hikima ne.
english: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.

hausa: A rana ta takwas, sai suka zo don a yi wa yaron kaciya, dā za su sa masa sunan mahaifinsa Zakariya ne,
english: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

hausa: A farkon fari ka kafa tushen duniya, sammai kuma aikin hannuwanka ne.
english: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.

hausa: Sun sa kukan matalauta ya kai wurinsa yadda ya kai ga jin kukan masu bukata.
