english: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.

hausa: “Ka yi musu wannan magana, “ ‘Bari idanuna su yi ta zub da hawaye dare da rana kada su daina; saboda ’yata budurwa, mutanena, sun sha wahalar babban rauni, an yi musu bugu mai ragargazawa.
english: “You shall say this word to them: “‘Let my eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease; for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous wound.

hausa: Bari taron mutane su taru kewaye da kai. Ka yi mulki a bisansu daga bisa;
english: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.

hausa: Da ƙwayan ya nuna, sai yă sa lauje yă yanka, domin lokacin girbi ya yi.”
english: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”

hausa: Teku zai malalo a kan Babilon, raƙumansa masu hauka za su rufe ta.
english: The sea has come up on Babylon. She is covered with the multitude of its waves.

hausa: sai ta ce wa Ibrahim, “Ka kori baiwan nan tare da ɗanta, saboda ɗan baiwan nan ba zai taɓa raba gādo da ɗana Ishaku ba.”
english: Therefore she said to Abraham, “Cast out this servant and her son! For the son of this servant will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”

hausa: ta ga abincin da yake teburinsa, ta ga zaman fadawansa, bayi masu yin masa hidima cikin rigunansu, ta ga masu riƙe kwaf cikin rigunansu da kuma hadayun ƙonawar da ya yi a haikalin Ubangiji, sai mamaki ya kama ta.
english: the food of his table, the seating of his servants, the attendance of his ministers, their clothing, his cup bearers and their clothing, and his ascent by which he went up to Yahweh’s house, there was no more spirit in her.

hausa: Hezro, mutumin Karmel, Fa’arai, mutumin Arbi,
english: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

hausa: A cikin mahaifa ya cafke ɗiɗɗigen ɗan’uwansa; a matsayin mutum ya yi kokawa da Allah.
english: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, and in his manhood he contended with God.

hausa: “Zo, ya ke Sihiyona! Ku tsere, ku masu zama a cikin Diyar Babilon!”
english: ‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.’

hausa: Su ba kome ba ne, aikin ruɗami ne; Sa’ad da hukuncinsu ya yi za su lalace.
english: They are vanity, a work of delusion. In the time of their visitation they will perish.

hausa: Sai Yowab da ƙungiyoyin mayaƙan da suke tare da shi suka matso don su yi yaƙi da Arameyawa, Arameyawan kuwa suka gudu a gabansa.
english: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.

hausa: Hezekiya ya tambayi firistoci da Lawiyawa game da tsibin;
english: Then Hezekiah questioned the priests and the Levites about the heaps.

hausa: domin ba su kiyaye dokokina ba amma suka ƙi ƙa’idodina suka kuma ƙazantar da Asabbataina, idanunsu suka yi sha’awar gumakan kakanninsu.
english: because they had not executed my ordinances, but had rejected my statutes, and had profaned my Sabbaths, and their eyes were after their fathers’ idols.

hausa: Sai ka yi wa jama’a iyaka kewaye da dutsen, ka kuma faɗa musu cewa, ‘Ku mai da hankali, kada ku hau dutsen ko ku taɓa gefensa. Duk wanda ya taɓa dutsen, lalle za a kashe shi.
english: You shall set bounds to the people all around, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t go up onto the mountain, or touch its border. Whoever touches the mountain shall be surely put to death.

hausa: “Ku ɗauki wannan Littafin Doka ku sa shi kusa da akwatin alkawarin Ubangiji Allahnku. A can zai kasance a matsayin shaida a kanku.
english: “Take this book of the law, and put it by the side of the ark of Yahweh your God’s covenant, that it may be there for a witness against you.

hausa: Kaleb ɗan Yefunne, daga kabilar Yahuda;
english: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

hausa: Dattijon nan, Zuwa ga uwargida zaɓaɓɓiya da kuma ’ya’yanta, waɗanda nake ƙauna ƙwarai da gaske kuma ba ni kaɗai ba, amma har da dukan waɗanda suka san gaskiya.
english: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,

hausa: Amma Musa da Haruna suka fāɗi rubda ciki suka tā da murya suka ce, “Ya Allah, Allahn ruhohin dukan ’yan adam, za ka husata da dukan taron ne, bayan mutum ɗaya ne ya yi zunubi?”
english: They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry with all the congregation?”

hausa: Da iko mai ƙarfi manzanni suka ci gaba da shaidar tashin matattu na Ubangiji Yesu, alheri mai yawa kuwa yana bisansu duka.
english: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.

hausa: Sai Allah ya dubi Isra’ilawa, ya kuma damu da su.
english: God saw the children of Israel, and God understood.

hausa: Sa’ad da masu zarginsa suka tashi tsaye don su yi magana, ba su zarge shi da wani laifin da na yi tsammani ba.
english: When the accusers stood up, they brought no charges against him of such things as I supposed;

hausa: Yowab ya ce, “In Arameyawa suka fi ni ƙarfi, sai ka kawo mini ɗauke da ni; amma in Ammonawa sun fi ka ƙarfi, sai in kawo maka ɗauke.
english: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you are to help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.

hausa: Bayan girgizar ƙasa, sai ga wuta, amma Ubangiji ba ya cikin wuta. Bayan wutar kuma sai ga wata ’yar murya.
english: After the earthquake a fire passed; but Yahweh was not in the fire. After the fire, there was a still small voice.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Mutumin da ake kira Yesu ne ya kwaɓa laka ya shafa mini a idanu. Ya ce mini in je Silowam in wanke. Na kuwa tafi, na wanke, sai na sami ganin gari.”
english: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”

hausa: Sai Shekem ya ce wa mahaifin Dina da kuma ’yan’uwanta. “Bari in sami tagomashi a idanunku, zan kuwa ba ku duk abin da kuka tambaya.
english: Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, “Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you will tell me I will give.

hausa: Kuna kwanciya a kan gadajen da aka yi musu shimfiɗar hauren giwa kuna mimmiƙe a kan kujerunku. Kuna cin naman ƙibabbun raguna da na ƙosassun ’yan maruƙa.
english: who lie on beds of ivory, and stretch themselves on their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the middle of the stall,

hausa: Sarki Solomon ya ba wa sarauniyar Sheba dukan abin da take so, da kuma duk abin da ta nema, ban da abin da ya ba ta daga yalwar fadan sarki. Sa’an nan ta koma tare da tawagarta zuwa ƙasarta.
english: King Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, in addition to that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own land, she and her servants.

hausa: Bezalel ya yi akwatin alkawari da itacen ƙirya, tsawonsa kamu biyu da rabi, fāɗinsa kamu ɗaya da rabi, tsayinsa kamu ɗaya da rabi.
english: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits, and its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

hausa: Ga shi za ki yi ciki ki kuma haifi ɗa, za ki kuma ba shi suna Yesu.
english: Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’

hausa: zuwa Dibon, Nebo da Bet-Dibilatayim,
english: on Dibon, on Nebo, on Beth Diblathaim,

hausa: Su Amoriyawa kuma suka dāge su zauna a Dutsen-Heres, Aiyalon, da Sha’albim. Amma yayinda mutanen Yusuf suka ƙara ƙarfi, sai suka su yin musu aikin gandu.
english: but the Amorites would dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim. Yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to forced labor.

hausa: Yohanna fitila ne da ya ci ya kuma ba da haske, kun kuwa zaɓa ku ji daɗin haskensa na ɗan lokaci.
english: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.

hausa: A shekara ta goma sha biyar ta mulkin Kaisar Tiberiyus, a lokacin Buntus Bilatus ne gwamnar Yahudiya, Hiridus kuma yana sarautar Galili, ɗan’uwansa Filibus yana sarautar Ituriya da Tarakunitis, Lisaniyas kuma yana sarautar Abiline.
english: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Don me kuke nemana? Ba ku san cewa, dole in kasance a gidan Ubana ba?”
english: He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”

hausa: Kada a sami yisti a gidajenku har kwana bakwai. Kuma duk wanda ya ci wani abu mai yisti, za a fid da shi daga taron jama’ar Isra’ila, ko baƙo ne, ko haifaffen ɗan ƙasa.
english: There shall be no yeast found in your houses for seven days, for whoever eats that which is leavened, that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he is a foreigner, or one who is born in the land.

hausa: Gobe ku fito ku gangara ku yaƙe su. Za su yi ta haurawa ta Mashigin Ziz, ku kuwa za ku same su a ƙarshen kwari a Hamadan Yeruwel.
english: Tomorrow, go down against them. Behold, they are coming up by the ascent of Ziz. You will find them at the end of the valley, before the wilderness of Jeruel.

hausa: Mutanen da suke zama a Samariya suna tsoro saboda gunki maraƙin Bet-Awen. Mutanensa za su yi makokinsa, haka ma firistocinsa matsafa, waɗanda suka yi farin ciki a kan darajarsa, don an ɗauke ta daga gare su aka kai ta zaman bauta.
english: The inhabitants of Samaria will be in terror for the calves of Beth Aven, for its people will mourn over it, along with its priests who rejoiced over it, for its glory, because it has departed from it.

hausa: A teburina za ku ci iya ƙoshiyarku da naman jama’a da kuma mahaya, manyan mutane da sojoji na kowane iri,’ in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: You shall be filled at my table with horses and charioteers, with mighty men, and with all men of war,” says the Lord Yahweh.’

hausa: Amma suka yi masa maƙarƙashiya, kuma ta wurin umarnin sarki suka jajjefe shi da duwatsu har ya mutu a filin haikalin Ubangiji.
english: They conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of Yahweh’s house.

hausa: “Tafi ka yi shela a kunnuwar Urushalima cewa, “ ‘Na tuna da amincin ƙuruciyarki, yadda kamar amarya kika ƙaunace ni kika kuma bi ni cikin hamada, cikin ƙasar da ba a yi shuka ba.
english: “Go and proclaim in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “I remember for you the kindness of your youth, your love as a bride, how you went after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.

hausa: Sau da yawa Yahudawan da suke da zama kusa da abokan gābanmu sun yi ta zuwa suna yin mana magana, suna cewa “Ko’ina muka juya, za su fāɗa mana.”
english: When the Jews who lived by them came, they said to us ten times from all places, “Wherever you turn, they will attack us.”

hausa: Ka tuba daga wannan mugunta ka kuma yi addu’a ga Ubangiji. Wataƙila zai gafarta maka don irin tunanin da yake a zuciyarka.
english: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.

hausa: Allah ya tashe mu tare da Kiristi, ya kuma ba mu wurin zama tare da shi a cikin mulkin samaniya.
english: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

hausa: Sa’ad da Lamek ya yi shekara 182, sai ya haifi ɗa.
english: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.

hausa: Ku mai da hankali, ku marasa azanci a cikin mutane; ku wawaye, yaushe za ku zama masu hikima?
english: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?

hausa: Ka tashi, ya Ubangiji, cikin fushinka; ka tashi gāba da fushin abokan gābana. Ka farka, Allahna, ka umarta adalci.
english: Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.

hausa: Sa’ad da mutumin ya tashi zai tafi, sai surukinsa ya roƙe shi, saboda haka ya kwana a wannan dare.
english: The man rose up to depart; but his father-in-law urged him, and he stayed there again.

hausa: Bari Allah na salama, wanda ta wurin jinin madawwamin alkawari ya tā da Ubangijinmu Yesu daga matattu, wannan Makiyayin tumaki mai girma,
english: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,

hausa: A ƙofar gidansa kuma akan ajiye wani mai bara, mai suna Lazarus, wanda jikinsa duk gyambuna ne.
english: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was taken to his gate, full of sores,

hausa: “A wannan rana zan kira bawana, Eliyakim ɗan Hilkiya.
english: It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,

hausa: Saboda haka, tun lokacin da na ji labarin bangaskiyarku cikin Ubangiji Yesu da kuma ƙaunar da kuke yi wa dukan mutanen Allah,
english: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints,

hausa: Da lokaci ya kai da Merab ’yar Shawulu za tă yi aure da Dawuda, sai aka aurar da ita wa Adriyel na Mehola.
english: But at the time when Merab, Saul’s daughter, should have been given to David, she was given to Adriel the Meholathite as wife.

hausa: Amma sai suka ci gaba da ihu, suna cewa, “A gicciye shi! A gicciye shi!”
english: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”

hausa: Zai kuma ba da Isra’ila saboda zunuban da Yerobowam ya yi, da ya kuma sa Isra’ila suka yi.”
english: He will give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam, which he has sinned, and with which he has made Israel to sin.”

hausa: Ya yi wannan ne domin dukan mutanen duniya su san cewa Ubangiji mai iko ne, domin kuma ku zama masu tsoron Ubangiji Allahnku.”
english: that all the peoples of the earth may know that Yahweh’s hand is mighty, and that you may fear Yahweh your God forever.’”

hausa: Biye da su, mutanen Tekowa suka yi gyaran wani sashe, daga babbar doguwar hasumiya zuwa katangar Ofel.
english: After him the Tekoites repaired another portion, opposite the great tower that stands out, and to the wall of Ophel.

hausa: Na ga ya kamata in jawo hankalinka ga batun in kuma ba da shawara ka saye shi a gaban waɗannan da suke zazzaune a nan da kuma a gaban dattawan jama’a. In kana so ka fanshe shi, to, sai ka yi. Amma in ba za ka yi ba, sai ka faɗa mini, don in sani. Gama babu wani mai izinin yin haka sai kai, ni ne kuwa na biye.” Sai ya ce, “Zan fansa.”
english: I thought I should tell you, saying, ‘Buy it before those who sit here, and before the elders of my people.’ If you will redeem it, redeem it; but if you will not redeem it, then tell me, that I may know. For there is no one to redeem it besides you; and I am after you.” He said, “I will redeem it.”

hausa: Da Gehazi ya isa wani tudu, sai ya karɓi kayan daga wurin bayin ya shiga da su a ɓoye a cikin gida. Sa’an nan ya sallami mutanen suka tafi.
english: When he came to the hill, he took them from their hand, and stored them in the house. Then he let the men go, and they departed.

hausa: Saboda haka sai ya tafi Zarefat. Sa’ad da ya isa ƙofar gari, sai ga wata gwauruwa tana tattara ’yan itace. Sai ya kira ta, ya ce, “Ki kawo mini ɗan ruwa a tulu don in sha.”
english: So he arose and went to Zarephath; and when he came to the gate of the city, behold, a widow was there gathering sticks. He called to her and said, “Please get me a little water in a jar, that I may drink.”

hausa: Kai, tun haihuwa mugaye sukan kauce; daga cikin ciki, su lalatattu ne maƙaryata.
english: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

hausa: In mahaifinka bai gan ni ba, ka gaya masa cewa, ‘Dawuda ya nemi izinina domin yă hanzarta yă tafi garinsa a Betlehem saboda ana hadaya ta shekara-shekara don dukan zuriyarsa.’
english: If your father misses me at all, then say, ‘David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Bethlehem, his city; for it is the yearly sacrifice there for all the family.’

hausa: Yesu ya ce musu, “Na yi abin banmamaki ɗaya, dukanku kuwa kuka yi mamaki.
english: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.

hausa: Saboda haka matalauta suna da bege, rashin gaskiya kuma ta yi shiru.
english: So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.

hausa: maganar mutumin da ya saurari maganar Allah, maganar wanda yake ganin wahayi daga Maɗaukaki, mutumin da ya fāɗi rubda ciki, wanda kuma idanunsa suna a buɗe.
english: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

hausa: Ba za ka sāke raya mu ba, don mutanenka su yi farin ciki a cikinka?
english: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

hausa: Sa’an nan aka kawo yara ƙanana wurin Yesu don yă ɗibiya musu hannuwansa, yă kuma yi musu addu’a. Amma almajirai suka tsawata wa waɗanda suka kawo su.
english: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.

hausa: Amma Musa ya ce wa Allah, “Wane ni in tafi wurin Fir’auna, in kuma fitar da Isra’ilawa daga Masar?”
english: Moses said to God, “Who am I, that I should go to Pharaoh, and that I should bring the children of Israel out of Egypt?”

hausa: Gama a cikin Kiristi Yesu, kaciya ko rashin kaciya ba su da wani amfani. Abin da kawai yake da amfani shi ne, bangaskiyar da take bayyana kanta ta wurin ƙauna.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.

hausa: Da yamma sai suka tashi suka tafi sansanin Arameyawa. Yayinda suka shiga tsakiyar sansanin Arameyawa kuwa, sai suka tarar ba kowa a can,
english: They rose up in the twilight to go to the camp of the Syrians. When they had come to the outermost part of the camp of the Syrians, behold, no man was there.

hausa: Zan nemi ɓatattuna in kuma dawo da waɗanda suka yi makuwa. Zan ɗaura raunin waɗanda suka ji ciwo in kuma ƙarfafa marasa ƙarfi, amma zan hallaka ƙarfafa da kuma masu ƙiba. Zan yi kiwo tumaki da adalci.
english: “I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick; but I will destroy the fat and the strong. I will feed them in justice.”’

hausa: Sa’ad da sarkin yaƙin ya ji cewa sarkin Assuriya ya bar Lakish, sai ya janye ya kuma sami sarki yana yaƙi da Libna.
english: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah, for he heard that he had departed from Lachish.

hausa: “ ‘Yanzu kuwa sai ku yi la’akari da wannan daga wannan rana zuwa gaba, ku tuna yadda al’amura suke kafin a ɗora wani dutse bisa wani a haikalin Ubangiji.
english: Now, please consider from this day and backward, before a stone was laid on a stone in Yahweh’s temple.

hausa: Ishmayel ɗansa kuma yana da shekara goma sha uku.
english: Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

hausa: Shawulu kuwa yana can, yana tabbatar da mutuwarsa. A wannan rana wani babban tsanani ya auka wa ikkilisiyar da take a Urushalima, sai duka suka warwatsu ko’ina a Yahudiya da Samariya, manzanni kaɗai ne suka rage.
english: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.

hausa: “Ku fāɗa wa ƙasar Meratayim da waɗanda suke zama a Fekod. Ku fafara, ku kashe kuma hallaka su sarai,” in ji Ubangiji. “Ku aikata dukan abin da na umarce ku.
english: “Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod. Kill and utterly destroy after them,” says Yahweh, “and do according to all that I have commanded you.

hausa: Ubangiji zai ji daɗin hadayar raguna dubbai da kuma rafuffukan mai dubbai goma? Zan ba da ɗan farina ne don laifina, ko ’ya’yan jikina domin zunubin raina?
english: Will Yahweh be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

hausa: Hannatu kuwa ta sami alfarma daga Ubangiji. Ta yi ciki. Ana cikin haka Sama’ila kuwa sai girma yake ta yi a gaban Ubangiji.
english: Yahweh visited Hannah, and she conceived and bore three sons and two daughters. The child Samuel grew before Yahweh.

hausa: Duk macen da ta yi addu’a ko annabci da kanta a buɗe kuwa ta rena kanta, ya zama kamar an aske kanta ke nan.
english: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.

hausa: da kuma don kumburi, ɓamɓaroki ko tabo,
english: and for a swelling, and for a scab, and for a bright spot;

hausa: Sa’an nan zan ce musu a fili, ‘Ban taɓa saninku ba. Ku rabu da ni, ku masu aikata mugunta!’
english: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’

hausa: A lokacin nan sai Menahem ya taso daga Tirza, ya kai wa Tifsa hari da kowa wanda yake a birnin da kewayenta, don sun ƙi su buɗe ƙofofinsu. Ya kori Tifsa daga aiki, ya kuma tsattsaga cikin dukan mata masu juna biyu.
english: Then Menahem attacked Tiphsah and all who were in it and its border areas, from Tirzah. He attacked it because they didn’t open their gates to him, and he ripped up all their women who were with child.

hausa: Solomon kuwa ya sāke gina Gezer.) Ya gina Bet-Horon ta Kwari,
english: Solomon built in the land Gezer, Beth Horon the lower,

hausa: Saboda haka mai gadin ya sa Yusuf ya zama shugaban dukan waɗanda aka tsare a kurkukun, Yusuf ne kuma yake lura da dukan abin da ake yi a can.
english: The keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners who were in the prison. Whatever they did there, he was responsible for it.

hausa: Abin da kuka faɗa a cikin duhu, za a ji shi a hasken rana. Kuma abin da kuka faɗa a kunne, a cikin ɗakunan ciki-ciki, za a yi shelarsa daga kan rufin ɗakuna.
english: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.

hausa: Ya kuma haifi ’ya’ya maza bakwai, mata uku.
english: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

hausa: Sai Rezin sarkin Aram, da Feka ɗan Remaliya sarkin Isra’ila suka haura don su kai wa Urushalima hari, suka kuma kewaye Ahaz, amma ba su iya shan ƙarfinsa ba.
english: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel came up to Jerusalem to wage war. They besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.

hausa: Ku yi farin ciki a cikin Ubangiji ku kuma yi murna, ku adalai; ku rera, dukanku waɗanda zuciyarku take daidai!
english: Be glad in Yahweh, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!

hausa: Ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, kai Allah ne! Maganarka da aminci take, ka kuma yi wa bawanka waɗannan abubuwa masu kyau.
english: “Now, O Lord Yahweh, you are God, and your words are truth, and you have promised this good thing to your servant.

hausa: Benahiya da Yahaziyel firistoci za su busa ƙahoni kullum a gaban akwatin alkawarin Allah.
english: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce mini, “Ɗan mutum, ka lura sosai, ka saurara sosai ka kuma mai da hankali ga kome da na faɗa maka game da dukan ƙa’idodi game da haikalin Ubangiji. Ka lura sosai da ƙofar shigar haikali da kuma dukan ƙofofin wuri mai tsarki.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Son of man, mark well, and see with your eyes, and hear with your ears all that I tell you concerning all the ordinances of Yahweh’s house and all its laws; and mark well the entrance of the house, with every exit of the sanctuary.

hausa: Kuma in na ce wa mugu, ‘Tabbatacce za ka mutu,’ amma sai ya juye daga zunubinsa ya kuma yi abin da yake gaskiya da kuma daidai,
english: Again, when I say to the wicked, “You will surely die,” if he turns from his sin and does that which is lawful and right,

hausa: Suka dalaye saman da dukan gefe-gefen da kuma ƙahonin da zinariya zalla, suka kuma yi zubin zinariya kewaye da shi.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.

hausa: Saboda haka aka kira wannan wuri Tabera, gama a wurin ne wuta daga Ubangiji ta ƙuna a cikinsu.
english: The name of that place was called Taberah, because Yahweh’s fire burned among them.

hausa: Taron yana zaune kewaye da shi, sai suka ce masa, “Mahaifiyarka da ’yan’uwanka suna waje, suna nemanka.”
english: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”

hausa: Ba kuwa saboda aikin lada ba, don kada wani yă ɗaga kai.
english: not of works, that no one would boast.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya rarraba abinci, da ƙosai, dabino, da waina ga kowane mutum a cikin dukan jama’ar Isra’ila, maza da mata. Dukan mutane kuwa suka watse zuwa gidajensu.
english: He gave to all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, both to men and women, to everyone a portion of bread, dates, and raisins. So all the people departed, each to his own house.

hausa: Zan saurari abin da Allah Ubangiji zai faɗa; ya yi alkawarin salama ga mutanensa, tsarkakansa, amma kada su koma ga wauta.
english: I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

hausa: Gama mutum zai yi aikinsa da dukan hikimarsa, da saninsa, da gwanintarsa, sa’an nan dole yă bar dukan abin da ya mallaka ga wani wanda bai yi wahalar kome a ciki ba. Wannan ma ba shi da amfani, hasara ce mai yawa.
english: For there is a man whose labor is with wisdom, with knowledge, and with skillfulness; yet he shall leave it for his portion to a man who has not labored for it. This also is vanity and a great evil.

hausa: A gaskiya, ba ko ɗaya daga cikin bakwai ɗin da ya bar ’ya’ya. Daga ƙarshe, macen ta mutu.
english: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.

hausa: Gama karuwa takan mai da kai kamar burodin kyauta, mazinaciya kuma takan farauci ranka.
english: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku, maigidan zai ba shi riƙon dukan dukiyarsa.
english: Truly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa ya yi musu ƙuri’a a gaban Ubangiji, a nan ne ya raba wa Isra’ilawa ƙasar bisa ga yadda aka raba su kabila-kabila.
english: Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before Yahweh. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.

hausa: Ya haifi Abitub da Efa’al ta wurin Hushim.
english: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.

hausa: a ciki ina kamar ruwan inabi wanda aka rufe a cikin kwalaba, kamar sabuwar salkar ruwan inabi mai shirin fashewa.
english: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.

hausa: “Ka umarci Isra’ilawa su kawo tsabtataccen mai na zaitun da aka matse, don ƙuna fitilun yadda harshen wutar ba zai taɓa mutuwa ba.
english: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

hausa: shi dā ma bai yarda da shawararsu, da kuma abin da suka yi ba. Shi daga Arimateya ne wani garin Yahudiya. Yana kuma jiran zuwa mulkin Allah.
english: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for God’s Kingdom.

hausa: Yoshuwa ya kira mutanen Ruben, mutanen Gad, da rabin kabilar Manasse
english: Then Joshua called the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh,

hausa: Suka amsa wa Yoshuwa suka ce, “An gaya wa bayinka dalla-dalla yadda Ubangiji Allahnka ya umarci bawansa Musa yă ba ka ƙasar duka, ka kuma kashe duk masu zama a cikinta, muka ji tsoro cewa za ka kashe mu shi ya sa muka yi haka.
english: They answered Joshua, and said, “Because your servants were certainly told how Yahweh your God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land, and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you. Therefore we were very afraid for our lives because of you, and have done this thing.

hausa: Bulus, bawan Kiristi Yesu, kirayaye don yă zama manzo, keɓaɓɓe kuma domin bisharar Allah.
english: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,

hausa: Musa ya tashi ya tafi wurin Datan da Abiram, dattawan Isra’ilawa kuwa suka bi shi.
english: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

hausa: Ko ka san yadda gizagizai suke tsayawa cik a sararin sama, waɗannan abubuwa al’ajabi na mai cikakken sani.
english: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

hausa: Na sha wahala sosai; ka kiyaye raina, ya Ubangiji, bisa ga maganarka.
english: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your word.

hausa: Ya ce, “Wannan shi ne jinin alkawarin da Allah ya umarce ku ku kiyaye.”
english: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.”

hausa: Akan yabi mutum bisa ga hikimarsa, amma mutane marasa azanci akan rena su.
english: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.

hausa: “Tare da babbar rundunar mayaƙa zai yi ƙarfin hali yă far wa sarkin Kudu da yaƙi. Sarkin kudu zai haɗa babbar rundunar soja mai ƙarfi don yaƙin, amma ba zai iya karo da shi ba, domin za a shirya masa maƙarƙashiya.
english: “He will stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south will wage war in battle with an exceedingly great and mighty army, but he won’t stand; for they will devise plans against him.

hausa: Amma waɗansu suka ce, “Kai, waɗannan kalmomi ba na mai aljani ba ne. Anya, aljani yana iya buɗe idanun makaho?”
english: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”

hausa: Sa’ad da Mordekai ya sami labari game da dukan abin da aka yi, sai ya yayyage rigunansa, ya sanya tsummokin makoki, ya zuba toka a kā, ya kuma shiga ciki birni yana kuka mai zafi da ƙarfi.
english: Now when Mordecai found out all that was done, Mordecai tore his clothes and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out into the middle of the city, and wailed loudly and bitterly.

hausa: Wata rana, baƙin da suke cikinsu, suka fara kwaɗayin waɗansu abinci, har suka sa Isra’ilawa suka fara kuka, suna cewa, “Da mun sami nama mun ci mana!
english: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly; and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us meat to eat?

hausa: Bayan sarauta ta kahu a ƙarƙashinsa, sai ya kashe hafsoshin da suka kashe mahaifinsa sarki.
english: Now when the kingdom was established to him, he killed his servants who had killed his father the king.

hausa: Dukan waɗanda suka dogara ga kiyaye Doka la’anannu ne, gama a rubuce yake cewa, “La’ananne ne duk wanda bai ci gaba da yi dukan abubuwan da aka rubuta a Littafin Doka ba.”
english: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”

hausa: bari ƙaya ta fito a maimakon alkama ciyawa kuma a maimakon sha’ir.” Maganar Ayuba ta ƙare.
english: let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.

hausa: Na ƙi mutane masu baki biyu, amma ina ƙauna dokarka.
english: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.

hausa: Yayinda mutumin yana tsaye kusa da ni, na ji wani yana magana da ni daga cikin haikalin.
english: I heard one speaking to me out of the house, and a man stood by me.

hausa: Tsoron Ubangiji ya kama dukan masarautun ƙasashen da suke kewaye da Yahuda, har ba su yi yaƙi da Yehoshafat ba.
english: The fear of Yahweh fell on all the kingdoms of the lands that were around Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.

hausa: Ka yi alheri ga bawanka, zan kuwa rayu; zan yi biyayya da maganarka.
english: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.

hausa: Sa’ad da Kiristi, wanda shi ne ranku, ya bayyana, ku ma za ku bayyana tare da shi cikin ɗaukaka.
english: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

hausa: Da ya gama magana, sai ya jefar da muƙamuƙin; aka ba wa wannan wuri suna Ramat Lehi.
english: When he had finished speaking, he threw the jawbone out of his hand; and that place was called Ramath Lehi.

hausa: “Sa’ad da an kai ku a gaban majami’u, da gaban masu mulki, da kuma gaban masu iko, kada ku damu da yadda za ku kāre kanku, ko kuma abin da za ku faɗa,
english: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will answer or what you will say;

hausa: Ɗaya daga cikin mutanen ya shiga gona don neman ganyaye, ya kuwa sami kabewar jeji. Ya tsinko ’ya’yanta cike da shafin rigarsa. Da ya dawo, sai ya yayyanka su ya zuba a cikin tukunyar faten, ko da yake ba wanda ya san ko mene ne.
english: One went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered a lap full of wild gourds from it, and came and cut them up into the pot of stew; for they didn’t recognize them.

hausa: Bayan kusan awa uku, sai matarsa ta shigo, ba da sanin abin da ya faru ba.
english: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.

hausa: Saboda haka, tabbatacce zan manta da ku in kuma jefar da ku daga gabana tare da birnin da na ba ku da kuma kakanninku.
english: therefore behold, I will utterly forget you, and I will cast you off with the city that I gave to you and to your fathers, away from my presence.

hausa: Duk mai dubana, yana duban wanda ya aiko ni ne.
english: He who sees me sees him who sent me.

hausa: Ana iya cewa zaman zuriyar Ibrahim, ba shi ne zama ’ya’yan Allah ba, a’a, zuriya ta alkawarin nan su ne ake lasaftawa zuriyar Ibrahim.
english: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.

hausa: Kowace rana a kwanaki bakwai na Bikin zai tanada bijimai guda bakwai da raguna bakwai marar lahani a matsayi hadaya ta ƙonawa ga Ubangiji, da kuma bunsuru saboda hadaya don zunubi.
english: The seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt offering to Yahweh, seven bulls and seven rams without defect daily the seven days; and a male goat daily for a sin offering.

hausa: Musa ya aikata dukan kome yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi.
english: Moses did so. According to all that Yahweh commanded him, so he did.

hausa: Duk da haka kana da mutane kima cikin Sardis waɗanda ba su ɓata tufafinsu ba. Za su yi tafiya tare da ni, saye da fararen tufafi, don sun cancanta.
english: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that didn’t defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.

hausa: Ka mai da manyansu kamar Oreb da Zeyib, dukan sarakunansu kamar Zeba da Zalmunna,
english: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Abiyam kuwa, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Yahuda. Aka yi yaƙi tsakanin Abiyam da Yerobowam.
english: The rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? There was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

hausa: “Wannan abokin bautarsa ya durƙusa ya roƙe shi, ‘Ka yi mini haƙuri, zan biya ka.’
english: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’

hausa: Ku ba da girma ga Ubangiji, ɗaukakar da ta dace da sunansa; ku bauta wa Ubangiji cikin ɗaukakar tsarkinsa.
english: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Worship Yahweh in holy array.

hausa: Ku yi iyakacin ƙoƙari ku yi zaman lafiya da kowa, ku kuma zama masu tsarki; gama in ban da tsarki ba babu wanda zai ga Ubangiji.
english: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,

hausa: da Lod, da Ono, da kuma a Kwarin Masu sana’a.
english: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.

hausa: Na ji tsoronka, don kai mai wuyan sha’ani ne. Kakan ɗauki abin da ba ka ajiye ba, kakan kuma yi girbin abin da ba ka shuka ba.’
english: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’

hausa: Ka dubi marasa zargi, ka lura da adali; akwai sa zuciya domin mutum mai salama.
english: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.

hausa: zai kuwa kasance da wannan awon, a wajen arewa kamu 45,000, wajen kudu kamu 45,000, wajen gabas kamu 45,000, wajen kudu kuma kamu 45,000.
english: These shall be its measurements: the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.

hausa: “To, yanzu, ’ya’ya mazanka biyu da aka haifa maka a Masar kafin in zo a nan za su zama nawa; Efraim da Manasse za su zama nawa, kamar yadda Ruben da Simeyon suke nawa.
english: Now your two sons, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh, even as Reuben and Simeon, will be mine.

hausa: Sai ta ce musu, “Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ya ce faɗa wa mutumin da ya aike ku gare ni,
english: She said to them, “Yahweh, the God of Israel says: ‘Tell the man who sent you to me,

hausa: Dawuda ya kira shi ‘Ubangiji.’ Ta, yaya zai zama ɗansa?”
english: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”

hausa: “ ‘Ya kai ƙazantaccen mugu, yerima Isra’ila, wanda kwanansa ta zo, wanda lokacin hukuncinsa ya cika fal,
english: “‘You, deadly wounded wicked one, the prince of Israel, whose day has come, in the time of the iniquity of the end,

hausa: “Ko ka taɓa tafiya zuwa maɓulɓulan teku, ko kuma ka taɓa zuwa cikin zurfin lungun teku?
english: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?

hausa: don ta kama gefen duniya ta kakkaɓe mugaye daga cikinta?
english: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?

hausa: Ya amsa musu ya ce, “Ku zo, za ku kuma gani.” Saboda haka suka je suka ga inda yake da zama, suka kuma zauna a can tare da shi. Wajen sa’a ta goma ce kuwa.
english: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

hausa: Amma wani ya ja bakansa kawai ya bugi Ahab sarkin Isra’ila a tsakanin sassan kayan yaƙinsa. Sai sarki ya ce wa mahayin keken yaƙinsa, “Juye, ka fitar da ni daga yaƙin. An ji mini rauni.”
english: A certain man drew his bow at random, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the armor. Therefore he said to the driver of his chariot, “Turn around, and carry me out of the battle, for I am severely wounded.”

hausa: bari waɗansu su ci abin da na shuka, kuma bari a tuge amfanin gonata.
english: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.

hausa: Don haka, ba abin mamaki ba ne, in bayin Shaiɗan sun ɓad da kamanni kamar su bayin adalci ne. A ƙarshe, za a sāka musu gwargwadon ayyukansu.
english: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.

hausa: Ana gwajin azurfa da kuma zinariya da wuta, amma Ubangiji ne mai gwajin zuciya.
english: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but Yahweh tests the hearts.

hausa: Shi ya sa aka kira birnin Babel, domin a can ne Ubangiji ya rikitar da harshen dukan duniya. Daga can Ubangiji ya watsar da su ko’ina a doron ƙasa.
english: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there Yahweh confused the language of all the earth. From there, Yahweh scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.

hausa: Amma ina gaya muku, duk wanda ya saki matarsa in ba a kan laifin zina ba, ya sa ta zama mazinaciya ke nan, kuma duk wanda ya auri macen da mijinta ya sake, shi ma yana zina ne.
english: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.

hausa: Don haka, saboda ku, za a nome Sihiyona kamar gona, Urushalima kuma ta zama tarin juji, tudun haikali kuwa zai zama kurmin ƙayayyuwa.
english: Therefore Zion for your sake will be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps of rubble, and the mountain of the temple like the high places of a forest.

hausa: Suka ce wa Sama’ila, “Kada ka fasa kai kukanmu ga Ubangiji Allahnmu saboda mu, don yă cece mu daga hannun Filistiyawa.”
english: The children of Israel said to Samuel, “Don’t stop crying to Yahweh our God for us, that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines.”

hausa: Duk da haka zan nuna ƙauna ga gidan Yahuda; zan kuma cece su, ba da baka, takobi ko yaƙi ba, ko ta wurin dawakai, ko masu hawan dawakai ba, sai ko ta wurin Ubangiji Allahnsu.”
english: But I will have mercy on the house of Judah, and will save them by Yahweh their God, and will not save them by bow, sword, battle, horses, or horsemen.”

hausa: An kafa kursiyin tun da daɗewa; kana nan tun fil azal.
english: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce, “Lalle ne a keɓe muke daga mata. Mutanena sukan keɓe kansu a koyaushe suka tashi ’yar tafiya, balle fa a yau!”
english: David answered the priest, and said to him, “Truly, women have been kept from us as usual these three days. When I came out, the vessels of the young men were holy, though it was only a common journey. How much more then today shall their vessels be holy?”

hausa: Ku saurara, gama ina da abubuwa masu darajan da zan faɗa; na buɗe leɓunana don in faɗa abin da yake daidai.
english: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.

hausa: bari su rera a gaban Ubangiji, gama yana zuwa domin yă hukunta duniya. Zai hukunta duniya da adalci mutane kuma cikin gaskiya.
english: Let them sing before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.

hausa: Dukan ƙofofin da madogaransu murabba’i ne, taga kuma tana ɗaura da ’yar’uwarta har jeri uku.
english: All the doors and posts were made square with beams; and window was facing window in three ranks.

hausa: Ubangiji ya sāke yi mini magana ya ce,
english: Yahweh spoke to me yet again, saying,

hausa: Waɗansu kuma suka fāɗi a cikin ƙaya. Da suka yi girma tare, sai ƙayan suka shaƙe su.
english: Some fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it and choked it.

hausa: Daga nan sai Elisha ya tafi Betel. Yayinda yake tafiya a hanya, sai waɗansu matasa suka fito daga cikin gari, suka yi masa dariya suna cewa, “Ka haura, ya kai mai kai marar gashi! Ka haura, kai mai kai marar gashi!”
english: He went up from there to Bethel. As he was going up by the way, some youths came out of the city and mocked him, and said to him, “Go up, you baldy! Go up, you baldy!”

hausa: Ba zan karɓi kome ba, sai dai abin da mutanena suka ci da kuma rabon mutanen da suka tafi tare da ni, ga Aner, Eshkol, da Mamre. Bari su ɗauki rabonsu.”
english: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion.”

hausa: Za ku sāke yi wa Ubangiji biyayya, ku kuma bi dukan umarnan da nake ba ku a yau.
english: You shall return and obey Yahweh’s voice, and do all his commandments which I command you today.

hausa: “Duk da haka, aka naɗa shi sarki, sa’an nan ya dawo gida. Sai ya aika aka kira bayin da ya ba su kuɗin, don yă san ribar da suka samu.
english: “When he had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.

hausa: Sa’ad da Musa ya kafa tabanakul, ya sa rammuka a wurinsu, ya sa katakan, ya kuma sa sandunan, ya kakkafa dogayen sandunan.
english: Moses raised up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.

hausa: Ya kuma ya ce a wani wuri, “Kai firist ne na har abada, bisa ga tsarin Melkizedek.”
english: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.”

hausa: Sa’an nan ya shimfiɗa tentin a bisa tabanakul, ya kuma sa murfi a bisa tentin, yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi.
english: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Ku yi ƙarfin hali, ku yi mazantaka, ku Filistiyawa, domin kada ku zama bayin Ibraniyawa kamar yadda suke a gare ku. Ku yi mazantaka, ku yi yaƙi.”
english: Be strong and behave like men, O you Philistines, that you not be servants to the Hebrews, as they have been to you. Strengthen yourselves like men, and fight!”

hausa: Za ku ji labarin yaƙe-yaƙe da kuma jita-jitarsu, sai dai ku lura kada hankalinku yă tashi. Dole irin waɗannan abubuwa su faru, amma ƙarshen tukuna.
english: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.

hausa: Sa’ad da kurciya ta komo wurinsa da yamma, sai ga ɗanyen ganyen zaitun da ta tsinko a bakinta! Sa’an nan Nuhu ya san cewa ruwa ya janye daga duniya.
english: The dove came back to him at evening and, behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ruben ya ji wannan, sai ya yi ƙoƙari yă cece shi daga hannuwansu. Ya ce, “Kada mu ɗauki ransa.
english: Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, “Let’s not take his life.”

hausa: Wata rana, yayinda yake yin sujada a haikalin allahnsa Nisrok, ’ya’yansa maza Adrammelek da Sharezer suka kashe shi da takobi, suka kuma gudu zuwa ƙasar Ararat. Esar-Haddon ɗansa kuwa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: As he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons struck him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Esar Haddon his son reigned in his place.

hausa: Ka saurara, ɗana, ka yarda da abin da na faɗa, shekarun rayuwarka kuwa za su zama masu yawa.
english: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.

hausa: A shekara ta goma sha biyu, a rana ta goma sha biyar ga wata, maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Gaba ɗaya dai, Mahalalel ya yi shekara 895, sa’an nan ya mutu.
english: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.

hausa: Na gode maka ina yabonka, Allah na kakannina. Kai ka san hikima da iko, ka sanar da ni abin da muka tambaye ka, ka kuma sanar da mu mafarkin sarki.”
english: I thank you and praise you, O God of my fathers, who have given me wisdom and might, and have now made known to me what we desired of you; for you have made known to us the king’s matter.”

hausa: gare shi wanda yake hawan daɗaɗɗen sararin sama, wanda yake tsawa da babbar murya.
english: to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.

hausa: Za a mai da rafuffukan Edom rami, ƙurarta za tă zama kibiritun farar wuta; ƙasarta za tă zama rami mai ƙuna!
english: Its streams will be turned into pitch, its dust into sulfur, and its land will become burning pitch.

hausa: “Sa’ad da Isra’ila yake yaro, na ƙaunace shi, daga Masar kuma na kira ɗana.
english: “When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya durƙusa ya ɗaga murya ya ce, “Ubangiji, kada ka riƙe wannan zunubi a kansu.” Da ya faɗi haka, sai ya yi barci.
english: He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.

hausa: Duk da haka kana a kursiyi a matsayin Mai Tsarkin nan; kai ne yabon Isra’ila.
english: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.

hausa: Yesu amsa ya ce, “Ina gaya maka, ba sau bakwai ba, amma sau saba’in da bakwai.
english: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.

hausa: Ka ba marar hikima shawara! Ka nuna kana da ilimi sosai.
english: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!

hausa: Dukan nunan fari na ƙasar da suke kawo wa Ubangiji, zai zama naka. Kowa da yake da tsarki a gidanka zai iya ci.
english: The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to Yahweh, shall be yours. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

hausa: Kai ne mafi kyau cikin mutane an kuma shafe leɓunanka da alheri, da yake Allah ya albarkace ka har abada.
english: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.

hausa: Za a ci wannan nama na hadaya don zumunci ta godiya a ranar da aka miƙa ta, kada yă bar wani abu daga naman yă kwana.
english: The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any of it until the morning.

hausa: da masu ɓata suna, masu ƙin Allah, masu rashin kunya, masu girman kai, masu rigima; sukan ƙaga hanyoyin yin mugunta; suna rashin biyayya ga iyayensu;
english: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

hausa: In kai, ya Ubangiji, za ka lissafta zunubai, Ya Ubangiji, wa zai tsaya?
english: If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?

hausa: Fushin Ubangiji ya yi ƙuna a kan Amaziya, sai ya aiki wani annabi wurinsa wanda ya ce, “Me ya sa ka nemi shawarar allolin mutanen nan, waɗanda ba za su cece mutanensu daga hannunka ba?”
english: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against Amaziah, and he sent to him a prophet who said to him, “Why have you sought after the gods of the people, which have not delivered their own people out of your hand?”

hausa: Da ba su iya kai shi wurin Yesu ba, saboda taron, sai suka buɗe rufin gidan saman, bisa daidai inda Yesu yake. Bayan da suka huda rami, sai suka saukar da shanyayyen, kwance a kan tabarmarsa.
english: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.

hausa: “Ka ƙidaya kabilar Merari bisa ga kabilarsu da iyalansu.
english: “As for the sons of Merari, you shall count them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;

hausa: Bari yă ƙarfafa zukatanku har ku zama marasa aibi da kuma tsarkaka a gaban Allahnmu da Ubanmu sa’ad da Ubangijimmu Yesu ya dawo tare da dukan tsarkakansa.
english: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

hausa: Amma yawan kiran da na yi wa Isra’ila haka nesa da ni da suke ta yi. Suka miƙa hadaya ga Ba’al suka kuma ƙona turare ga siffofi.
english: They called to them, so they went from them. They sacrificed to the Baals, and burned incense to engraved images.

hausa: Abin da ya miƙe daga Mahanayim haɗe da dukan Bashan, da gefen masarautar Og sarkin Bashan, da dukan garuruwan Yayir guda sittin da suke a Bashan,
english: Their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.

hausa: Kada ku yi kuka domin sarkin da ya mutu ko ku yi makoki saboda rashinsa; a maimako, ku yi kuka mai zafi saboda wanda aka kai zaman bauta, domin ba zai ƙara dawowa ba ko ya ƙara ganin ƙasarsa ta haihuwa.
english: Don’t weep for the dead. Don’t bemoan him; but weep bitterly for him who goes away, for he will return no more, and not see his native country.

hausa: Ga bala’in da Ubangiji zai bugi dukan al’umman da suka yi yaƙi da Urushalima. Fatar jikinsu za tă ruɓe tun suna tsaye a ƙafafunsu, idanunsu za su ruɓe a cikin kwarminsu, harsunansu kuma zai ruɓe a cikin bakunansu.
english: This will be the plague with which Yahweh will strike all the peoples who have fought against Jerusalem: their flesh will consume away while they stand on their feet, and their eyes will consume away in their sockets, and their tongue will consume away in their mouth.

hausa: Sa’an nan Musa ya shiga girgijen ya hau kan dutsen. Ya zauna a kan dutsen yini arba’in da dare arba’in.
english: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

hausa: Na sa miki tarko, Babilon, kika kuwa kamu kafin ki sani; aka same ki aka kuma kama ki domin kin tayar wa Ubangiji.
english: I have laid a snare for you, and you are also taken, Babylon, and you weren’t aware. You are found, and also caught, because you have fought against Yahweh.

hausa: Ku ku tafi Bikin, ba zan haura zuwa wannan Bikin ba yanzu, domin lokacina bai yi ba tukuna.”
english: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”

hausa: Saboda haka aka kira wurin Beyersheba, domin a nan ne su biyun suka yi rantsuwa.
english: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.

hausa: ta karya kan tohonsa da yake can bisansa ta kai ƙasar ciniki, inda ta shuka shi a birnin ’yan kasuwa.
english: He cropped off the topmost of its young twigs, and carried it to a land of traffic. He planted it in a city of merchants.

hausa: Waɗannan sha biyun ne Yesu ya aika da umarni cewa, “Kada ku je cikin Al’ummai, ko kuwa ku shiga wani garin Samariyawa.
english: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.

hausa: Ba ku taɓa tambayar waɗanda suke tafiya ba? Ba ku kula da labaransu,
english: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,

hausa: Nan da nan da manyan firistoci da ma’aikatansu suka gan shi, sai suka yi ihu suka ce, “A gicciye! A gicciye!” Amma Bilatus ya amsa ya ce, “Ku, ku ɗauke shi ku gicciye. Ni dai ban same shi da wani abin zargi ba.”
english: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”

hausa: Sa’an nan zai saki tsuntsu mai rai ɗin a fili waje da birnin ya tafi. Ta haka zai yi kafara saboda gidan, gidan kuwa zai zama tsarkakakke.”
english: but he shall let the living bird go out of the city into the open field. So shall he make atonement for the house; and it shall be clean.”

hausa: Na zama abin dariya ga mutanena duka; suna yi mini ba’a cikin waƙa dukan yini.
english: I have become a derision to all my people, and their song all day long.

hausa: Gama abin kunya ne a ma faɗi abubuwan da marasa biyayya suke yi a ɓoye.
english: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.

hausa: “Amma tabbatacce Allah zai zauna a duniya tare da mutane? Sammai, har ma da saman sammai, ba za su iya riƙe ka ba. Balle wannan haikalin da na gina!
english: “But will God indeed dwell with men on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less this house which I have built!

hausa: A yin ginin haikalin, duwatsun da aka fafe ne kaɗai daga wurin fafe duwatsu aka yi amfani da su, ba a ji karar guduma ko gizago, ko wani abin da aka yi da ƙarfe a wurin ginin haikali yayinda ake gina shi ba.
english: The house, when it was under construction, was built of stone prepared at the quarry; and no hammer or ax or any tool of iron was heard in the house while it was under construction.

hausa: Ban da haka ma, Manasse ya zub da jinin marasa laifi har ya cika Urushalima daga wannan ɓangare zuwa wancan, ban da zunubin da ya sa Yahuda ta aikata, ta haka suka yi mugunta a gaban Ubangiji.
english: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, until he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; in addition to his sin with which he made Judah to sin, in doing that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight.

hausa: ta wuce zuwa Bahar Rum. Daga Mikmetat a arewa kuwa iyakar ta karkata gabas zuwa Ta’anat Shilo, ta wuce zuwa Yanowa a gabas.
english: The border went out westward at Michmethath on the north. The border turned about eastward to Taanath Shiloh, and passed along it on the east of Janoah.

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Yayinda Bafilistin yana matsowa kusa domin yă fāɗa wa Dawuda, sai Dawuda ya ruga a guje zuwa bakin dāgā don yă same shi.
english: When the Philistine arose, and walked and came near to meet David, David hurried and ran toward the army to meet the Philistine.

hausa: Wani mutumin da yake zama a can ya ce, “Wane ne kuma mahaifinsu?” Ta haka sai wannan ya zama karin magana cewa, “Shawulu ma yana cikin annabawa?”
english: One from the same place answered, “Who is their father?” Therefore it became a proverb, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”

hausa: Ubangiji ya miƙa hannunsa a bisa teku ya kuma sa mulkokinsa suka yi rawar jiki. Ya ba da umarni game da Funisiya cewa a hallaka kagararta.
english: He has stretched out his hand over the sea. He has shaken the kingdoms. Yahweh has ordered the destruction of Canaan’s strongholds.

hausa: Tun daga kwanakin Yohanna Mai Baftisma har yă zuwa yanzu, mulkin sama yana sha da ƙyar, fitanannu kuma sun kama mulkin sama sun riƙe gam.
english: From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.

hausa: Bayan da ya tafi, bayin sarki suka zo suka tarar duk ƙofofin ɗakin sama suna kulle, suka ce, “Wataƙila yana bayan gari ne a ɗakin ciki.”
english: After he had gone, his servants came and saw that the doors of the upper room were locked. They said, “Surely he is covering his feet in the upper room.”

hausa: Sai Asa ya ɗauki azurfa da zinariya daga ma’ajin haikalin Ubangiji da kuma na fadansa ya aika wa Ben-Hadad sarkin Aram, wanda yake mulki a Damaskus.
english: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of Yahweh’s house and of the king’s house, and sent to Ben Hadad king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,

hausa: Sai dukan mutanen yankin Gerasenawa suka roƙi Yesu ya bar su, don sun tsorata sosai. Sai Yesu ya shiga jirgin ruwa ya tafi.
english: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much afraid. Then he entered into the boat and returned.

hausa: Gama a wani wuri ya yi magana a kan rana ta bakwai cikin waɗannan kalmomi, “A rana ta bakwai kuwa Allah ya huta daga dukan aikinsa.”
english: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;”

hausa: Gama Allah ya san cewa sa’ad da kuka ci daga itacen idanunku za su buɗe, za ku kuma zama kamar Allah, ku san abin da yake mai kyau da abin da yake mugu.”
english: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”

hausa: Bari roƙona yă zo gabanka; ka cece ni bisa ga alkawarinka.
english: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yefta ya aiki jakadu zuwa wurin sarkin Ammonawa su tambaya, “Me ya haɗa ka da ni, da ka kawo wa ƙasata yaƙi?”
english: Jephthah sent messengers to the king of the children of Ammon, saying, “What do you have to do with me, that you have come to me to fight against my land?”

hausa: Ya yi sarauta shekaru arba’in a bisa Isra’ila. Wato, shekaru bakwai a Hebron da kuma talatin da uku a Urushalima.
english: The days that David reigned over Israel were forty years; he reigned seven years in Hebron, and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

hausa: Kun san cewa sa’ad da kuke masu bautar gumaka, ya zama, an shawo kanku, aka kuma ɓad da ku ga bin gumaka marasa magana.
english: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.

hausa: “ ‘Ku bi farillaina, ku kuma yi hankali ga kiyaye dokokina, za ku kuwa zauna lafiya a ƙasar.
english: “‘Therefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.

hausa: “Ku ne shaiduna,” in ji Ubangiji, “bawana kuma wanda na zaɓa, saboda ka sani ka kuma gaskata ni ka kuma fahimci cewa ni ne shi. Kafin ni babu allahn da aka siffanta, ba kuwa za a yi wani a bayana ba.
english: “You are my witnesses,” says Yahweh, “With my servant whom I have chosen; that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he. Before me there was no God formed, neither will there be after me.

hausa: Diyar Fir’auna ta ce mata, “Ɗauki jaririn, ki yi mini renonsa, zan kuwa biya ki.” Saboda haka ta ɗauki yaron, ta yi renonsa.
english: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child away, and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages.” The woman took the child, and nursed him.

hausa: Sai Babiloniyawa suka cinna wa fadar da kuma gidajen mutane wuta suka farfasa katangar Urushalima.
english: The Chaldeans burned the king’s house and the people’s houses with fire and broke down the walls of Jerusalem.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yesu yana kan hanyarsa zuwa Urushalima, sai ya bi ta cikin garuruwan da ƙauyukan, yana koyarwa.
english: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.

hausa: Amma na yi rayuwa marar zargi; ka cece ni ka kuma yi mini jinƙai.
english: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.

hausa: Ba a dai ƙidaya Lawiyawa tare da sauran Isra’ilawa ba yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Kukan kuma ce, ‘In wani ya rantse da bagade, ba damuwa; amma in ya rantse da bayarwar da take bisansa, sai rantsuwar ta kama shi.’
english: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated.’

hausa: Wannan shi ne saƙon da kuka ji tun farko. Ya kamata mu ƙaunaci juna.
english: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—

hausa: Yoshuwa ya tattara dukan kabilan Isra’ila a Shekem. Ya aika a kira dattawa, shugabanni, alƙalai da manyan ma’aikatan Isra’ila, suka kai kansu gaban Allah.
english: Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem, and called for the elders of Israel, for their heads, for their judges, and for their officers; and they presented themselves before God.

hausa: Ubangiji ya rantse da Girman Yaƙub, “Ba zan taɓa mantawa da duk wani abin da suka yi ba.
english: Yahweh has sworn by the pride of Jacob, “Surely I will never forget any of their works.

hausa: Saboda haka ku lura, kwanaki suna zuwa, in ji Ubangiji, sa’ad da mutane ba za su ƙara ce da wannan wuri Tofet ko Kwarin Ben Hinnom ba, amma za su ce da shi Kwarin Kisa.
english: Therefore, behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that this place will no more be called ‘Topheth’, nor ‘The Valley of the son of Hinnom’, but ‘The valley of Slaughter’.

hausa: Sa’an nan sarkin yaƙin ya tsaya ya kuma yi kira da Yahudanci ya ce, “Ku ji kalmomin babban sarki, sarkin Assuriya!
english: Then Rabshakeh stood, and called out with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and said, “Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!

hausa: Mikahiya ya ci gaba, “Saboda haka sai ka ji maganar Ubangiji. Na ga Ubangiji yana zama a kan kursiyinsa tare da dukan rundunar sama tsaye a damansa da hagunsa.
english: Micaiah said, “Therefore hear Yahweh’s word: I saw Yahweh sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.

hausa: Ɗan lokaci bayan wannan, sai Yesu ya ƙetare zuwa gaɓar mai nesa na Tekun Galili (wato, Tekun Tibariya),
english: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, “ ‘Mikinku marar warkewa ne, raunin da kuka ji ya sha ƙarfin warkarwa.
english: For Yahweh says, “Your hurt is incurable. Your wound is grievous.

hausa: Muna sanar da sarki cewa in har aka sāke gina wannan birnin da katangarsa, zai zama ka rasa kome a gefen Kewayen Kogin Yuferites ke nan.
english: We inform the king that if this city is built and the walls finished, then you will have no possession beyond the River.

hausa: Zuriyar Issakar bisa ga kabilansu, daga Tola, kabilar Tolatawa; daga Fuwa, kabilar Fuwayawa;
english: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;

hausa: Ki zo, ya gidan Yaƙub, bari mu yi tafiya a hasken Ubangiji.
english: House of Jacob, come, and let’s walk in the light of Yahweh.

hausa: Kai wawa, kana son tabbaci cewa bangaskiya marar ayyuka banza ce?
english: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?

hausa: A kwanakin da Solomon yake raye, Yahuda da Isra’ila, daga Dan zuwa Beyersheba, sun zauna lafiya, kowane mutum ya zauna a ƙarƙashin itacen inabi da na ɓaurensa.
english: Judah and Israel lived safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beersheba, all the days of Solomon.

hausa: Raguwar Yaƙub za tă kasance tare da al’ummai, a cikin mutane masu yawa, kamar zaki a cikin sauran namun jeji, kamar ɗan zaki cikin garken tumaki, wanda yake tattaka yă kuma yi kaca-kaca da su sa’ad da yake ratsa a cikinsu, ba kuwa wanda zai cece su.
english: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, among many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep; who, if he goes through, treads down and tears in pieces, and there is no one to deliver.

hausa: Bayan mutuwar Yehohiyada, hafsoshin Yahuda suka zo suka yi mubaya’a wa sarki, ya kuma saurare su.
english: Now after the death of Jehoiada, the princes of Judah came and bowed down to the king. Then the king listened to them.

hausa: “Ku shirya garkuwoyinku, manya da ƙanana, ku kuma fito don yaƙi!
english: “Prepare the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle!

hausa: Duk wanda ya ƙi ya kiyaye dokar Musa akan kashe shi ba tausayi, a kan shaidar mutum biyu ko uku.
english: A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.

hausa: Sai wani malamin dokoki ya zo wurinsa ya ce, “Malam, zan bi ka duk inda za ka.”
english: A scribe came and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”

hausa: “Sa’ad da mutanenka suka je yaƙi da abokan gābansu, ko’ina ka kai su, kuma sa’ad da suka yi addu’a gare ka suna duban wannan birnin da ka zaɓa da haikalin nan da na gina domin Sunanka,
english: “If your people go out to battle against their enemies, by whatever way you send them, and they pray to you toward this city which you have chosen, and the house which I have built for your name;

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Ba’asha, abin da ya yi, da kuma nasarorinsa, an rubuta su cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Isra’ila.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

hausa: Kaitonki, ya ke ƙasa wadda sarkinki bawa ne wadda kuma hakimanta ke ta shagali tun da safe.
english: Woe to you, land, when your king is a child, and your princes eat in the morning!

hausa: “Na fafari abokan gābana, na murƙushe su; ban kuwa juya ba sai da na hallaka su.
english: I have pursued my enemies and destroyed them. I didn’t turn again until they were consumed.

hausa: bisa ɗayan rabi kabilar Manasse a Gileyad shi ne, Iddo ɗan Zakariya; bisa mutanen Benyamin shi ne, Ya’asiyel ɗan Abner;
english: of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah; of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner;

hausa: Za su ƙone gidajenki su kuma hukunta ki a idon mata masu yawa. Zan kawo ƙarshen karuwancinki, ba za ki kuma ƙara biyan kwartayenki ba.
english: They will burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. I will cause you to cease from playing the prostitute, and you will also give no hire any more.

hausa: Bayan wannan sai ya tafi Kafarnahum tare da mahaifiyarsa da ’yan’uwansa da kuma almajiransa. A can suka zauna ’yan kwanaki.
english: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.

hausa: In wurin da Ubangiji Allahnku ya zaɓa don yă sa Sunansa yana da nisa sosai daga inda kuke, za ku iya yankan dabbobi daga garkunanku na shanu da na tumakin da Ubangiji ya ba ku, kamar yadda na umarce ku, a cikin biranenku kuma za ku iya ci, yadda kuke so.
english: If the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to put his name is too far from you, then you shall kill of your herd and of your flock, which Yahweh has given you, as I have commanded you; and you may eat within your gates, after all the desire of your soul.

hausa: Sa’an nan kuwa zan yi muku abin da na shirya yin musu.’ ”
english: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so I will do to you.”

hausa: Ka ajiye laifinmu a gabanka, asirin zunubanmu a hasken kasancewarka.
english: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

hausa: Daga zuriyar Bebai, akwai Yehohanan, Hananiya, Zabbai, da Atlai.
english: Of the sons of Bebai: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.

hausa: ’ya’yan Yehiyeli maza su ne, Zetam da ɗan’uwansa Yowel. Su ne suke kula da ma’ajin haikalin Ubangiji.
english: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of Yahweh’s house.

hausa: da yake kuna neman tabbaci cewa Kiristi yana magana ta wurina ne. To, ai, shi ba rarrauna ba ne a gare ku, amma ƙaƙƙarfa ne a cikinku.
english: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Yaflet maza su ne, Fasak, Bimhal da Ashwat. Waɗannan su ne ’ya’yan Yaflet maza.
english: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

hausa: Idanuna kullum suna a kan Ubangiji, gama shi ne kaɗai zai kuɓutar da ƙafafuna daga tarko.
english: My eyes are ever on Yahweh, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.

hausa: Ku kawo ɗan saniya mai ƙiba ku yanka. Bari mu yi biki mu yi shagali.
english: Bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let’s eat and celebrate;

hausa: Duk da haka an sami wani abin kirki a wurinka, gama ka kawar da ginshiƙan Ashera a ƙasar, ka kuma sa zuciyarka a kan neman Allah.”
english: Nevertheless there are good things found in you, in that you have put away the Asheroth out of the land, and have set your heart to seek God.”

hausa: baƙi kuma su na zuwa don su yi mini fadanci; da zarar sun ji ni, sukan yi mini biyayya.
english: The foreigners will submit themselves to me. As soon as they hear of me, they will obey me.

hausa: Haruna zai miƙa Lawiyawa a gaban Ubangiji a matsayin hadaya ta kaɗawa daga Isra’ilawa, saboda a shirya su domin aikin Ubangiji.
english: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before Yahweh for a wave offering on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of Yahweh.

hausa: Ubangiji zai aiko muku da annoba wadda za tă manne muku, tă cinye ku cikin ƙasar da za ku shiga, ku mallake ta.
english: Yahweh will make the pestilence cling to you, until he has consumed you from off the land where you go in to possess it.

hausa: Tentinsa yana a Salem mazauninsa yana a Sihiyona.
english: His tabernacle is also in Salem. His dwelling place in Zion.

hausa: Don me? Don ba na ƙaunar ku ne? Allah dai ya sani ina ƙaunarku!
english: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.

hausa: A ƙarshen shekara ta uku, Assuriyawa suka ci Samariya da yaƙi. An ci Samariya da yaƙi a shekara ta shida ta mulki Hezekiya, wanda ya zo daidai da shekara ta tara ta mulkin Hosheya sarkin Isra’ila.
english: At the end of three years they took it. In the sixth year of Hezekiah, which was the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel, Samaria was taken.

hausa: Zabura ce ta yabo. Ta Dawuda. Zan ɗaukaka ka, ya Allahna, Sarki; zan yabi sunanka har abada abadin.
english: A praise psalm by David. I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.

hausa: Sa’ad da waɗannan kwanaki suka wuce, sai sarki ya yi liyafa a cikin lambun da aka shinge na fadar sarki wadda ta ɗauki kwana bakwai wa dukan mutane daga ƙarami har zuwa babba, waɗanda suke zama a masarautar Shusha.
english: When these days were fulfilled, the king made a seven day feast for all the people who were present in Susa the palace, both great and small, in the court of the garden of the king’s palace.

hausa: Dukan waɗannan mayaƙa ne waɗanda suka ba da kansu da yardar rai su yi hidima. Suka zo Hebron da cikakken niyya don su naɗa Dawuda sarki a bisa dukan Isra’ila. Duka sauran Isra’ilawa su ma suka goyi baya a naɗa Dawuda sarki.
english: All these were men of war who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

hausa: Sai bayan da aka kai tsakiyar Bikin, sa’an nan Yesu ya haura zuwa filin haikali ya fara koyarwa.
english: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

hausa: Iyakar za tă gangara daga Shefam zuwa Ribla a gefen gabashin Ayin, sa’an nan tă ci gaba a gangaren gabashin Tekun Kinneret.
english: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.

hausa: Gama duk abin da aka rubuta a dā an rubuta ne domin yă koya mana, don ta wurin jimrewa da kuma ƙarfafawar Nassosi mu kasance da bege.
english: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

hausa: Amma Bala’am ya amsa musu ya ce, “Ko da a ce Balak zai ba ni gidansa cike da azurfa da zinariya, ba zan yi wani abu ko kaɗan saɓanin umarnin Ubangiji Allahna ba.
english: Balaam answered the servants of Balak, “If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the word of Yahweh my God, to do less or more.

hausa: Ka ɗauke abokaina da ƙaunatattuna daga gare ni; duhu ne abokina na kurkusa.
english: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.

hausa: Sai sarki ya cika da murna ƙwarai, ya kuma yi umarni a ciro Daniyel daga ramin zakoki. Kuma da aka fito da Daniyel daga ramin, ba a sami wani rauni a jikinsa ba, domin ya dogara ga Allahnsa.
english: Then the king was exceedingly glad, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no kind of harm was found on him, because he had trusted in his God.

hausa: Zan sa hannunsa a bisa teku, hannunsa na dama a bisa koguna.
english: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.

hausa: Ba shi da kyau ka kasance da niyya babu sani, ko ka kasance mai garaje ka ɓace hanya.
english: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty with one’s feet and miss the way.

hausa: Sai bābān ya tambayi Filibus ya ce, “Ka gaya mini, ina roƙonka, annabin yana magana a kan wane ne, kansa ne, ko kuwa wani dabam?”
english: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”

hausa: Da ya ga Yesu yana wucewa, sai ya ce, “Ku ga, ga Ɗan Rago na Allah!”
english: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”

hausa: A can jarumin ya sami wani jirgin ruwan Alekzandariyan da za shi Italiya sai ya sa mu a ciki.
english: There the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing for Italy, and he put us on board.

hausa: Sai Ayuba ya ɗauki kaskon tukunya yana ta sosa ƙurajen da shi, yayinda yake zaune cikin toka.
english: He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.

hausa: Ni, Ubangiji na faɗa, zan kuwa aikata waɗannan abubuwa a kan dukan muguwar jama’an nan da suka haɗa kai, suka tayar mini. Za su sadu da ƙarshensu a wannan hamada; a nan za su mutu.”
english: I, Yahweh, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”

hausa: Ka ’yantar da kanka, kamar barewa daga hannun mai farauta, kamar tsuntsu daga tarkon mai kafa tarko.
english: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

hausa: Sai na ga wani mala’ika yana zuwa daga gabas, yana da hatimin Allah mai rai. Ya yi kira da babbar murya wa mala’ikun nan huɗu da aka ba su iko su cuci ƙasa da teku ya ce,
english: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,

hausa: Zan tsirar da kai daga mutanenka da kuma daga Al’ummai. Ina aikan ka zuwa gare su domin
english: delivering you from the people and from the Gentiles, to whom I send you,

hausa: Sa’an nan ni kaina zan shaida maka cewa hannun damanka zai iya cetonka.
english: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.

hausa: Suka tashi daga Hamadan Sin, suka yi sansani a Dofka.
english: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

hausa: Sa’an nan Solomon ya ce, “Ubangiji ya faɗa cewa zai zauna cikin duhun girgije;
english: Then Solomon said, “Yahweh has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

hausa: (Yakan ɗauki kwana goma sha ɗaya daga Horeb zuwa Kadesh Barneya ta hanyar Dutsen Seyir.)
english: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.

hausa: Zan ɗau fansa a kan Edom ta hannun mutanena Isra’ila, za su kuwa hukunta Edom bisa ga fushina da hasalata; za su san sakayyata, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.’ ”
english: I will lay my vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel. They will do in Edom according to my anger and according to my wrath. Then they will know my vengeance,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: Don me za ku karya zuciya Isra’ilawa daga hayewa zuwa ƙasar da Ubangiji ya ba su?
english: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which Yahweh has given them?

hausa: nardi, da asfaran, kalamus, da kirfa, da kowane irin itacen turare, da mur da aloyes da kuma dukan kayan yaji masu kyau.
english: spikenard and saffron, calamus and cinnamon, with every kind of incense tree; myrrh and aloes, with all the best spices,

hausa: Mutanen da aka jera sunayensu a bisa, shugabannin gidajensu ne. Iyalansu sun ƙaru sosai,
