english: these mentioned by name were princes in their families. Their fathers’ houses increased greatly.

hausa: A’a! Sai dai wannan taron da ba su san kome game da Doka ba, la’anannu ne.”
english: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Zan hallaka duk wani da ya yi aiki a wannan rana daga mutanensa.
english: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day, I will destroy that person from among his people.

hausa: Duk wanda ya ci nasara zai gāji dukan wannan, zan kuma zama Allahnsa, shi kuma zai zama ɗana.
english: He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.

hausa: Yesu ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Ba duka goma ne aka tsabtacce ba? Ina sauran taran?
english: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?

hausa: Kowace shekara mahaifiyarsa takan ɗinka ’yar taguwa ta kai masa sa’ad da ita da mijinta suka je miƙa hadaya ta shekara.
english: Moreover his mother made him a little robe, and brought it to him from year to year when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice.

hausa: Matasa suna zalunta mutanena, mata suna mulki a bisansu. Ya mutanena, jagorarinku suna ɓad da ku; suna karkatar da ku daga hanya.
english: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. My people, those who lead you cause you to err, and destroy the way of your paths.

hausa: to, za ka gane tsoron Ubangiji ka kuma sami sanin Allah.
english: then you will understand the fear of Yahweh, and find the knowledge of God.

hausa: Ka koya mini Ya Ubangiji, don in bi ƙa’idodinka; sa’an nan zan kiyaye su har ƙarshe.
english: Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.

hausa: Ya ba da waɗannan umarnai ga Hilkiya, Ahikam ɗan Shafan, Abdon ɗan Mika, Shafan magatakarda da kuma Asahiya mai hidimar sarki.
english: The king commanded Hilkiah, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Abdon the son of Micah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying,

hausa: A ranar da aka shirya Hiridus, sanye da kayan sarautarsa, ya zauna a gadon sarautarsa ya kuma ya wa mutanen jawabi.
english: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.

hausa: (domin amfanin haske ya ƙunshi nagarta, adalci, da kuma gaskiya)
english: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

hausa: Magdiyel da Iram. Waɗannan su ne manyan Edom bisa ga mazauninsu cikin ƙasar da suka zauna. Wannan shi ne zuriyar Isuwa, kakan mutanen Edom.
english: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.

hausa: Ahaziya ɗan Ahab ya zama sarkin Isra’ila a Samariya a shekara ta goma sha bakwai ta Yehoshafat sarkin Yahuda, ya kuma yi mulki a bisa Isra’ila shekaru biyu.
english: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and he reigned two years over Israel.

hausa: Azarel, Shelemiya, da Shemariya,
english: Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,

hausa: Zan yi tafiya a cikinki in kuma zama Allahnku, za ku kuwa zama mutanena.
english: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.

hausa: In mutum ya juya wa abokansa baya don a ba shi wata lada ’ya’yansa za su makance.
english: He who denounces his friends for plunder, even the eyes of his children will fail.

hausa: Amma ko Titus ma da yake tare da ni, ba a ce dole sai ya yi kaciya ba, ko da yake shi mutumin Al’ummai ne.
english: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

hausa: Almajiran suka je suka tashe shi daga barci, suka ce, “Ubangiji, Ubangiji, za mu nutse!” Ya tashi ya kwaɓe iskar da kuma haukar ruwan. Sai ruwan da iskar suka natsu. Kome ya yi tsit.
english: They came to him and awoke him, saying, “Master, Master, we are dying!” He awoke and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water; then they ceased, and it was calm.

hausa: Saboda haka ’yan’uwa, cikin dukan damuwarmu da tsananinmu an ƙarfafa mu game da ku saboda bangaskiyarku.
english: For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.

hausa: “Duk da haka, a shekara ta farko ta mulkin Sairus sarkin Babilon, Sarki Sairus ya ba da umarni cewa a sāke gina wannan gidan Allah.
english: But in the first year of Cyrus king of Babylon, Cyrus the king made a decree to build this house of God.

hausa: Ya Diyar Babilon, an ƙaddara ke zuwa hallaka, mai farin ciki ne wanda ya sāka miki saboda abin da kika yi mana,
english: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.

hausa: Saboda haka sai ku kame zukatanku, kada ku ƙara yin taurinkai.
english: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiff-necked.

hausa: Kaɗe-kaɗen garayu sun yi shiru, surutun masu murna ya daina, garayan farin ciki ya yi shiru.
english: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.

hausa: Elam ya ɗauki kwari da baka, tare da mahayan kekunan yaƙinta da dawakai; Kir ta buɗe garkuwoyi.
english: Elam carried his quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.

hausa: Lidda yana kusa da Yoffa; saboda haka sa’ad da almajirai suka ji cewa Bitrus yana a Lidda, sai suka aiki mutum biyu wurinsa su roƙe shi cewa, “In ka yarda ka zo nan da nan!”
english: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.

hausa: Kowa yă auna ayyukansa. A sa’an nan ne zai iya yin taƙama da kansa, ba tare da kwatanta kansa da wani ba,
english: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.

hausa: “Tabbatacce rana tana zuwa; za tă yi ƙuna kamar wutar maƙera. Dukan masu girman kai da kowane mai aikata mugunta zai zama ciyawa, wannan rana mai zuwa za tă ƙone su. Babu saiwa ko reshen da za a bar musu,” in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: “For behold, the day comes, burning like a furnace, when all the proud and all who work wickedness will be stubble. The day that comes will burn them up,” says Yahweh of Armies, “so that it will leave them neither root nor branch.

hausa: In kuwa waɗansu za su yi magana a wani harshe, to, kada su fi mutum biyu ko uku, kuma a yi bi da bi, wani kuma yă fassara.
english: If any man speaks in another language, let there be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.

hausa: Sarki ya ce, “Wace girma da daraja ce aka ba wa Mordekai saboda wannan?” Masu hidimarsa suka ce, “Ba a yi masa wani abu ba.”
english: The king said, “What honor and dignity has been given to Mordecai for this?” Then the king’s servants who attended him said, “Nothing has been done for him.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Yusuf ya ce wa ’yan’uwansa, “Ku zo kusa da ni.” Da suka yi haka, sai ya ce, “Ni ne ɗan’uwanku Yusuf, wannan da kuka sayar zuwa Masar!
english: Joseph said to his brothers, “Come near to me, please.” They came near. He said, “I am Joseph, your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.

hausa: Yoshuwa kuwa ya rubuta abubuwan nan a cikin Littafin Dokoki na Allah. Sa’an nan ya ɗauki babban dutse ya ajiye a ƙarƙashin itacen oak kusa da tsattsarkan wuri na Ubangiji.
english: Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God; and he took a great stone, and set it up there under the oak that was by the sanctuary of Yahweh.

hausa: Duk da haka ba su saurari mahukuntansu ba amma sai suka shiga ha’inci da waɗansu alloli suka kuma bauta musu. Ba kamar kakanninsu ba, nan da nan suka kauce daga hanyar da kakanninsu suka bi, hanyar biyayya ga umarnan Ubangiji.
english: Yet they didn’t listen to their judges; for they prostituted themselves to other gods, and bowed themselves down to them. They quickly turned away from the way in which their fathers walked, obeying Yahweh’s commandments. They didn’t do so.

hausa: Ta Dawuda. Yabi Ubangiji, ya raina; dukan abin da yake cikin cikina, yabi sunansa mai tsarki.
english: By David. Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!

hausa: Ba shakka kuna iya tunawa, ’yan’uwa, famarmu da kuma wahalarmu; mun yi aiki dare da rana don kada mu zama nauyi wa wani yayinda muke muku wa’azin bisharar Allah.
english: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.

hausa: Ku zauna a wannan gidan, kuna ci kuna shan duk abin da suka ba ku, gama ma’aikaci ya cancanci albashinsa. Kada ku yi yawan sāke masauƙi, daga gida zuwa gida.
english: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.

hausa: Saboda haka, ina roƙonku, ’yan’uwa, saboda yawan jinƙan Allah, ku miƙa jikunanku hadaya wadda take mai rai, mai tsarki abin karɓa kuma ga Allah, wannan ita ce hanyar hidimarku ta ruhaniya.
english: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

hausa: Zabura ta Dawuda. Sa’ad da yake a hamadar Yahuda. Ya Allah, kai ne Allahna, da nacewa na neme ka; raina yana ƙishinka, jikina yana marmarinka, cikin busasshiyar ƙasar da ta zozaye inda babu ruwa.
english: A Psalm by David, when he was in the desert of Judah. God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

hausa: Da Elisha ya isa gidan, sai ga gawar yaron kwance a kan gadonsa.
english: When Elisha had come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and lying on his bed.

hausa: “Sai ya sāke aiken waɗansu bayi ya ce, ‘Ku ce wa waɗanda aka gayyata cewa na shirya abinci. An yanka bijimai da shanun da aka yi kiwo, kome a shirye yake. Ku zo bikin auren mana.’
english: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the wedding feast!”’

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce masa, “Ka lura kada ka gaya wa kowa. Sai dai ka tafi, ka nuna kanka ga firist ka kuma yi bayarwar da Musa ya umarta, a matsayin shaida gare su.”
english: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”

hausa: Sai Maryamu Magdalin ta wajen almajiran da labari cewa, “Na ga Ubangiji!” Ta kuma gaya musu cewa ya faɗa mata waɗannan abubuwa.
english: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.

hausa: Na ga tentin Kushan cikin azaba; wuraren zaman Midiyan cikin damuwa.
english: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction. The dwellings of the land of Midian trembled.

hausa: Ko ba a wurin tsofaffi ake samun hikima ba? Ba tsawon rai yana kawo ganewa ba?
english: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.

hausa: Ya sāke komawa, ya maimaita addu’ar da ya yi.
english: Again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.

hausa: sai idanunsu suka buɗe. Yesu ya gargaɗe su sosai ya ce, “Ku lura kada wani yă san wani abu game da wannan.”
english: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”

hausa: Har iyayenku, da ’yan’uwanku maza, da danginku, da abokanku ma, duk za su bashe ku, su kuma kashe waɗansunku.
english: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.

hausa: har iyakar Kan’ana ta kai Sidon ta wajen Gerar har zuwa Gaza, sa’an nan ta milla zuwa Sodom, Gomorra, Adma da Zeboyim, har zuwa Lasha.
english: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.

hausa: Ka saurara! Zan sa ruhuna a cikinsa saboda sa’ad da ya ji wani labari, zai koma zuwa ƙasarsa, a can kuwa zan sa a kashe shi da takobi.’ ”
english: Behold, I will put a spirit in him and he will hear news, and will return to his own land. I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.”’”

hausa: Yanzu Isuwa ya san cewa Ishaku ya albarkaci Yaƙub ya kuma aike shi zuwa Faddan Aram don yă auri mata daga can, ya kuma san cewa sa’ad da ya albarkace shi, ya umarce shi cewa, “Kada ka auro wata mace daga cikin Kan’aniyawa,”
english: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan Aram, to take him a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a command, saying, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;”

hausa: Ta wurin wannan duka, muka sami ƙarfafawa. Ban da ƙarfafawar da muka samu, mun ji daɗi ƙwarai saboda yadda muka ga farin cikin Titus, domin ruhunsa ya sami wartsakewa daga gare ku duka.
english: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.

hausa: Mun sa zuciya ga salama amma ba lafiya, mun sa zuciya ga lokacin warkarwa amma sai ga razana.
english: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!

hausa: Allah yă sa mana albarka, dukan iyakar duniya kuma su ji tsoronsa.
english: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.

hausa: “Wahayin nan na safiya da yamma da aka nuna maka gaskiya ne, amma ka ɓoye wahayin, gama ya shafi nan gaba mai tsawo ne.”
english: “The vision of the evenings and mornings which has been told is true; but seal up the vision, for it belongs to many days to come.”

hausa: Amma Sama’ila bai ji daɗi sa’ad da suka ce, “Ka ba mu sarki da zai bi da mu.” Sai ya yi addu’a ga Ubangiji.
english: But the thing displeased Samuel when they said, “Give us a king to judge us.” Samuel prayed to Yahweh.

hausa: To, ku saurare ni! Ku mai da ’yan’uwanku da kuka kama a matsayin ’yan kurkuku, gama fushin Ubangiji yana a kanku.”
english: Now hear me therefore, and send back the captives that you have taken captive from your brothers, for the fierce wrath of Yahweh is on you.”

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce, “Zan kasance tare da kai, za ka kuwa fatattake dukan Midiyawa gaba ɗaya.”
english: Yahweh said to him, “Surely I will be with you, and you shall strike the Midianites as one man.”

hausa: Sun yi saurin juyawa daga abin da na umarce su, sun kuma yi wa kansu gunki na siffar ɗan maraƙi. Sun yi sujada ga ɗan maraƙi, suka yi hadaya gare shi, suka kuma ce, waɗannan su ne allolinka ya Isra’ila, waɗanda suka fito da kai daga Masar.”
english: They have turned away quickly out of the way which I commanded them. They have made themselves a molded calf, and have worshiped it, and have sacrificed to it, and said, ‘These are your gods, Israel, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.’”

hausa: A’a, muna magana ne a kan asirin hikimar Allah, hikimar da tun dā, take a ɓoye, wadda Allah ya ƙaddara domin ɗaukakarmu, tun kafin farkon zamanai.
english: But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,

hausa: Ta kuma ba sarki talenti 120 na zinariya, da kayan yaji masu yawa, da kuma duwatsu masu daraja. Ba a taɓa kawo kayan yaji da yawa haka kamar yadda sarauniyar Sheba ta ba wa Sarki Solomon ba.
english: She gave the king one hundred twenty talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never again was there such an abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.

hausa: Amma fa ba a kawar da masujadan kan tuddai ba; mutane suka ci gaba da miƙa hadayu da kuma ƙona turare a kan tuddai.
english: However, the high places were not taken away. The people still sacrificed and burned incense in the high places.

hausa: Ya ƙone hadayu a Kwarin Ben Hinnom, ya kuma miƙa ’ya’yansa maza a cikin wuta, yana bin hanyoyi banƙyama na al’umman da Ubangiji ya kora a gaban Isra’ilawa.
english: Moreover he burned incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burned his children in the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.

hausa: Saboda haka Isra’ila ya kama hanya da dukan abin da yake nasa, sa’ad da ya kai Beyersheba, sai ya miƙa hadayu ga Allah na Ishaku, mahaifinsa.
english: Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.

hausa: “ ‘Mutum zai yi zunubi in bai yi magana ba sa’ad da ya ji ana shelar neman shaida game da wani abin da ya gani ko kuwa ya ji, alhakin zai zauna a wuyansa.
english: “‘If anyone sins, in that he hears a public adjuration to testify, he being a witness, whether he has seen or known, if he doesn’t report it, then he shall bear his iniquity.

hausa: Sa’an nan ka yi amfani da shi don shafa wa Tentin Sujada, da akwatin alkawari,
english: You shall use it to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant,

hausa: A lokacin, Yesu ya zo daga Nazaret na Galili, Yohanna kuwa ya yi masa baftisma a Urdun.
english: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

hausa: Gama ga abin Ubangiji yana cewa, “An sayar da ke ba da kuɗi ba, kuma ba da kuɗi za a fanshe ki ba.”
english: For Yahweh says, “You were sold for nothing; and you will be redeemed without money.”

hausa: waɗanda hanyoyinsu karkatattu ne waɗanda kuma suke cuku-cuku a hanyoyinsu.
english: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Ahimawaz, shi ne a Naftali (ya auri Basemat ’yar Solomon);
english: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he also took Basemath the daughter of Solomon as wife);

hausa: “ ‘In hadayar wani mutum, hadaya ta salama ce, ya kuma miƙa ’yar dabba daga garke, ko namiji ko ta mace ce, sai yă miƙa dabbar da ba ta da lahani a gaban Ubangiji.
english: “‘If his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he offers it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without defect before Yahweh.

hausa: Waɗanda suka yi rantsuwa da abin kunya na Samariya, ko kuma su ce, ‘Muddin allahnku yana a raye, ya Dan,’ ko kuwa, ‘Muddin allahn Beyersheba yana a raye,’ za su fāɗi, ba kuwa za su ƙara tashi ba.”
english: Those who swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, ‘As your god, Dan, lives,’ and, ‘As the way of Beersheba lives,’ they will fall, and never rise up again.”

hausa: Ƙasarsu gādonsu ta haɗa da, Yezireyel, Kessulot, Shunem,
english: Their border was to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,

hausa: “ ‘Amma ’ya’yan suka yi mini tawaye. Ba su bi ƙa’idodina ba, ba su kula su kiyaye dokokina ba, ko da yake mutumin da ya kiyaye su zai rayu ta wurinsu, suka kuma ƙazantar da Asabbataina. Saboda haka na ce zan zuba hasalata a kansu in kuma aukar musu da fushina a hamada.
english: “‘“But the children rebelled against me. They didn’t walk in my statutes, and didn’t keep my ordinances to do them, which if a man does, he shall live in them. They profaned my Sabbaths. Then I said I would pour out my wrath on them, to accomplish my anger against them in the wilderness.

hausa: Dabbobi sun ɓoye; sun zauna cikin kogunansu.
english: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.

hausa: Da safe, ya Ubangiji, ka ji muryata; da safe na gabatar da bukatuna a gabanka in kuma jira da sa zuciya.
english: Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

hausa: Mutumin da aka same shi da haramtattun abubuwan kuwa za a ƙone shi, duk da mallakarsa domin ya karya sharaɗin da Ubangiji ya yi muku, ya yi abin kunya a Isra’ila!’ ”
english: It shall be, that he who is taken with the devoted thing shall be burned with fire, he and all that he has, because he has transgressed Yahweh’s covenant, and because he has done a disgraceful thing in Israel.’”

hausa: Dukan waɗannan ’ya’yan Yediyayel maza kawunan iyalai ne. Akwai mazan da suka isa yaƙi waje 17,200.
english: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.

hausa: Za su gina gidaje su kuma zauna a cikinsu; za su yi shuki a gonakin inabi su kuma ci ’ya’yansu.
english: They will build houses and inhabit them. They will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

hausa: sai da Wannan wanda yake tun fil azal ya zo ya furta hukunci, aka kuma ba tsarkaka na Mafi Ɗaukaka gaskiya, lokaci kuwa ya cika sai suka karɓi mulki.
english: until the Ancient of Days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the Most High, and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.

hausa: Da dukan mutanen da suka taru, domin shaidar waɗannan abubuwa, suka ga abin da ya faru, sai suka buga ƙirjinsu suka tafi.
english: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their chests.

hausa: Ɗaukar da aka yi musu bisa ga iyalai yana kamar haka. Daga Yahuda, shugaban ƙungiya 1,000. Adna ne shugaba, tare da jarumawa 300,000;
english: This was the numbering of them according to their fathers’ houses: From Judah, the captains of thousands: Adnah the captain, and with him three hundred thousand mighty men of valor;

hausa: Waɗannan su ne zuriyar ’ya’yan Nuhu maza bisa ga jerin zuriyarsu cikin al’ummominsu. Daga waɗannan ne al’ummomi suka bazu ko’ina a duniya bayan ambaliya.
english: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these on the earth after the flood.

hausa: “ ‘In mutum ya kwana da matar ɗansa, dole a kashe su biyun. Abin da suka yi haram ne; alhakin jininsu zai zauna a kansu.
english: “‘If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death. They have committed a perversion. Their blood shall be upon themselves.

hausa: Nuna sonkai ba shi da kyau, duk da haka mutum zai aikata abin da ba daidai ba saboda ’yar ƙaramar rashawa.
english: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.

hausa: Sa’ad da ɗansa Ishaku ya kai kwana takwas da haihuwa, sai Ibrahim ya yi masa kaciya, kamar yadda Allah ya umarce shi.
english: Abraham circumcised his son, Isaac, when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.

hausa: Sai sojojin suka tuƙa rawanin ƙaya suka sa masa a kā, suka kuma yafa masa wata riga mai ruwan shunayya.
english: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.

hausa: gidaje cike da kowane irin abubuwa masu kyau, da ba ku kuka tanadar ba, rijiyoyin da ba ku kuka haƙa ba, da gonakin inabi da itatuwan zaitun da ba ku kuka shuka ba, sa’ad da kuwa kuka ci, kuka kuma ƙoshi,
english: and houses full of all good things which you didn’t fill, and cisterns dug out which you didn’t dig, vineyards and olive trees which you didn’t plant, and you shall eat and be full;

hausa: A rubuce yake cewa, ‘An lissafta shi tare da masu zunubi.’ Ina kuwa gaya muku, dole wannan ya cika a kaina. I, abin da aka rubuta a kaina yana kusan cikawa.”
english: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: ‘He was counted with transgressors.’ For that which concerns me is being fulfilled.”

hausa: “Mun ɗauka hakkin bin umarnai na ba da kashi ɗaya bisa uku na shekel kowace shekara don hidimar gidan Allahnmu.
english: Also we made ordinances for ourselves, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God:

hausa: Amma Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Kada a ƙara yin wannan!” Sai ya taɓa kunnen mutumin da aka sara, ya warkar da shi.
english: But Jesus answered, “Let me at least do this”—and he touched his ear and healed him.

hausa: Ko da yake ciwona gwaji ne gare ku, ba ku yi mini reni ko ƙyama ba. A maimakon haka, kuka karɓe ni sai ka ce mala’ikan Allah, kuma sai ka ce Kiristi Yesu kansa.
english: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

hausa: Ubangiji yana shari’a da dattawa da kuma shugabannin mutanensa, “Ku ne kuka lalace gonar inabina; ganimar talakawa suna a gidajenku.
english: Yahweh will enter into judgment with the elders of his people and their leaders: “It is you who have eaten up the vineyard. The plunder of the poor is in your houses.

hausa: Haka kuma Konaniya tare da Shemahiya da Netanel, ɗan’uwansa, da Hashabiya, Yehiyel da Yozabad, shugabannin Lawiyawa, suka tanadar da hadayun Bikin Ƙetarewa dubu biyar da kuma bijimai ɗari biyar domin Lawiyawa.
english: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethanel, his brothers, and Hashabiah, Jeiel, and Jozabad, the chiefs of the Levites, gave to the Levites for the Passover offerings five thousand small livestock and five hundred head of cattle.

hausa: Ba ka gani abin da suke yi a biranen Yahuda da kuma a titunan Urushalima?
english: Don’t you see what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

hausa: Saboda haka na juya, na sauko daga dutsen yayinda yake cin wuta. Allunan biyu na alkawarin kuma suna a hannuwana.
english: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire. The two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.

hausa: ta goma sha shida a kan Hananiya, na goma sha biya a kan Yerimot, ’ya’yansa maza da danginsa, 12
english: for the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

hausa: Yaƙub ya ɗaga ido ke nan, sai ga Isuwa yana zuwa tare da mutanensa ɗari huɗu; saboda haka sai ya rarraba ’ya’yan wa Liyatu, Rahila da kuma matan nan biyu masu hidima.
english: Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau was coming, and with him four hundred men. He divided the children between Leah, Rachel, and the two servants.

hausa: To, a ce sun auri mutane daga waɗansu kabilan Isra’ilawa fa; ka ga, za a ɗebe gādonsu daga gādon kakanninmu a ƙara wa gādon kabilan mutanen da suka aura ke nan. Ta haka za a ɗebe sashe daga gādon da aka ba mu ke nan.
english: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.

hausa: Sai matar ta ce, “Wa kake so in hauro maka?” Sai ya ce, “Ki hauro mini da Sama’ila.”
english: Then the woman said, “Whom shall I bring up to you?” He said, “Bring Samuel up for me.”

hausa: dokokin da ka bayar ta wurin annabawa lokacin da ka ce, ‘Ƙasar da za ku mallaka, ƙasa ce marar tsarki, mutanenta sun ɓata ta da ƙazamin hali, ƙazamin halinsu ya ɓata ko’ina.
english: which you have commanded by your servants the prophets, saying, ‘The land to which you go to possess is an unclean land through the uncleanness of the peoples of the lands, through their abominations, which have filled it from one end to another with their filthiness.

hausa: mai yiwuwa yă yi musu magana a cikin kunnuwansu yă razana su da gargaɗinsa,
english: then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,

hausa: Bakin adali maɓulɓulan rai ne, amma kalmar mugun takan ɓoye makircinsa.
english: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

hausa: Ka yi da bawanka bisa ga ƙaunarka ka kuma koya mini ƙa’idodinka.
english: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.

hausa: Dishon, Ezer da Dishan. Waɗannan su ne manyan Horiyawa, ’ya’yan Seyir, maza, a ƙasar Edom.
english: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Ya Uba ka yi musu gafara, don ba su san abin da suke yi ba.” Suka rarraba tufafinsa ta wurin jefa ƙuri’a.
english: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yesu ya shiga Urushalima, dukan birnin ya ruɗe, ana ta tambaya, “Wane ne wannan?”
english: When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, “Who is this?”

hausa: Da ya faɗi haka, sai ya nuna musu hannuwansa da ƙafafunsa.
english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.

hausa: Bayan wannan sai na duba, a cikin sama kuwa sai ga haikali, wato, tabanakul na Shaida, a buɗe.
english: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.

hausa: Sai na ji yana magana, da ina sauraronsa, sai na shiga barci mai nauyi, na kuwa fāɗi rubda ciki.
english: Yet I heard the voice of his words. When I heard the voice of his words, then I fell into a deep sleep on my face, with my face toward the ground.

hausa: Biye da su, Ezer ɗan Yeshuwa, mai mulkin Mizfa, ya yi gyara wani sashe, daga inda yake fuskantar hawan gidan makamai har zuwa kusurwa.
english: Next to him, Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, repaired another portion across from the ascent to the armory at the turning of the wall.

hausa: A shekara ta biyu ta mulkin Yehowash ɗan Yehoyahaz sarkin Isra’ila, Amaziya ɗan Yowash sarkin Yahuda ya fara mulki.
english: In the second year of Joash, son of Joahaz, king of Israel, Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah began to reign.

hausa: Sama’ila ya ce musu, “Ubangiji yă zama shaida a kanku, shafaffensa kuma yă zama shaida a wannan rana cewa ba ku same ni da wani laifin kome ba.” Suka ce, “I, shi ne shaida.”
english: He said to them, “Yahweh is witness against you, and his anointed is witness today, that you have not found anything in my hand.” They said, “He is witness.”

hausa: Saboda haka kamar yadda harshen wuta yakan lashe kara kuma kamar yadda busasshiyar ciyawa takan ƙone ƙurmus a cikin wuta, haka saiwarsu za su ruɓa iska kuma ta hura furanninsu kamar ƙura; gama sun ƙi dokar Ubangiji Maɗaukaki suka kuma ƙyale maganar Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila.
english: Therefore as the tongue of fire devours the stubble, and as the dry grass sinks down in the flame, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust, because they have rejected the law of Yahweh of Armies, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.

hausa: Uzziya ya kasance da gogaggun mayaƙa, a shirye su fito ɓangarori-ɓangarori bisa ga yawansu yadda Yehiyel magatakarda, da Ma’asehiya jarumi, suka karkasa su bisa ga umarnin Hananiya, ɗaya daga cikin fadawa.
english: Moreover Uzziah had an army of fighting men who went out to war by bands, according to the number of their reckoning made by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king’s captains.

hausa: Haka kuma Markus, Aristarkus, Demas da kuma Luka, abokan aikina.
english: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

hausa: Zan sa mutane da yawa su giggice saboda abin da ya same ka, sarakunansu kuma za su yi rawar jiki saboda kai sa’ad da na kaɗa takobina a gabansu. A ranar fāɗuwarka kowannensu zai yi rawar jiki a kowane lokaci saboda ransa.
english: Yes, I will make many peoples amazed at you, and their kings will be horribly afraid for you, when I brandish my sword before them. They will tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of your fall.”

hausa: Amma idanun Ubangiji suna a kan wanda yake tsoronsa, a kan waɗanda suke sa zuciya cikin ƙaunarsa marar ƙarewa,
english: Behold, Yahweh’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,

hausa: Za ka yi wa Yaƙub aminci, ka kuma nuna jinƙai ga Ibrahim, kamar yadda ka yi alkawari da rantsuwa ga kakanninmu tun a kwanankin dā.
english: You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.

hausa: Musa da Haruna, Nadab da Abihu, da dattawa saba’in, Allah na Isra’ila suka haura
english: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.

hausa: an kuma kuɓutar da su kyauta ta wurin alherinsa bisa ga aikin fansar da ya zo ta wurin Yesu Kiristi.
english: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,

hausa: Sa’an nan ya gangara ya yi magana da yarinyar, yana kuwa sonsa.
english: He went down and talked with the woman, and she pleased Samson well.

hausa: “Ni ne mafi jahilci a cikin mutane; ba ni da fahimi irin na mutum.
english: “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.

hausa: Zan sa kibiyoyina su bugu da jini, yayinda takobina yana cin nama, jinin kisassu da na kamammu, kawunan shugabannin abokan gāba.”
english: I will make my arrows drunk with blood. My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the head of the leaders of the enemy.”

hausa: Amma Yonadab, ɗan Shimeya ɗan’uwan Dawuda ya ce, “Kada ranka yă daɗe yă yi tunani cewa an kashe dukan ’ya’yan sarki maza; Amnon ne kaɗai ya mutu. Wannan ce niyyar Absalom tun lokacin da Amnon ya yi wa Tamar ’yar’uwansa fyaɗe.
english: Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother, answered, “Don’t let my lord suppose that they have killed all the young men, the king’s sons, for Amnon only is dead; for by the appointment of Absalom this has been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.

hausa: Yanzu fa, ’ya’yana, ku saurare ni; ku kasa kunne ga abin da nake faɗa.
english: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.

hausa: A cikinsa muka sami fansa ta wurin jininsa, wato, yafewar zunubanmu. Kiristi ya yi wannan saboda yawan alherin Allah
english: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace

hausa: “Za su mutu da muguwar cuta. Ba za a yi kuka dominsu ba, ba kuwa za a binne su ba, amma za a bar su a juji. Takobi da yunwa ne za su hallaka su, gawawwakinsu za su zama abincin tsuntsayen sararin sama da kuma namun jeji na duniya.”
english: “They will die grievous deaths. They will not be lamented, neither will they be buried. They will be as dung on the surface of the ground. They will be consumed by the sword and by famine. Their dead bodies will be food for the birds of the sky and for the animals of the earth.”

hausa: Mai ɗaga kai za tă yi tuntuɓe ta kuma fāɗi kuma ba wanda zai taimake ta tă tashi; zan hura wuta a garuruwanta da za tă cinye duk waɗanda suke kewaye da ita.”
english: The proud one will stumble and fall, and no one will raise him up. I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it will devour all who are around him.”

hausa: Za mu sāke ƙin yin biyayya da umarninka mu yi auratayya da mutanen nan da suke aikata waɗannan abubuwan banƙyama? Ba za ka yi fushi da mu, ka ƙone mu da fushinka har babu ɗan saura ba?
english: shall we again break your commandments, and join ourselves with the peoples that do these abominations? Wouldn’t you be angry with us until you had consumed us, so that there would be no remnant, nor any to escape?

hausa: Na ce wa Allah Dutsena, “Me ya sa ka manta da ni? Me zai sa in yi ta yawo ina makoki, a danne a hannun abokin gāba?”
english: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”

hausa: daga kabilar Simeyon mutum 12,000, daga kabilar Lawi mutum 12,000, daga kabilar Issakar mutum 12,000,
english: of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,

hausa: Mutanen Ruben suka sāke gina Heshbon, Eleyale, da Kiriyatayim,
english: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,

hausa: kamar yadda kuka ɗan fahimce mu, za ku kai ga cikakkiyar fahimta cewa za ku iya yin taƙama da mu, kamar yadda mu ma za mu yi taƙama da ku a ranar da Ubangiji Yesu zai dawo.
english: as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

hausa: (Dā ma can sun ga Turofimus mutumin Afisa a birni tare da Bulus suka yi tsammani Bulus ya kawo shi filin haikali.)
english: For they had seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.

hausa: ɗan Shamma mutumin Harar, da Ahiyam, ɗan Sharar mutumin Harod.
english: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite,

hausa: Ruwa ya ƙaru ƙwarai a duniya, ya kuma rufe dukan duwatsu masu tsawo a ƙarƙashin sammai.
english: The waters rose very high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.

hausa: Kekunan yaƙi sun zabura a tituna, suna kai da kawowa a dandali. Suna walƙiya kamar tocila suna sheƙawa a guje kamar walƙiya.
english: The chariots rage in the streets. They rush back and forth in the wide ways. Their appearance is like torches. They run like the lightnings.

hausa: Sai al’ummai suka tayar masa, waɗannan daga yankunan da suke kewaye. Suka yafa raga dominsa ya kuwa fāɗa cikin raminsu.
english: Then the nations attacked him on every side from the provinces. They spread their net over him. He was taken in their pit.

hausa: Musa ya kuma ɗauki jinin, ya yayyafa a kan mutanen ya ce, “Wannan shi ne jinin alkawarin da Ubangiji ya yi da ku, bisa ga dukan waɗannan kalmomi.”
english: Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Look, this is the blood of the covenant, which Yahweh has made with you concerning all these words.”

hausa: A ranar Akish ya ba shi Ziklag wanda tun dā take ta sarkin Yahuda.
english: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: therefore Ziklag belongs to the kings of Judah to this day.

hausa: Zan yi taƙama game da mutum irin wannan, sai dai ni ba zan yi taƙama da kaina ba, sai dai a kan rashin ƙarfina.
english: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.

hausa: Ku tashi, mu tafi! Ga mai bashe ni nan yana zuwa!”
english: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

hausa: Na sa su je wurin Iddo wanda yake shugaba a Kasifiya. Aka gaya musu abin da za su gaya wa Iddo da ’yan’uwansa masu aiki a haikali a Kasifiya don su aiko mana waɗanda za su yi mana hidima a haikalin Allahnmu.
english: I sent them out to Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia; and I told them what they should tell Iddo and his brothers the temple servants at the place Casiphia, that they should bring to us ministers for the house of our God.

hausa: Za ku iya roƙe ni kome a cikin sunana, zan kuwa yi.
english: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.

hausa: To, ’yan’uwa, ina so in tuna muku da bisharar da na yi muku wa’azinta, wadda kuka karɓa, wadda kuma kuka yanke shawara ku tsaya a kai.
english: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,

hausa: A wannan rana Isra’ila za tă zama na uku, tare da Masar da Assuriya, abin albarka ga duniya.
english: In that day, Israel will be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing within the earth;

hausa: “ ‘Iyakarku a gabashi, za tă tashi daga Hazar-Enan zuwa Shefam.
english: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.

hausa: Suka yi bagaden ƙona turare da itacen ƙirya. Shi bagaden, murabba’i ne, tsawonsa kamu ɗaya, fāɗinsa kamu ɗaya, tsayinsa kuma kamu biyu, ƙahoninsa kuwa a haɗe suke da shi.
english: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its width a cubit. Its height was two cubits. Its horns were of one piece with it.

hausa: saye ku fa aka yi da tsada, saboda haka, sai ku girmama Allah da jikinku.
english: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.

hausa: “ ‘In wani ya keɓe wa Ubangiji wani sashe daga cikin gonarsa ta gādo, sai yă kimanta kuɗin gonar daidai da yawan irin da za a iya shuka a gonar. Za a kimanta kuɗin a kan shekel hamsin na irin sha’ir.
english: “‘If a man dedicates to Yahweh part of the field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it. The sowing of a homer of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

hausa: Saboda haka ka gaya wa mutanen, ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, ‘Ku komo gare ni,’ in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, ‘ni kuma zan komo gare ku,’ in ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: Therefore tell them, Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Return to me,’ says Yahweh of Armies, ‘and I will return to you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: Suka ce masa, “Ka tsufa, ’ya’yanka kuma ba sa bin hanyarka, saboda haka sai ka naɗa sarkin da zai bi da mu kamar yadda sauran ƙasashe suke da su.”
english: They said to him, “Behold, you are old, and your sons don’t walk in your ways. Now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.”

hausa: “ ‘Waɗannan su ne tsuntsayen da za ku yi ƙyamarsu, ba za ku ci su ba domin sun zama abin ƙyama. Tsuntsayen kuwa su ne, gaggafa, ungulu, baƙin ungulu,
english: “‘You shall detest these among the birds; they shall not be eaten because they are an abomination: the eagle, the vulture, the black vulture,

hausa: Babu wata bukata in rubuta muku game da hidiman nan ga tsarkaka.
english: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,

hausa: gama sun yi tayarwa a kan maganar Allah suka ƙi shawarar Mafi Ɗaukaka.
english: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.

hausa: Ya ce masa, “Zan ba ka dukan ikonsu da darajarsu, gama ni aka danƙa wa, kuma zan bai wa duk wanda na ga dama.
english: The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority and their glory, for it has been delivered to me, and I give it to whomever I want.

hausa: A wannan lokaci, waɗansu Farisiyawa suka zo suka ce wa Yesu, “Ka bar nan ka tafi wani wuri dabam. Hiridus yana so ya kashe ka.”
english: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”

hausa: Ya gargaɗe taron ya ce, “Ku ƙaurace wa tentin waɗannan mugayen mutane! Kada ku taɓa kome da yake nasu, domin kada a shafe ku saboda zunubansu.”
english: He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins!”

hausa: Da yake bai iya biya ba, sai maigida ya umarta a sayar da shi da matarsa da yaransa da kuma duk abin da yake da shi, a biya bashin.
english: But because he couldn’t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

hausa: Ni ma da ’yan’uwana da kuma mutanena muna ba wa mutane bashin kuɗi da kuma hatsi. Sai mu daina sha’anin ba da rance da ruwa!
english: I likewise, my brothers and my servants, lend them money and grain. Please let us stop this usury.

hausa: ta haka za a fallasa tunanin zukatan mutane da yawa. Ke ma, takobi zai soki zuciyarki.”
english: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”

hausa: Ubangiji zai aiko muku da la’ana, da ruɗewa, da damuwa cikin dukan abin da za ku yi, har ya hallaka ku, ku lalace da sauri saboda mugayen ayyukanku, domin kuma kuka rabu da ni.
english: Yahweh will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.

hausa: kamar yadda Musa bawan Ubangiji ya umarci Isra’ilawa. Ya gina bisa ga abin da yake a rubuce a cikin Littafin Dokoki na Musa, bagade na duwatsun da ba a sassaƙa su ba, waɗanda ba wani ƙarfen da ya taɓa su. Suka miƙa wa Ubangiji hadayu na ƙonawa da hadayu na salama a kai.
english: as Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses: an altar of uncut stones, on which no one had lifted up any iron. They offered burnt offerings on it to Yahweh and sacrificed peace offerings.

hausa: Bitrus ya bi shi suka fita kurkukun, amma bai ma san cewa abin da mala’ikan yake yi tabbatacce ne ba; yana tsammani wahayi yake gani.
english: And he went out and followed him. He didn’t know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.

hausa: Dole ku kiyaye dokokina kuma ku lura ku bi farillaina. Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: You shall do my ordinances. You shall keep my statutes and walk in them. I am Yahweh your God.

hausa: Ku yi shela ga kagarun Ashdod da kuma ga kagarun Masar. “Ku tara kanku a tuddan Samariya; ku ga rashin jituwar da take a cikinta, da kuma zaluncin da ake yi a cikin mutanenta.”
english: Proclaim in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, “Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria, and see what unrest is in her, and what oppression is among them.”

hausa: Ya ce mini, “Wannan shi ne wurin da firistoci za su dafa hadaya don laifi, da hadaya don zunubi, a nan ne kuma za su toya hadaya ta gari, domin kada su kai su a filin da yake waje, su tsarkake mutane.”
english: He said to me, “This is the place where the priests shall boil the trespass offering and the sin offering, and where they shall bake the meal offering, that they not bring them out into the outer court, to sanctify the people.”

hausa: Amma, ai, kun san darajar Timoti yadda muka yi bautar bishara tare, kamar ɗa da mahaifinsa.
english: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

hausa: Sha’arayim, Aditayim, Gedera (Gederotayim ke nan). Garuruwa goma sha huɗu ke nan da ƙauyukansu.
english: Shaaraim, Adithaim and Gederah (or Gederothaim); fourteen cities with their villages.

hausa: Zuwa ga Titus, ɗana na gaske a tarayyarmu cikin bangaskiya. Alheri da salama daga Allah Uba da kuma Kiristi Yesu Mai Cetonmu, su kasance tare da kai.
english: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

hausa: Bayan haka, sai Lawiyawa suka zo don su yi aikinsu a Tentin Sujada, a ƙarƙashin Haruna da ’ya’yansa. Suka yi da Lawiyawa kamar dai yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.
english: After that, the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron and before his sons: as Yahweh had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.

hausa: “Bai ga mugunta a cikin Yaƙub ba, bai kuma ga wahala a Isra’ila ba. Ubangiji Allahnsu yana tare da su; sowar Sarki yana cikinsu.
english: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. Yahweh his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.

hausa: “Ka miƙa hannunka na dama, ƙasa ta haɗiye abokan gābanka.
english: You stretched out your right hand. The earth swallowed them.

hausa: Addu’ar mutum mai shan wahala. Sa’ad da ya rasa ƙarfi ya kuma yi makoki a gaban Ubangiji. Ka ji addu’ata, ya Ubangiji; bari kukata ta neman taimako ta zo gare ka.
english: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before Yahweh. Hear my prayer, Yahweh! Let my cry come to you.

hausa: Da Abimelek ya ji dukan mutanen hasumiyar Shekem sun taru a can,
english: Abimelech was told that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.

hausa: Zan mai da guragu su zama raguwa, waɗanda aka kora, su zama al’umma mai ƙarfi. Ubangiji zai yi mulkinsu a Dutsen Sihiyona daga wannan rana da kuma har abada.
english: and I will make that which was lame a remnant, and that which was cast far off a strong nation: and Yahweh will reign over them on Mount Zion from then on, even forever.”

hausa: Kaleb ya ce, “Zan ba da ’yata Aksa aure ga wanda zai ci Kiriyat Sefer da yaƙi.”
english: Caleb said, “He who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it, to him I will give Achsah my daughter as wife.”

hausa: Sa’ad da annabin da ya dawo da mutumin Allah ya ji, sai ya ce, “Mutumin Allah ne, wanda ya ƙazantar da maganar Ubangiji. Ubangiji ya bashe shi ga zaki, wanda ya yayyage shi ya kuma kashe shi, kamar yadda maganar Ubangiji ta gargaɗe shi.”
english: When the prophet who brought him back from the way heard of it, he said, “It is the man of God who was disobedient to Yahweh’s word. Therefore Yahweh has delivered him to the lion, which has mauled him and slain him, according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke to him.”

hausa: Sa’an nan za su kira ga Ubangiji, amma ba zai amsa musu ba. A wannan lokaci zai ɓoye fuskarsa daga gare su saboda irin muguntar da suka yi.
english: Then they will cry to Yahweh, but he will not answer them. Yes, he will hide his face from them at that time, because they made their deeds evil.”

hausa: daga Asriyel, kabilar Asriyelawa; daga Shekem, kabilar Shekem;
english: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;

hausa: Da ya ga Yesu, sai mutumin ya ɗaga murya da ƙarfi, ya fāɗi a gabansa, yana ihu cewa, “Ina ruwanka da ni, Yesu, Ɗan Allah Mafi Ɗaukaka? Ina roƙonka, kada ka ba ni wahala!”
english: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, “What do I have to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don’t torment me!”

hausa: Zan iya ƙirga ƙasusuwana; mutane suna farin ciki a kaina.
english: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.

hausa: Ka ji addu’ata, ya Ubangiji Allah Maɗaukaki; ka saurare ni, ya Allah na Yaƙub. Sela
english: Yahweh, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.

hausa: Da jin haka, Dawuda ya aiki Yowab tare da dukan mayaƙa masu yaƙi.
english: When David heard of it, he sent Joab with all the army of the mighty men.

hausa: “Cikin fushinku kada ku yi zunubi.” Kada ku bar rana ta fāɗi kuna fushi,
english: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,

hausa: Ki lura da gonar da mutanena suke girbi, ki bi su tare da ’yan matana. Na riga na faɗa wa mazan kada su taɓa ke. Kuma duk sa’ad da kika ji ƙishirwa, ki tafi ki ɗebo ruwa daga tulunan da mazan suka cika.”
english: Let your eyes be on the field that they reap, and go after them. Haven’t I commanded the young men not to touch you? When you are thirsty, go to the vessels, and drink from that which the young men have drawn.”

hausa: Munafukai! Kuna san yadda za ku fassara yanayin ƙasa da na sararin sama. Ta yaya ba ku san yadda za ku yi fassarar wannan zamani ba?
english: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t interpret this time?

hausa: (Ba ta jin tsoro, ko kuma kunya, ƙafafunta ba sa zama a gida;
english: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.

hausa: Mutanen Gad sun zauna a Bashan da ƙauyukan da suke kurkusa da shi, da kuma a dukan makiyayan Sharon har zuwa iyaka inda suka kai.
english: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon as far as their borders.

hausa: Ka dalaye shi da zinariya zalla ciki da waje, za ka yi wa gefe-gefensa ado da gurun zinariya.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.

hausa: Bayan haka, Yesu ya bayyana ga Sha Ɗayan, yayinda suke cin abinci. Ya tsawata musu a kan rashin bangaskiyarsu, da yadda suka ƙi gaskata waɗanda suka gan shi bayan ya tashi.
english: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table; and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

hausa: Ka sa burodin Kasancewa a kan wannan tebur, yă kasance a gabana kullum.
english: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.

hausa: A nan kuwa mutane da yawa suka gaskata da Yesu.
english: Many believed in him there.

hausa: A shekara ta farko ta mulkin sarkin Farisa, wato, sarki Sairus, domin a cika maganar Ubangiji da aka yi ta bakin Irmiya, sai Ubangiji ya taɓa zuciyar Sairus sarkin Farisa ya yi shela a duk fāɗin ƙasarsa, ya kuma rubuta cewa,
english: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that Yahweh’s word by Jeremiah’s mouth might be accomplished, Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

hausa: Abin da ɗango ya bari fāri masu girma sun cinye; abin da fāri masu girma suka bari, burduduwa ta cinye; abin da burduduwa ta bari sauran kwari sun cinye.
english: What the swarming locust has left, the great locust has eaten. What the great locust has left, the grasshopper has eaten. What the grasshopper has left, the caterpillar has eaten.

hausa: Ibrahim kuwa ya ba wa wurin suna, Ubangiji Zai Tanada. Gama kamar yadda ake ce har yă zuwa yau, “A bisan dutsen Ubangiji, za a tanada.”
english: Abraham called the name of that place “Yahweh Will Provide”. As it is said to this day, “On Yahweh’s mountain, it will be provided.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Ubangiji Allahnku ya kawo ku cikin ƙasar da za ku shiga ku ci gādonta, sai ku yi shelar albarkun nan a dutsen Gerizim, ku kuma yi na la’ana a dutsen Ebal.
english: It shall happen, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land that you go to possess, that you shall set the blessing on Mount Gerizim, and the curse on Mount Ebal.

hausa: sai ya tara wa kansa ’yan iska da mugayen mutane suka yi gāba da Rehobowam ɗan Solomon. Rehobowam lokacin kuwa ba shi da wayo, don haka bai iya tsai da su ba.
english: Worthless men were gathered to him, wicked fellows who strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tender hearted, and could not withstand them.

hausa: Sa’an nan Samson ya kai hannuwansa ga ginshiƙan waɗanda haikalin yake a kai, ya jingina jikinsa, hannunsa dama yana a ɗaya, hannun hagu kuma na ɗayan,
english: Samson took hold of the two middle pillars on which the house rested and leaned on them, the one with his right hand and the other with his left.

hausa: Zan suturta abokan gābansa da kunya, amma rawanin da yake a kansa zai yi ta walƙiya.”
english: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”

hausa: Waɗannan su ne zuriyar Ishmayel ɗan Ibrahim, wanda Hagar mutuniyar Masar, baranyar Saratu, ta haifa wa Ibrahim.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant, bore to Abraham.

hausa: Bulus ya yanke shawara yă wuce Afisa a jirgin ruwa don kada yă ɓata lokaci a lardin Asiya, gama yana sauri yă kai Urushalima, in ya yiwu ma, a ranar Fentekos.
english: For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it were possible for him, to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost.

hausa: “Ka ɗauki waɗannan kayan yaji masu kyau, shekel 500 na ruwan mur, rabin turaren sinnamon mai daɗin ƙanshi shekel 250, shekel 250 na turaren wuta mai ƙanshi,
english: “Also take fine spices: of liquid myrrh, five hundred shekels; and of fragrant cinnamon half as much, even two hundred and fifty; and of fragrant cane, two hundred and fifty;

hausa: Mugaye sun kafa mini tarko, amma ban kauce daga farillanka ba.
english: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.

hausa: faɗa mana abin da nan gaba ta ƙunsa, don mu san cewa ku alloli ne. Ku yi wani abu, mai kyau ko mummuna, don mu ji tsoro da fargaba.
english: Declare the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and see it together.

hausa: Ku gina bagade wa Ubangiji Allahnku, bagaden dutse. Kada ku yi amfani da wani kayan aiki na ƙarfe a kansu.
english: There you shall build an altar to Yahweh your God, an altar of stones. You shall not use any iron tool on them.

hausa: Amma ku da kuke girmama sunana, ranar adalci za tă fito tare da warkarwa a fikafikanta. Za ku kuwa fita kuna tsalle kamar ’yan maruƙan da aka sake daga garke.
english: But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings. You will go out and leap like calves of the stall.

hausa: Saboda haka muna iya fitowa gabagadi, mu ce, “Ubangiji ne mai taimakona; ba zan ji tsoro ba. Me mutum zai iya yi mini?”
english: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”

hausa: Amma na faɗa muku, “Za ku mallaki ƙasarsu, zan ba ku ita gādo, ƙasa mai zub da madara da zuma.” Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku, wanda ya keɓe ku daga al’ummai.
english: But I have said to you, “You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey.” I am Yahweh your God, who has separated you from the peoples.

hausa: “Ka saƙa doguwar riga da lallausan lilin ka kuma yi hula da lallausan zaren lilin, ka kuma saƙa abin ɗamara mai ado.
english: You shall weave the tunic with fine linen. You shall make a turban of fine linen. You shall make a sash, the work of the embroiderer.

hausa: Saboda haka sauran almajiran suka ce masa, “Ai, mun ga Ubangiji!” Amma ya ce musu, “Ina, ai, sai na ga ramin ƙusa a hannuwansa na sa yatsata a inda ƙusoshi suka kasance, na kuma sa hannuna a gefensa, in ba haka ba, ba zan gaskata ba.”
english: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”

hausa: Zan aika da wuta a kan Magog da kuma a kan waɗanda suke zama lafiya a bakin teku, za su kuwa san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.
english: “I will send a fire on Magog and on those who dwell securely in the islands. Then they will know that I am Yahweh.

hausa: “Za ku ji kunya saboda masujadan ƙarƙashin itatuwan oak da kuka yi farin ciki; za a kunyata ku saboda lambun da kuka zaɓa.
english: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.

hausa: Suka ruga suka kawo shi. Da ya tsaya cikin mutane, sai ya fi kowa tsayi.
english: They ran and got him there. When he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.

hausa: Har yă zuwa yau, Edom tana yi wa Yahuda tawaye. A lokaci ɗaya ne Libna ma ta yi tawaye.
english: So Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.

hausa: Cikin wannan duka Ayuba bai yi wa Allah zunubi ta wurin ba shi laifi ba.
english: In all this, Job didn’t sin, nor charge God with wrongdoing.

hausa: Gama idanuna sun ga cetonka,
english: for my eyes have seen your salvation,

hausa: Sai mutanen suka huta a rana ta bakwai.
english: So the people rested on the seventh day.

hausa: Ubangiji zai kira sai ka ce ke mace ce da aka yashe ta tana kuma damuwa a ranta, macen da ta yi aure a ƙuruciya, sai kawai aka ƙi ta,” in ji Allahnki.
english: For Yahweh has called you as a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit, even a wife of youth, when she is cast off,” says your God.

hausa: Ana samun hikima a leɓunan masu fahimi, amma bulala domin bayan marasa azanci ne.
english: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.

hausa: Sa’ad da Husham ya mutu, Hadad ɗan Bedad, wanda ya ci Midiyan da yaƙi a cikin ƙasar Mowab, ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki. Aka kira birninsa Awit.
english: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.

hausa: Da lokacin hidimarsa ya cika, sai ya koma gida.
english: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.

hausa: Sa’ad da na kawo su cikin ƙasa mai zub da madara da zuma, ƙasar da na yi alkawari da rantsuwa ga kakanninsu, sa’ad da kuma suka ci suka ƙoshi, suka kuma yi ƙiba, za su juya ga waɗansu alloli su bauta musu, su ƙi ni, su kuma karya alkawarina.
english: For when I have brought them into the land which I swore to their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they have eaten and filled themselves, and grown fat, then they will turn to other gods, and serve them, and despise me, and break my covenant.

hausa: Wani zai ce, ‘Ni na Ubangiji ne’; wani kuma zai kira kansa da sunan Yaƙub; har yanzu wani zai rubuta a hannunsa, ‘Na Ubangiji,’ ya kuma ɗauki sunan Isra’ila.
english: One will say, ‘I am Yahweh’s.’ Another will be called by the name of Jacob; and another will write with his hand ‘to Yahweh,’ and honor the name of Israel.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Sihon da dukan sojojinsa suka fito don su sadu da mu, a yaƙi, a Yahaz,
english: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.

hausa: “ ‘Sa’ad da kuka yi girbin amfanin gonarku, kada ku girbe har zuwa gefen gonar, ko ku yi kalan girbinku.
english: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.

hausa: Tsirararki zai bayyana za a kuma buɗe kunyarki. Zan ɗauki fansa; ba zan bar wani ba.”
english: Your nakedness will be uncovered. Yes, your shame will be seen. I will take vengeance, and will spare no one.”

hausa: “Feres, An raba mulkinka aka ba wa Medes da Farisa.”
english: PERES: your kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.”

hausa: Game da sauran ayyukan mulkin Ahaz, abubuwan da ya yi, duk a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Yahuda.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

hausa: Kayifas ne wanda ya shawarci Yahudawa cewa zai fi kyau mutum ɗaya yă mutu saboda mutane.
english: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.

hausa: Na sani, ya Ubangiji, cewa ran mutum ba nasa ba ne; ba mutum ne yake kiyaye takawarsa ba.
english: Yahweh, I know that the way of man is not in himself. It is not in man who walks to direct his steps.

hausa: Kwana bakwai za ku yi shagalin Bikin ga Ubangiji Allahnku a wurin da ya zaɓa. Gama Ubangiji Allahnku zai albarkace ku a cikin dukan girbinku da kuma cikin dukan aikin hannuwanku, farin cikinku kuwa zai cika.
english: You shall keep a feast to Yahweh your God seven days in the place which Yahweh chooses, because Yahweh your God will bless you in all your increase and in all the work of your hands, and you shall be altogether joyful.

hausa: Ku bayar, ku ma sai a ba ku mudu a cike, a danƙare, har yă yi tozo, yana zuba, za a juye muku a hannun riga. Mudun da kuka auna da shi, da shi za a auna muku.”
english: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”

hausa: Sai Yoshuwa ya aika mutane daga Yeriko zuwa Ai kusa da Bet-Awen gabas da Betel, ya ce musu, “Ku je ku leƙo ku ga yadda yankin yake.” Sai mutanen suka je suka leƙo asirin ƙasar Ai.
english: Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth Aven, on the east side of Bethel, and spoke to them, saying, “Go up and spy out the land.” The men went up and spied out Ai.

hausa: Kada ku miƙa gaɓoɓin jikinku ga zunubi a matsayin kayan aikin mugunta, sai dai ku miƙa kanku ga Allah, a matsayin waɗanda aka fitar da su daga mutuwa zuwa rai; ku kuma miƙa gaɓoɓin jikinku gare shi a matsayin kayan aikin adalci.
english: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.

hausa: Zakoki za su iya rasa ƙarfi su kuma ji yunwa, amma waɗanda suke neman Ubangiji ba sa rasa abu mai kyau.
english: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.

hausa: Akwai kuma Gibeyon, Rama, Beyerot,
english: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,

hausa: To, fa, Ruhun Ubangiji ya riga ya rabu da Shawulu, sai mugun ruhu daga Ubangiji ya soma ba shi wahala.
english: Now Yahweh’s Spirit departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from Yahweh troubled him.

hausa: Sai jarumawa ukun nan suka yi kukan ƙura, suka sheƙa a guje suka ratsa cikin sansanin Filistiyawa, suka ɗebo ruwa daga rijiyar da take kusa da bakin ƙofar Betlehem, suka kawo wa Dawuda. Amma Dawuda ya ƙi yă sha; a maimako sai ya zuba shi a gaban Ubangiji.
english: The three mighty men broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate and took it and brought it to David; but he would not drink of it, but poured it out to Yahweh.

hausa: ya ce masa, “Ranka yă daɗe, ina roƙonka kada ka riƙe laifina a zuciya. Kada ka tuna da laifin da na yi maka ranka yă daɗe, ranan nan da kake gudu daga Urushalima. Kada ka tuna da shi ko kaɗan.
english: He said to the king, “Don’t let my lord impute iniquity to me, or remember that which your servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.

hausa: Sai Dawuda ya zauna a kagarar, ya kuma kira ta Birnin Dawuda. Ya gina wuraren da suke kewaye da ita, tun daga madogaran gini zuwa ciki.
english: David lived in the stronghold, and called it David’s city. David built around from Millo and inward.

hausa: “A kan bagaden zinariya, za su shimfiɗa zane mai ruwan shuɗi, su kuma rufe shi da fatar shanun teku, sai a zura masa sandunansa.
english: “On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Za ku iya sa abokan ango yin azumi yayinda yake tare da su?
english: He said to them, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?

hausa: Ga ni! Ina tsaye a bakin ƙofa, ina ƙwanƙwasawa. Duk wanda ya ji muryata ya kuma buɗe ƙofar, zan shiga in kuma ci tare da shi, shi kuma tare da ni.
english: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me.

hausa: In ka nome ƙasa, ba za tă ƙara ba ka hatsinta ba. Za ka kuma zama mai yawo barkatai a duniya.”
english: From now on, when you till the ground, it won’t yield its strength to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth.”

hausa: Suna riƙe da baka da māshi; mugaye ne marasa tausayi. Amonsu ya yi kamar rurin teku yayinda suke hawan dawakansu; suna zuwa kamar mutane a dāgār yaƙi don su fāɗa miki, ya Diyar Babilon.
english: They take up bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea. They ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Babylon.

hausa: Amma mataimakinka, Yoshuwa ɗan Nun, zai shiga. Ka ƙarfafa shi gama shi ne zai jagoranci Isra’ila su gāje ta.
english: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

hausa: Sai Eliyakim ɗan Hilkiya, sarkin fada, da Shebna magatakarda, da Yowa ɗan Asaf, marubuci, suka je wurin Hezekiya da tufafinsu a kece, suka faɗa masa abin da shugaban sojojin ya faɗa.
english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, came with Shebna the scribe and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him Rabshakeh’s words.

hausa: Ya yi kokawa da mala’ika ya kuma rinjaye shi; ya yi kuka ya kuma yi roƙo don tagomashi. Ya same shi a Betel ya kuma yi magana da shi a can,
english: Indeed, he struggled with the angel, and prevailed; he wept, and made supplication to him. He found him at Bethel, and there he spoke with us—

hausa: A wannan rana, Ubangiji ya yi alkawari da Abram ya ce, “Ga zuriyarka na ba da wannan ƙasa, daga kogin Masar zuwa babban kogi, Yuferites ke nan,
english: In that day Yahweh made a covenant with Abram, saying, “I have given this land to your offspring, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:

hausa: Benahiya, Bedeya, Keluhi,
english: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,

hausa: Ku yi haka da shanunku da tumakinku. Bari su kasance da iyayensu mata, har kwana bakwai, amma ku ba ni su a rana ta takwas.
english: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. It shall be with its mother seven days, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me.

hausa: Sarki Dawuda ya ce, “Ku kira mini Zadok firist, annabi Natan, da Benahiya ɗan Yehohiyada.” Da suka zo gaban sarki,
english: King David said, “Call to me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada.” They came before the king.

hausa: ya kuma kawo bunsuru ɗaya domin hadaya don zunubi;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

hausa: “ ‘Sa’an nan na wuce na ga kina birgima cikin jininki, yayinda kike kwance can cikin jininki sai na ce miki, “Ki rayu!”
english: “‘“When I passed by you, and saw you wallowing in your blood, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’ Yes, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’

hausa: Da sarauniya Sheba ta ga dukan hikimar Solomon da fadan da ya gina.
english: When the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, the house that he had built,

hausa: Ina magana da ku a kan ku mutane ne fa masu azanci; ku duba da kanku ku ga abin da nake faɗa.
english: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.

hausa: “Ka ɗauki duwatsu biyu masu daraja, ka rubuta sunayen ’ya’yan Isra’ila a kai
english: You shall take two onyx stones, and engrave on them the names of the children of Israel.

hausa: Sukan kuma nemi wuraren zama mafi daraja a majami’u, da kuma wuraren zaman manya a bukukkuwa.
english: and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts,

hausa: Amma Ittai ya ce wa sarki, “Muddin Ubangiji yana a raye kuma muddin ranka yă daɗe yana a raye, duk inda ranka yă daɗe sarki zai kasance, ko a yi rai ko a mutu, a can bawanka zai kasance.”
english: Ittai answered the king and said, “As Yahweh lives, and as my lord the king lives, surely in what place my lord the king is, whether for death or for life, your servant will be there also.”

hausa: A wannan lokaci za a manta da Taya har shekaru saba’in, tsawon rayuwar sarki. Amma a ƙarshen waɗannan shekaru saba’in, zai zama wa Taya kamar yadda yake a waƙar karuwa cewa,
english: It will come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. After the end of seventy years it will be to Tyre like in the song of the prostitute.

hausa: ’Yan’uwa, ku yi mana addu’a.
english: Brothers, pray for us.

hausa: Adalcinka yana kama da manyan duwatsu, hukuncinka kamar zurfi mai girma. Ya Ubangiji, kana lura da mutum da dabba.
english: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. Yahweh, you preserve man and animal.

hausa: Da suka bar taron, sai suka tafi tare da shi yadda yake, a cikin jirgin ruwa. Akwai waɗansu jiragen ruwa kuma tare da shi.
english: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.

hausa: Duk wanda ya taɓa gadonta dole yă wanke rigunansa yă kuma yi wanka, zai kuma ƙazantu har yamma.
english: Whoever touches her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

hausa: “Amma duba, mu bayi ne a yau, bayi a ƙasar da ka ba kakanninmu don su ci amfaninta da kuma waɗansu abubuwa masu kyau da take bayarwa.
english: “Behold, we are servants today, and as for the land that you gave to our fathers to eat its fruit and its good, behold, we are servants in it.

hausa: Kun sani, ’yan’uwa, cewa ziyararmu a gare ku ba tă zama a banza ba.
english: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,

hausa: Bari mu yarda da Ubangiji; bari mu nace gaba don mu yarda da shi. Muddin rana tana fitowa, zai bayyana; zai zo mana kamar ruwan bazara, kamar ruwan saman farko da yake jiƙe ƙasa.”
english: Let’s acknowledge Yahweh. Let’s press on to know Yahweh. As surely as the sun rises, Yahweh will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.”

hausa: Sai sarki ya ce mata, “Kada ki ji tsoro. Me kika gani?” Matar ta ce, “Na ga wani kurwa tana fitowa daga ƙasa.”
english: The king said to her, “Don’t be afraid! What do you see?” The woman said to Saul, “I see a god coming up out of the earth.”

hausa: Domin na yi masa zunubi, zan fuskanci fushin Ubangiji, har sai ya dubi batuna ya kuma tabbatar da ’yancina. Zai kawo ni zuwa wurin haske; zan ga adalcinsa.
english: I will bear the indignation of Yahweh, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case and executes judgment for me. He will bring me out to the light. I will see his righteousness.

hausa: “Sa’ad da sarakunan duniya da suka yi zina da ita suka kuma yi tarayya cikin jin daɗinta suka ga hayaƙin ƙunarta, za su yi kuka da makoki saboda ita.
english: The kings of the earth who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her will weep and wail over her, when they look at the smoke of her burning,

hausa: A rana ta shida, suka tattara ninki biyu, mudu biyu ga mutum guda, sai shugabannin taron suka zo suka kawo ƙara wurin Musa.
english: On the sixth day, they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one; and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

hausa: Yesu ya ci gaba da cewa, “To, da me zan kwatanta mutanen zamanin nan? Kamar me suke?
english: “To what then should I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?

hausa: A rana ta bakwai firist zai bincike shi, in kuwa ya ga cewa mikin bai canja ba, bai kuwa yaɗu a fatar jikin ba, zai kaɗaice shi na waɗansu ƙarin kwana bakwai.
english: The priest shall examine him on the seventh day. Behold, if in his eyes the plague is arrested and the plague hasn’t spread in the skin, then the priest shall isolate him for seven more days.

hausa: Zai sa yaudara ta ƙara yin yawa, zai ɗaukaka kansa. Sa’ad da suke ji sun sami mafaka, zai hallaka mutane da yawa sa’an nan kuma yă fara gāba da Sarkin sarakuna. Duk da haka za a hallaka shi, amma ba da ikon mutum ba.
english: Through his policy he will cause deceit to prosper in his hand. He will magnify himself in his heart, and he will destroy many in their security. He will also stand up against the prince of princes, but he will be broken without human hands.

hausa: gama mutane za su ji game da girman sunanka, da ƙarfin hannunka, da kuma hannunka mai iko, sa’ad da ya zo, ya yi addu’a yana fuskantar wannan haikali,
english: (for they shall hear of your great name and of your mighty hand and of your outstretched arm), when he comes and prays toward this house,

hausa: Mutanen Ruben, Gad da rabin kabilar Manasse suka ƙetare da shirin yaƙi, suka wuce gaban Isra’ila kamar yadda Musa ya ce su yi.
english: The children of Reuben, and the children of Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh crossed over armed before the children of Israel, as Moses spoke to them.

hausa: Ina roƙonku ’yan’uwa, a cikin sunan Ubangijinmu Yesu Kiristi, dukanku ku yarda da juna, domin kada a sami tsattsaguwa a cikinku, domin kuma ku zama ɗaya, cikakku a cikin halinku da tunaninku.
english: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

hausa: Don me na sa kaina cikin hatsari na yi kasada da raina?
english: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?

hausa: Kada ka bari ƙafar mai girman kai yă fāɗa mini, ko hannun mugu ya kore ni.
english: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.

hausa: Saboda haka suka tsere a gaban Isra’ila zuwa wajen hamada, amma ba su iya tsere wa yaƙin ba. Mutanen Isra’ila da suka fito daga cikin birnin suka karkashe su a can.
english: Therefore they turned their backs before the men of Israel to the way of the wilderness, but the battle followed hard after them; and those who came out of the cities destroyed them in the middle of it.

hausa: Suka karanta daga Littafin Dokar Allah, suna sa kowa ya gane, suna kuma ba da fassarar domin mutane su fahimci abin da ake karatu.
english: They read in the book, in the law of God, distinctly; and they gave the sense, so that they understood the reading.

hausa: Sa’ad da Maɗaukaki ya watsar da sarakuna a cikin ƙasa, sai ya zama kamar ƙanƙara ta sauka a kan Zalmon.
english: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.

hausa: Ku munafukai! Daidai ne Ishaya ya yi annabci a kanku da ya ce,
english: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,

hausa: Amma yanzu sun fi dare duhu; ba a iya gane su a tituna. Fatar jikinsu ta manne da ƙasusuwansu; sun bushe kamar itace.
english: Their appearance is blacker than a coal. They are not known in the streets. Their skin clings to their bones. It is withered. It has become like wood.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa da Haruna,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

hausa: Ba shi ne ya ce mini, ‘Ita ’yar’uwata ba ce,’ ita ma ba tă ce, ‘Shi ɗan’uwana ba ne’? Na yi haka da kyakkyawan nufi da hannuwa masu tsabta.”
english: Didn’t he tell me, ‘She is my sister’? She, even she herself, said, ‘He is my brother.’ I have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Nebuzaradan shugaban matsara ya kwashe waɗansu matalauta, da sauran mutane da aka bari a birnin, da waɗanda suka gudu zuwa wurin Sarkin Babilon, da sauran masu sana’a, ya kai su bautar talala a Babilon.
english: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the poorest of the people, and the rest of the people who were left in the city, and those who fell away, who defected to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude.

hausa: Ubangiji yana tsaron baƙi yana kuma lura da marayu da kuma gwauruwa, amma yakan lalatar da hanyoyin mugaye.
english: Yahweh preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.

hausa: Da suka isa wurin da ake kira “Ƙoƙon Kai,” nan suka gicciye shi, tare da masu laifin nan, ɗaya a hannun damansa, ɗayan kuma a hagunsa.
english: When they came to the place that is called “The Skull”, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.

hausa: Amma Ubangiji mai adalci ne; ya ’yantar da ni daga igiyoyin mugaye.
english: Yahweh is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.

hausa: Zan fitar da waɗanda suke mini tayarwa da kuma ’yan tawaye. Ko da yake zan fitar da su daga ƙasar da suke zama, duk da haka ba za su shiga ƙasar Isra’ila ba. Sa’an nan za ku san cewa ni ne Ubangiji.
english: I will purge out from among you the rebels and those who disobey me. I will bring them out of the land where they live, but they shall not enter into the land of Israel. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.”

hausa: Bakunanmu sun cika da dariya, harsunanmu da waƙoƙin farin ciki. Sai ana faɗi a cikin al’ummai, “Ubangiji ya aikata manyan abubuwa dominsu.”
english: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “Yahweh has done great things for them.”

hausa: Shawulu ya ce, “Ba za ka iya yin faɗa da wannan Bafilistin ba, ya daɗe yana yaƙi, ya yi yaƙi tun yana saurayi. Ga shi kuwa kai ɗan yaro ne kawai.”
english: Saul said to David, “You are not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him; for you are but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.”

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
