hausa: ’Ya’yan Shobal maza su ne, Alwan, Manahat, Ebal, Shefo da Onam.
english: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

hausa: In wani ya tambaye ku, ‘Don me kuke yin haka?’ Ku gaya masa cewa, ‘Ubangiji yana bukatarsa, zai kuma dawo da shi ba da jimawa ba.’ ”
english: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs him;’ and immediately he will send him back here.”

hausa: “Bari ka ga muguntarsu duka; ka yi musu yadda ka yi mini domin dukan zunubansu. Nishina da yawa kuma zuciyata ta gaji.”
english: “Let all their wickedness come before you. Do to them as you have done to me for all my transgressions. For my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.

hausa: Saboda haka ya yi tsayi fiye da sauran itatuwan kurmi; rassansa suka ƙaru suka yi tsayi, suka bazu saboda yalwar ruwaye.
english: Therefore its stature was exalted above all the trees of the field; and its boughs were multiplied. Its branches became long by reason of many waters, when it spread them out.

hausa: Ku gane wannan, cewa ba domin adalcinku ba ne ya sa Ubangiji Allahnku yana ba ku wannan ƙasa mai kyau, ku mallaki, gama ku mutane masu taurinkai ne.
english: Know therefore that Yahweh your God doesn’t give you this good land to possess for your righteousness, for you are a stiff-necked people.

hausa: Za a miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa da bijimi guda, rago guda, ’yan raguna bakwai, bana ɗaya-ɗaya don daɗin ƙanshi ga Ubangiji, duka su kasance marasa lahani.
english: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

hausa: Gama kamar yadda ƙasa takan sa tsire-tsire su tohu lambu kuma ya sa iri ya yi girma, haka Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka zai sa adalci da yabo su tsiro a gaban dukan al’ummai.
english: For as the earth produces its bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring up, so the Lord Yahweh will cause righteousness and praise to spring up before all the nations.

hausa: Yanzu ga sarkinku da kuka zaɓa wanda kuka nema, ga shi Ubangiji ya naɗa muku sarki.
english: Now therefore see the king whom you have chosen and whom you have asked for. Behold, Yahweh has set a king over you.

hausa: Sai ta tambaya shi ta ce, “Na roƙe ka ɗa ne, ranka yă daɗe? Ba na ce maka, ‘Kada ka sa in fara bege ba’?”
english: Then she said, “Did I ask you for a son, my lord? Didn’t I say, ‘Do not deceive me’?”

hausa: Marta kuwa, aikin hidima da ya kamata a yi, ya ɗauke mata hankali, sai ta zo wurin Yesu, ta ce, “Ubangiji, ba ka damu da yadda ’yar’uwata ta bar mini aiki ni kaɗai ba? Gaya mata ta taimake ni!”
english: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”

hausa: ka kiyaye harshenka daga mugunta da kuma leɓunanku daga faɗar ƙarairayi.
english: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.

hausa: Sa’ad da lokaci ya gabato da Isra’ila zai mutu, sai ya kira ɗansa Yusuf, ya ce masa, “Ka yi mini wannan alheri, ka sa hannunka ƙarƙashin cinyar ƙafata, ka yi mini alkawari saboda ina roƙonka kaɗa ka bizne ni a Masar,
english: The time came near that Israel must die, and he called his son Joseph, and said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, please put your hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me. Please don’t bury me in Egypt,

hausa: Awwiyawa suka ƙera Nibhaz da Tartak, Sefarfayawa kuwa suka ƙone ’ya’yansu a wuta a matsayi hadayu ga Adrammelek da Anammelek allolin Sefarfayim.
english: and the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.

hausa: Yosiya kuma ya haifi Yekoniya da ’yan’uwansa a lokacin da aka kwashe su zuwa bauta a Babilon.
english: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.

hausa: Ɗaukan waɗannan zuriyar Obed-Edom ne; su da ’ya’yansu maza da danginsu, jarumawa ne masu ƙarfin yin aiki. Zuriyar Obed-Edom, mutum 62 ne duka.
english: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.

hausa: Wa ya faɗi wannan tun daga farko, don mu sani, ko kafin ya faru, don mu ce, ‘Ya faɗi daidai’? Ba wanda ya faɗa wannan, ba wanda ya riga faɗe shi, ba wanda ya ji wata magana daga gare ku.
english: Who has declared it from the beginning, that we may know? and before, that we may say, ‘He is right’? Surely, there is no one who declares. Surely, there is no one who shows. Surely, there is no one who hears your words.

hausa: Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa, “Ina gab da kawo hukunci a kan allahn Amon na Tebes, a kan Fir’auna, a kan Masar da allolinta da sarakunanta, da kuma a kan waɗanda suka dogara ga Fir’auna.
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will punish Amon of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with her gods and her kings, even Pharaoh, and those who trust in him.

hausa: Saboda haka ku ƙarfafa juna da waɗannan kalmomi.
english: Therefore comfort one another with these words.

hausa: A wannan lokaci za a kawo kyautai wa Ubangiji Maɗaukaki daga dogayen mutane masu sulɓin jiki, daga mutanen da ake jin tsoro a ko’ina, al’umma mai ƙarfin iko na jawabin da ba a saba ji ba, mai ƙasar da koguna suka raba. Za a kawo kyautai zuwa Dutsen Sihiyona, wurin da Sunan Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yake.
english: In that time, a present will be brought to Yahweh of Armies from a people tall and smooth, even from a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide, to the place of the name of Yahweh of Armies, Mount Zion.

hausa: Ɗanɗanon maganarka akwai zaki, sun ma fi zuma zaki a bakina!
english: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!

hausa: Na furta laifina; na damu da zunubina.
english: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.

hausa: Kada ku rena annabci,
english: Don’t despise prophecies.

hausa: Zan yi murna in kuma yi farin ciki a cikin ƙaunarka, gama ka ga azabata ka kuma san wahalar raina.
english: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.

hausa: Sun kuma yi mini wannan. A lokaci guda sun ƙazantar da wuri mai tsarkina suka ɓata Asabbataina.
english: Moreover this they have done to me: they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day, and have profaned my Sabbaths.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Gaskiya nake faɗa maka, ba wanda zai iya ganin mulkin Allah sai an sāke haihuwarsa.”
english: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”

hausa: Har ’ya’yansu ma sun tuna bagadansu da ginshiƙan Asheransu kusa da itatuwa masu duhuwa da kuma a kan tuddai masu tsayi.
english: Even their children remember their altars and their Asherah poles by the green trees on the high hills.

hausa: Sai na ji wani abu mai ƙara kamar wata murya a tsakiyar halittu huɗun nan masu rai tana cewa, “Kwatan alkama don albashin aikin yini, da kuma kwata uku na sha’ir don albashin yini guda, kada kuwa ka ɓata man da ruwan inabi!”
english: I heard a voice in the middle of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! Don’t damage the oil and the wine!”

hausa: “Wa ya taɓa sanin hankalin Ubangiji, har da zai koya masa?” Amma muna da tunani iri na Kiristi ne.
english: “For who has known the mind of the Lord that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.

hausa: Ya ce wa mutanen Sukkot, “Ku ba wa mutanena burodi; sun gaji, har yanzu ina fafarar Zeba da Zalmunna, sarakunan Midiyawa.”
english: He said to the men of Succoth, “Please give loaves of bread to the people who follow me; for they are faint, and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.”

hausa: A rana ta bakwai na watan biyar, wadda ta zama shekara ta goma sha tara ta mulkin Sarki Nebukadnezzar na Babilon, Nebuzaradan, babban hafsan matsaran sarki, kuma bafadan sarkin Babilon, ya zo Urushalima
english: Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya kawo ’ya’yan Haruna maza, ya sa musu taguwoyi, ya ɗaɗɗaura igiyoyi kewaye da su, ya kuma sa musu huluna yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi.
english: Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and clothed them with tunics, and tied sashes on them, and put headbands on them, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Kalmomin mai gulma suna kama da burodi mai daɗi; sukan gangara can cikin cikin mutum.
english: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, they go down into the innermost parts.

hausa: Za su lura da dukan kayayyakin Tentin Sujada, suna cika hakkin Isra’ilawa ta wurin yin aiki a tabanakul.
english: They shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting, and the obligations of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

hausa: Sai Bafarisiyen ya tashi tsaye, ya yi addu’a game da kansa yana cewa, ‘Allah, na gode maka, saboda ni ba kamar sauran mutane ba ne, wato, mafasa, masu aikata mugunta, masu zina, ko kuma kamar mai karɓar harajin nan.
english: The Pharisee stood and prayed by himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men: extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.

hausa: Daga can ya haura zuwa Beyersheba.
english: He went up from there to Beersheba.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ibrahim ya miƙa hannunsa ya ɗauki wuƙar don yă yanka ɗansa.
english: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.

hausa: Mutumin da ba shi da azanci yakan ɗauki lamunin wani ya kuma ɗauki nauyin biyan basusuwan maƙwabci.
english: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.

hausa: Da suka iso gidan mai mulkin majami’ar, sai Yesu ya ga ana hayaniya, mutane suna kuka da kururuwa.
english: He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.

hausa: Nonanki sun yi kamar bareyi biyu, tagwayen barewa.
english: Your two breasts are like two fawns, that are twins of a roe.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa, “Game da annabawa masu ɓad da mutanena, in wani ya ciyar da su, sai su ce akwai ‘salama’ amma in bai ciyar da su ba, a shirye suke su kai masa hari.
english: Yahweh says concerning the prophets who lead my people astray—for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!” and whoever doesn’t provide for their mouths, they prepare war against him:

hausa: ƙanƙara ta fāɗo, walƙiya kuma tana ta wulƙawa. Wannan ce ƙanƙara mafi munin da aka taɓa yi, a dukan ƙasar Masar, tun tarihin kahuwarta na zaman al’umma.
english: So there was very severe hail, and lightning mixed with the hail, such as had not been in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation.

hausa: Idan zuciyarmu ta nuna mana muna da laifi, mun san cewa Allah ya fi zuciyarmu, ya kuma san dukan kome.
english: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

hausa: ya kuma ce mini, ‘Zan sa ka yi ta haihuwa ka kuma riɓaɓɓanya, za ka ƙaru a yawa. Zan mai da kai al’ummar mutane, zan kuma ba ka wannan ƙasa tă zama madawwamiyar mallaka ga zuriyarka a bayanka.’
english: and said to me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful, and multiply you, and I will make of you a company of peoples, and will give this land to your offspring after you for an everlasting possession.’

hausa: Ubangiji ya sadu da Bala’am, ya kuma ba shi saƙo ya ce, “Koma wurin Balak ka ba shi wannan saƙo.”
english: Yahweh met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”

hausa: Tunaninka suna da daraja gare ni, ya Allah! Yawansu ba su da iyaka!
english: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!

hausa: “Ni, Daniyel, ruhuna ya damu ƙwarai, kuma wahayin da ya ratsa tunanina ya dame ni.
english: “As for me, Daniel, my spirit was grieved within my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.

hausa: Sa’ad da raƙuman suka gama shan ruwa, mutumin ya fitar da zoben hanci na zinariya mai nauyin giram biyar da woroworo biyu na zinariya masu nauyin shekel goma, ya ba ta.
english: As the camels had finished drinking, the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,

hausa: A gare ka, ya Ubangiji, nake kira, gama wuta ta cinye wurin kiwo harshen wuta kuma ya ƙone dukan itatuwan jeji.
english: Yahweh, I cry to you, for the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame has burned all the trees of the field.

hausa: in kuwa alamar, ko al’ajabin da annabin ya yi faɗin ya faru, ya kuma ce, “Bari mu bi waɗansu alloli (allolin da ba ku sani ba) mu kuma yi musu sujada,”
english: and the sign or the wonder comes to pass, of which he spoke to you, saying, “Let’s go after other gods” (which you have not known) “and let’s serve them,”

hausa: Da baiwar ta gan shi a can, sai ta sāke gaya wa waɗanda suke tsattsaye a wurin, ta ce, “Wannan mutum yana ɗaya daga cikinsu.”
english: The maid saw him and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”

hausa: Zai kawo maka saƙo wanda ta wurinsa kai da dukan iyalinka za ku sami ceto.’
english: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’

hausa: Ka ’yantar da ni daga tarkon da aka sa mini, gama kai ne mafakata.
english: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.

hausa: Za su ɗauki hakkin laifinsu annabin zai zama mai laifi daidai da wanda ya zo neman shawararsa.
english: They will bear their iniquity. The iniquity of the prophet will be even as the iniquity of him who seeks him,

hausa: Amma a ranan nan zai tā da murya ya ce, “Ba ni ba dai. Ba ni da abinci ko abin sawa a gidana; kada ka mai da ni shugaban mutane.”
english: In that day he will cry out, saying, “I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing. You shall not make me ruler of the people.”

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Kada Ubangiji ya yi fushi, amma bari in ƙara magana. A ce mutum talatin kaɗai aka samu a can fa?” Ya ce, “Ba zan aikata ba, in na sami mutum talatin a can.”
english: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak. What if there are thirty found there?” He said, “I will not do it if I find thirty there.”

hausa: Me ka sani da ba mu sani ba? Wane fahimi kake da shi da ba mu da shi?
english: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?

hausa: sai Haruna ya ce wa Musa, “Ranka yă daɗe, ina roƙonka kada ka hukunta mu, gama zunubin da muka yi, mun yi ne cikin wauta.
english: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.

hausa: Tsoro zai kwashe shi kamar ambaliyar ruwa; Da dare iska za tă tafi da shi.
english: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.

hausa: Ta ba da kanta ga duk waɗanda suke masu ilimin Assuriya ta kuma ƙazantar da kanta da dukan gumaka na kowa da take kai da kawowa a cikinsu.
english: She gave herself as a prostitute to them, all of them the choicest men of Assyria. She defiled herself with the idols of whomever she lusted after.

hausa: Zan juya ka in kuma ja ka. Zan kawo ka daga can arewa in aike ka don ka fāɗa wa duwatsun Isra’ila.
english: I will turn you around, will lead you on, and will cause you to come up from the uttermost parts of the north; and I will bring you onto the mountains of Israel.

hausa: Sa’ad da suka yi ɗan nisa daga gidan Mika, sai aka kira mutanen da suke maƙwabtakar da Mika suka taru suka bi mutanen Dan suka cim musu.
english: When they were a good way from the house of Micah, the men who were in the houses near Micah’s house gathered together and overtook the children of Dan.

hausa: Masar, Yahuda, Edom, Ammon, Mowab da dukan waɗanda suke zaune a hamada a wurare masu nisa. Gama dukan waɗannan al’ummai marasa kaciya ne, har dukan gidan Isra’ila ma marasa kaciya ne a zuciya.”
english: Egypt, Judah, Edom, the children of Ammon, Moab, and all who have the corners of their hair cut off, who dwell in the wilderness, for all the nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in heart.”

hausa: Ubangiji zai tashi kamar yadda ya yi a Dutsen Feratsim, zai tā da kansa kamar a Kwarin Gibeyon don yă aikata aikinsa, aikinsa da ba a saba gani ba, yă kuma yi aikinsa, baƙon aikinsa.
english: For Yahweh will rise up as on Mount Perazim. He will be angry as in the valley of Gibeon; that he may do his work, his unusual work, and bring to pass his act, his extraordinary act.

hausa: Sai mutanen ƙasar suka kashe duk waɗanda suka ƙulla wa Sarki Amon maƙarƙashiya, sa’an nan suka naɗa ɗansa sarki a maimakonsa.
english: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against King Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place.

hausa: Zan furta sunanka ga ’yan’uwana; cikin taron masu sujada zan yabe ka.
english: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.

hausa: sai suka sa wa wannan wuri suna, Bokim. A nan suka miƙa hadaya a gaban Ubangiji.
english: They called the name of that place Bochim, and they sacrificed there to Yahweh.

hausa: “Bawansa ya dawo ya gaya wa maigidansa wannan. Sai maigidan ya yi fushi, ya ba da umarni ga bawansa ya ce, ‘Ka fita da sauri, ka bi titi-titi da lungu-lungu na garin, ka kawo matalauta, da guragu, da makafi, da shanyayyu.’
english: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’

hausa: Wanda ba ya ƙaunata ba zai yi biyayya da koyarwata ba. Waɗannan kalmomin da kuke ji ba nawa ba ne; na Uba ne da ya aiko ni.
english: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.

hausa: Akwai wani mutumin da aka aiko daga Allah; mai suna Yohanna.
english: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.

hausa: Masu albarka ne waɗanda suke yin adalci, waɗanda kullum suke yin abin da yake daidai.
english: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.

hausa: A bisa duwatsun nan goma sha biyu, sai a zāna sunayen ’ya’yan Isra’ila bisa ga kabilansu goma sha biyu. Za a zāna sunayen kamar hatimi.
english: The stones shall be according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, they shall be for the twelve tribes.

hausa: A ranan nan Sadukiyawa, waɗanda suke cewa babu tashin matattu, suka zo wurinsa da tambaya.
english: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,

hausa: Amma a cikin Isra’ilawa, ba karen da zai yi haushi wa mutum ko dabba.’ Ta haka za ku sani Ubangiji zai bambanta tsakanin Masar da Isra’ila.
english: But against any of the children of Israel a dog won’t even bark or move its tongue, against man or animal, that you may know that Yahweh makes a distinction between the Egyptians and Israel.

hausa: mutanen Efraim, jarumawa, sanannu cikin gidajensu, su 20 800;
english: Of the children of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.

hausa: domin, kamar yadda zunubi ya yi mulki cikin mutuwa, haka ma alheri yă yi mulki ta wurin adalci yă kuwa kawo rai madawwami ta wurin Yesu Kiristi Ubangijinmu.
english: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

hausa: Na ga cewa hikima ta fi wauta, kamar yadda haske ya fi duhu.
english: Then I saw that wisdom excels folly, as far as light excels darkness.

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya tambaye ni ya ce, “Me ka gani, Irmiya?” Na ce, “’Ya’yan ɓaure. Masu kyau ɗin suna da kyau sosai, amma munanan sun yi muni har ba a iya ci.”
english: Then Yahweh asked me, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” I said, “Figs. The good figs are very good, and the bad are very bad, so bad that they can’t be eaten.”

hausa: Suka tashi daga Yotbata, suka yi sansani a Abrona.
english: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.

hausa: Babu wani zunubin da ya aikata da za a tuna da shi. Ya yi abin da yake gaskiya da kuma daidai; tabbatacce zai rayu.
english: None of his sins that he has committed will be remembered against him. He has done that which is lawful and right. He will surely live.

hausa: Za ka ɗauki kowane irin abinci wanda za a ci, ka adana don yă zama abincinka da nasu.”
english: Take with you some of all food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; and it will be for food for you, and for them.”

hausa: Ya aiko da alamu da abubuwan banmamaki a tsirkiyarku, ya Masar, a kan Fir’auna da kuma dukan bayinsa.
english: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.

hausa: Dole taro su kāre wanda ake zargi da kisa, daga mai bin hakkin jini. Su mai da shi birnin mafaka inda ya gudu ya tafi. Dole yă kasance a can sai mutuwar babban firist, wanda aka shafe da mai mai tsarki.
english: The congregation shall deliver the man slayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, where he had fled. He shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

hausa: Ka tuɓe taguwar Haruna ka sa wa ɗansa Eleyazar, gama Haruna zai rasu a can.”
english: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron shall be gathered, and shall die there.”

hausa: Ban ga haikali a cikin birnin ba, domin Ubangiji Allah Maɗaukaki da kuma Ɗan Ragon ne haikalin birnin.
english: I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God the Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.

hausa: Su ne kuma manyan shugabanni masu lura da ayyukan Solomon, su ne shugabanni 550 masu lura da mutanen da suke aiki.
english: These were the five hundred fifty chief officers who were over Solomon’s work, who ruled over the people who labored in the work.

hausa: Yana kama da itacen da aka shuka kusa da maɓulɓulan ruwa, wanda yake ba da amfani a daidai lokaci wanda kuma ganyensa ba sa bushewa. Duk abin da yake yi, yakan yi nasara.
english: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

hausa: Saboda haka, ku nuna wa waɗannan mutane shaidar ƙaunarku, da kuma dalilin taƙamarmu da ku, domin ikkilisiyoyi su gani.
english: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.

hausa: babba da yaro mai arziki da talaka.
english: both low and high, rich and poor together.

hausa: A wannan rana mutane za su zo gare ka daga Assuriya da kuma biranen Masar, daga Masar ma har zuwa Yuferites daga teku zuwa teku, kuma daga dutse zuwa dutse.
english: In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and mountain to mountain.

hausa: Fir’auna sarkin Masar, ma’aikatansa, fadawansa da dukan mutanensa,
english: Pharaoh king of Egypt, with his servants, his princes, and all his people;

hausa: Sai suka kawo mutumin da dā yake makaho wurin Farisiyawa.
english: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.

hausa: Bayan an kau da Shawulu, sai ya naɗa Dawuda ya zama sarkinsu. Ya kuma yi shaida game da shi cewa, ‘Na sami Dawuda ɗan Yesse, mutum ne da nake so a zuciyata; shi zai aikata dukan abin da nake so.’
english: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’

hausa: “Maigidana ya ce, ‘Ubangiji wanda yake tare da ni zai aiki mala’ikansa tare da kai, yă kuma sa tafiyarka tă yi nasara, don ka samo wa ɗana mata daga dangina, daga kuma gidan mahaifina.
english: He said to me, ‘Yahweh, before whom I walk, will send his angel with you, and prosper your way. You shall take a wife for my son from my relatives, and of my father’s house.

hausa: Isra’ilawa a ɓoye sun aikata abubuwan da ba daidai ba ga Ubangiji Allahnsu. Tun daga hasumiyoyi har zuwa birane masu katanga, sun gina wa kansu wuraren sujada na tudu a dukan garuruwansu.
english: The children of Israel secretly did things that were not right against Yahweh their God; and they built high places for themselves in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city;

hausa: Da numfashinsa ya sa sararin sama ya yi kyau da hannunsa ya soke macijin nan mai gudu.
english: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.

hausa: “Ka gabatar da damuwarka,” in ji Ubangiji. “Ka kawo gardandaminka,” in ji Sarki na Yaƙub.
english: Produce your cause,” says Yahweh. “Bring out your strong reasons!” says the King of Jacob.

hausa: Suka tafi, suka haura zuwa ƙasar tudu, suka kai Kwarin Eshkol, suka leƙo asirin ƙasar.
english: They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.

hausa: Za su kuma dawo da dukan ’yan’uwanku, daga dukan al’ummai, zuwa dutsena mai tsarki a Urushalima kamar hadaya ga Ubangiji, a kan dawakai, a kekunan yaƙi da wagonu, da kuma a kan alfadarai da kuma raƙuma,” in ji Ubangiji. “Za su kawo su, kamar yadda Isra’ilawa suke kawo hadayun hatsi, zuwa haikalin Ubangiji a cikin tsabtatattun kore.
english: They shall bring all your brothers out of all the nations for an offering to Yahweh, on horses, in chariots, in litters, on mules, and on camels, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, says Yahweh, as the children of Israel bring their offering in a clean vessel into Yahweh’s house.

hausa: Ya kuwa fāɗa musu ya kuma karkashe su da yawa. Sa’an nan ya gangara ya zauna a kogo a dutsen Etam.
english: He struck them hip and thigh with a great slaughter; and he went down and lived in the cave in Etam’s rock.

hausa: Ka yi duhu, sai ya zama dare, sai dukan namun jeji a kurmi suka fito a maƙe.
english: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.

hausa: Ruwa ya taso, ya ƙaru ƙwarai a duniya, jirgin kuma ya yi ta yawo a bisa ruwa.
english: The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.

hausa: Don haka, ina roƙonku kada ku fid da zuciya saboda abin da ake yi mini a nan. Ai, saboda ku ne nake shan wahalolin nan, wannan kuwa ɗaukakarku ce.
english: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

hausa: Sai ya ba da umarni mai tsanani, kada kowa yă san kome game da wannan. Sai ya ce musu, su ba ta wani abu tă ci.
english: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.

hausa: Rafi mai gudu a hankali zai zama kango saboda zafin fushin Ubangiji.
english: The peaceful folds are brought to silence because of the fierce anger of Yahweh.

hausa: “Idan mutane suka yi faɗa, ɗayan ya jefa ɗayan da dutse, ko ya naushe shi amma bai mutu ba, sai dai ya yi ta jiyya,
english: “If men quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone, or with his fist, and he doesn’t die, but is confined to bed;

hausa: Almajiran Yohanna suka zo suka ɗauki gawarsa suka binne. Sa’an nan suka je suka gaya wa Yesu.
english: His disciples came, took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.

hausa: “Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa game da mutanen Anatot, waɗanda suke neman ranka suna kuma cewa, ‘Kada ka yi annabci da sunan Ubangiji in ba haka za ka mutu a hannunmu’
english: “Therefore Yahweh says concerning the men of Anathoth, who seek your life, saying, ‘You shall not prophesy in Yahweh’s name, that you not die by our hand’—

hausa: Elisha ya ce mata, “War haka baɗi, za ki riƙe ɗa na kanki.” Sai ta ce masa, “A’a, ranka yă daɗe, mutumin Allah, kada ka ruɗi baiwarka!”
english: He said, “At this season next year, you will embrace a son.” She said, “No, my lord, you man of God, do not lie to your servant.”

hausa: “Ruwan da aka sata ya fi daɗi; abincin da aka ci a ɓoye ya fi daɗi!”
english: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”

hausa: Firist zai ƙone su a kan bagade kamar hadayar abinci, wato, hadaya ce da aka ƙone da wuta ga Ubangiji.
english: The priest shall burn it on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire to Yahweh.

hausa: Hezekiya ya ba da umarni a miƙa hadaya ta ƙonawa a kan bagade. Yayinda aka fara miƙawa, ana rerawa ga Ubangiji, tare da bushe-bushe da kiɗe-kiɗen kayan waƙa na Dawuda sarkin Isra’ila.
english: Hezekiah commanded them to offer the burnt offering on the altar. When the burnt offering began, Yahweh’s song also began, along with the trumpets and instruments of David king of Israel.

hausa: “Ka kasa kunne gare ni, ya Yaƙub, Isra’ila, wanda na kira cewa, Ni ne shi; ni ne na farko ni ne kuma na ƙarshe.
english: “Listen to me, O Jacob, and Israel my called: I am he. I am the first. I am also the last.

hausa: Dukan hafsoshi da dukan mutane suka kawo nasu kuɗin da aka sa musu da farin ciki, suna zuba su cikin akwatin sai da ya cika.
english: All the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had filled it.

hausa: Yakan yi kwanto kusa da ƙauyuka; daga kwanton yakan kashe marar laifi. Yana kallon waɗanda za su shiga hannunsa a ɓoye.
english: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.

hausa: Dole ka koyar da abin da yake bisa sahihiyar koyarwa.
english: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

hausa: sai Dawuda da mutanensa suka yi kuka, suka yi ta kuka har sai da ƙarfinsu ya ƙare.
english: Then David and the people who were with him lifted up their voice and wept until they had no more power to weep.

hausa: Suka faɗa masa, “Yusuf yana da rai! Gaskiya, shi ne mai mulkin dukan Masar.” Gaban Yaƙub ya fāɗi, domin bai gaskata su ba.
english: They told him, saying, “Joseph is still alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt.” His heart fainted, for he didn’t believe them.

hausa: Akwai ramin azurfa akwai kuma wurin da ake tace zinariya.
english: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.

hausa: ta tara a kan Mattaniya, ’ya’yansa maza da danginsa, 12
english: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

hausa: Suna girbi a gonakin da ba nasu ba, suna yin kala a gonar inabi ta mugaye.
english: They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.

hausa: Suka yi fasalin ’ya’yan rumman da shuɗi, da shunayya, da jan zare, da lallausan lilin kewaye da gefe-gefen taguwar.
english: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.

hausa: sai ya ce wa Hazayel, “Ɗauki wannan tare da kai ka tafi ka taryi mutumin Allah. Ka nemi nufin Ubangiji ta wurinsa; ka tambaye shi, ‘Zan warke daga ciwon nan?’ ”
english: The king said to Hazael, “Take a present in your hand, and go meet the man of God, and inquire of Yahweh by him, saying, ‘Will I recover from this sickness?’”

hausa: Wani mutum a cikin taron ya amsa ya ce, “Malam, na kawo maka ɗana mai wani ruhun da yake hana shi magana.
english: One of the multitude answered, “Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;

hausa: kwasakwasa, ungulu, da babba da jaka,
english: the pelican, the vulture, the cormorant,

hausa: Za su yi bikin da yamma, a rana ta sha huɗu ga wata na biyu. Za su ci naman tunkiya, tare da burodi marar yisti, da ganyaye masu ɗaci.
english: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

hausa: Iyakar ƙasar Manasse ta tashi daga Asher zuwa Mikmetat a gabashin Shekem. Iyakar kuma ta miƙe har zuwa kudu wadda ta ƙunshi mutanen da suke zaune a En Taffuwa.
english: The border of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem. The border went along to the right hand, to the inhabitants of En Tappuah.

hausa: A ce sabon mikin ya canja ya juya fari, dole yă je wurin firist.
english: Or if the raw flesh turns again, and is changed to white, then he shall come to the priest.

hausa: Saboda haka in kana tsammani kana tsaye ne, to, ka yi hankali kada ka fāɗi!
english: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.

hausa: Amon yana da shekara ashirin da biyu sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya yi mulki a Urushalima shekara biyu.
english: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Jerusalem.

hausa: Firist ya amsa ya ce, “Ku sauka lafiya, gama tafiyarku tana da yardan Ubangiji.”
english: The priest said to them, “Go in peace. Your way in which you go is before Yahweh.”

hausa: Akwai rubutu na zarginsa, da ya ce, Sarkin Yahudawa.
english: The superscription of his accusation was written over him: “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

hausa: Ta haka za a kasance da hadayu masu adalci, hadayun ƙonawa ɗungum don su faranta ka; sa’an nan za a miƙa bijimai a bagadenka.
english: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.

hausa: Ka yi tunani a ranka ka ce, “Zan hau zuwa sama; zan ɗaga kursiyina sama da taurarin Allah; zan zauna a kursiyi a kan dutsen taro, a can ƙurewar saman dutse mai tsarki.
english: You said in your heart, “I will ascend into heaven! I will exalt my throne above the stars of God! I will sit on the mountain of assembly, in the far north!

hausa: Dukan taron Isra’ilawa suka kama tafiya daga Hamadar Sin, suka yi ta tafiya suna sauka a wurare dabam-dabam bisa ga umarnin Ubangiji. A ƙarshe suka sauka a Refidim, suka zauna a can, amma ba ruwan da jama’a za su sha.
english: All the congregation of the children of Israel traveled from the wilderness of Sin, starting according to Yahweh’s commandment, and encamped in Rephidim; but there was no water for the people to drink.

hausa: Abubuwan da suke tabbatar da manzo, alamu, abubuwa da kuma ayyukan banmamaki, an aikata su a cikinku da matuƙar nacewa.
english: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.

hausa: In ka komo ga Maɗaukaki, za ka warke. In ka kawar da mugunta daga cikin gidanka.
english: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.

hausa: Na ce wa kaina, “Zo, zan gwada ka da jin daɗi don in ga abin da yake da kyau.” Amma wannan ma ya zama ba amfani.
english: I said in my heart, “Come now, I will test you with mirth; therefore enjoy pleasure;” and behold, this also was vanity.

hausa: Saboda haka, ina ƙoƙari kullum in kasance da lamiri mai tsabta a gaban Allah da mutane.
english: In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.

hausa: Ta haka Zimri ya hallaka dukan iyalin Ba’asha, bisa ga maganar da Ubangiji ya yi game da Ba’asha ta wurin annabi Yehu.
english: Thus Zimri destroyed all the house of Baasha, according to Yahweh’s word which he spoke against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,

hausa: Suka kame birane masu katanga masu ƙarfi, da ƙasa masu ba da amfani; suka mallaki gidaje cike da kowane irin abu mai kyau, da rijiyoyin da aka riga aka haƙa, da gonakin inabi, da gonakin itatuwan zaitun da kuma itatuwan ba da ’ya’ya a yalwace a ciki. Suka ci suka ƙoshi, suka kuma yi ƙiba; suka ji daɗi cikin alherinka mai girma.
english: They took fortified cities and a rich land, and possessed houses full of all good things, cisterns dug out, vineyards, olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate, were filled, became fat, and delighted themselves in your great goodness.

hausa: A shekarar da babban shugaban yaƙin da Sargon sarkin Assuriya ya aika, ya zo Ashdod ya kuma fāɗa mata ya kuma ci ta da yaƙi,
english: In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it;

hausa: Muna cika da tsoro, da lalatarwa da hallakarwa.”
english: Terror and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.”

hausa: zancen da na umarci kakanni-kakanninku sa’ad da na fitar da su daga Masar, daga cikin tanderun narkewar ƙarfe.’ Na ce, ‘Ku yi mini biyayya ku kuma aikata kowane abin da na umarce ku, za ku kuwa zama mutanena, ni kuwa zan zama Allahnku.
english: which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace,’ saying, ‘Obey my voice and do them, according to all which I command you; so you shall be my people, and I will be your God;

hausa: Sanballat da Geshem suka aika mini wannan saƙo cewa, “Ka zo, mu sadu a wani ƙauye a filin Ono.” Amma makirci ne suke yi don su cuce ni;
english: Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, “Come! Let’s meet together in the villages in the plain of Ono.” But they intended to harm me.

hausa: Na faɗa haka ne domin waɗansu mutanen da aka rubuta hukuncinsu tun dā sun shiga cikinku a ɓoye. Su fa marasa tsoron Allah ne. Su ne waɗanda suka mai da alherin Allahnmu ya zama dalilin yin fasikanci, suna kuma mūsun Yesu Kiristi wanda shi ne Makaɗaici Mai Iko Duka da kuma Ubangijinmu.
english: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.

hausa: A wata na biyu na shekara ta biyu, bayan sun komo gidan Allah a Urushalima, sai Zerubbabel ɗan Sheyaltiyel, Yoshuwa ɗan Yozadak da sauran ’yan’uwansa (Firistoci da Lawiyawa da duk waɗanda suka komo Urushalima daga bauta) suka fara aiki, aka zaɓi Lawiyawa daga masu shekaru ashirin da haihuwa zuwa waɗanda suka wuce haka don su dubi aikin ginin gidan Ubangiji.
english: Now in the second year of their coming to God’s house at Jerusalem, in the second month, Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the rest of their brothers the priests and the Levites, and all those who had come out of the captivity to Jerusalem, began the work and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to have the oversight of the work of Yahweh’s house.

hausa: ba mu kuma gina gidaje mu zauna a ciki ba ko mu yi gonakin inabi, gonaki ko hatsi ba.
english: and not to build houses for ourselves to dwell in. We have no vineyard, field, or seed;

hausa: Amma Bitrus ya sa shi ya tashi. Ya ce, “Tashi, ni mutum ne kawai.”
english: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”

hausa: Ka amsa mini, ya Ubangiji, ka amsa mini, saboda waɗannan mutane su san cewa kai, ya Ubangiji, kai ne Allah, su kuma san cewa kana sāke juye zukatansu zuwa gare ka.”
english: Hear me, Yahweh, hear me, that this people may know that you, Yahweh, are God, and that you have turned their heart back again.”

hausa: Sai Yusuf ya ce wa ’yan’uwansa, “Ina gab da mutuwa. Amma tabbatacce Allah zai taimake ku, yă fid da ku daga wannan ƙasa zuwa ƙasar da ya alkawarta da rantsuwa wa Ibrahim, Ishaku da kuma Yaƙub.”
english: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am dying, but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land to the land which he swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.”

hausa: Saboda girman sunana na jinkirta fushina; saboda girman yabona na janye shi daga gare ku, don dai kada a yanke ku.
english: For my name’s sake, I will defer my anger, and for my praise, I hold it back for you so that I don’t cut you off.

hausa: In Allah bai nuna amincewa ga tsarkakansa ba, in har sammai ba su da tsarki a idonsa,
english: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;

hausa: Alherinka da girma yake, wanda ka ajiye domin waɗanda suke tsoronka, wanda ka mayar a gaban mutane a kan waɗanda suke neman mafaka daga gare ka.
english: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!

hausa: “Ina dai gaya muku abokaina, kada ku ji tsoron masu kashe jiki, amma bayan haka, ba sauran abin da za su iya yi.
english: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

hausa: Maharai mutumin Netofa, Heled ɗan Ba’ana mutumin Netofa,
english: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

hausa: fāra ba su da sarki, duk da haka suna tafiya tare bisa ga girma;
english: The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.

hausa: “Lokaci yana zuwa,” in ji Ubangiji, “sa’ad da zan yi sabon alkawari da gidan Isra’ila da kuma gidan Yahuda.
english: “Behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah,

hausa: Bijimai masu yawa sun kewaye ni; bijimai masu ƙarfi na Bashan sun sa ni a tsaka.
english: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.

hausa: Sai shugaban masu shayarwa ya ce wa Fir’auna, “Yau an tuna mini da kāsawata.
english: Then the chief cup bearer spoke to Pharaoh, saying, “I remember my faults today.

hausa: Da yake Edom suka ƙi su bar su su ratsa yankinsu, sai Isra’ila suka juya suka janye daga gare su.
english: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border, so Israel turned away from him.

hausa: Yotam ya yi yaƙi da sarkin Ammonawa ya kuma ci su. A wannan shekara Ammonawa suka biya shi haraji talenti ɗari na azurfa, garwan alkama dubu goma da kuma garwa dubu goma na sha’ir. Ammonawa suka kawo masa wannan kuma a shekara ta biyu da ta uku.
english: He also fought with the king of the children of Ammon, and prevailed against them. The children of Ammon gave him the same year one hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cors of wheat, and ten thousand cors of barley. The children of Ammon also gave that much to him in the second year, and in the third.

hausa: Saboda haka na miƙa hannuna gāba da ke na kuma rage iyakarki; na ba da ke ga abokan gābanki masu haɗama, ’yan matan Filistiyawa, waɗanda suka sha mamaki saboda halinki na lalata.
english: See therefore, I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished your portion, and delivered you to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who are ashamed of your lewd way.

hausa: tare da ’ya’yanku da matanku, da baƙin da suke zama sansanoninku, har ma da waɗanda suke muku faskare, da waɗanda suke ɗiba muku ruwa.
english: your little ones, your wives, and the foreigners who are in the middle of your camps, from the one who cuts your wood to the one who draws your water,

hausa: Sai manyan Isra’ila masu bi da aikin gandu suka tafi wurin Fir’auna suka yi roƙo suna cewa, “Don me kake yi wa bayinka haka?
english: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried to Pharaoh, saying, “Why do you deal this way with your servants?

hausa: Abigiyel ba tă ɓata lokaci ba. Ta ɗauki burodi guda ɗari biyu, da salkar ruwan inabi biyu da tumaki biyar da aka gyara, da soyayyen hatsi mudu biyar, da waina guda ɗari na ’ya’yan inabi, da masa ɗari biyu na kauɗar ɓaure ta labta wa jakuna.
english: Then Abigail hurried and took two hundred loaves of bread, two containers of wine, five sheep ready dressed, five seahs of parched grain, one hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on donkeys.

hausa: Ina dalilin da kuke marmatsa mutanena kuna gurgurje fuskokin talakawa?” Ni Ubangiji Maɗaukaki na faɗa.
english: What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: gama shaidarmu game da Kiristi ta tabbata a cikinku.
english: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you—

hausa: Mai adalci ne zai kawo ƙara a wurinsa, kuma zan samu kuɓuta daga wurin mai shari’an nan har abada.
english: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.

hausa: Kai kaɗai ne Ubangiji. Kai ka yi sammai, har ma da sama sammai, da dukan rundunar taurari, da duniya da kuma dukan abin da yake cikinta, da tekuna da dukan abubuwan da suke cikinsu. Ka ba da rai ga kome, kuma rundunonin sama suna maka sujada.
english: You are Yahweh, even you alone. You have made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their army, the earth and all things that are on it, the seas and all that is in them, and you preserve them all. The army of heaven worships you.

hausa: Duk wanda ya sami hikima yana ƙaunar ransa; duka wanda yake jin daɗi fahimi kan ci gaba.
english: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.

hausa: Sa’ad da ta ga ya bar rigarsa a hannunta ya gudu ya fita daga gidan,
english: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and had run outside,

hausa: Yesu yana kan hanyarsa zuwa Urushalima, sai ya bi takan iyakar Samariya da Galili.
english: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.

hausa: Musa ya gina bagade, sai ya kira shi Ubangiji shi ne Tutata.
english: Moses built an altar, and called its name “Yahweh our Banner”.

hausa: Abimelek ɗan Yerub-Ba’al ya tafi Shekem wurin ’yan’uwan mahaifiyarsa, ya ce musu da kuma dukan dangin mahaifiyarsa,
english: Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem to his mother’s brothers, and spoke with them and with all the family of the house of his mother’s father, saying,

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Wadda ta fi girma duka, ita ce wannan. ‘Ku saurara, ya Isra’ila, Ubangiji Allahnmu, Ubangiji ɗaya ne.
english: Jesus answered, “The greatest is: ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.

hausa: “Ruben, kai ne ɗan farina, ƙarfina, alamar farko ta ƙarfina, mafi matsayi, kuma mafi iko.
english: “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, excelling in dignity, and excelling in power.

hausa: “ ‘Ka mai da takobi a kubensa. A inda aka halicce ka, a ƙasar kakanninka, zan hukunta ka.
english: Cause it to return into its sheath. In the place where you were created, in the land of your birth, I will judge you.

hausa: (adon kuwa abin da adalin nan ya yi, ya kuma gani, sa’ad da yake a cikinsu, sai kowace rana yakan ji ciwon aikinsu na kangara a zuciyarsa mai adalci)
english: (for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds),

hausa: Abokin gāba yana fafarata, ya murƙushe ni har ƙasa; ya sa ina zama a cikin duhu kamar waɗanda suka mutu tun tuni.
english: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

hausa: Ta haka Isra’ila ya kasance cikin tawaye a kan gidan Dawuda har yă zuwa wannan rana.
english: So Israel rebelled against David’s house to this day.

hausa: Sai suka yi shawara da junansu, suka ce, “In muka ce, ‘Daga sama ne,’ zai tambaya, ‘To, don me ba ku gaskata shi ba?’
english: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’

hausa: Maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Don a zuga hasala a kuma yi sakayya na sa jininta a dutsen da ba a rufe ba, saboda kada a rufe.
english: That it may cause wrath to come up to take vengeance, I have set her blood on the bare rock, that it should not be covered.”

hausa: ’Ya’yan Simeyon maza su ne, Yemuwel, Yamin, Ohad, Yakin, Zohar da Sha’ul ɗan mutuniyar Kan’ana.
english: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya auna shirayin hanyar shiga;
english: He measured also the porch of the gate toward the house, one reed.

hausa: Na sa matsara a kan katangarki, ya Urushalima; ba za su taɓa yin shiru ba, dare da rana. Ku da kuke kira bisa sunan Ubangiji, kada ku ba kanku hutu,
english: I have set watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem. They will never be silent day nor night. You who call on Yahweh, take no rest,

hausa: Saboda haka Akish ya kira Dawuda ya ce masa, “Muddin Ubangiji yana a raye, na amince da kai tun daga ranar da ka zo wurina har yă zuwa yau, ban same ka da wani laifi ba, na kuma yi farin ciki in sa ka a cikin sojojina don ka yi mini aiki. Amma masu mulki nawa ba su yarda da kai ba.
english: Then Achish called David and said to him, “As Yahweh lives, you have been upright, and your going out and your coming in with me in the army is good in my sight; for I have not found evil in you since the day of your coming to me to this day. Nevertheless, the lords don’t favor you.

hausa: Gileyad ya tsaya gaban Urdun. Kai kuma Dan, don me ka ka yi ta zama a wajen jiragen ruwa? Asher ya ci gaba da kasance a bakin teku ya kasance a wuraren zamansa.
english: Gilead lived beyond the Jordan. Why did Dan remain in ships? Asher sat still at the haven of the sea, and lived by his creeks.

hausa: Da yake sun ƙi sani ba su kuwa zaɓi tsoron Ubangiji ba,
english: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of Yahweh.

hausa: Akuyan zai ɗauka a kansa dukan zunubansu zuwa kaɗaitaccen wuri, a can mutumin zai sake shi a jeji.
english: The goat shall carry all their iniquities on himself to a solitary land, and he shall release the goat in the wilderness.

hausa: Darajar jejinsa da gonakinsa masu dausayi za a hallaka su ɗungum, kamar yadda ciwo yakan kashe mutum.
english: He will consume the glory of his forest and of his fruitful field, both soul and body. It will be as when a standard bearer faints.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yesu ya fito sanye da rawanin ƙayar da kuma riga mai ruwan shunayya, sai Bilatus ya ce musu, “Ga mutumin!”
english: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”

hausa: A daren nan maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Natan cewa,
english: That same night, Yahweh’s word came to Nathan, saying,

hausa: Saboda haka sarki ya zare zoben hatimi daga yatsarsa, ya ba wa Haman ɗan Hammedata, mutumin Agag, abokin gāban Yahudawa.
english: The king took his ring from his hand, and gave it to Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews’ enemy.

hausa: Abin da Allah ya faɗa game da Hamada da take kusa da Teku. Kamar guguwa mai share cikin ƙasar kudu, mai hari ya zo daga hamada, daga ƙasar mai banrazana.
english: The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it comes from the wilderness, from an awesome land.

hausa: Za ku ba da cinya ta dama ta hadaya don zumuncinku ga firist a matsayin baiko.
english: The right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

hausa: Sai sarki da dukan masu yin masa hidima waɗanda suke jin maganan nan ba su firgita ba, balle su keta rigunansu.
english: The king and his servants who heard all these words were not afraid, and didn’t tear their garments.

hausa: “Na tattake ’ya’yan inabi ni kaɗai; cikin al’ummai kuma babu wani tare da ni. Na tattake su cikin fushina Na matse su cikin hasalata; jininsu ya fantsamar wa rigunana, na kuma ɓata dukan tufafina.
english: “I have trodden the wine press alone. Of the peoples, no one was with me. Yes, I trod them in my anger and trampled them in my wrath. Their lifeblood is sprinkled on my garments, and I have stained all my clothing.

hausa: “Ruhun Ubangiji ya yi magana ta wurina; maganarsa tana a harshena.
english: “Yahweh’s Spirit spoke by me. His word was on my tongue.

hausa: Ya Allahna, ka tuna da Tobiya da Sanballat, saboda abin da suka yi; ka kuma tuna da annabiya Nowadiya da sauran annabawa waɗanda suke ƙoƙari su tsorata ni.
english: “Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and also the prophetess Noadiah and the rest of the prophets that would have put me in fear.”

hausa: Nan da nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, da Haruna da kuma Miriyam, “Ku fita ku tafi Tentin Sujada, dukanku uku.” Sai dukansu uku suka tafi.
english: Yahweh spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.

hausa: In kuna da aure, kada ku nemi kashe auren. In ba ku da aure, kada ku nemi yin aure.
english: Are you bound to a wife? Don’t seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don’t seek a wife.

hausa: Sai manyan firistoci da Farisiyawa suka kira taron Majalisa. Suka yi tambaya suna cewa, “Me muke yi ne? Ga mutumin nan yana yin abubuwan banmamaki masu yawa.
english: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many signs.

hausa: Yawan buri da yawan magana ba su da amfani. Saboda haka, ka ji tsoron Allah.
english: For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities, as well as in many words; but you must fear God.

hausa: Kamar yadda ƙarfe kan wasa ƙarfe haka mutum kan koyi daga mutum.
english: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya tambaye, su ya ce, “Lokacin da na aike ku ba tare da jakar kuɗi, ko jaka, ko takalma ba, kun rasa wani abu?” Suka amsa, “Babu.”
english: He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, bag, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”

hausa: ba ko ɗayansu da zai gan ƙasar da na yi alkawari da rantsuwa zan ba wa kakanninsu. Ba ko ɗaya da ya rena ni, da zai taɓa ganinta.
english: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of those who despised me see it.

hausa: Reyahiya ɗan Shobal shi ne mahaifin Yahat, Yahat shi ne mahaifin Ahumai da Lahad. Waɗannan su ne gidajen Zoratiyawa.
english: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

hausa: Maryamu kuwa ta tsaya a bakin kabarin daga waje tana kuka. Da tana cikin kuka, sai ta sunkuya ta leƙa cikin kabarin,
english: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,

hausa: Sai Toma (wanda ake kira Didaimus) ya ce wa sauran almajiran, “Mu ma mu je, mu mutu tare da shi.”
english: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s also go, that we may die with him.”

hausa: Bari tsarkaka su yi farin ciki a wannan bangirma su kuma rera don farin ciki a kan gadajensu.
english: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.

hausa: waɗanda ya juya zukatansu su ƙi mutanensa don su haɗa baki a kan bayinsa.
english: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

hausa: Gama in mutane suna yin waɗannan abubuwa a lokacin da itace na ɗanye, me zai faru in ya bushe?”
english: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”

hausa: Dole a hana su yin magana, domin suna kawo rushewar iyalai ta wurin koyar da abubuwan da bai kamata su koyar ba don neman ƙazamar riba.
english: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.

hausa: Akish ya ce, “A ganina kai marar laifi ne kamar mala’ikan Allah, duk da haka shugabannin sojojin Filistiyawa sun ce, ‘Ba zai tafi yaƙi tare da mu ba.’
english: Achish answered David, “I know that you are good in my sight, as an angel of God. Notwithstanding, the princes of the Philistines have said, ‘He shall not go up with us to the battle.’

hausa: ’Ya’yan Zofa maza su ne, Suwa, Harnefer, Shuwal, Beri, Imra,
english: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,

hausa: Ubangiji zai sa ku zama kai, ba wutsiya ba. In kun mai da hankali ga umarnan Ubangiji Allahnku da nake ba ku a wannan rana, kuka kuma lura, kuka bi su, kullum za ku kasance a bisa, ba a ƙasa ba.
english: Yahweh will make you the head, and not the tail. You will be above only, and you will not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God which I command you today, to observe and to do,

hausa: Ashkelon za tă ga haka ta ji tsoro; Gaza za tă yi birgima cikin azaba, haka Ekron ma, gama za tă fid da zuciya. Gaza za tă rasa sarkinta za a kuma gudu a bar Ashkelon.
english: Ashkelon will see it, and fear; Gaza also, and will writhe in agony; as will Ekron, for her expectation will be disappointed; and the king will perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon will not be inhabited.

hausa: Ni, Yohanna, na ji, na kuma ga abubuwan nan. Kuma sa’ad da na ji, na kuma gan su, sai na fāɗi a ƙasa a gaban mala’ikan da yake nuna mini su, don in yi sujada.
english: Now I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.

hausa: Ya dogara ga Allah. Bari Allah yă cece shi yanzu, in yana sonsa, domin ya ce, ‘Ni Ɗan Allah ne.’ ”
english: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”

hausa: Zan tsayar da dukan bukukkuwarta, bukukkuwarta na shekara-shekara, da kuma kiyaye bikin Sababbin Wata nata, kwanakin Asabbacinta, dukan ƙayyadaddun bukukkuwarta.
english: I will also cause all her celebrations to cease: her feasts, her new moons, her Sabbaths, and all her solemn assemblies.

hausa: gama himma da nake yi wa gidanka yana ƙunata, kuma zagi na masu zaginka yana fāɗuwa a kaina.
english: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.

hausa: Ke mace, kin sani ne, ko ke ce za ki ceci mijinki? Kai miji, ka sani ne, ko kai ne za ka ceci matarka?
english: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?

hausa: Ba su gane cewa yana yin musu magana game da Ubansa ba ne.
english: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.

hausa: Ubangiji wanda ya cece ni daga kumbar zaki da kuma kumbar beyar, zai cece ni daga hannun wannan Bafilistin.” Shawulu ya ce wa Dawuda, “Je ka, Ubangiji yă kasance tare da kai.”
english: David said, “Yahweh, who delivered me out of the paw of the lion and out of the paw of the bear, will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine.” Saul said to David, “Go! Yahweh will be with you.”

hausa: Kuraye za su yi ta kuka a kagarorinta, diloli kuma a cikin fadodinta masu alfarma. Lokacinta ya yi kusa, kwanakinta kuma ba za su yi tsawo ba.
english: Hyenas will cry in their fortresses, and jackals in the pleasant palaces. Her time is near to come, and her days will not be prolonged.

hausa: Abokinsa ya ce, “Ai wannan ba wani abu ba ne fiye da takobin Gideyon ɗan Yowash, mutumin Isra’ila. Allah ya ba da Midiyawa da dukan sansani a hannuwansa.”
english: His fellow answered, “This is nothing other than the sword of Gideon the son of Joash, a man of Israel. God has delivered Midian into his hand, with all the army.”

hausa: yă kuma buɗe maka asirin hikima, gama hikima ta gaskiya tana da gefe biyu. Ka san wannan, Allah ya riga ya manta da waɗansu zunubanka.
english: that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.

hausa: Manyan mutane suna aika bayinsu su ɗebo ruwa a maɓulɓulai amma babu ruwa. Suka dawo da tulunansu haka nan; da kunya da kuma ƙasƙanci, da kawunansu a rufe.
english: Their nobles send their little ones to the waters. They come to the cisterns, and find no water. They return with their vessels empty. They are disappointed and confounded, and cover their heads.

hausa: Ina addu’a ku san girman ikon Allah wanda ya wuce misali, wanda yake namu. Ikon da yake aiki a cikinmu, ɗaya ne da ikon nan
english: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

hausa: Sai ya ci gaba ya ce, Fir’auna ya taɓa husata da bayinsa, ya kuma jefa ni da shugaban masu tuya a cikin kurkuku a gidan shugaban masu tsaro.
english: Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, with the chief baker.

hausa: Farkon bishara game da Yesu Kiristi, Ɗan Allah.
english: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

hausa: Don haka Musa ya koma wurin Ubangiji ya ce, “Kaito, mutanen nan sun yi zunubi mai girma! Sun yi wa kansu allolin zinariya.
english: Moses returned to Yahweh, and said, “Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves gods of gold.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Babu wani da yakan sa hannunsa a garman shanu, sa’an nan ya waiwaya baya, da ya isa ya shiga hidima a cikin mulkin Allah ba.”
english: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”

hausa: Kaitonku ku waɗanda kuke ƙara wa kanku gidaje kuke kuma haɗa gonaki da gonaki har babu sauran filin da ya rage ku kuma zauna ku kaɗai a ƙasar.
english: Woe to those who join house to house, who lay field to field, until there is no room, and you are made to dwell alone in the middle of the land!

hausa: Cikin Wuri Mafi Tsarki ya yi kerubobi biyu, ya kuma shafe su da zinariya.
english: In the most holy place he made two cherubim by carving, and they overlaid them with gold.

hausa: Saboda haka dukiyar da suka tara suka kuma ajiye sun ɗauka suka ƙetare Rafin Arabim da su.
english: Therefore they will carry away the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have stored up, over the brook of the willows.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yetro surukin Musa, ya kawo hadaya ta ƙonawa da waɗansu hadayu wa Allah, Haruna ya zo tare da dukan dattawan Isra’ila, suka ci abinci tare da surukin Musa a gaban Allah.
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God. Aaron came with all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law before God.

hausa: Ni teku ne, ko kuwa dodon ruwa, don me kake tsaro na?
english: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?

hausa: Gama Ubangiji yana ba da hikima, daga bakinsa kuma, sani da ganewa sukan fito.
english: For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

hausa: “Mun yi alkawari ba za mu ba da ’ya’yanmu mata aure ga mutanen da suke kewaye da mu ba, ba kuwa za mu auri ’ya’yansu mata wa ’ya’yanmu maza ba.
english: and that we would not give our daughters to the peoples of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons;

hausa: Ga asalin zuriyar Ferez. Ferez shi ne mahaifin Hezron,
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Perez: Perez became the father of Hezron,

hausa: Sa’an nan Musa ya kira Bezalel da Oholiyab da kowane mutumin da Ubangiji ya ba shi iyawa da kuma wanda ya yi niyya yă yi aiki.
english: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart Yahweh had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it.

hausa: Sa’an nan su sa a kansa dukan kayayyakin da aka yi amfani da su a bagaden, haɗe da farantai don wuta, cokula masu yatsu don nama, manyan cokula, da darunan yayyafawa. A kansa za su shimfiɗa murfi na fatun shanun teku, su zura sandunan ɗaukarsa.
english: They shall put on it all its vessels with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the meat hooks, the shovels, and the basins—all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.

hausa: Sarki ya ce wa macen, “Koma gida, zan ba da umarni a madadinki.”
english: The king said to the woman, “Go to your house, and I will give a command concerning you.”

hausa: Sai Zedekiya ɗan Kena’ana ya hau ya mari Mikahiya a fuska. Ya yi tambaya, “A wace hanya ce ruhu daga Ubangiji ya bar ni ya yi maka magana?”
english: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did Yahweh’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”

hausa: A shekara ta huɗu ta Sarki Dariyus, maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Zakariya a rana ta huɗu ta watan tara, wato, watan Kisleb.
english: In the fourth year of King Darius, Yahweh’s word came to Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.

hausa: A shekara ta hamsin da biyu ta mulkin Azariya sarkin Yahuda, Feka ɗan Remaliya ya zama sarkin Isra’ila a Samariya, ya yi mulki shekara ashirin.
english: In the fifty-second year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Israel in Samaria for twenty years.

hausa: gama za su ƙara maka tsawon rai da shekaru masu yawa su kuma kawo maka wadata.
english: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.

hausa: Akan sa wawaye a manyan matsayi, yayinda masu arziki suna ƙarƙashi.
english: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in a low place.

hausa: Gawawwakinsu za su kasance a kwance a titin babban birni, wanda a misalce ake kira Sodom da Masar, inda kuma aka gicciye Ubangijinsu.
english: Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

hausa: Ya ba da waɗannan umarnai ga Hilkiya firist, da Ahikam ɗan Shafan, da Akbor ɗan Mikahiya, da Shafan magatakarda, da kuma Asahiya mai hidimar sarki, ya ce,
english: The king commanded Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam the son of Shaphan, Achbor the son of Micaiah, Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king’s servant, saying,

hausa: Zai fid da sashen tunawa daga hadaya ta gari, yă ƙone shi a kan bagade kamar hadayar da ka yi da wuta, mai daɗin ƙanshi ga Ubangiji.
english: The priest shall take from the meal offering its memorial, and shall burn it on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

hausa: Ku yi addu’a yadda zan yi shelarsa, yadda ya kamata.
english: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

hausa: Mutanen da suke masu adalci wannan abu ya ba su tsoro; marasa laifi sun tayar wa marasa tsoron Allah.
english: Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.

hausa: Amaziya ɗan Yowash sarkin Yahuda ya rayu shekara goma sha biyar bayan mutuwar Yehowash ɗan Yehoyahaz sarkin Isra’ila.
english: Amaziah the son of Joash, king of Judah, lived for fifteen years after the death of Joash, son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.

hausa: Domin shi kansa ya sha wahala sa’ad da aka gwada shi, yana iya taimakon waɗanda ake yi wa gwaji.
english: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.

hausa: Saboda haka, da yake ba dama a yi mūsun wannan gaskiya, ya kamata ku natsu kada ku yi kome da garaje.
english: Seeing then that these things can’t be denied, you ought to be quiet and to do nothing rash.

hausa: Sai dai ban so in yi kome ban da yardarka ba, domin kowane alherin da za ka yi, yă fito daga zuciyarka, ba na tilas ba.
english: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.

hausa: Bawan ya ce, ‘Ai, ɗan’uwanka ne ya dawo, shi ne mahaifinka ya yanka ɗan saniya mai ƙiba, gama ya yi murna ya karɓi ɗansa da ya dawo gida lafiyayye, ba abin da ya same shi.’
english: He said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and healthy.’

hausa: Duk wanda ya gaskata da shi ba za a yi masa hukunci ba, amma duk wanda bai gaskata ba an riga an yi masa hukunci domin bai gaskata da sunan wanda yake Ɗaya kuma Makaɗaicin Ɗan Allah ba.
english: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.

hausa: ko kuma a danne wa mutum shari’ar gaskiya ashe Ubangiji ba zai ga irin waɗannan abubuwa ba?
english: to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.

hausa: Sunayen ’ya’yan Haruna su ne, Nadab ɗan fari, da Abihu, da Eleyazar da Itamar.
english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

hausa: Bisa ga umarni Ubangiji, Haruna firist, ya hau Dutsen Hor, inda ya mutu a rana ta fari ga watan biyar, a shekara ta arba’in, bayan Isra’ilawa suka fito daga Masar.
english: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of Yahweh and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.

hausa: Sai nan da nan kuma na fāɗi rubda ciki a gaban Ubangiji, yini arba’in da dare arba’in; ban ci ba, ban sha ba, kamar yadda dā na yi, duka saboda zunubin da kuka aikata a gaban Ubangiji. Ta haka kuka tsokane shi don yă yi fushi.
english: I fell down before Yahweh, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all your sin which you sinned, in doing that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

hausa: Kogin wuta yana gudu, yana fitowa daga gabansa. Dubun dubbai sun yi masa hidima; dubu goma sau dubu goma sun tsaya a gabansa. Aka zauna don shari’a, aka kuma buɗe littattafai.
english: A fiery stream issued and came out from before him. Thousands of thousands ministered to him. Ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him. The judgment was set. The books were opened.

hausa: Gama duk mai son ceton ransa zai rasa shi, amma duk wanda ya rasa ransa saboda ni zai same shi.
english: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake will save it.

hausa: Ku yi rayuwa kamar mutanen da aka ’yantar, sai dai kada ku yi amfani da ’yancinku a matsayin hujjar aikata mugunta; ku yi rayuwa kamar bayin Allah.
english: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

hausa: Masu rai, masu rai, su suke yabonka, kamar yadda nake yi a yau; iyaye za su faɗa wa ’ya’yansu game da amincinka.
english: The living, the living, he shall praise you, as I do today. The father shall make known your truth to the children.

hausa: Yana zuba ƙanƙara kamar ƙananan duwatsu. Wa zai iya jure wa sanyin da ya aiko?
english: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?

hausa: Saboda taron, sai ya ce wa almajiransa su shirya masa ƙaramin jirgin ruwa, don kada mutane su matse shi.
english: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.

hausa: (Ubangiji ya sa mutane suka sami tagomashi a idon Masarawa, Musa kuwa ya sami girma sosai a cikin ƙasar Masar a gaban fadawan Fir’auna da kuma a gaban jama’ar.)
english: Yahweh gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians. Moreover, the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt, in the sight of Pharaoh’s servants, and in the sight of the people.

hausa: domin dukansu sun gan shi, suka kuma tsorata. Nan da nan ya yi magana da su ya ce, “Ku yi ƙarfin hali! Ni ne. Kada ku ji tsoro.”
english: for they all saw him and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

hausa: Muddin hannun Musa yana a miƙe, sai Isra’ilawa su yi ta cin nasara, amma da zarar hannunsa ya sauka, sai Amalekawa su yi ta cin nasara.
english: When Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed. When he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

hausa: Sa’ad da masu sihiri, da masu dabo, da masanan taurari da masu duba suka zo, na faɗa musu mafarkin, amma ba su iya fassarta mini mafarkin ba.
english: Then the magicians, the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers came in; and I told them the dream, but they didn’t make known to me its interpretation.

hausa: Amma in wani marar bi, ko jahili ya shigo sa’ad da kowa yana annabci, sai maganar kowa ta ratsa shi, za su shawo kansa yă gane cewa shi mai zunubi ne saboda abin da kowa yake faɗi,
english: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.

hausa: Kada ku yi waɗansu alloli in ban da ni, kada ku yi wa kanku allolin azurfa ko na zinariya.
english: You shall most certainly not make gods of silver or gods of gold for yourselves to be alongside me.

hausa: Za ki zama rawanin daraja a hannun Ubangiji, rawanin sarauta a hannun Allahnki.
english: You will also be a crown of beauty in Yahweh’s hand, and a royal diadem in your God’s hand.

hausa: Bayan mutanen suka ga abin banmamakin da Yesu ya yi, sai suka fara cewa, “Lalle, wannan shi ne Annabin nan mai zuwa duniya.”
english: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”

hausa: Kukan ce, “Don me ba ya karɓan hadayunmu?” Ai, domin Ubangiji ya zama shaida tsakaninka da matar ƙuruciyarka, gama ka keta amanar da ka yi mata, ko da yake ita abokiyar zamanka ce, matar aurenka ta alkawari.
english: Yet you say, ‘Why?’ Because Yahweh has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt treacherously, though she is your companion and the wife of your covenant.

hausa: Sai na ji wata babbar murya daga haikalin tana ce wa mala’iku bakwai nan, “Ku tafi ku zuba kwanoni bakwai nan na fushin Allah a kan duniya.”
english: I heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth!”

hausa: ’Ya’yan Gad maza su ne, Zafon, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi da Areli.
english: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.

hausa: mutanen Zebulun, ƙwararru sojoji shiryayyu don yaƙi da kowane irin makami, suka zo don su taimaki Dawuda da zuciya ɗaya, su 50,000;
english: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array with all kinds of instruments of war: fifty thousand who could command and were not of double heart.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya tambaye ta ya ce, “Me ya faru?” Sai ta amsa ta ce, “Wannan mace ta ce mini, ‘Kawo ɗanki mu ci yau, gobe kuwa mu ci ɗana.’
english: Then the king asked her, “What is your problem?” She answered, “This woman said to me, ‘Give your son, that we may eat him today, and we will eat my son tomorrow.’

hausa: Sama’ila ya ce, “Kada ku ji tsoro.” Kun yi waɗannan mugunta duk da haka kada ku bar bin Ubangiji, amma ku bauta wa Ubangiji da dukan zuciyarku.
english: Samuel said to the people, “Don’t be afraid. You have indeed done all this evil; yet don’t turn away from following Yahweh, but serve Yahweh with all your heart.

hausa: Za tă murɗe shi ba tausayi, lokacin da yake guje wa ikon iskar.
english: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.

hausa: Ubangiji ya sāka mini bisa ga adalcina bisa ga tsarkina a gabansa.
english: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.

hausa: Amma, cikin waɗanda suke sāke tona abin da suka riga suka haɗiye ɗin, ko suke da rababben kofato, ba za ku ci raƙumi, zomo ko rema ba. Ko da yake suna sāke tona abin da suka riga suka haɗiye, suna kuma da rababben kofato, su ɗin marar tsarki ne gare ku.
english: Nevertheless these you shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of those who have the hoof split: the camel, the hare, and the rabbit. Because they chew the cud but don’t part the hoof, they are unclean to you.

hausa: Ɗaya daga cikin fadawan sarki ya ce, “A sa waɗansu mutane su ɗauki dawakai biyar da suka ragu cikin birni, idan ba su tsira ba, za su zama kamar sauran Isra’ilawan da suka riga suka mutu ne. Bari mu aika, mu gani.”
english: One of his servants answered, “Please let some people take five of the horses that remain, which are left in the city. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are left in it. Behold, they are like all the multitude of Israel who are consumed. Let’s send and see.”

hausa: Ƙotar kibiyarsa kuwa kamar sandar saƙar igiya take, ƙarfen kibiyar kuma nauyinsa ya kai shekel ɗari shida. Mai riƙe masa garkuwa yana tafe a gabansa.
english: The staff of his spear was like a weaver’s beam; and his spear’s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron. His shield bearer went before him.

hausa: Amma ba su ce kome ba. Sai ya riƙe mutumin, ya warkar da shi, sa’an nan ya sallame shi.
english: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi fushi sosai da Haruna, har ya yi niyya yă hallaka shi, amma a wannan lokaci, na yi addu’a saboda Haruna shi ma.
english: Yahweh was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him. I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.

hausa: Tabbatacce Hiridus da Buntus Bilatus suka haɗu tare da Al’ummai da kuma mutanen Isra’ila a wannan birni ce don su ƙulla gāba da bawanka mai tsarki Yesu, wanda ka shafe.
english: “For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed,

hausa: Ya yi mini kwanton ɓauna ya kuma kewaye ni da baƙin ciki da kuma wahala.
english: He has built against me, and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.

hausa: Waɗansu suka rinjayu da abin da ya faɗa, amma waɗansu suka ba su gaskata ba.
english: Some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.

hausa: Mutane sukan fita su tattara ta, su niƙa a dutsen niƙa, ko kuwa su daka a turmi. Su dafa, ko su yi waina da ita. Ɗanɗanonta yakan yi kamar abin da aka yi da man zaitun.
english: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.

hausa: don kada kowa yă raunana ta wurin waɗannan gwaje-gwajen. Kun sani sarai cewa an ƙaddara mu don waɗannan.
english: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.

hausa: “Me ya sa kuke damuwa a kan riguna? Ku dubi yadda furannin jeji suke girma mana. Ba sa aiki ko saƙa.
english: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,

hausa: Ku ba da mutum uku daga kowace kabila, ni kuwa in aike su, su zagaya dukan ƙasar su rubuta bayani game da ita, bisa ga yadda za a raba ta gādo ga kowace kabila, sa’an nan su dawo wurina.
english: Appoint for yourselves three men from each tribe. I will send them, and they shall arise, walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; then they shall come to me.

hausa: Yehoshafat ɗan Asa ya zama sarkin Yahuda a shekara ta huɗu ta Ahab sarkin Isra’ila.
english: Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel.

hausa: Babu wata kalmar da Musa ya umarta da Yoshuwa bai karanta wa dukan taron Isra’ilawa ba, haɗe da mata, da yara, da baƙin da suke zama tare da su.
english: There was not a word of all that Moses commanded which Joshua didn’t read before all the assembly of Israel, with the women, the little ones, and the foreigners who were among them.

hausa: Ko na taɓa cewa, ‘Ku ba da wani abu a madadina, ko na roƙe ku, ku ba da wani abu domina daga cikin dukiyarku,
english: Did I ever say, ‘Give to me’? or, ‘Offer a present for me from your substance’?

hausa: “Kada ku yi alloli na zubi.
english: “You shall make no cast idols for yourselves.

hausa: Sa’ad da Kiristi ya zo a matsayin babban firist na kyawawan abubuwan da suka riga suka kasance a nan, ya bi ta cikin tabanakul mafi girma da kuma mafi cikakke wanda ba mutum ne ya yi ba, wato, ba na wannan halitta ba.
english: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,
