hausa: Yesu ya yi waɗansu abubuwa da yawa kuma. Da a ce an rubuta kowannensu, na tabbata ko duniya duka ba za tă sami wuri saboda littattafan da za a rubuta ba.
english: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.

hausa: Yabe shi, dukanku mala’ikunsa, yabe shi, dukanku rundunarsa na sama.
english: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!

hausa: Ka sa wa labulen rammuka da ulu mai ruwan shuɗin a gefen ƙarshe na labule ɗaya, a kuma yi haka a ƙarshen gefe na ɗaya kuma.
english: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling, and you shall do likewise on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.

hausa: Abin da Allah ya faɗa game da Kwarin Wahayi. Mene ne ya dame ku a yanzu, da dukanku kuka hau kan rufin gidaje.
english: The burden of the valley of vision. What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the housetops?

hausa: Sa’an nan na ji babbar murya daga sama tana cewa, “Yanzu ceto da iko da mulkin Allahnmu, da kuma ikon Kiristinsa. Gama mai zargin ’yan’uwanmu, wanda yake zarginsu a gaban Allahnmu dare da rana, an jefar da shi ƙasa.
english: I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ has come; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them before our God day and night.

hausa: Shi da yake tafiya cikin adalci yana kuma magana abin da yake daidai, wanda yake ƙin riba daga cuta yana kuma kiyaye hannunsa daga karɓan cin hanci, wanda yake hana kunnuwansa daga ƙulla kisa ya kuma rufe idanunsa a kan tunanin aikata mugunta,
english: He who walks righteously and speaks blamelessly, he who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands, refusing to take a bribe, who stops his ears from hearing of bloodshed, and shuts his eyes from looking at evil—

hausa: Kai ma da aka saro daga zaitun ɗin da asalinsa yake na jeji, aka ɗaura aure da kai a jikin zaitun ɗin na gida, saɓanin yadda aka saba, balle waɗannan rassa na asali, da za a ɗaura aure da su a jikin zaitun ɗin nan nasu na asali?
english: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?

hausa: Amma yau ina ’yantar da kai daga sarƙoƙin da suke a hannuwanka. Zo mu tafi Babilon, in kana so, zan kuwa lura da kai; amma in ba ka so, kada ka zo. Ga shi, dukan ƙasar tana a gabanka; ka tafi duk inda ka so.”
english: Now, behold, I release you today from the chains which are on your hand. If it seems good to you to come with me into Babylon, come, and I will take care of you; but if it seems bad to you to come with me into Babylon, don’t. Behold, all the land is before you. Where it seems good and right to you to go, go there.”

hausa: Balak ya yi yadda Bala’am ya faɗa, sai su biyu suka miƙa bijimi da rago a kan kowane bagade.
english: Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.

hausa: “Sa’an nan sai sarkin Kudu zai kama hanya da fushi zuwa yaƙi da sarkin Arewa, wanda zai tattara babbar rundunar yaƙi, amma za a ci shi da yaƙi.
english: “The king of the south will be moved with anger and will come out and fight with him, even with the king of the north. He will send out a great multitude, and the multitude will be given into his hand.

hausa: Isra’ilawa sun yi tafiya a jeji shekaru arba’in, har sai da dukan mazan da suka kai shekarun shiga soja da suka bar Masar suka mutu, domin ba su yi wa Ubangiji biyayya ba. Gama Ubangiji ya rantse cewa ba zai bar su su ga ƙasar da ya yi wa iyayensu alkawari da rantsuwa cewa zai ba su ba, ƙasar da zuma da madara suke kwarara, ƙasar da take cike da albarka.
english: For the children of Israel walked forty years in the wilderness until all the nation, even the men of war who came out of Egypt, were consumed, because they didn’t listen to Yahweh’s voice. Yahweh swore to them that he wouldn’t let them see the land which Yahweh swore to their fathers that he would give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.

hausa: Sa’ad da Shekara ta Murnar Isra’ilawa ta kewayo, za a haɗa gādonsu da na kabilan mutanen da suka aura, a kuma ba su mallakar gādon da aka ɗebe daga kabilar kakanninmu.”
english: When the jubilee of the children of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”

hausa: Mai magana don kansa, neman ɗaukakar kansa yake yi. Amma mai neman ɗaukakar wanda ya aiko shi, shi ne mai gaskiya, ba kuwa rashin gaskiya a gare shi.
english: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

hausa: Yoshuwa ya ba Kaleb ɗan Yefunne wuri a Yahuda, Kiriyat Arba, wato, Hebron, bisa ga umarnin Ubangiji. (Arba shi ne mahaifin Anak.)
english: He gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh a portion among the children of Judah, according to the commandment of Yahweh to Joshua, even Kiriath Arba, named after the father of Anak (also called Hebron).

hausa: Ka fitar da kowane iri halitta mai rai da take tare da kai waje, tsuntsaye, dabbobi, da dukan halittu masu rarrafe a ƙasa, don su yi ta haihuwa, su yi yawa, su ƙaru a duniya.”
english: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly on the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”

hausa: Za su kuwa gaya wa mutanen wannan ƙasa. Sun riga sun ji cewa kai, ya Ubangiji, kana tare da waɗannan mutane, kuma cewa kai, ya Ubangiji, an gan ka fuska da fuska, cewa girgijenka ya tsaya bisansu, cewa kana tafiya a gabansu cikin ginshiƙin girgije da rana, da ginshiƙin wuta kuma da dare.
english: They will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you Yahweh are among this people; for you Yahweh are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them, and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.

hausa: “Amma ka faɗa na ji, na ji daidai abin da ka faɗa,
english: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,

hausa: “Saboda haka sai ka aiko mini da mutum wanda ya gwanince a aiki da azurfa, tagulla, baƙin ƙarfe, da kuma shunayya, da garura, da shuɗɗan zare, da wanda kuma ya gwanince da aikin sassaƙa, domin yă yi aiki tare da gwanayen mutane da nake da su a Yahuda da Urushalima, waɗanda mahaifina Dawuda ya tanada.
english: “Now therefore send me a man skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, and in purple, crimson, and blue, and who knows how to engrave engravings, to be with the skillful men who are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father provided.

hausa: Kada ku karɓi jinginar dutsen niƙa tare da ɗan dutsen niƙan, domin yin haka zai zama karɓar jinginar rai ne.
english: No man shall take the mill or the upper millstone as a pledge, for he takes a life in pledge.

hausa: Don haka sai ya yi kamar ya taɓu a gabansu. A duk lokacin da yake tare da su, sai yă yi kamar ya haukace. Ya yi ta zāne-zāne a ƙofofi, ya bar miyau yana ta bin gemunsa.
english: He changed his behavior before them and pretended to be insane in their hands, and scribbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down on his beard.

hausa: Sai na gaya musu, ‘Duk wanda yana da kayan ado na zinariya, ya cire?’ Sa’an nan suka ba ni zinariya, sai na jefa cikin wuta, wannan ɗan maraƙi ya fito.”
english: I said to them, ‘Whoever has any gold, let them take it off.’ So they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.”

hausa: “Fikafikan jimina suna bugawa cike da farin ciki amma ba za su gwada kansu da fikafikan da na shamuwa ba.
english: “The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, but are they the feathers and plumage of love?

hausa: Gara ka ci busasshen burodi da kwanciyar rai kuma shiru da ka je cin abinci a gidan da ke cike da biki amma da ɓacin rai.
english: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.

hausa: Ku faɗa wa sarkin Yahuda, wanda ya aike ku ku nemi nufin Ubangiji, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila yana cewa game da kalmomin da ka ji.
english: But to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of Yahweh, tell him, “Yahweh the God of Israel says, ‘Concerning the words which you have heard,

hausa: Sa’ad da dukan hafsoshin soja tare da mutanensu suka ji cewa sarkin Babilon ya naɗa Gedaliya a matsayin gwamna, sai suka zo wurin Gedaliya a Mizfa. Mutanen da suka zo su ne, Ishmayel ɗan Netaniya, Yohanan ɗan Kareya, Serahiya ɗan Tanhumet mutumin Netofa, Ya’azaniya ɗan mutumin Ma’aka, tare da mutanensu.
english: Now when all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, Johanan the son of Kareah, Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.

hausa: Yanzu ka tara mutane daga dukan Isra’ila su sadu da ni a kan Dutsen Karmel. Ka kuma kawo annabawa ɗari huɗu da hamsin na Ba’al, da kuma annabawa ɗari huɗu na Ashera, waɗanda suke ci a teburin Yezebel.”
english: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Israel to Mount Carmel, and four hundred fifty of the prophets of Baal, and four hundred of the prophets of the Asherah, who eat at Jezebel’s table.”

hausa: Sai macen, da ta ga ba halin ɓoyewa, sai ta fita, jikinta na rawa, ta fāɗi a gabansa. A gaban dukan mutanen, ta faɗi dalilin da ya sa ta taɓa shi, da yadda ta warke nan take.
english: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling; and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

hausa: Zomo, ko da yake yana tuƙa, duk da haka ba shi da rababben kofato; saboda haka namansa haram ne gare ku.
english: The hare, because it chews the cud but doesn’t have a parted hoof, is unclean to you.

hausa: Mutane da yawa kuwa suka fita taryensa, saboda sun ji labarin abin banmamakin da ya yi.
english: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.

hausa: “Bayan wannan, za ka tafi Gebiya ta Allah, inda sansanin Filistiyawa yake. Kana shiga garin, za ka sadu da jerin gwanon annabawa suna gangarowa daga tudu, ana kaɗa garaya, ana bugan ganguna, ana hura sarewa, ana kuma bugan molo, a gabansu, su kuma za su yi ta annabci.
english: “After that you will come to the hill of God, where the garrison of the Philistines is; and it will happen, when you have come there to the city, that you will meet a band of prophets coming down from the high place with a lute, a tambourine, a pipe, and a harp before them; and they will be prophesying.

hausa: Mutanen Zebulun sun kasai da rayukansu; haka ma Naftali a bakin dāgā.
english: Zebulun was a people that jeopardized their lives to the death; Naphtali also, on the high places of the field.

hausa: Maigidan Yusuf ya ɗauke shi ya sa a kurkuku, wurin da ake tsare ’yan kurkukun sarki. Amma yayinda Yusuf yake can a cikin kurkuku,
english: Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were bound, and he was there in custody.

hausa: Don ƙofar shiga wuri mai tsarki na ciki kuwa, ya yi ƙofofin katakon zaitun da madogarai masu gefe biyar.
english: For the entrance of the inner sanctuary, he made doors of olive wood. The lintel and door posts were a fifth part of the wall.

hausa: Duk wanda ya ɓoye zunubansa ba ya taɓa cin nasara, amma duk wanda ya furta ya kuma ƙi su yakan sami jinƙai.
english: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

hausa: Ya tara firistoci da Lawiyawa wuri ɗaya ya ce musu, “Ku je garuruwan Yahuda ku karɓa kuɗin da ya kamata a biya shekara-shekara daga dukan Isra’ila, don gyaran haikalin Allahnku. Ku yi haka yanzu.” Amma Lawiyawa ba su yi haka nan da nan ba.
english: He gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, “Go out to the cities of Judah, and gather money to repair the house of your God from all Israel from year to year. See that you expedite this matter.” However the Levites didn’t do it right away.

hausa: Yanzu fa sai ku saurara, ku masu arziki, ku yi kuka da ihu, saboda azabar da take zuwa a kanku.
english: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

hausa: Titunan birnin za su cika da samari da ’yan mata suna wasa.”
english: The streets of the city will be full of boys and girls playing in its streets.”

hausa: Ina yin wannan alkawari da rantsuwar, ba da ku kaɗai da
english: Neither do I make this covenant and this oath with you only,

hausa: Gama Dawuda ya yi abin da yake daidai a gaban Ubangiji, bai kuma fasa kiyaye wani daga umarnan Ubangiji ba dukan kwanakinsa, sai dai a batun Uriya mutumin Hitti.
english: because David did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and didn’t turn away from anything that he commanded him all the days of his life, except only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

hausa: Zuwa ga Timoti, ƙaunataccen ɗana. Alheri, jinƙai da salama daga Allah Uba da kuma Kiristi Yesu Ubangijinmu, su kasance tare da kai.
english: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ina gāba da makiyaya kuma zan nemi hakkin tumakina daga gare su. Zan hana su yin kiwon tumakin don kada makiyayan su ƙara yin kiwon kansu. Zan ƙwace tumakina daga bakunansu, ba kuwa za su ƙara zama abincinsu.
english: The Lord Yahweh says: “Behold, I am against the shepherds. I will require my sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep. The shepherds won’t feed themselves any more. I will deliver my sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.”

hausa: Ubangiji ya sa zuba musu ruhun jiri; suka sa Masar ta yi tangaɗi cikin kome da take yi, kamar yadda mutumin da ya bugu yake tangaɗi cikin amansa.
english: Yahweh has mixed a spirit of perverseness in the middle of her; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in all of its works, like a drunken man staggers in his vomit.

hausa: Yana ’ya’ya talatin, waɗanda suke hawan jakuna talatin. Sun shugabanci birane talatin a Gileyad, har wa yau ana ce da biranen Hawwot Yayir.
english: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts. They had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth Jair to this day, which are in the land of Gilead.

hausa: Babu shakka tsibirai suna dogara gare ni; jiragen Tarshish kuma su ne a gaba, suna kawo ’ya’yanki maza daga nesa, tare da azurfa da zinariya, domin su girmama Ubangiji Allahnki, Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila, gama ya cika ki da daraja.
english: Surely the islands will wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring your sons from far away, their silver and their gold with them, for the name of Yahweh your God, and for the Holy One of Israel, because he has glorified you.

hausa: A wannan rana, Ubangiji ya fito da Isra’ilawa ɓangare-ɓangare daga Masar.
english: That same day, Yahweh brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.

hausa: Mutumin da ya shiga ta ƙofa makiyayin tumakinsa ne.
english: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

hausa: Su ne kuma za su tsaya kowace safiya su yi godiya, su kuma yabi Ubangiji. Za su kuma yi haka da yamma
english: and to stand every morning to thank and praise Yahweh, and likewise in the evening;

hausa: A ɗan ƙanƙanen lokaci, mugaye za su shuɗe; ko ka neme su, ba za a same su ba.
english: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.

hausa: Ka yi ƙwazo cikin waɗannan batuttuwa; ka ba da kanka gaba ɗaya gare su, don kowa yă ga ci gabanka.
english: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.

hausa: Sa’an nan Debora ta ce wa Barak, “Je ka! Wannan ita ce ranar da Ubangiji ya ba da Sisera a hannunka. Ba Ubangiji ya riga ya sha gabanka?” Saboda haka Barak ya gangara zuwa Dutsen Tabor, da mutum dubu goma biye da shi.
english: Deborah said to Barak, “Go; for this is the day in which Yahweh has delivered Sisera into your hand. Hasn’t Yahweh gone out before you?” So Barak went down from Mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

hausa: Amma yayinda dukan wannan yake faruwa, ba ni a Urushalima, gama a shekara ta talatin da biyu na Artazerzes sarkin Babilon na dawo wurin sarki. A wani lokaci daga baya na nemi izininsa
english: But in all this, I was not at Jerusalem; for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I went to the king; and after some days I asked leave of the king,

hausa: Sarakunan duniya sun ɗauki matsayi masu mulki sun taru gaba ɗaya suna gāba da Ubangiji da kuma Shafaffensa.
english: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed, saying,

hausa: Duk wanda ya ci ta zai zama da laifi domin ya ƙazantar da abin da yake da tsarki ga Ubangiji, dole a raba mutumin nan da mutanensa.
english: but everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the holy thing of Yahweh, and that soul shall be cut off from his people.

hausa: na gina ƙasaitaccen haikali dominka, wuri domin ka zauna har abada.”
english: But I have built you a house and home, a place for you to dwell in forever.”

hausa: Yayinda Bitrus yake ƙasa a filin gidan, sai wata yarinya, baiwa, ɗaya daga cikin ma’aikatan babban firist, ta zo can.
english: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,

hausa: “In mutum ya bugi bawa ko baiwa a ido, har idon ya lalace, dole yă ’yantar da shi ko ita, maimakon ido.
english: “If a man strikes his servant’s eye, or his maid’s eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.

hausa: Na karya ƙarfin mugaye na ƙwato waɗanda suke riƙe da haƙoransu.
english: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

hausa: Ikon Ubangiji ya sauko a kan Iliya, ya sha ɗamara, ya ruga a guje a gaban Ahab har zuwa Yezireyel.
english: Yahweh’s hand was on Elijah; and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

hausa: Sarki Solomon ya yi manyan garkuwoyi ɗari biyu na zinariya. An yi kowace garkuwa da zinariya bekas ɗari shida.
english: King Solomon made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred shekels of gold went to one buckler.

hausa: Amma ba abin da aka koya muku ke nan ba sa’ad da kuka zo ga sanin Kiristi.
english: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,

hausa: sa’ad da kuwa wani cikin mutanenka Isra’ila ya yi wata addu’a ko roƙo, kowa yana sane a azabarsa da kuma zafinsa, yana buɗe hannuwansa yana duban wajen wannan haikali,
english: whatever prayer and supplication is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, who will each know his own plague and his own sorrow, and shall spread out his hands toward this house,

hausa: Suna da sulkuna kamar sulkunan ƙarfe, ƙarar fikafikansu kuma ta yi kamar motsin dawakai da kekunan yaƙi masu yawa da suke rugawa zuwa yaƙi.
english: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of many chariots and horses rushing to war.

hausa: A can ne waɗansu mutane suka kawo masa wani kurma, wanda da ƙyar yake magana. Sai suka roƙe shi yă ɗibiya hannunsa a kan mutumin.
english: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.

hausa: Game da Yedutun kuwa, daga ’ya’yansa maza. Gedaliya, Zeri, Yeshahiya, Shimeyi, Hashabiya da Mattitiya, su shida ne duka, a ƙarƙashin kulawar mahaifinsu Yedutun, wanda ya yi annabci, yana amfani da garaya a yin godiya da yabon Ubangiji.
english: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising Yahweh with the harp.

hausa: bagaden hadaya ta ƙonawa da dukan kayansa, da daro da mazauninsa.
english: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils, and the basin with its base.

hausa: Dawuda kuwa ya gane Ubangiji ya naɗa shi sarki bisa Isra’ila, ya kuma ɗaukaka masarautarsa saboda mutanensa Isra’ila.
english: David perceived that Yahweh had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel’s sake.

hausa: Shefatiya, Hattil, Fokeret-Hazzebayim, da Ami.
english: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, the children of Ami.

hausa: “Ina roƙonka ka gwada bayinka kwana goma. Kada ka ba mu kome sai kayan lambu mu ci da kuma baƙin ruwa mu sha.
english: “Test your servants, I beg you, ten days; and let them give us vegetables to eat and water to drink.

hausa: fatun ragunan da aka wanke, fatun awaki masu kyau, itacen akashiya,
english: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,

hausa: Ta yi ta faɗin haka har kwanaki masu yawa. A ƙarshe Bulus ya damu ƙwarai sai ya juya ya ce wa aljanin, “A cikin sunan Yesu Kiristi na umarce ka, ka rabu da ita!” Nan take aljanin ya rabu da ita.
english: She was doing this for many days. But Paul, becoming greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, “I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her!” It came out that very hour.

hausa: Zan yi hankali ga yin rayuwa marar zargi, yaushe za ka zo gare ni? Zan bi da sha’anin gidana da zuciya marar abin zargi
english: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.

hausa: Ku gaggai da dukan ’yan’uwa da sumba mai tsarki.
english: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

hausa: Ga yadda za ku ci shi, ku yi ɗamara, takalma kuwa a ƙafafunku, kuna riƙe da sandunan tafiya a hannunku. Ku ci shi da gaggawa; Bikin Ƙetarewa ne na Ubangiji.
english: This is how you shall eat it: with your belt on your waist, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and you shall eat it in haste: it is Yahweh’s Passover.

hausa: Duk wanda ya gaskata da ni, kamar yadda Nassi ya ce, kogunan ruwa masu rai za su gudana daga cikinsa.”
english: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”

hausa: Amma tun da muka daina ƙone turare ga Sarauniyar Sama da kuma miƙa mata hadayun sha, muka rasa kome muna ta mutuwa ta wurin takobi da yunwa.”
english: But since we stopped burning incense to the queen of the sky, and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have lacked all things, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.”

hausa: Amma cikin tausayinka mai girma ba ka kawo su ga ƙarshe ko ka yashe su ba, gama kai Allah ne mai alheri da kuma mai jinƙai.
english: “Nevertheless in your manifold mercies you didn’t make a full end of them, nor forsake them; for you are a gracious and merciful God.

hausa: Gaskiya nake faɗa maka, muna magana a kan abin da muka sani, muka kuma shaida abin da muka gani ne, amma har yanzu kun ƙi ku karɓi shaidarmu.
english: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, in kuna da bangaskiya, ba kuwa da wata shakka ba, ba kawai za ku iya yin abin da aka yi wa itacen ɓauren nan ba, amma za ku ma iya ce wa dutsen nan, ‘Je ka, ka jefa kanka cikin teku,’ sai yă faru.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it would be done.

hausa: Ku bayi, ku yi biyayya ga iyayengijinku na duniya. Ku nuna musu halin bangirma, kuna kuma yin musu biyayya cikin dukan abu, da zuciya ɗaya kamar ga Kiristi kuke yi.
english: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,

hausa: Suka ce, “Ka yi shiru! Kada ka ce wani abu. Zo tare da mu, ka zama mahaifinmu da kuma firist. Bai fi maka ka yi wa kabila da kuma zuriya a Isra’ila aikin firist ba, da ka bauta wa iyali guda kawai?”
english: They said to him, “Hold your peace, put your hand on your mouth, and go with us. Be a father and a priest to us. Is it better for you to be priest to the house of one man, or to be priest to a tribe and a family in Israel?”

hausa: “Kun dai ji an faɗa, ‘Kada ka yi zina.’
english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery;’

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce masa, “Je gidan Yahuda da yake a Miƙaƙƙen Titi ka yi tambaya ko akwai wani mutum daga Tarshish mai suna Shawulu, gama ga shi yana addu’a.
english: The Lord said to him, “Arise and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,

hausa: Amma Yahudawa suka zuga waɗansu mata masu tsoron Allah masu martaba da kuma waɗansu maza masu matsayi a gari. Suka tā da tsanani ga Bulus da Barnabas, suka kore su daga yankinsu.
english: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.

hausa: Waɗanda suke gāba da shi kuwa dole yă yi musu gargaɗi cikin hankali, da fata Allah zai sa su tuba su kai ga sanin gaskiya,
english: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,

hausa: “Ni Ubangiji ba na canjawa. Shi ya sa ku zuriyar Yaƙub, ba a hallaka ku ƙaƙaf ba.
english: “For I, Yahweh, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Akwai abin da ya fi ƙarfina ne? Bari ka gani ko abin da na ce zan yi, zai faru ko babu.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Has Yahweh’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”

hausa: Suna riƙe da baka da māshi; mugaye ne kuma marasa tausayi. Motsinsu kamar ƙugin teku ne yayinda suke hawan dawakansu; suna zuwa a jere kamar wanda ya yi shirin yaƙi don su fāɗa miki, ya Diyar Sihiyona.”
english: They take hold of bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Zion.”

hausa: Yesu ya juya ya gan ta. Sai ya ce, “Kada ki damu diyata, bangaskiyarki ta warkar da ke.” Nan take macen ta warke.
english: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.

hausa: Eden, Miniyamin, Yeshuwa, Shemahiya, Amariya da Shekaniya sun taimake shi da aminci a cikin garuruwan firistoci, suna ba da rabo wa ’yan’uwansu firistoci bisa ga sassansu, tsofaffi da yara.
english: Under him were Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their office of trust, to give to their brothers by divisions, to the great as well as to the small;

hausa: ’Ya’yan Kora maza, su ne, Assir, Elkana da Abiyasaf. Waɗannan su ne dangin Kora.
english: The sons of Korah: Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.

hausa: Ya kasa kunne yayinda Bulus yake magana. Bulus kuma ya kafa masa ido, ya lura cewa yana da bangaskiyar da za tă warkar da shi
english: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,

hausa: Saboda haka, duk wanda ya ƙasƙantar da kansa kamar wannan yaro, shi ne mafi girma a mulkin sama.
english: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

hausa: Ya gina ƙauyuka ya kuma samo shanu da garkuna masu yawa, gama Allah ya ba shi arziki mai yawa sosai.
english: Moreover he provided for himself cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance; for God had given him abundant possessions.

hausa: Ganyayensa suna da kyau, yana da ’ya’ya jingim, abinci kuma domin kowa da kowa. A ƙarƙashinsa namun jeji suke samun wurin hutawa, kuma tsuntsayen sama suna zaune a bisa rassansa; daga cikinsa kowace halitta take cin abinci.
english: Its leaves were beautiful, and it had much fruit, and in it was food for all. The animals of the field had shade under it, and the birds of the sky lived in its branches, and all flesh was fed from it.

hausa: Baƙin da suke tare da ku, za su yi ta ƙaruwa, ku kuwa za ku yi ta komawa baya-baya.
english: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher, and you will come down lower and lower.

hausa: Duk waɗanda suke da niyya, maza da mata, gaba ɗaya, suka kawo kayan ado na zinariya na kowane iri. ’Yan kunne, da ƙawane, da mundaye, da kayayyakin zinariya iri-iri. Dukansu suka miƙa zinariyarsu a matsayin hadaya ga Ubangiji.
english: They came, both men and women, as many as were willing-hearted, and brought brooches, earrings, signet rings, and armlets, all jewels of gold; even every man who offered an offering of gold to Yahweh.

hausa: In ba a hanzarta aka yanke hukunci a kan laifi ba, zukatan mutane sukan cika da ƙulle-ƙullen aikata abubuwan da ba daidai ba.
english: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.

hausa: Na ce, “Cikin tsakiyar rayuwata dole in bi ta ƙofofin mutuwa a kuma raba ni da sauran shekaruna?”
english: I said, “In the middle of my life I go into the gates of Sheol. I am deprived of the residue of my years.”

hausa: Sai ya kalle su da fushi, don taurin zuciyarsu ya ɓata masa rai sosai. Sai ya ce wa mutumin, “Miƙo hannunka.” Sai ya miƙa, hannunsa kuwa ya koma lafiyayye.
english: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.

hausa: “ ‘Za ka ba wa birnin fāɗin mallakarsa kamu 5,000, tsawonsa kuma 25,000, haɗe da tsattsarkan rabo; zai kasance na gidan Isra’ila duka.
english: “‘“You shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand cubits wide and twenty-five thousand long, side by side with the offering of the holy portion. It shall be for the whole house of Israel.

hausa: “Na nemi mutum guda a cikinsu wanda zai gina katanga ya tsaya a gabana a tsakani a madadin ƙasar don kada in hallaka ta, amma ban sami ko ɗaya ba.
english: “I sought for a man among them who would build up the wall and stand in the gap before me for the land, that I would not destroy it; but I found no one.

hausa: Cikin duhu mutane suna fasa gidaje, amma da rana sukan kulle kansu; ba sa so wani abu yă haɗa su da haske.
english: In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don’t know the light.

hausa: Kuna kiyaye ƙa’idodin Omri da dukan ayyukan gidan Ahab kun kuma bi al’adunsu. Saboda haka, zan maishe ku kufai in mai da ku abin dariya a cikin mutane, za ku sha reni a wurin al’ummai.”
english: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of Ahab’s house. You walk in their counsels, that I may make you a ruin, and your inhabitants a hissing. You will bear the reproach of my people.”

hausa: Ku lura fa, ’yan’uwa, cewa kada waninku yă kasance da zuciya mai zunubi marar bangaskiya da takan juye daga bin Allah mai rai.
english: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;

hausa: Za su zauna a ƙasar da na ba wa bawana Yaƙub, ƙasar da kakanninsu suka zauna. Su da ’ya’yansu da ’ya’ya ’ya’yansu za su zauna a can har abada, kuma Dawuda bawana zai zama sarkinsu har abada.
english: They will dwell in the land that I have given to Jacob my servant, in which your fathers lived. They will dwell therein, they, and their children, and their children’s children, forever. David my servant will be their prince forever.

hausa: “Akwai takobi a kan Babiloniyawa!” In ji Ubangiji “a kan waɗanda suke zama a Babilon da kuma a kan fadawanta da masu hikimarta!
english: “A sword is on the Chaldeans,” says Yahweh, “and on the inhabitants of Babylon, on her princes, and on her wise men.

hausa: Ɗaukakata za tă kasance tare da ni garau, bakana koyaushe sabo ne a hannuna.’
english: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’

hausa: A wannan rana Ubangiji zai yi feɗuwa yă kira ƙudaje daga rafuffuka masu nisa na Masar da kuma ƙudan zuma daga ƙasar Assuriya.
english: It will happen in that day that Yahweh will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.

hausa: To, ku ’yan’uwa, ku ’ya’yan alkawari ne kamar Ishaku.
english: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku, za ku yi kuka da kuma gunji, yayinda duniya take murna. Za ku yi baƙin ciki, amma baƙin cikinku zai koma farin ciki.
english: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

hausa: Ya ce, “A wani gari, an yi wani alƙali wanda ba ya tsoron Allah, bai kuma kula da mutane ba.
english: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect man.

hausa: Musa ya tara dukan jama’ar Isra’ilawa ya ce musu, “Waɗannan su ne abubuwan da Ubangiji ya umarce ku, ku yi.
english: Moses assembled all the congregation of the children of Israel, and said to them, “These are the words which Yahweh has commanded, that you should do them.

hausa: Bari Ubangiji, Allahn kakanninku yă ƙara yawanku sau dubu, yă kuma albarkace ku yadda ya yi alkawari!
english: May Yahweh, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as you are and bless you, as he has promised you!

hausa: Yesu ya tsaya ya ce, “Ku kira shi.” Sai suka kira makahon suka ce, “Ka yi farin ciki! Tashi tsaye! Yana kiranka.”
english: Jesus stood still and said, “Call him.” They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”

hausa: Ga kuwa yadda za a gwada ku. Muddin Fir’auna yana a raye, ba za ku bar wannan wuri ba sai ƙaramin ɗan’uwanku ya zo nan.
english: By this you shall be tested. By the life of Pharaoh, you shall not go out from here, unless your youngest brother comes here.

hausa: “A wannan rana,” in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, “Zan sa rana ta fāɗi da tsakar rana in kuma duhunta duniya da rana tsaka.
english: It will happen in that day,” says the Lord Yahweh, “that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the earth in the clear day.

hausa: Zan aiki rina a gabanku, su kori Hiwiyawa, Kan’aniyawa da kuma Hittiyawa.
english: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.

hausa: da Arower, da Sifmot, da Eshtemowa,
english: to those who were in Aroer, to those who were in Siphmoth, to those who were in Eshtemoa,

hausa: Mu bare ne kuma baƙi a gabanka, kamar yadda dukan kakanninmu suke. Kwanakinmu a duniya suna kamar inuwa ne, ba sa zuciya.
english: For we are strangers before you and foreigners, as all our fathers were. Our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no remaining.

hausa: Ka ƙidaya maza masu shekara talatin zuwa hamsin waɗanda sukan zo hidimar aiki a Tentin Sujada.
english: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old: all who enter in to wait on the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

hausa: Za su gudu zuwa kogwannin duwatsu da kuma zuwa tsagaggun duwatsu daga razanar Ubangiji da kuma darajar ɗaukakarsa, sa’ad da ya tashi don yă girgiza duniya.
english: to go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka gaya wa Sisera cewa Barak ɗan Abinowam ya haura zuwa dutsen Tabor,
english: They told Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor.

hausa: “Kada fa ku ɗauka na zo ne don in kawo salama a duniya. A’a, ban zo don in kawo salama ba, sai dai takobi.
english: “Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.

hausa: Duk da haka, sa’ad da suke a ƙasar abokan gābansu, ba zan ƙi su, ko in yi ƙyamarsu, in hallaka su ƙaƙaf, har in karya alkawarina da su ba. Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnsu.
english: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly and to break my covenant with them; for I am Yahweh their God.

hausa: sai waninku yă ce masa, “Sauka lafiya, Allah ya ba da ci da sha da kuma sutura,” amma bai yi wani abu game da bukatunsa na jiki ba, ina amfani?
english: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?

hausa: Mutane suka kawo ƙananan yara wurin Yesu don yă taɓa su, amma almajiran suka kwaɓe su.
english: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.

hausa: Kowace shekara, kai da iyalinka za ku ci su a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku, a wurin da ya zaɓa.
english: You shall eat it before Yahweh your God year by year in the place which Yahweh shall choose, you and your household.

hausa: da ta Bakbuk, da ta Hakufa, da ta Harhur,
english: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

hausa: “Yanzu kuma ’ya’yansu maza su suke yi mini ba’a cikin waƙa na zama abin banza a gare su.
english: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.

hausa: Suka ce, “Dole mutanen Benyamin da suka ragu su sami gādo, domin kada wata kabila a Isra’ila ta ɓace.
english: They said, “There must be an inheritance for those who are escaped of Benjamin, that a tribe not be blotted out from Israel.

hausa: Rabuwata da su ke nan sai na sami wanda zuciyata take ƙauna. Na riƙe shi, ban yarda yă tafi ba sai da na kawo shi gidan mahaifiyata, zuwa ɗakin wadda ta yi cikina.
english: I had scarcely passed from them, when I found him whom my soul loves. I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother’s house, into the room of her who conceived me.

hausa: Za su kashe shi, a rana ta uku kuma za a tashe shi.” Almajiran kuwa suka cika da baƙin ciki.
english: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.

hausa: Dole ku aikata hukuncin da suka yi a wurin da Ubangiji zai zaɓa. Ku lura fa, ku aikata kome da suka faɗa muku.
english: You shall do according to the decisions of the verdict which they shall give you from that place which Yahweh chooses. You shall observe to do according to all that they shall teach you.

hausa: Shawulu ya ce, “Ka saurara yanzu, ɗan Ahitub.” Ya amsa ya ce, “Ina saurara, ranka yă daɗe.”
english: Saul said, “Hear now, you son of Ahitub.” He answered, “Here I am, my lord.”

hausa: “Gama sa’ad da Dawuda ya gama hidimar nufin Allah a zamaninsa, sai ya yi barci; aka binne shi tare da kakanninsa jikinsa kuwa ya ruɓe.
english: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.

hausa: “ ‘A waɗannan kwanaki da kuma a wannan lokaci zan tā da Reshe mai adalci daga zuriyar Dawuda; zai yi abin da yake daidai da kuma gaskiya a ƙasar.
english: “In those days and at that time, I will cause a Branch of righteousness to grow up to David. He will execute justice and righteousness in the land.

hausa: shekara uku na yunwa, wata uku na shan ɗibga a gaban abokan gābanka, sa’ad da za su bi suna kakkashe ku, ko kuwa kwana uku na takobin Ubangiji, ranakun annoba a cikin ƙasar, mala’ikan Ubangiji zai hallaka kowane sashe na Isra’ila.’ Yanzu sai ka yanke shawara yadda zan amsa wa wanda ya aiko ni.”
english: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or else three days of the sword of Yahweh, even pestilence in the land, and Yahweh’s angel destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.’”

hausa: zuciyata ta jarrabtu gare su a ɓoye, hannuna kuma ya sumbace su.
english: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth;

hausa: Doka ta farko wadda aka haɗa da alkawari ita ce, “Ka girmama mahaifinka da mahaifiyarka,
english: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka ga ɓarawo, kukan haɗa kai da shi; kukan haɗa kai da mazinata.
english: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.

hausa: Sai ya tashi, ya ɗauki tabarmarsa, ya yi tafiyarsa a gabansu duka. Wannan ya ba wa kowa mamaki, suka kuma ɗaukaka Allah suna cewa, “Ba mu taɓa ganin abu haka ba!”
english: He arose, and immediately took up the mat and went out in front of them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”

hausa: Ashe, ba Musa ba ne ya ba ku Doka? Duk da haka ba ko ɗayanku da yake kiyaye Dokar. Me ya sa kuke nema ku kashe ni?”
english: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”

hausa: Allahnmu yana zuwa ba kuwa zai yi shiru ba; wuta mai cinyewa a gabansa, babban hadari kuma ya kewaye shi.
english: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.

hausa: Ya je ya faɗa wa matarsa Zeresh, da dukan abokansa, me ya same shi. Masu ba shi shawara, da matarsa Zeresh, suka ce masa, “Idan Mordekai, wanda ka fara fāɗuwa a gabansa, daga zuriyar Yahudawa yake, to, ba za ka yi nasara a kansa ba, tabbatacce za ka fāɗi a gabansa!”
english: Haman recounted to Zeresh his wife and all his friends everything that had happened to him. Then his wise men and Zeresh his wife said to him, “If Mordecai, before whom you have begun to fall, is of Jewish descent, you will not prevail against him, but you will surely fall before him.”

hausa: ya kuma ga takobi yana zuwa a kan ƙasar ya kuwa busa ƙaho don yă faɗakar da mutane,
english: if, when he sees the sword come on the land, he blows the trumpet and warns the people,

hausa: Sai Musa ya hau Dutsen Nebo daga filayen Mowab, zuwa ƙwanƙolin Fisga, wanda yake ƙetare Yeriko. A can Ubangiji ya nuna masa dukan ƙasar, daga Gileyad zuwa Dan,
english: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is opposite Jericho. Yahweh showed him all the land of Gilead to Dan,

hausa: A rana ta goma sha ɗaya, Fagiyel ɗan Okran, shugaban mutanen Asher, ya kawo hadayarsa.
english: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ochran, prince of the children of Asher,

hausa: Na ɗora maka kwanaki bisa ga shekarun zunubinsu. Saboda haka cikin kwana 390 za ka ɗauki zunubin gidan Isra’ila.
english: For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be to you a number of days, even three hundred ninety days. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

hausa: Da wannan, shugaban ya tafi tare da dogarawansa suka kawo manzannin. Sun kawo su amma fa ba ƙarfi da yaji ba, don suna tsoro kada mutane su jajjefe su da duwatsu.
english: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.

hausa: Suka haura su kara da mutanen Benyamin a rana ta uku suka ja dāgā a Gibeya kamar dā.
english: The children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and set themselves in array against Gibeah, as at other times.

hausa: Ya ajiye rundunar sojoji ko’ina a Edom, dukan mutanen Edom kuwa suka zama bayin Dawuda. Ubangiji ya ba wa Dawuda nasara a duk inda ya tafi.
english: He put garrisons in Edom. Throughout all Edom, he put garrisons, and all the Edomites became servants to David. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.

hausa: Dukan sojojinsa zaɓaɓɓu za a kashe su da takobi, za a kuma watsar da waɗanda suka ragu ko’ina. Ta haka za ku san cewa Ni Ubangiji na faɗa.
english: All his fugitives in all his bands will fall by the sword, and those who remain will be scattered toward every wind. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken it.’

hausa: Ƙafafunmu suna tsaye a ƙofofinki, ya Urushalima.
english: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Gideyon, “Da mutum ɗari uku ɗin nan da suka tanɗi ruwa, zan cece ka in kuma ba da Midiyawa a hannuwanku. Ka bar sauran mutane su tafi kowa zuwa wurinsa.”
english: Yahweh said to Gideon, “I will save you by the three hundred men who lapped, and deliver the Midianites into your hand. Let all the other people go, each to his own place.”

hausa: Ibnehiya ɗan Yeroham; Ela ɗan Uzzi, ɗan Mikri; da Meshullam ɗan Shefatiya, ɗan Reyuwel, ɗan Ibniya.
english: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

hausa: A shekara ta goma, a wata na goma, a rana ta goma sha biyu, maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini cewa,
english: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth day of the month, Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

hausa: Hannunsa na hagu yana a ƙarƙashin kaina, hannunsa na dama kuma ya rungume ni.
english: His left hand is under my head. His right hand embraces me.

hausa: Ya yi alama a kawo masa allo, a gaban kowa sai ya rubuta, “Sunansa Yohanna.” Dukan mutane kuwa suka yi mamaki.
english: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.

hausa: Ƙasarsu gādonsu ta haɗa da, Helkat, Hali, Beten, Akshaf,
english: Their border was Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,

hausa: Yayinda take girma ba a yanka ta, takan mutu da sauri fiye da ciyawa.
english: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.

hausa: Amma aka yi masa rauni saboda laifofinmu, aka ƙuje shi saboda kurakuranmu; hukuncin da ya kawo mana salama ya kasance a kansa, kuma ta wurin mikinsa ya sa muka warke.
english: But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.

hausa: da mabiyansa, Gabbai da Sallai, mutum 928.
english: After him Gabbai and Sallai, nine hundred twenty-eight.

hausa: Ina za mu? ’Yan’uwanmu suka sa muka fid da zuciya. Suka ce, ‘Mutanen sun fi mu ƙarfi, sun kuma fi mu tsayi; biranen manya ne, da katanga har sama. Mun ma ga Anakawa a can.’ ”
english: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our heart melt, saying, ‘The people are greater and taller than we. The cities are great and fortified up to the sky. Moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there!’”

hausa: Maɗaurinku sun kunce ƙarfafan itacen jirgin ba su da kāriya, fikafikan jirgin ba su buɗu ba. Ta haka za a raba yalwar ganima har ma guragu za su kwashe ganimar.
english: Your rigging is untied. They couldn’t strengthen the foot of their mast. They couldn’t spread the sail. Then the prey of a great plunder was divided. The lame took the prey.

hausa: Baƙi suna kawo mini hari; mutane marasa imani suna neman raina, mutanen da ba sa tsoron Allah. Sela
english: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.

hausa: Sa’ad da bayi da bābānnin Esta suka zo suka faɗa mata game da Mordekai, sai ta damu ƙwarai. Ta aika masa da riguna domin yă sa a maimakon tsummokin makoki, amma ya ƙi.
english: Esther’s maidens and her eunuchs came and told her this, and the queen was exceedingly grieved. She sent clothing to Mordecai, to replace his sackcloth, but he didn’t receive it.

hausa: Ku tafi ku ƙara shiri. Ku san inda yakan tafi, wane ne kuma ya gan shi a can. An gaya mini cewa shi mai wayo ne sosai.
english: Please go make yet more sure, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who has seen him there; for I have been told that he is very cunning.

hausa: Yana gangarawa a titi kusa da kusurwarta, yana tafiya a gefen wajen gidanta
english: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,

hausa: Dole yă yarda cewa ɗan matar da ba ya ƙaunar ne ɗan fari, ta wurin ba shi rabo kashi biyu na dukan abin da yake da shi, gama shi ne mafarin ƙarfinsa, yana da hakkin ɗan fari.
english: but he shall acknowledge the firstborn, the son of the hated, by giving him a double portion of all that he has; for he is the beginning of his strength. The right of the firstborn is his.

hausa: Amma waɗanda suka juye ga karkatattun hanyoyi Ubangiji zai kore su tare da masu aikata mugunta. Salama tă kasance tare da Isra’ila.
english: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, Yahweh will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.

hausa: Zan yi haka don in sāke ƙame zukatan mutanen Isra’ila, waɗanda duk suka yashe ni don gumakansu.’
english: that I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.”’

hausa: Lokacin nema, da lokacin fid da zuciya, lokacin ajiyewa da lokacin zubarwa.
english: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

hausa: To, domin Yesu yana yin waɗannan abubuwa a ranar Asabbaci, sai Yahudawa suka tsananta masa.
english: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.

hausa: “Sai dukan budurwan nan suka farka suka kuna fitilunsu.
english: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

hausa: Takan marabci talakawa takan kuma taimaki masu bukata.
english: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.

hausa: Annabi, tare da Allahna, su ne masu tsaro a bisa Efraim, duk da haka tarko na jiransa a dukan hanyoyi, da kuma ƙiyayya a cikin gidan Allahnsa.
english: A prophet watches over Ephraim with my God. A fowler’s snare is on all of his paths, and hostility in the house of his God.

hausa: “Ki rera, ya ke bakararriya, ke da ba ki taɓa haihuwa ba; ki ɓarke da waƙa, ki yi sowa don farin ciki, ke da ba ki taɓa naƙuda ba; domin ’ya’yan mace mai kaɗaici sun fi na mai miji yawa,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: “Sing, barren, you who didn’t give birth! Break out into singing, and cry aloud, you who didn’t travail with child! For more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife,” says Yahweh.

hausa: To, wani mutum mai suna Mika daga ƙasar tudu ta Efraim
english: There was a man of the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Micah.

hausa: Sai mala’ikan Ubangiji ya sha gabansa, ya tsaya a ƙunƙuntaccen wuri inda ba wurin juyawa dama ko hagu.
english: Yahweh’s angel went further, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce, “Domin sun bar dokata, wadda na sa a gabansu; ba su yi biyayya da ni ko su bi dokata ba.
english: Yahweh says, “Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice or walked in my ways,

hausa: Marasa bangaskiya za su sami sakamako cikakke saboda hanyoyinsu, kuma mutumin kirki zai sami lada saboda nasa.
english: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.

hausa: ga Ishaku kuwa na ba shi Yaƙub da Isuwa. Na ba Isuwa ƙasar kan tudu ta Seyir, amma Yaƙub da ’ya’yansa maza suka gangara zuwa Masar.
english: I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau Mount Seir, to possess it. Jacob and his children went down into Egypt.

hausa: Ku lura da abin da Allah ya yi. Wa zai iya miƙe abin da ya tanƙware?
english: Consider the work of God, for who can make that straight which he has made crooked?

hausa: Kowane namiji a iyalin firistoci zai iya ci; gama abu ne mafi tsarki.
english: Every male among the priests shall eat of it. It is most holy.

hausa: A lokacin za su ce da Urushalima Kursiyin Ubangiji, kuma dukan al’ummai za su taru a Urushalima don su girmama sunan Ubangiji. Ba za su ƙara bin taurinkai zuciyarsu mai mugunta ba.
english: At that time they will call Jerusalem ‘Yahweh’s Throne;’ and all the nations will be gathered to it, to Yahweh’s name, to Jerusalem. They will no longer walk after the stubbornness of their evil heart.

hausa: Gwamna ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Wane ne cikin biyun nan, kuke so in sakar muku?” Suka ce, “Barabbas.”
english: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”

hausa: “Je ka faɗa wa Dawuda, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, ina ba ka zaɓi uku. Ka zaɓi ɗaya daga cikinsu don in aikata maka shi.’ ”
english: “Go and speak to David, ‘Yahweh says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”

hausa: Ko da sun kuɓuta daga hallaka, Masar za tă tattara su, Memfis kuma za tă binne su. Sarƙaƙƙiya za tă mamaye kayan azurfansu, ƙayayyuwa su tsiro a cikin tentunansu.
english: For, behold, when they flee destruction, Egypt will gather them up. Memphis will bury them. Nettles will possess their pleasant things of silver. Thorns will be in their tents.

hausa: Amma Yehoshafat ya yi tambaya ya ce, “Babu wani annabin Ubangiji a nan da za mu nemi nufin Ubangiji ta wurinsa?” Wani hafsan sarkin Isra’ila ya amsa ya ce, “Ai, akwai Elisha ɗan Shafat, wanda dā ya yi wa Iliya hidima.”
english: But Jehoshaphat said, “Isn’t there a prophet of Yahweh here, that we may inquire of Yahweh by him?” One of the king of Israel’s servants answered, “Elisha the son of Shaphat, who poured water on the hands of Elijah, is here.”

hausa: Gama Musa ya ce, ‘Ka girmama mahaifinka da mahaifiyarka,’kuma, ‘Duk wanda ya zagi mahaifinsa ko mahaifiyarsa, dole a kashe shi.’
english: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa wa shafaffensa, ga Sairus, wanda hannun damansa yana riƙe da shi don yă ci al’ummai a gabansa ya kuma tuɓe makaman sarakuna, don yă buɗe ƙofofi a gabansa don kada a kulle ƙofofi.
english: Yahweh says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have held to subdue nations before him and strip kings of their armor, to open the doors before him, and the gates shall not be shut:

hausa: amma a ƙarshe tana da ɗaci kamar tafashiya, mai ci kamar takobi mai kaifi biyu.
english: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.

hausa: Amma game da ni, ƙafafuna suna gab da yin santsi; tafin ƙafana ya yi kusan zamewa.
english: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.

hausa: “ ‘Kowa, ko haifaffe ɗan ƙasa ko baƙo, da ya ci wani abin da aka sami a mace, ko naman jeji ya yayyage, dole yă wanke rigunansa, yă kuma yi wanka, zai kuma ƙazantu har yamma; sa’an nan zai tsarkake.
english: “‘Every person that eats what dies of itself, or that which is torn by animals, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening. Then he shall be clean.

hausa: Urushalima ta yi sarakuna masu iko sosai waɗanda suka yi mulkin Kewayen Kogin Yuferites gaba ɗaya, an kuma biya masu haraji, da kuɗin shiga da na fita na kaya.
english: There have also been mighty kings over Jerusalem who have ruled over all the country beyond the River; and tribute, custom, and toll was paid to them.

hausa: “Sa’ad da Efraim ya ga ciwonsa, Yahuda kuwa miyakunta, sai Efraim ya juya ga Assuriya, ya aika wurin babban sarki don neman taimako. Amma bai iya warkar da kai ba, bai iya warkar da miyakunka ba.
english: “When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to King Jareb: but he is not able to heal you, neither will he cure you of your wound.

hausa: Adorayim, Lakish, Azeka,
english: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,

hausa: Ehud ya kai hannun hagunsa, ya zaro takobi daga cinyar ƙafar damansa ya soki sarki a ciki.
english: Ehud put out his left hand, and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his body.

hausa: Sa’ad da ƙasa ta yi tayarwa, takan kasance da masu mulki da yawa, amma mai fahimi da sani kan mai da zaman lafiya.
english: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.

hausa: “Ka faɗa wa Zerubbabel gwamnan Yahuda cewa zan girgiza sammai da ƙasa.
english: “Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, ‘I will shake the heavens and the earth.

hausa: Bari waɗanda suke tsoronka su juya gare ni, waɗanda suka gane da farillanka.
english: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.

hausa: na goma sha uku a kan Huffa, na goma sha huɗu a kan Yeshebeyab,
english: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

hausa: Zan albarkace su in kuma sa tuduna kewaye da su. Zan zubo yayyafi a lokacinsa; za a kasance da yayyafin albarka.
english: I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing. I will cause the shower to come down in its season. There will be showers of blessing.

hausa: A gutsuttsura shi, a zuba mai a kansa, hadaya ce ta hatsi.
english: You shall cut it in pieces, and pour oil on it. It is a meal offering.

hausa: Kai da kake zama a ‘Lebanon,’ kai da kake sheƙa a gine-ginen al’ul za ka yi nishi sa’ad da zafi ya auka maka, zafi kamar na mace mai naƙuda!
english: Inhabitant of Lebanon, who makes your nest in the cedars, how greatly to be pitied you will be when pangs come on you, the pain as of a woman in travail!

hausa: Bari yă juye zukatanmu gare shi, don mu yi tafiya a cikin dukan hanyoyinsa, mu kuma kiyaye umarnansa, ƙa’idodinsa, da kuma farillan da ya ba wa kakanninmu.
english: that he may incline our hearts to him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, which he commanded our fathers.

hausa: gama kowa zai ɗauki kayansa.
english: For each man will bear his own burden.

hausa: “Ko kuwa in wata mace tana da kuɗi na azurfa guda goma, sa’an nan ɗaya ya ɓata, ashe, ba za tă ƙuna fitila, ta share gidan, ta nema a hankali, har sai ta samu ba?
english: “Or what woman, if she had ten drachma coins, if she lost one drachma coin, wouldn’t light a lamp, sweep the house, and seek diligently until she found it?

hausa: Wannan shi ne alkawarin da zan yi da gidan Isra’ila, bayan lokacin nan, in ji Ubangiji. Zan sa dokokina a cikin zukatansu, in kuma rubuta su a kan zukatansu. Zan zama Allahnsu, su kuwa za su zama mutanena.
english: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the Lord: “I will put my laws into their mind; I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

hausa: Gama kwanaki tabbatacce suna zuwa, sa’ad da zan hukunta gumakan Babilon, zan kunyatar da dukan ƙasar kuma matattunta duk za su kwanta a cikinta.
english: Therefore behold, the days come that I will execute judgment on the engraved images of Babylon; and her whole land will be confounded. All her slain will fall in the middle of her.

hausa: (Fāɗin shirayun hanyoyin shiga kewaye da filin ciki kamu ashirin da biyar ne, fāɗinsu kuma kamu biyar.)
english: There were arches all around, twenty-five cubits long and five cubits wide.

hausa: Amma mutumin da yake ƙaunar Allah, Allah yana sane da shi.
english: But anyone who loves God is known by him.

hausa: Dukan mazan da aka ba su aiki a sansanin Ruben, bisa ga sashensu sun kai 151,450. Su ne za su zama na biyu in za a tashi.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, according to their armies. They shall set out second.

hausa: A bayanta ya bar haske kamar zurfin ruwan da yana kumfa.
english: He makes a path shine after him. One would think the deep had white hair.

hausa: A rana ta uku, Eliyab ɗan Helon, shugaban mutanen Zebulun, ya kawo hadayarsa.
english: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun,

hausa: Ubangiji ya yi magana da Manasse da mutanensa, amma ba su kula ba.
english: Yahweh spoke to Manasseh and to his people, but they didn’t listen.

hausa: Sa’ad da adali ya yi nasara, birnin kan yi farin ciki; sa’ad da mugu ya hallaka, akwai sowa ta farin ciki.
english: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.

hausa: Ya ce masa, “Je ka, ka wanke a Tafkin Silowam” (kalman nan tana nufin “Aikakke”). Saboda haka mutumin ya tafi ya wanke, ya kuma dawo gida yana gani.
english: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

hausa: Wannan shi ne wanda aka rubuta game da shi cewa, “ ‘Zan aiko da ɗan saƙona yă sha gabanka, wanda zai shirya hanya, a gabanka.’
english: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

hausa: Gama duba, mugaye sun tanƙware bakkunansu; sun kuma ɗana kibiyoyinsu don su harbi mutanen kirki a zuciya daga cikin duhu.
english: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.

hausa: Sai ta amsa ta ce, “I, tafi.” Sai yarinyar ta tafi ta kawo mahaifiyar yaron.
english: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Go.” The young woman went and called the child’s mother.

hausa: Sai aka rasa ruwa da jama’a za su sha, mutane suka taru, suka tayar wa Musa da Haruna.
english: There was no water for the congregation; and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

hausa: Yesu ya ce, “Ku ƙyale ta mana. Don me kuke damunta? Ta yi abu mai kyau a gare ni.
english: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.

hausa: Ga wata tabbatacciyar magana. In wani ya sa zuciyarsa a kan zama mai kula da ikkilisiya, yana marmarin yin aiki mai daraja ne.
english: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.

hausa: dole mutanen nan biyu da suke rikici su tsaya a gaban Ubangiji, a gaban firistoci da alƙalai waɗanda suke aiki a lokacin.
english: then both the men, between whom the controversy is, shall stand before Yahweh, before the priests and the judges who shall be in those days;

hausa: Ka sāke jawo mu gare ka, ya Ubangiji, don mu komo; ka sabunta kwanakinmu su zama kamar yadda suke a dā
english: Turn us to yourself, Yahweh, and we will be turned. Renew our days as of old.

hausa: Gama mulkin Allah ba batun ci da sha ba ne, sai dai na adalci, salama, da kuma farin ciki cikin Ruhu Mai Tsarki,
english: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

hausa: Da Yesu ya ga haka, sai ya yi fushi, ya ce musu, “Ku bar yara ƙanana su zo wurina, kada ku hana su, gama mulkin Allah na irin waɗannan ne.
english: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

hausa: Sai mahaifin ya gane a daidai wannan lokaci ne Yesu ya ce masa, “Ɗanka zai rayu.” Saboda haka shi da dukan iyalinsa suka gaskata.
english: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.

hausa: Sai Filistiyawa suka taru don su yi yaƙi da Isra’ilawa. Suka fito da kekunan-dawakan yaƙi dubu talatin, da masu hawan dawakai dubu shida, da sojoji masu yawa kamar yashi a bakin teku. Suka tafi Mikmash a gabashin Bet-Awen, suka kafa sansani a can.
english: The Philistines assembled themselves together to fight with Israel: thirty thousand chariots, six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the seashore in multitude. They came up and encamped in Michmash, eastward of Beth Aven.

hausa: Da suka iso, sai suka hau gidan sama, zuwa ɗakin da suke zama. Waɗanda suka kasance kuwa su ne, Bitrus, Yohanna, Yaƙub da Andarawus; Filibus da Toma; Bartolomeyu da Mattiyu; Yaƙub ɗan Alfayus da Siman Zilot, da kuma Yahuda ɗan Yaƙub.
english: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.

hausa: “To, ku saurari ma’anar misali na mai shukan nan.
english: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Bilha maza, mai hidimar Rahila su ne, Dan da Naftali.
english: The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.

hausa: Sai ta ba wa Ubangiji wanda ya yi magana da ita, wannan suna. “Kai Allah ne wanda yake ganina,” gama ta ce, “Yanzu na ga wanda yake ganina.”
english: She called the name of Yahweh who spoke to her, “You are a God who sees,” for she said, “Have I even stayed alive after seeing him?”

hausa: Kaito na biyu ya wuce; kaito na uku yana zuwa ba da daɗewa ba.
english: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe comes quickly.

hausa: (yadda yake a rubuce a Dokar Ubangiji cewa, “Kowane ɗan fari, za a keɓe shi ga Ubangiji”),
english: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),

hausa: Da Yesu ya ga tana kuka, Yahudawan da suka zo tare da ita ma suna kuka, sai ya yi juyayi ƙwarai a ruhu ya kuma damu.
english: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,

hausa: “Zan kuma sa mutanen su sami tagomashi daga wurin Masarawa, saboda sa’ad da za ku fita, ba za ku fita hannu wofi ba.
english: I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and it will happen that when you go, you shall not go empty-handed.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Asher maza su ne, Imna, Ishba, Ishwi da Beriya. ’Yar’uwarsa ita ce Sera.
english: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister.

hausa: Almajiransa suka dubi juna, suka rasa ko da wa yake.
english: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.

hausa: Gama zunubi ba zai zama maigidanku ba, domin ba kwa ƙarƙashin doka, sai dai ƙarƙashin alheri.
english: For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka kawo wa Musa tabanakul, tentin da dukan kayayyakinsa, ƙugiyoyinsa, katakansa, da sandunansa, da dogayen sandunansa da rammukansa;
english: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

hausa: Ana nan sai Amnon ɗan Dawuda ya fara son Tamar, kyakkyawar ’yar’uwar Absalom ɗan Dawuda.
english: After this, Absalom the son of David had a beautiful sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.

hausa: ta wurin sani ɗakunanta sukan cika da kyawawan kayayyaki masu daraja.
english: by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.

hausa: daga Ozni, kabilar Ozniyawa daga Eri, kabilar Eriyawa;
english: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;

hausa: Za ku gudu ta wajen kwarin dutsena, gama zai miƙe har zuwa Azel. Za ku gudu kamar yadda kuka guje wa girgizar ƙasa a kwanakin Uzziya sarkin Yahuda. Sa’an nan Ubangiji Allahna zai zo, tare da duk masu tsarki.
english: You shall flee by the valley of my mountains, for the valley of the mountains shall reach to Azel. Yes, you shall flee, just like you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Yahweh my God will come, and all the holy ones with you.

hausa: Yesu ya kira almajiransa wurinsa ya ce, “Ina jin tausayin mutanen nan; gama kwana uku ke nan suke tare da ni ba abin da za su ci. Ba na so in sallame su da yunwa, don kada su kāsa a hanya.”
english: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”

hausa: Ya sarkin Assuriya, makiyayanka sun yi barci; manyan mutanenka sun kwanta su huta. An watsar da mutanenka a cikin duwatsu, ba wanda zai tattaro su.
english: Your shepherds slumber, king of Assyria. Your nobles lie down. Your people are scattered on the mountains, and there is no one to gather them.

hausa: Gederot, Bet-Dagon, Na’ama, Makkeda, garuruwa goma sha shida ke nan da ƙauyukansu.
english: Gederoth, Beth Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen cities with their villages.

hausa: Saboda haka Hebron ta zama ƙasar Kaleb ɗan Yefunne Bakenizze tun daga lokacin nan, domin ya bi Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila da dukan zuciyarsa.
english: Therefore Hebron became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite to this day, because he followed Yahweh, the God of Israel wholeheartedly.

hausa: Ahitofel ya ce wa Absalom, “Zan zaɓi mutum dubu goma sha biyu su fita a daren nan in fafari Dawuda.
english: Moreover Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me now choose twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David tonight.

hausa: Ɗansa na wajen mace ’yar aikin gidansa ya zo bisa ga ƙa’idar jiki ne; amma ɗansa na wajen ainihin matarsa ya zo a sakamakon alkawarin ne.
english: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.

hausa: sai ku kawo hadaya ta gari tare da bijimi, kashi ɗaya bisa uku na gari mai laushi kwaɓaɓɓe da rabin garwan mai.
english: then he shall offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;

hausa: Ya ce, “Zan ɓoye fuskata daga gare su, in ga ƙarshensu; gama su muguwar tsara ce, ’ya’ya ne marasa aminci.
english: He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.

hausa: Sai almajiran suka fita, suka yi wa’azi ko’ina. Ubangiji kuwa ya yi aiki tare da su, ya tabbatar da maganarsa ta wurin alamu da suke biye da maganar.
english: They went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.

hausa: In wani ya far miki, ba daga wurina ba ne; duk wanda ya far miki zai miƙa wuya gare ki.
english: Behold, they may gather together, but not by me. Whoever gathers together against you will fall because of you.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, “Saboda zunubai uku na Gaza, har guda huɗu ma, ba zan fasa hukunta su ba. Don sun kwashe al’umma gaba ɗaya sun sayar wa Edom,
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Gaza, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because they carried away captive the whole community, to deliver them up to Edom;

hausa: Ayuba ya ce,
english: Job answered:

hausa: Da Amaziya ya dawo daga kisan mutanen Edom, sai ya dawo da allolin mutanen Seyir. Ya kafa su a matsayin allolinsa, ya rusuna musu, ya kuma miƙa musu hadayun ƙonawa.
english: Now after Amaziah had come from the slaughter of the Edomites, he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them and burned incense to them.

hausa: “Malam, Musa ya rubuta mana cewa, ‘In ɗan’uwan wani mutum ya mutu, ya bar mata amma ba ’ya’ya, dole mutumin ya aure gwauruwar, ya samo wa ɗan’uwansa ’ya’ya.’
english: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife and raise up children for his brother.

hausa: Ka faɗa masa, ‘Ka yi hankali, ka natsu kada kuma ka ji tsoro ko ka damu, kada ka ji tsoron fushin sarki Rezin da na Aram da na ɗan Remaliya, ba wani abu mai hatsari ba ne, bai fi hayaƙin ’yan ƙirare biyu da suke cin wuta ba.
english: Tell him, ‘Be careful, and keep calm. Don’t be afraid, neither let your heart be faint because of these two tails of smoking torches, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.

hausa: Duk da haka ka mai da hankali ga addu’ar bawanka da kuma roƙo don jinƙai, ya Ubangiji, Allahna. Ka ji kuka da addu’ar da bawanka yake yi a gabanka.
english: Yet have respect for the prayer of your servant and to his supplication, Yahweh my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer which your servant prays before you;

hausa: Ku jajjefe shi da duwatsu har sai ya mutu, domin ya yi ƙoƙari yă juye ku daga Ubangiji Allahnku, wanda ya fitar da ku daga Masar, daga ƙasar bauta kuma.
english: You shall stone him to death with stones, because he has sought to draw you away from Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

hausa: Suka ce, “Duba, mu bayinka muna da masu ji da ƙarfi hamsin. Bari su je su nemi maigidanka. Wataƙila, Ruhun Ubangiji ya ɗauke shi ya ajiye bisa wani dutse, ko wani kwari.” Elisha ya ce, “A’a, kada ku aike su.”
english: They said to him, “See now, there are with your servants fifty strong men. Please let them go and seek your master. Perhaps Yahweh’s Spirit has taken him up, and put him on some mountain or into some valley.” He said, “Don’t send them.”

hausa: Abincin tafiyan nan namu yana da ɗumi lokacin da muka kintsa tashi daga gida a ranar da za mu kama hanya zuwa wurinku. Amma yanzu duba yadda ya bushe, ya yi fumfuna.
english: This our bread we took hot for our supplies out of our houses on the day we went out to go to you; but now, behold, it is dry, and has become moldy.

hausa: Dukan waɗannan ’ya’yan Dawuda ne maza, ban da ’ya’yansa maza ta wurin ƙwarƙwaransa. Tamar ita ce ’yar’uwarsu.
english: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.

hausa: ya albarkace su, yawansu kuma ya ƙaru, bai kuwa bar garkunansu suka ragu ba.
english: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.

hausa: Kun san cewa ban yi wata-wata yin muku wa’azi game da duk abin da zai amfane ku ba amma na koyar da ku a fili da kuma gida-gida.
english: how I didn’t shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,

hausa: In fa kuka yi alkawari ga Ubangiji Allahnku, to, kada ku yi jinkirin cikawa, gama tabbatacce Ubangiji Allahnku zai neme shi daga gare ku, za ku kuma zama masu laifin zunubi.
english: When you vow a vow to Yahweh your God, you shall not be slack to pay it, for Yahweh your God will surely require it of you; and it would be sin in you.

hausa: Da kunne zai ce, “Saboda ni ba ido ba ne, ni ba gaɓar jiki ba ne.” Wannan ba zai hana shi zama gaɓar jikin ba.
english: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.

hausa: Biye da shi, Baruk ɗan Zakkai da ƙwazo ya gyara wani sashe, daga kusurwa zuwa mashigin gidan Eliyashib babban firist.
english: After him, Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired another portion, from the turning of the wall to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

hausa: Amma idan ka riga ka yi aure, to, ba laifi, ba zunubi ba ne, kuma idan yarinya ta yi aure, ba tă yi laifi ba. Sai dai waɗanda suka yi aure za su fuskanci damuwoyi masu yawa a cikin rayuwa, ni kuwa ina so in fisshe su daga wannan.
english: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.

hausa: Firist zai ƙone su a kan bagade, hadaya ce da aka ƙone da wuta ga Ubangiji. Hadaya ce don laifi.
english: and the priest shall burn them on the altar for an offering made by fire to Yahweh: it is a trespass offering.

hausa: kowane ’yan raguna bakwai, kashi ɗaya bisa goma.
english: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

hausa: in sun juye gare ka da dukan zuciyarsu, da dukan ransu a ƙasar abokan gābansu waɗanda suka kwashe kamammu, suka yi addu’a gare ka, suka fuskanci wajen ƙasar da ka ba wa kakanninsu, waje birnin da ka zaɓa, da kuma haikalin da na gina domin Sunanka;
english: if they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies who carried them captive, and pray to you toward their land which you gave to their fathers, the city which you have chosen and the house which I have built for your name,

hausa: Ubangiji ya kuma ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Gama kun mutu, ranku yanzu kuwa yana ɓoye tare da Kiristi a cikin Allah.
english: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

hausa: Kwana bakwai za su yi kafara saboda bagaden su kuma tsarkake shi; ta haka za su keɓe shi.
english: Seven days shall they make atonement for the altar and purify it. So shall they consecrate it.

hausa: Ya yi tafiya a dukan hanyoyin Yerobowam ɗan Nebat da kuma cikin zunubinsa wanda ya sa Isra’ila suka yi, har suka tsokane Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila yă yi fushi ta wurin gumakansu marasa amfani.
english: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sins with which he made Israel to sin, to provoke Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger with their vanities.

hausa: Ko da yake ka san ba ni da laifi, kuma ba wanda zai iya cetona daga hannunka.
english: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.

hausa: Za mu tanada burodin da ake ajiye a kan tebur; za mu ba da hadayun hatsi da hadayun ƙonawa na kullum; za mu ba da hadayun Asabbatai, da na bukukkuwan Sabon Wata da na bukukkuwan da aka ƙayyade; za mu ba da hadayu masu tsarki; za mu ba da hadayun zunubi don a yi kafara domin Isra’ila; mu kuma ba da abubuwan da ake bukata dukan domin ayyukan gidan Allahnmu.
english: for the show bread, for the continual meal offering, for the continual burnt offering, for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, for the set feasts, for the holy things, for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.

hausa: Salma mahaifin Betlehem, da kuma Haref mahaifin Bet-Gader.
english: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.

hausa: Ka duba daga sama ka gani daga kursiyinka da yake bisa, mai tsarki da kuma mai ɗaukaka. Ina kishinka da kuma ikonka? Ka janye juyayi da kuma tausayin da kake yi mana daga gare mu.
english: Look down from heaven, and see from the habitation of your holiness and of your glory. Where are your zeal and your mighty acts? The yearning of your heart and your compassion is restrained toward me.

hausa: Da Shawulu ya gane Ubangiji yana tare da Dawuda, ’yarsa Mikal kuma tana ƙaunarsa,
english: Saul saw and knew that Yahweh was with David; and Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved him.

hausa: A can jiragen ruwa suna kai komo, kuma dodon ruwan da ka yi, yă yi wasa a can.
english: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.

hausa: Ubangiji zai aika da albarka a rumbunanku da kuma a bisa kome da kuka sa hannunku a kai. Ubangiji Allahnku zai albarkace ku a ƙasar da yake ba ku.
english: Yahweh will command the blessing on you in your barns, and in all that you put your hand to. He will bless you in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.

hausa: Bangaskiya ita ce kasance tabbacin abin da muke bege a kai da kuma tabbatar da abin da ba mu gani ba.
english: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

hausa: “Tsoron Ubangiji shi ne mafarin hikima, sanin Mai Tsarki kuwa fahimi ne.
