english: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

hausa: Na kuma ji cewa sassan da ake ba wa Lawiyawa ba a ba su ba, cewa kuma dukan Lawiyawa da mawaƙan da suke da hakkin hidima sun koma gonakinsu.
english: I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them, so that the Levites and the singers, who did the work, had each fled to his field.

hausa: Aka aika ’yan-kada-tă-kwana da saƙoni zuwa dukan lardunan sarki da umarni a hallaka, a karkashe, a kuma kawar da dukan Yahudawa, manya da ƙanana, mata da yara, a kuma washe kayayyakinsu.
english: Letters were sent by couriers into all the king’s provinces, to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish, all Jews, both young and old, little children and women, in one day, even on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, and to plunder their possessions.

hausa: Sarki Solomon ya yi wa kansa abin ɗauka; ya yi shi da katako daga Lebanon.
english: King Solomon made himself a carriage of the wood of Lebanon.

hausa: Ku san cewa Ubangiji ya keɓe masu tsoron Allah wa kansa; Ubangiji zai ji sa’ad da na yi kira gare shi.
english: But know that Yahweh has set apart for himself him who is godly; Yahweh will hear when I call to him.

hausa: Ahira ɗan Enan kuma shi ne shugaban kabilar Naftali.
english: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.

hausa: Zan lalace Masar ta Bisa in ƙuna wuta wa Zowan in zartar da hukunci a kan Tebes.
english: I will make Pathros desolate, and will set a fire in Zoan, and will execute judgments on No.

hausa: Kowanne ya miƙe gaba sosai. Duk inda ruhu zai tafi, can za su, ba tare da juyawa ba yayinda suke tafiya.
english: Each one went straight forward. Where the spirit was to go, they went. They didn’t turn when they went.

hausa: Kaiton masu mugunta! Masifa tana a kansu! Za a rama abin da hannuwansu suka yi.
english: Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them, for the deeds of their hands will be paid back to them.

hausa: Manzannin suka yi ayyukan da alamu masu banmamaki masu yawa a cikin mutanen. Dukan masu bi kuwa sukan taru a Shirayin Solomon.
english: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.

hausa: Na ga daga abin da ya yi kamar kwankwasonsa zuwa bisa ya yi kamar ƙarfe mai walƙiya, sai ka ce wuta, kuma daga kwankwasonsa zuwa ƙasa ya yi kamar wuta; haske kuma mai walƙiya sosai kewaye da shi.
english: I saw as it were glowing metal, as the appearance of fire within it all around, from the appearance of his waist and upward; and from the appearance of his waist and downward I saw as it were the appearance of fire, and there was brightness around him.

hausa: Allah ya albarkace su ya ce, “Ku yi ta haihuwa ku kuma ƙaru da yawa, ku cika ruwan tekuna, bari kuma tsuntsaye su yi yawa a bisa duniya.”
english: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”

hausa: Yau, na kira sama da duniya, su zama shaidata a kanku. Idan kuka yi rashin biyayya, lalle za ku hallaka nan da nan daga ƙasar da kuke ƙetare Urdun ku gāda. Ba za ku daɗe a cikinta ba, amma za a kawar da ku ƙaƙaf.
english: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon utterly perish from off the land which you go over the Jordan to possess it. You will not prolong your days on it, but will utterly be destroyed.

hausa: Sai Rehobowam ya huta da kakanninsa, aka kuma binne shi tare da su a Birnin Dawuda. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Na’ama, ita kuwa mutuniyar Ammon ce. Sai Abiyam ɗansa ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonitess. Abijam his son reigned in his place.

hausa: sai ya aiki ɗansa Yoram wurin Sarki Dawuda yă gaishe, yă kuma yi masa barka saboda nasarar da ya yi a kan Hadadezer, gama Hadadezer nan ya hana Towu sakewa. Yoram ya tafi ɗauke da kayan azurfa, da na zinariya, da na tagulla.
english: then Toi sent Joram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him; for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. Joram brought with him vessels of silver, vessels of gold, and vessels of bronze.

hausa: ku da kuke kiran kanku ’yan ƙasar birni mai tsarki kuna kuma dogara ga Allah na Isra’ila, Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ne sunansa,
english: for they call themselves citizens of the holy city, and rely on the God of Israel; Yahweh of Armies is his name.

hausa: Kada ka tuna da zunuban ƙuruciyata da kuma hanyoyin tawayena; bisa ga ƙaunarka ka tuna da ni, gama kai nagari ne, ya Ubangiji.
english: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, Yahweh.

hausa: Na yi taƙama da ku a wurinsa, ba ku kuwa ba ni kunya ba. Kamar dai yadda dukan abin da muka gaya muku gaskiya ne, haka ma taƙamarmu a kanku a gaban Titus ya zama gaskiya.
english: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.

hausa: Suna hidima a cikin tsattsarkan wuri wanda yake hoto da kuma siffar abin da yake cikin sama. Shi ya sa aka gargaɗi Musa sa’ad da yana dab da gina tabanakul cewa, “Ka lura fa, ka yi kome daidai bisa ga zānen da aka nuna maka a kan dutsen.”
english: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, “See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.”

hausa: Duk wanda ya kashe dabba, dole yă biya, amma duk wanda ya kashe mutum, dole a kashe shi.
english: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.

hausa: Amma ka nuna mini alheri marar ƙarewa iri ta Ubangiji dukan rayuwata don kada a kashe ni.
english: You shall not only show me the loving kindness of Yahweh while I still live, that I not die;

hausa: Moza shi ne mahaifin Bineya; Rafa, Eleyasa da kuma Azel.
english: Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

hausa: Gama Ɗan Mutum, a cikin ranarsa, zai zama kamar walƙiya da take walƙawa, da take kuma haskaka sararin sama, daga wannan kusurwa zuwa wancan kusurwa.
english: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of one part under the sky, shines to another part under the sky, so will the Son of Man be in his day.

hausa: Bari waɗanda suke la’anta ranaku su la’anta wannan rana su waɗanda suke umartar dodon ruwa.
english: Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.

hausa: Yesu ya ce masa, “Ku mutane, in ba kun ga alamu da abubuwan banmamaki ba, ba yadda za a yi ku ba da gaskiya.”
english: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”

hausa: A wannan dare Yaƙub ya tashi ya ɗauki matansa biyu, da matan nan biyu masu hidima da ’ya’yansa goma sha ɗaya ya haye rafin Yabbok.
english: He rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of the Jabbok.

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Ga muryar “Mutuwar Ɗa.” Zabura ta Dawuda. Zan yabe ka, ya Ubangiji, da dukan zuciyata; zan faɗa dukan abubuwan banmamakinka.
english: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm by David. I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.

hausa: da Miklot, wanda ya zama mahaifin Shimeya. Su ma sun zauna kusa da danginsu a Urushalima.
english: and Mikloth, who became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their families in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

hausa: Wannan mai baƙaƙen dawakai zai nufi wajen ƙasar arewa, mai fararen dawakai zai nufi wajen yamma, sai kuma mai dawakai masu ɗigo-ɗigo a jiki zai nufi wajen kudu.”
english: The one with the black horses goes out toward the north country; and the white went out after them; and the dappled went out toward the south country.”

hausa: Waɗannan mutane dai, gunaguni gare su, kullum ganin laifin waɗansu suke yi. Muguwar sha’awa ce kaɗai tunaninsu. Sun cika da banzar magana ta yabon kansu. Suna ruɗin mutane da zaƙin baki don samun ribar kansu.
english: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of persons to gain advantage.

hausa: Mutane za su amsa, ‘Domin sun yashe Ubangiji Allah na kakanninsu, wanda ya fitar da su daga Masar, suka rungumi waɗansu alloli, suna musu sujada, suna bauta musu, shi ya sa ya kawo dukan wannan masifa a kansu.’ ”
english: They shall answer, ‘Because they abandoned Yahweh, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and took other gods, worshiped them, and served them. Therefore he has brought all this evil on them.’”

hausa: Ƙarfin dawakan nan kuwa yana a bakunansu da wutsiyoyinsu; gama wutsiyoyinsu suna kama da macizai masu kawuna, da wutsiyoyin ne kuma suke yi wa mutane rauni.
english: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads; and with them they harm.

hausa: Gaskiya ta ɓace gaba ɗaya, kuma duk wanda ya guji mugunta zai zama ganima. Ubangiji ya duba bai kuwa ji daɗi cewa babu adalci ba.
english: Yes, truth is lacking; and he who departs from evil makes himself a prey. Yahweh saw it, and it displeased him that there was no justice.

hausa: Na zama abin dariya ga masu zargina; sa’ad da suka gan ni, suka kaɗa kawunansu.
english: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.

hausa: Sai matar ta ce, “Bari baiwarka ta ƙara yin magana sau ɗayan nan wa ranka yă daɗe.” Ya ce, “Ki faɗa.”
english: Then the woman said, “Please let your servant speak a word to my lord the king.” He said, “Say on.”

hausa: “Ma’aikatan da ka ɗauka wajen sa’a ta goma sha ɗaya suka zo, kowannensu kuwa ya karɓi dinari guda.
english: “When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.

hausa: Ya ce musu “Sam! Kun zo ne ku ga inda ƙasarmu babu tsaro.”
english: He said to them, “No, but you have come to see the nakedness of the land!”

hausa: da ƙaramin bijimi guda ɗaya, tunkiya ɗaya, da rago, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya domin hadaya ta ƙonawa;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

hausa: Ya zaga dukan ƙasar da take kewaye da Urdun, yana wa’azin baftismar tuba don gafarar zunubai.
english: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.

hausa: A lokacin girbi, sai ya aiki bawa zuwa wurin masu hayan, don su ba shi daga cikin ’ya’yan inabin. Amma ’yan hayan suka yi wa bawan nan dūka, suka kore shi hannu wofi.
english: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him and sent him away empty.

hausa: “ ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa sa’ad da na tattara mutanen Isra’ila daga al’ummai inda suke a warwatse, zan nuna kaina mai tsarki a cikinsu a idon al’ummai. Sa’an nan za su zauna a ƙasarsu, wadda na ba wa bawana Yaƙub.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “When I have gathered the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they are scattered, and am shown as holy among them in the sight of the nations, then they will dwell in their own land which I gave to my servant Jacob.

hausa: Ya riga ya faɗa wa Rahila cewa shi dangin mahaifinta ne kuma ɗan Rebeka. Saboda haka ta ruga da gudu ta faɗa wa mahaifinta.
english: Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s relative, and that he was Rebekah’s son. She ran and told her father.

hausa: Ku dubi mutanen Isra’ila mana. Ashe, waɗanda suke cin hadayu, ba ɗaya suke da juna cikin cin hadayun da aka miƙa a bagade ba?
english: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?

hausa: Masu tsaro suka gamu da ni yayinda suke kai kawo a cikin birni, sai na ce, “Kun ga mini wanda zuciyata take ƙauna?”
english: The watchmen who go about the city found me; “Have you seen him whom my soul loves?”

hausa: Saboda haka Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, zai aukar da cuta mai kisa a kan ƙosassu jarumawa; a ƙarƙashin sansaninsa zai ƙuna wuta kamar harshen wuta.
english: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.

hausa: Don haka, yanzu ku ba baƙi ba ne, ku kuma ba bare ba ne. Ku ’yan ƙasa ne tare da mutanen Allah, iyalin gidan Allah kuma.
english: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,

hausa: Ku ji wannan magana, ya gidan Isra’ila, ina makokin nan dominku.
english: Listen to this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel:

hausa: To, dukanku Isra’ilawa, sai ku yi magana ku kuma yanke hukuncinku.”
english: Behold, you children of Israel, all of you, give here your advice and counsel.”

hausa: Kuna kaɗa molayenku yadda Dawuda ya yi kuna ƙirƙiro waƙoƙi a kan kayan kaɗe-kaɗe.
english: who strum on the strings of a harp, who invent for themselves instruments of music, like David;

hausa: ya ce masa, “Yi gudu, gaya wa saurayin can cewa, ‘Urushalima za tă zama birni marar katanga domin mutane da dabbobi masu yawa ƙwarai za su kasance a cikinta.
english: and said to him, “Run, speak to this young man, saying, ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of men and livestock in it.

hausa: Bayan sun yi tafiya dukan dare daga Gilgal, Yoshuwa ya auko musu ba labari.
english: Joshua therefore came to them suddenly. He marched from Gilgal all night.

hausa: Abin nan da yana mai kyau, zai kawo mini mutuwa? Ko kaɗan! Amma domin zunubi ya bayyana kansa a matsayin zunubi, sai ya haifar da mutuwa a cikina ta wurin abin da yake mai kyau, domin ta wurin umarnin nan zunubi ya fito da matuƙar muninsa.
english: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was producing death in me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful.

hausa: Ya cire darajar da nake da ita, ya kuma cire rawani daga kaina.
english: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

hausa: Wajen sa’a ta tara, Yesu ya ɗaga murya da ƙarfi ya ce, “Eloi, Eloi,lama sabaktani?” (Wato, “Ya Allahna, ya Allahna, don me ka yashe ni?”).
english: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

hausa: Ninebe ta tattara rundunarta, duk da haka sun yi ta tuntuɓe a kan hanyarsu. Sun ruga zuwa katangan birnin, sun sanya garkuwar kāriya a inda ya kamata.
english: He summons his picked troops. They stumble on their way. They dash to its wall, and the protective shield is put in place.

hausa: Saboda haka, ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila yana cewa, “Ga shi zan sa wannan mutane su ci abinci mai ɗaci su kuma sha ruwan dafi.
english: Therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, “Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.

hausa: Darajarsa ta yi kamar fitowar rana; ƙyalƙyali ya wulga daga hannunsa, inda ikonsa yake a ɓoye.
english: His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden.

hausa: sai abin da ya rigafaɗi ya cika sai da maganar Ubangiji ta tabbatar da shi mai gaskiya.
english: until the time that his word happened, and Yahweh’s word proved him true.

hausa: Sa’ad da zuciyata ta ɓaci hankalina kuma ya tashi,
english: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.

hausa: ba zan ba wa idanuna barci ba, ba gyangyaɗi wa idanuna,
english: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,

hausa: Sunan kogi na uku Tigris. Wannan ne ya malala ya bi ta gefen gabashin Asshur. Kogi na huɗu kuwa shi ne Yuferites.
english: The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.

hausa: Shugabanni ba su san inda na tafi, ko abin da nake yi ba, domin ban riga na faɗa wa Yahudawa, ko firistoci, ko manyan gari, ko shugabanni, ko sauran waɗanda za su yi aiki, kome ba.
english: The rulers didn’t know where I went, or what I did. I had not as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest who did the work.

hausa: “Ka yi wa ƙyallen maƙalawa a ƙirjin tuƙaƙƙun sarƙoƙin zinariya zalla.
english: You shall make on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

hausa: Zai zama tsattsarkan rabo na ƙasa domin firistoci, waɗanda za su yi hidima a cikin wuri mai tsarki da kuma waɗanda za su zo kusa don su yi hidima a gaban Ubangiji. Zai zama wuri don gidajensu ya kuma zama tsattsarkan wuri saboda wuri mai tsarki.
english: It is a holy portion of the land; it shall be for the priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, who come near to minister to Yahweh. It shall be a place for their houses and a holy place for the sanctuary.

hausa: Dawuda ya bar Zadok firist da ’yan’uwansa firistoci a gaban tabanakul na Ubangiji a tudun da yake a Gibeyon
english: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before Yahweh’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,

hausa: Dukanmu mukan yi tuntuɓe a hanyoyi dabam-dabam. In wani bai taɓa yin kuskure a cikin maganarsa ba, shi cikakke ne, yana kuma iya ƙame dukan jikinsa.
english: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.

hausa: Sai ta tafi, ta zauna ɗan nesa da yaron, misalin nisan harbin baka, gama ta yi tunani ta ce, “Ba zan iya kallon yaron yana mutuwa ba.” Da ta zauna nesa da yaron, sai ta fara kuka.
english: She went and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she said, “Don’t let me see the death of the child.” She sat opposite him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.

hausa: Yesu dai bai riga ya shiga ƙauyen ba tukuna, har yanzu yana inda Marta ta tarye shi.
english: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.

hausa: In Ubangiji ya ji daɗinmu, zai kai mu ƙasan nan, ƙasar da take zub da madara da zuma, yă kuwa ba mu ita.
english: If Yahweh delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us: a land which flows with milk and honey.

hausa: Ta haka zan koyar wa masu laifi hanyoyinka, masu zunubi kuma za su komo gare ka.
english: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.

hausa: Kada masu ɓata suna su taɓa kahu a ƙasar; bari masifa ta farauci mutane masu rikici.
english: An evil speaker won’t be established on the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

hausa: ’Ya’yan Zera maza su ne, Zimri, Etan, Heman, Kalkol da Darda, su biyar ne.
english: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all.

hausa: To, saura kwana biyu ne kaɗai a yi Bikin Ƙetarewa da Bikin Burodi Marar Yisti, sai manyan firistoci da malaman dokoki, suka nemi wani dalili su kama Yesu a ɓoye, su kashe.
english: It was now two days before the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception and kill him.

hausa: Da Yesu ya ce, “Ni ne shi,” sai suka ja da baya suka fāɗi a ƙasa.
english: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward and fell to the ground.

hausa: Kai za ka riƙe sashe mafi tsarki na hadayun da suka ragu daga wuta. Daga dukan kyautai mafi tsarki na hadayun da suka miƙa mini, ko ta gari, ko don zunubi, ko kuma don laifi, wannan kashi naka ne da ’ya’yanka.
english: This shall be yours of the most holy things from the fire: every offering of theirs, even every meal offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall give to me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.

hausa: Da ba don Ubangiji ya yi mini taimako ba, da tuni na zauna shiru a wurin mutuwa.
english: Unless Yahweh had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.

hausa: Yaƙub ya kwana da Rahila ita ma, ya kuwa ƙaunaci Rahila fiye da Liyatu. Ya kuma yi wa Laban aiki na ƙarin waɗansu shekaru bakwai.
english: He went in also to Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him seven more years.

hausa: ‘Wane ne a cikinku ya ragu da ya ga wannan gida a darajarsa ta dā? Yaya yake a gare ku a yanzu? Bai yi kamar a bakin kome ba, ko ba haka ba?
english: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? Isn’t it in your eyes as nothing?

hausa: Kwanakina suna kamar inuwar yamma; na bushe kamar ciyawa.
english: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.

hausa: Dukansu kuwa suka sami ƙarfafawa, suka kuma ci abinci.
english: Then they all cheered up, and they also took food.

hausa: zan yi abin da ka roƙa. Zan ba ka zuciya mai hikima da ta ganewa, har yă zama ba a taɓa samun wani kamar ka ba, ba kuwa za a taɓa samunsa ba.
english: behold, I have done according to your word. Behold, I have given you a wise and understanding heart, so that there has been no one like you before you, and after you none will arise like you.

hausa: Nuhu ya aikata duk abin da Ubangiji ya umarce shi.
english: Noah did everything that Yahweh commanded him.

hausa: Kada baƙon da ya miƙa kansa ga Ubangiji ya ce, “Ai Ubangiji zai ware ni daga mutanensa.” Kada kuma wani bābā ya yi gunaguni cewa, “Ni busasshen itace ne kawai.”
english: Let no foreigner who has joined himself to Yahweh speak, saying, “Yahweh will surely separate me from his people.” Do not let the eunuch say, “Behold, I am a dry tree.”

hausa: mutum fa, wanda yake da mugunta da lalacewa, wanda yake shan mugunta kamar ruwa!
english: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!

hausa: Waɗanda suke kusa da waɗanda suke nesa za su yi miki ba’a, ya ke birni marar kunya, cike da rigima.
english: Those who are near and those who are far from you will mock you, you infamous one, full of tumult.

hausa: Sa’an nan ya rungume ɗan’uwansa Benyamin ya yi kuka, sai Benyamin ya rungume shi yana kuka.
english: He fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.

hausa: sai ’ya’yan Allah maza suka ga cewa ’ya’yan mutane mata suna da bansha’awa, sai suka zaɓi waɗanda suke so, suka aura.
english: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.

hausa: Ya riƙa aika su dubu goma-goma zuwa Lebanon kowane wata, saboda su yi wata ɗaya a Lebanon, watanni biyu kuma a gida. Adoniram ne ya lura da aikin gandun.
english: He sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: for a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home; and Adoniram was over the men subject to forced labor.

hausa: Sa’ad da Musa ya ji haka, sai ya gudu zuwa ƙasar Midiyan, inda ya yi baƙunci, ya kuma haifi ’ya’ya biyu maza.
english: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.

hausa: Da Yesu ya sauka, ya ga taro mai yawa, sai ya ji tausayinsu, gama kamar tumaki suke waɗanda ba su da makiyayi. Sai ya fara koya musu abubuwa da yawa.
english: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.

hausa: Sai Iliya ya ce masa, “Ka dakata a nan, Ubangiji ya aike ni Urdun.” Sai Elisha ya ce masa, “Muddin Ubangiji yana a raye, kai kuma kana raye, ba zan rabu da kai ba.” Saboda haka suka ci gaba da tafiya tare.
english: Elijah said to him, “Please wait here, for Yahweh has sent me to the Jordan.” He said, “As Yahweh lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you.” Then they both went on.

hausa: Dawuda da kansa ya kira shi ‘Ubangiji.’ To, ta yaya zai zama ɗansa?” Taro mai yawa suka saurare shi da murna.
english: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.

hausa: Sai ta ce masa, “Ni ’yar Betuwel ce ɗan da Milka ta haifa wa Nahor.”
english: She said to him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.”

hausa: Nan da nan abin da aka faɗa a kan Nebukadnezzar tabbatarsa ya cika. Aka kore shi daga cikin mutane ya kuma shiga cin ciyawa kamar shanu. Jikinsa ya jiƙe da raɓa, har gashinsa ya yi tsawo kamar fikafikan gaggafa, kumbarsa kuma suka yi tsawo kamar na tsuntsu.
english: This was fulfilled the same hour on Nebuchadnezzar. He was driven from men and ate grass like oxen; and his body was wet with the dew of the sky until his hair had grown like eagles’ feathers, and his nails like birds’ claws.

hausa: Nebukadnezzar ya ɗauki Yehohiyacin ya kai bauta a Babilon. Ya kuma kwashe mahaifiyar sarki, da matansa, da fadawansa, da manyan mutanen ƙasar daga Urushalima ya kai Babilon.
english: He carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, with the king’s mother, the king’s wives, his officers, and the chief men of the land. He carried them into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

hausa: A kwanakin sai Ubangiji ya fara rage girman Isra’ila, Hazayel ya yi nasara a bisa Isra’ila a ko’ina a yankinsu
english: In those days Yahweh began to cut away parts of Israel; and Hazael struck them in all the borders of Israel

hausa: Ana ciki haka, sai Bafilistin nan shi ma ya fita yana gusowa zuwa wurin Dawuda. Mai riƙe masa garkuwar yaƙi kuwa yana tafe a gabansa.
english: The Philistine walked and came near to David; and the man who bore the shield went before him.

hausa: Ran kowace halitta yana a hannunsa, haka kuma numfashin dukan ’yan adam.
english: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?

hausa: Amma Allah ne mai yin shari’a, yakan saukar da wannan, yă kuma tayar da wani.
english: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.

hausa: “Za su dawo gare ta su kawar da dukan mugayen siffofi da gumaka masu banƙyama.
english: “‘They will come there, and they will take away all its detestable things and all its abominations from there.

hausa: Zuciyarka ta cika da alfarma saboda kyanka, ka kuma lalace hikimarka saboda darajarka. Saboda haka na jefar da kai zuwa ƙasa; na sa ka zama abin kallo a gaban sarakuna.
english: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty. You have corrupted your wisdom by reason of your splendor. I have cast you to the ground. I have laid you before kings, that they may see you.

hausa: Wannan ita ce muguntar da take faruwa a cikin dukan abubuwa a duniya. Ƙaddara ɗaya ce take a kan kowa. Amma zukatan mutane cike suke da mugunta, akwai kuma hauka a zukatansu yayinda suke a raye, bayan haka kuma sai su mutu.
english: This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all. Yes also, the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness is in their heart while they live, and after that they go to the dead.

hausa: Da ya zo kusa da inda nake tsaye, na firgita na kuma fāɗi rubda ciki. Ya ce da ni “Ɗan mutum, ka gane da cewa wannan wahayi yana magana ne a kan kwanakin ƙarshe.”
english: So he came near where I stood; and when he came, I was frightened, and fell on my face; but he said to me, “Understand, son of man, for the vision belongs to the time of the end.”

hausa: Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Miƙa hannunka bisa teku don ruwa yă koma kan Masarawa, da keken yaƙinsu, da kuma mahayansu.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand over the sea, that the waters may come again on the Egyptians, on their chariots, and on their horsemen.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Farisiyawa suka ga wannan, sai suka ce masa, “Duba! Almajiranka suna yin abin da doka ta hana a yi a ranar Asabbaci.”
english: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”

hausa: ’Ya’yan Shawulu maza su ne, Yonatan, Ishbi, da Malki-Shuwa. Sunan babban ’yarsa ita ce Merab, ƙaramar kuma Mikal.
english: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua; and the names of his two daughters were these: the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal.

hausa: Za a watse a bar biranen Arower a bar wa tumaki da shanu, waɗanda za su kwanta, ba tare da wani wanda zai tsorata su ba.
english: The cities of Aroer are forsaken. They will be for flocks, which shall lie down, and no one shall make them afraid.

hausa: Ku yi ƙoƙari sosai ku kiyaye zaman ɗayan nan da Ruhu ya ba ku, ku yi haka ta wurin zaman lafiya da juna.
english: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

hausa: jimina, ƙururu, bubuƙuwa, kowane irin shaho,
english: the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, the hawk of any kind,

hausa: ’Ya’yan sarakunansu sun fi ƙanƙara haske sun kuma fi madara fari, jikunansu sun fi murjani ja, kyansu kamar shuɗin yakutu.
english: Her nobles were purer than snow. They were whiter than milk. They were more ruddy in body than rubies. Their polishing was like sapphire.

hausa: A can mutanen Dan suka kafa wa kansu gumaka, Yonatan ɗan Gershom, ɗan Musa, da ’ya’yansa maza firistoci ne na kabilar Dan har lokacin da aka kwashe mutane zuwa bauta.
english: The children of Dan set up for themselves the engraved image; and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons were priests to the tribe of the Danites until the day of the captivity of the land.

hausa: Sa’an nan dukan fadawan sarkin Babilon suka shiga suka zazzauna a Ƙofar Tsakiya. Wato, Nergal-Sharezer na Samgar-Nebo, Sarsekim wani babban hafsa, Nergal-Sharezer bafade mai girma da dukan sauran fadawan sarkin Babilon.
english: All the princes of the king of Babylon came in, and sat in the middle gate: Nergal Sharezer, Samgarnebo, Sarsechim the Rabsaris, Nergal Sharezer the Rabmag, with all the rest of the princes of the king of Babylon.

hausa: Zuriyar Simeyon bisa ga kabilansu, daga Nemuwel, kabilar Nemuwelawa; daga Yamin, kabilar Yaminawa; daga Yakin, kabilar Yakinawa;
english: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;

hausa: Zan komo da su daga Masar in kuma tattara su daga Assuriya. Zan kawo su Gileyad da Lebanon, har wuri yă kāsa musu.
english: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria. I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and there won’t be room enough for them.

hausa: Lambun yana da fararen labulen da aka rataye da shunayya na lallausan lilin, da aka ɗaura da igiyoyin fararen lilin, da yadin jan garura, haɗe da zoban azurfa a kan ginshiƙin farin ƙasa. A nan, akwai kujeru na zinariya da na azurfa a kan daɓe mai ado da aka yi da duwatsu masu daraja, da farin ƙasa, da fararen duwatsun wuya, da waɗansu duwatsu masu tsada.
english: There were hangings of white and blue material, fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and marble pillars. The couches were of gold and silver, on a pavement of red, white, yellow, and black marble.

hausa: “ ‘Kada ku yi amfani da mudun ƙarya sa’ad da kuke awon tsawo, nauyi, ko yawan abu.
english: “‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.

hausa: Ka cece mu ka kuma taimake mu da hannunka na dama, domin waɗanda kake ƙauna su kuɓuta.
english: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

hausa: Za ku iya nemi ruwa a bashin da kuka ba baƙo, amma ba ɗan’uwanku mutumin Isra’ila ba, domin Ubangiji Allahnku yă sa muku albarka a kowane abin da kuka sa hannunku a kai, a ƙasar da kuke shiga ku ci gādonta.
english: You may charge a foreigner interest; but you shall not charge your brother interest, that Yahweh your God may bless you in all that you put your hand to, in the land where you go in to possess it.

hausa: Saboda haka a kwanakin Zerubbabel da Nehemiya, dukan Isra’ila suka ba da sashe na kowace rana domin mawaƙa da matsaran ƙofofi. Suka kuma keɓe sashe don sauran Lawiyawa, Lawiyawan kuma suka keɓe sashe don zuriyar Haruna.
english: All Israel in the days of Zerubbabel and in the days of Nehemiah gave the portions of the singers and the gatekeepers, as every day required; and they set apart that which was for the Levites; and the Levites set apart that which was for the sons of Aaron.

hausa: “Ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, ka fara nuna wa bawanka ɗaukakarka da ikonka. Akwai wani allah a sama ko a duniya, wanda zai aikata waɗannan manyan ayyukan kamar ka?
english: “Lord Yahweh, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or in earth that can do works like yours, and mighty acts like yours?

hausa: Kowane mutum zai zama kamar wurin fakewa daga iska mafaka kuma daga hadari, kamar rafuffukan ruwa a hamada da kuma inuwar babban dutse a ƙeƙasasshiyar ƙasa.
english: A man shall be as a hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the storm, as streams of water in a dry place, as the shade of a large rock in a weary land.

hausa: Tabbatacce mugunta tana ƙuna kamar wuta; tana cin ƙayayyuwa da sarƙaƙƙiya, ta sa wuta a jeji mai itatuwa masu yawa, don yă yi murtuke hayaƙi har zuwa sama.
english: For wickedness burns like a fire. It devours the briers and thorns; yes, it kindles in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.

hausa: Kullum nakan sa Ubangiji a gabana. Gama yana a hannun damana, ba zan jijjigu ba.
english: I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

hausa: Ku wuce tsirara da kuma kunya, ku mazaunan Shafir. Bet-Ezel tana makoki domin babu wani daga Za’anan da ya fito don yă taimaka.
english: Pass on, inhabitant of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame. The inhabitant of Zaanan won’t come out. The wailing of Beth Ezel will take from you his protection.

hausa: Yayinda Yehu ya shiga ƙofa, sai ta ce, “Lafiya, kai Zimri, mai kashe maigidansa?”
english: As Jehu entered in at the gate, she said, “Do you come in peace, Zimri, you murderer of your master?”

hausa: Don mai bi da kaɗe-kaɗe. Mai muryar “Lilin Alkawari.” Na Asaf. Zabura ce. Ka ji mu, ya Makiyayin Isra’ila, kai da ka bishe Yusuf kamar garke. Kai da kake zaune a kursiyi tsakanin kerubobi, ka haskaka
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lilies of the Covenant.” A Psalm by Asaph. Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.

hausa: A wannan rana, “Ku rera game da gonar inabi mai ba da ’ya’ya ku ce
english: In that day, sing to her, “A pleasant vineyard!

hausa: Duk da haka suna ce wa Allah, ‘Ka rabu da mu.’ Ba ma so mu san hanyoyinka.
english: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.

hausa: Ya yi magana da su daga ginshiƙin girgije; ya kiyaye farillansa da ƙa’idodin da ya ba su.
english: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.

hausa: Ka daure su a yatsotsinka; ka rubuta su a allon zuciyarka.
english: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

hausa: Haka ma Kiristi bai kai kansa neman ɗaukaka na zama babban firist ba. Allah ne dai ya ce masa, “Kai Ɗana ne; yau na zama Uba a gare ka.”
english: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.”

hausa: Gama bai kashe ni a cikin ciki ba, da ma ya sa cikin mahaifiyata ya zama kabarina, cikinta ya fadada har abada.
english: because he didn’t kill me from the womb. So my mother would have been my grave, and her womb always great.

hausa: Daga mugayen zukatansu laifi kan fito mugaye ƙulle-ƙullen da suke cikin zukatansu ba su da iyaka.
english: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yesu ya ce wa almajiransa, “Duk mai son bina, dole yă ƙi kansa, yă ɗauki gicciyensa, yă bi ni.
english: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

hausa: Gādon da aka samu da sauri a farkon farawa ba zai zama mai albarka a ƙarshe ba.
english: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won’t be blessed in the end.

hausa: Haka kuma daga kabilar Dan, aka ba su, Elteke, Gibbeton,
english: Out of the tribe of Dan, Elteke with its pasture lands, Gibbethon with its pasture lands,

hausa: Sun shirya teburori, sun shimfiɗa dardumai, sun ci, sun sha! Tashi, ku hafsoshi, sa mai a garkuwoyi!
english: They prepare the table. They set the watch. They eat. They drink. Rise up, you princes, oil the shield!

hausa: Da na ce, “Zan faɗa haka,” da na bashe ’ya’yanka.
english: If I had said, “I will speak thus”, behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.

hausa: Ka gargaɗe mutumin da yake kawo tsattsaguwa sau ɗaya, ka kuma gargaɗe shi sau na biyu. Bayan haka, kada wani abu yă haɗa ka da shi.
english: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,

hausa: Dole mu yi tafiya kwana uku cikin hamada domin miƙa hadayu ga Ubangiji Allahnmu, yadda ya umarce mu.”
english: We will go three days’ journey into the wilderness, and sacrifice to Yahweh our God, as he shall command us.”

hausa: Me za ku ce ke nan, in kuka gan Ɗan Mutum yana hawa zuwa inda yake dā!
english: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?

hausa: Ya kamata Allah yă yi maka bisa ga abin da ka ce ne, sa’ad da ka ƙi ka tuba? Dole kai ka zaɓa, ba ni ba; yanzu ka gaya mini abin da ka sani.
english: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.

hausa: “Duba! Ga sojoji suna zuwa daga arewa; babbar al’umma da sarakuna masu yawa suna tahowa daga iyakokin duniya.
english: “Behold, a people comes from the north. A great nation and many kings will be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

hausa: Mai albarka ce wadda ta gaskata cewa abin da Ubangiji ya faɗa mata zai cika!”
english: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”

hausa: Mutane suka rena shi suka ƙi shi, mutum ne cike da baƙin ciki, ya kuma saba da wahala. Kamar wanda mutane suna ɓuya fuskokinsu daga gare shi aka rena shi aka yi banza da shi.
english: He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom men hide their face; and we didn’t respect him.

hausa: Daidai ne in yi wannan tunani game da dukanku, da yake kuna a zuciyata; domin ko ina daure cikin sarƙoƙi ko ina kāre bishara ina kuma tabbatar da ita, dukanku kuna tarayya cikin alherin Allah tare da ni.
english: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

hausa: Da yake muna da bege irin wannan, to, muna da ƙarfin zuciya sosai ke nan.
english: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,

hausa: Ko ka nemi abokan gābanka, ba za ka same su ba. Waɗanda suke yaƙi da kai za su zama kamar ba kome ba.
english: You will seek them, and won’t find them, even those who contend with you. Those who war against you will be as nothing, as a nonexistent thing.

hausa: Ya yi abin da yake mugu a gaban Ubangiji, yana bin ayyukan banƙyama na al’umman da Ubangiji ya kora a gaban Isra’ilawa.
english: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, after the abominations of the nations whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.

hausa: sa’an nan zan amsa wa masu cin mutuncina, gama na dogara ga maganarka.
english: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.

hausa: Da babbar murya suka rera, “Macancanci ne Ɗan Ragon nan da aka kashe, don yă sami iko da wadata da hikima da ƙarfi da girma da ɗaukaka da kuma yabo!”
english: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”

hausa: Ya furta cewa zai sa ku zama masu yabo, masu suna, masu daraja, fiye da dukan al’umman da ya yi. Za ku zama jama’a tsattsarka ta Ubangiji Allahnku, kamar yadda ya yi alkawari.
english: He will make you high above all nations that he has made, in praise, in name, and in honor, and that you may be a holy people to Yahweh your God, as he has spoken.

hausa: “Ko kuma mutum yă sha horo ta wurin kwanciya da ciwo da rashin jin daɗi cikin ƙasusuwansa,
english: “He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,

hausa: Ki ɗauki dunƙulen burodi goma tare da ke, da waina, da tulun zuma, ki tafi wurinsa. Zai faɗa miki abin da zai faru da yaron.”
english: Take with you ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will become of the child.”

hausa: Bayan wahalar ransa, zai ga hasken rai, ya kuma gamsu; ta wurin saninsa bawana mai adalci zai ’yantar da mutane masu yawa, zai kuma ɗauki laifofinsu.
english: After the suffering of his soul, he will see the light and be satisfied. My righteous servant will justify many by the knowledge of himself; and he will bear their iniquities.

hausa: Amma da Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon ya kawo wa ƙasan nan hari, sai muka ce, ‘Ku zo, dole mu tafi Urushalima don mu tsira daga Babiloniyawa da kuma sojojin Arameyawa.’ Saboda haka ne muke a Urushalima.”
english: But when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, we said, ‘Come! Let’s go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians; so we will dwell at Jerusalem.’”

hausa: Ɗan Mutum zai tafi kamar yadda yake a rubuce game da shi, amma kaiton mutumin da ya bashe Ɗan Mutum! Zai fi masa, da ba a haife shi ba.”
english: For the Son of Man goes as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

hausa: Ina fata, ɗan’uwa, zan sami amfani daga gare ka cikin Ubangiji; ka wartsake zuciyata cikin Kiristi.
english: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.

hausa: “Ashe, gidana bai daidaita da Allah ba? Ashe, Allah bai yi madawwamiyar yarjejjeniya da ni shiryayye da ɗaurarre a kowane sashi ba? Ba zai kawo ga cikar cetona yă kuma biya duk bukatuna ba?
english: Isn’t my house so with God? Yet he has made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure, for it is all my salvation and all my desire. Won’t he make it grow?

hausa: Mutum biyu za su iya yin tafiya tare in ba su yarda su yi haka ba?
english: Do two walk together, unless they have agreed?

hausa: Gama in saƙon da aka faɗi ta bakin mala’iku ya zama tabbatacce, kuma kowane ƙeta umarni da rashin biyayya suka karɓi sakamakonsu da ya dace,
english: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just penalty,

hausa: Waɗannan su ne kabilan Efraim bisa ga kabilansu, daga Shutela, kabilar Shutelawa; daga Beker, kabilar Bekerawa; daga Tahan, kabilar Tahanawa.
english: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

hausa: Ba ku san cewa Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila ya ba da sarautar Isra’ila ga Dawuda da zuriyarsa har abada ta wurin alkawarin gishiri ba?
english: Ought you not to know that Yahweh, the God of Israel, gave the kingdom over Israel to David forever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, “Mai yiwuwa ya zama da mamaki ga raguwar wannan mutanen da suke nan a lokacin, amma zai zama abin mamaki gare ni ne?” In ji Ubangiji Maɗaukaki.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “If it is marvelous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days, should it also be marvelous in my eyes?” says Yahweh of Armies.

hausa: “Wanda duk yake a fili, ya kuma taɓa gawa wanda aka kashe da takobi, ko wanda ya mutu mutuwar Allah, ko ƙashin mutum, ko kabari, zai ƙazantu har bakwai.
english: “Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

hausa: Bari Isra’ila su yi farin ciki da Mahaliccinsu; bari mutanen Sihiyona su yi murna da Sarkinsu.
english: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

hausa: Shugabannin iyalin Lawiyawa a kwanakin Eliyashib, Yohiyada, Yohanan da Yadduwa, da kuma na firistoci, an rubuta su a zamanin mulkin Dariyus mutumin Farisa.
english: As for the Levites, in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua, there were recorded the heads of fathers’ households; also the priests, in the reign of Darius the Persian.

hausa: Sun yi kamar mutane masu wāshin gatura don yanka itatuwa a kurmi.
english: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.

hausa: Ku yabi Ubangiji, ku iyalan al’ummai, ku yabi ɗaukaka da ƙarfin Ubangiji,
english: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of the peoples, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength!

hausa: Suka yi zance a kan tashinsa, wanda shi ya kusan ya kawo ga cikarsa a Urushalima.
english: who appeared in glory and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.

hausa: Ku wawayen mutane! Ashe, wanda ya yi bayan, ba shi ne kuma ya yi cikin ba?
english: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?

hausa: A wannan lokaci, Merodak-Baladan ɗan Baladan sarkin Babilon ya aika wa Hezekiya wasiƙu tare da kyauta, domin ya sami labarin rashin lafiyar Hezekiya.
english: At that time Berodach Baladan the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah, for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.

hausa: da kuma a cikin hamada. A can ma kun ga yadda Ubangiji Allahnku ya riƙe ku ko’ina da kuka tafi, kamar yadda mahaifi yakan riƙe ɗansa, sai da kuka kai wannan wuri.”
english: and in the wilderness where you have seen how that Yahweh your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went, until you came to this place.”

hausa: Bai san cewa ita surukarsa ce ba, sai ya ratse zuwa wurinta a gefen hanya ya ce, “Zo mana, in kwana da ke.” Sai ta ce, “Me za ka ba ni in na kwana da kai?”
english: He turned to her by the way, and said, “Please come, let me come in to you,” for he didn’t know that she was his daughter-in-law. She said, “What will you give me, that you may come in to me?”

hausa: A daren nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Gideyon, “Tashi ka tafi sansaninsu domin zan ba da su a hannuwanka.
english: That same night, Yahweh said to him, “Arise, go down into the camp, for I have delivered it into your hand.

hausa: Sa’ad da bawan Ibrahim ya ji abin da suka ce, sai ya rusuna har ƙasa a gaban Ubangiji.
english: When Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth to Yahweh.

hausa: Sai ya yi gaba kaɗan, ya fāɗi a ƙasa, ya yi addu’a, ya ce in mai yiwuwa ne, a ɗauke masa wannan sa’a.
english: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.

hausa: Mutanen kuwa suka yi mamaki sa’ad da suka ga kurame suna magana, shanyayyu suna samun lafiya, guragu suna takawa, makafi kuma suna ganin gari. Sai suka yabi Allah na Isra’ila.
english: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, the injured healed, the lame walking, and the blind seeing—and they glorified the God of Israel.

hausa: Amma Bulus ya yi ihu ya ce, “Kada ka yi wa kanka lahani! Dukanmu muna nan!”
english: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, “Don’t harm yourself, for we are all here!”

hausa: Saboda haka ’yan’uwansa mata suka aika da saƙo wa Yesu cewa, “Ubangiji, wannan da kake ƙauna yana rashin lafiya.”
english: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”

hausa: In ba za tă iya kawo ɗan rago ba, sai ta kawo kurciyoyi biyu ko tattabarai biyu, ɗaya domin hadaya ta ƙonawa ɗayan kuma domin hadaya don zunubi. Ta haka firist zai yi kafara dominta, za tă kuwa zama tsabtacciya.’ ”
english: If she cannot afford a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons: the one for a burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering. The priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.’”

hausa: Saboda alherinka, ya Allah, an sami kaka mai albarka, amalankenka kuwa sun cika har suna zuba.
english: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.

hausa: Bayan ya haifi Enosh, Set ya yi shekara 807, ya kuma haifi waɗansu ’ya’ya maza da mata.
english: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

hausa: Ta’aziyya, ku ta’azantu mutanena, in ji Allahnku.
english: “Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.

hausa: Amma dole su ba da lissafi gare shi wanda yake a shirye yă shari’anta masu rai da matattu.
english: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Ka mayar da sandan Haruna a akwatin Alkawari, don a ajiye shi alama ga masu tawaye. Wannan zai kawo ƙarshen gunaguninsu a kaina, domin kada su mutu.”
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Put back the rod of Aaron before the covenant, to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion; that you may make an end of their complaining against me, that they not die.”

hausa: Har yaushe bawanka zai yi ta jira? Yaushe za ka hukunta masu tsananta mini?
english: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?

hausa: Akwai kuma Ayin, Rimmon, Eter da Ashan, garuruwa huɗu ke nan da ƙauyukansu,
english: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan; four cities with their villages;

hausa: Mai albarka ne mutumin da yake daurewa cikin gwaji, gama bayan ya yi nasara da gwajin, zai sami rawanin rai wanda Allah ya yi alkawari ga waɗanda suke ƙaunarsa.
english: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.

hausa: Amma fa, a cikin biranen al’ummai da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku gādo, kada ku bar wani abu mai numfashi da rai.
english: But of the cities of these peoples that Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, you shall save alive nothing that breathes;

hausa: Ko da yake ya hana Solomon bin waɗansu alloli, Solomon bai kiyaye umarnin Ubangiji ba.
english: and had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods; but he didn’t keep that which Yahweh commanded.

hausa: A ƙasar tudun Efraim aka ba su Shekem (birnin mafaka), da Gezer,
english: They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands and Gezer with its pasture lands,

hausa: Sai suka amsa, “Wani mutum ya sadu da mu ya ce mana, ‘Ku koma wurin sarkin da ya aike ku, ku ce masa, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, don babu Allah ne a Isra’ila da ka aika a tuntuɓi Ba’al-Zebub allahn Ekron? Saboda haka ba za ka tashi daga gadon da kake kwance ba. Ba shakka za ka mutu!” ’ ”
english: They said to him, “A man came up to meet us, and said to us, ‘Go, return to the king who sent you, and tell him, “Yahweh says, ‘Is it because there is no God in Israel that you send to inquire of Baal Zebub, the god of Ekron? Therefore you will not come down from the bed where you have gone up, but you will surely die.’”’”

hausa: Da ya same mu a Assos, sai muka ɗauke shi a jirgin ruwan muka zo Mitilen.
english: When he met us at Assos, we took him aboard and came to Mitylene.

hausa: Mugun mutum kan fāɗa a tarkon maganarsa ta zunubi, amma adali kan kuɓuta daga wahala.
english: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.

hausa: Bayan an karanta muku wannan wasiƙa, ku tabbata an karanta ta kuma a ikkilisiyar Lawodiseyawa; ku ma ku karanta wasiƙar da ta zo daga Lawodiseya.
english: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

hausa: Aka zāna duwatsu goma sha biyu, ɗaya don kowane sunan ’ya’yan Isra’ila goma sha biyu, kamar yadda akan yi hatimi.
english: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.

hausa: Sai ɗayansu ya kai sara ga bawan babban firist, ya sare kunnen damansa.
english: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

hausa: Na lura da ragon sa’ad da ya kai karo wajen yamma da arewa da kudu. Babu wata dabbar da ta iya ƙarawa da shi, babu kuma wanda ya iya kuɓuta daga ikonsa. Ya yi yadda ya ga dama, ya kuma zama mai girma.
english: I saw the ram pushing westward, northward, and southward. No animals could stand before him. There wasn’t any who could deliver out of his hand, but he did according to his will, and magnified himself.

hausa: Aka kuma tattara mawaƙa su ma daga yankin kewayen Urushalima, daga ƙauyukan Netofawa,
english: The sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain around Jerusalem and from the villages of the Netophathites;

hausa: Kada ka yi ƙyashin mugaye, kada ka yi sha’awar ƙungiyarsu;
english: Don’t be envious of evil men, neither desire to be with them;

hausa: Filistiyawa suka yi yaƙi da Isra’ilawa, sai Isra’ilawa suka gudu a gaban Filistiyawa, aka kuma karkashe da yawa a dutsen Gilbowa.
english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

hausa: Ka ce wa Taya, wadda take zaune a hanyar shiga zuwa teku, kasuwar masu yawa mutane a bakin teku, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, “ ‘Kin ce, ya Taya, “Ni kyakkyawa ce cikakkiya.”
english: and tell Tyre, ‘You who dwell at the entry of the sea, who are the merchant of the peoples to many islands, the Lord Yahweh says: “You, Tyre, have said, ‘I am perfect in beauty.’

hausa: Yoshuwa ɗan Nun kuwa ya kira firistoci ya ce musu, “Ku ɗauki akwatin alkawari, ku sa firistoci guda bakwai su riƙe ƙahoni su kasance a gabansa.”
english: Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said to them, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before Yahweh’s ark.”

hausa: Sa’an nan firist zai umarta a kashe ɗaya daga cikin tsuntsayen a bisa ruwa mai kyau a tukunyar laka.
english: The priest shall command them to kill one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water.

hausa: Gaskiya nake gaya muku, duk wanda ba zai karɓi mulkin Allah kamar ƙaramin yaro ba, ba zai taɓa shiga mulkin ba.”
english: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

hausa: Ka aikata ayyukan banmamaki da kuma al’ajabai a Masar ka kuma ci gaba da su har yă zuwa yau, a Isra’ila da kuma a cikin dukan ’yan adam, ka kuma sami sunan da har yanzu yake naka.
english: who performed signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even to this day, both in Israel and among other men; and made yourself a name, as it is today;

hausa: Isra’ilawa kuwa suka yi yadda Musa ya umarce su, suka roƙi Masarawa kayan adonsu na azurfa da na zinariya, da kuma tufafi.
english: The children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they asked of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing.

hausa: Sai Yonatan ya ce, “Duk abin da kake so in yi maka zan yi.”
english: Then Jonathan said to David, “Whatever your soul desires, I will even do it for you.”

hausa: Yana kama da yisti wadda mace ta ɗauka, ta kwaɓa garin alkama mai yawa da shi, har sai da yistin ya gauraye kullun duka.”
english: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”

hausa: Aka faɗa wa Yowab cewa, “Sarki yana kuka, yana kuma makoki saboda Absalom.”
english: Joab was told, “Behold, the king weeps and mourns for Absalom.”

hausa: Sai ku tafi da sauri ku gaya wa almajiransa cewa, ‘Ya tashi daga matattu, ya kuma ya sha gabanku zuwa Galili. Can za ku gan shi.’ Ga shi na faɗa muku.”
english: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”

hausa: Hadayar da ya kawo ita ce, faranti guda ɗaya na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel ɗari ɗaya da talatin, da kuma daro na yayyafawa na azurfa, nauyinsa shekel saba’in, dukan biyu, an auna su bisa ga ma’aunin shekel na tsattsarkan wuri, kowannensu cike da lallausan gari, haɗe da mai kamar hadaya ta gari;
english: He offered for his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

hausa: Sammai naka ne, haka kuma duniya; ka kafa duniya da dukan abin da yake cikinta.
english: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.

hausa: jimillarsu ta kai 8,580.
english: even those who were counted of them, were eight thousand five hundred eighty.

hausa: Amma kafin yaron yă isa yanke shawara yă ƙi abin da yake mummuna, yă zaɓi abin da yake nagari, ƙasashen sarakunan nan biyu da kuke tsoro za su zama kango.
english: For before the child knows to refuse the evil and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.

hausa: Za ku same ni,” in ji Ubangiji, “zan kuma komo da ku daga bauta. Zan tattaro ku daga dukan al’ummai in sa ku inda na kore ku,” in ji Ubangiji, “zan kuma komo da ku zuwa wurin da na kwashe ku zuwa zaman bauta.”
english: I will be found by you,” says Yahweh, “and I will turn again your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places where I have driven you,” says Yahweh. “I will bring you again to the place from where I caused you to be carried away captive.”

hausa: Sa’ad da aka ajiye shi a waje, diyar Fir’auna ta ɗauke shi ta kuma rene shi kamar ɗanta.
english: When he was abandoned, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.

hausa: Suka iske an riga an gungurar da dutsen daga bakin kabarin.
english: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

hausa: Waɗanda suka dogara ga Kush suka yi taƙama da Masar za su ji tsoro su kuma sha kunya.
english: They will be dismayed and confounded, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.

hausa: Za ku zama kamar itacen oak mai busasshen ganyaye, kamar lambu marar ruwa.
english: For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fades, and as a garden that has no water.

hausa: Ubangiji zai koya wa dukan ’ya’yanki maza, da girma kuma salamar ’ya’yanki zai zama.
english: All your children will be taught by Yahweh, and your children’s peace will be great.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, waɗannan mutane sun kafa gumaka a cikin zukatansu suka sa mugayen abubuwan sa tuntuɓe a gabansu. Zan bar su, su taɓa nemi ni?
english: “Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before their face. Should I be inquired of at all by them?

hausa: Tana da ’yar’uwa mai suna Maryamu, wadda ta zauna a gaban Ubangiji tana jin maganarsa.
english: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard his word.

hausa: Zif, Telem, Beyalot,
english: Ziph, Telem, Bealoth,

hausa: Amma Mai Taimako, Ruhu Mai Tsarki, wanda Uba zai aiko cikin sunana, zai koya muku kome, zai kuma tuna muku duk abin da na faɗa muku.
english: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.

hausa: “Ga shi ku kuma, tarin masu zunubi, kuna tsaya a matsayin kakanninku, kuna sa Ubangiji yă sāke husata da Isra’ila.
english: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of Yahweh toward Israel.

hausa: Sun yi alkawura masu yawa, suka yi rantsuwar ƙarya da kuma yarjejjeniyoyi; saboda haka ƙararraki suka taso kamar ciyayi masu dafi da aka nome a gona.
english: They make promises, swearing falsely in making covenants. Therefore judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field.

hausa: Da Allah ya tashe bawansa, ya aike shi da fari zuwa gare ku don yă albarkace ku ta wurin juye kowannenku daga mugayen hanyoyinku.”
english: God, having raised up his servant Jesus, sent him to you first to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your wickedness.”

hausa: Magabci ya yi fahariya, cewa ‘Zan fafare su, in ci musu. Zan raba ganima; abin da na so ya samu. Zan ja takobina hannuna kuwa zai hallaka su.’
english: The enemy said, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder. My desire will be satisfied on them. I will draw my sword. My hand will destroy them.’

hausa: Musa ya duba ya ga mutane sun kauce gaba ɗaya domin Haruna ya sa suka kauce, har suka zama abin dariya ga abokan gābansu.
english: When Moses saw that the people were out of control, (for Aaron had let them lose control, causing derision among their enemies),

hausa: Suka tuttuɓe shi suka yanke kansa suka ɗauka duk da kayan yaƙinsa, suka kuma aika ’yan aika ko’ina a ƙasar Filistiyawa, a yi shela labarin a cikin gumakansu da kuma mutanensu.
english: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people.

hausa: ba ya yin da mu gwargwadon zunubanmu ko yă sāka mana bisa ga laifofinmu.
english: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.

hausa: Amma arzikinsu ba a hannunsu yake ba saboda haka ba ruwana da shawarar mugaye.
english: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

hausa: Saboda motsi mai zurfi da zuciyarsa ta yi da ganin ɗan’uwansa, sai Yusuf ya gaggauta ya fita, ya nemi wuri yă yi kuka. Ya shiga ɗakinsa ya yi kuka a can.
english: Joseph hurried, for his heart yearned over his brother; and he sought a place to weep. He entered into his room, and wept there.

hausa: Wata rana, bayan Musa ya yi girma, sai ya haura, ya tafi inda mutanensa suke, ya kuma ga yadda suke shan wahala da aiki. Ya ga wani mutumin Masar yana dūkan mutumin Ibraniyawa, ɗaya daga cikin mutanensa.
english: In those days, when Moses had grown up, he went out to his brothers and saw their burdens. He saw an Egyptian striking a Hebrew, one of his brothers.

hausa: “Mutum bai sha wahalar aiki ba a duniya? Rayuwarsa ba kamar ta wanda aka yi hayarsa ba ne?
english: “Isn’t a man forced to labor on earth? Aren’t his days like the days of a hired hand?

hausa: Yoshuwa kuwa ya ce musu, “Ku ne shaidun kanku cewa kun zaɓi ku bauta wa Ubangiji.” Suka amsa suka ce, “I, mu ne shaidun kanmu.”
english: Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen Yahweh yourselves, to serve him.” They said, “We are witnesses.”

hausa: “Ga Allah dai, hanyarsa cikakkiya ce; maganar Ubangiji babu kuskure. Shi garkuwa ce ga waɗanda suka nemi mafaka a gare shi.
english: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tested. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

hausa: Ka yi shi ƙasa kaɗan da Allah ka yi masa rawani da ɗaukaka da girma.
english: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.

hausa: Zan watsa miki ƙazanta, in yi miki wulaƙanci in kuma mai da ke abin reni.
english: I will throw abominable filth on you and make you vile, and will make you a spectacle.

hausa: Da lokacin tsarkakewarsu bisa ga Dokar Musa ya cika, sai Yusuf da Maryamu suka ɗauke shi suka haura zuwa Urushalima don su miƙa shi ga Ubangiji
english: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord

hausa: Yamma ta kasance, safiya kuma ta kasance, kwana ta biyar ke nan.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

hausa: Yesu ya shiga Yeriko, yana ratsa ta cikinta.
english: He entered and was passing through Jericho.

hausa: Amma da Kiristi ya miƙa hadaya ɗaya ta dukan lokaci saboda zunubai, sai ya zauna a hannun dama na Allah.
english: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God,

hausa: Sai suka ba wa Barnabas, sunan Zeyus, Bulus kuma suka kira Hermes domin shi ne shugaban magana.
english: They called Barnabas “Jupiter”, and Paul “Mercury”, because he was the chief speaker.

hausa: Sa’ad da Solomon ya gama haikalin Ubangiji da kuma fadan sarki ya kuma yi nasara a yin dukan abin da yake a zuciyarsa da zai yi a haikalin Ubangiji da kuma a fadarsa,
english: Thus Solomon finished Yahweh’s house and the king’s house; and he successfully completed all that came into Solomon’s heart to make in Yahweh’s house and in his own house.

hausa: Sun ɓata mini hanyata; sun yi nasara cikin hallaka ni, ba tare da wani ya taimake su ba.
english: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.

hausa: Ka dalaye shi da zinariya zalla ka kuma yi masa ado kewaye da gurun zinariya.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.

hausa: Sai babban firist ya tashi a gabansu, ya tambayi Yesu ya ce, “Ba za ka amsa ba? Wane shaida ke nan waɗannan mutane suke kawowa a kanka?”
english: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”

hausa: Saboda haka ya tambayi hafsoshin Fir’auna, waɗanda suke a kurkuku tare da shi, a gidan maigidansa ya ce, “Me ya sa fuskokinku suke a ɓace haka?”
english: He asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in custody in his master’s house, saying, “Why do you look so sad today?”

hausa: “A ce akwai mai adalci wanda yake aikata abin da yake daidai da kuma gaskiya;
english: “But if a man is just, and does that which is lawful and right,

hausa: ’Ya’yan Yahuda maza su ne, Er, Onan, Shela, Ferez da Zera (amma Er da Onan sun mutu a ƙasar Kan’ana). ’Ya’yan Ferez maza su ne, Hezron da Hamul.
english: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

hausa: Bayan wannan, matarsa Elizabet ta yi ciki, ta kuma riƙa ɓuya har wata biyar.
english: After these days Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,

hausa: Kerubobin suka buɗe fikafikansu sama, suka inuwatar da murfin da fikafikansu. Kerubobin suna fuskantar juna, suna kuma kallon murfin.
english: The cherubim spread out their wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.

hausa: “Saboda haka,” in ji Ubangiji, “Ina gāba da annabawan da suke satar maganganuna daga juna.
english: “Therefore behold, I am against the prophets,” says Yahweh, “who each steal my words from his neighbor.

hausa: In naman ragon naɗi ko wani burodin ya ragu har safiya, a ƙone shi, kada a ci gama tsarkake ne.
english: If anything of the meat of the consecration, or of the bread, remains to the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire. It shall not be eaten, because it is holy.

hausa: Ka juyo gare ni ka yi mini jinƙai; ka ba wa bawanka ƙarfi; ka ceci ni gama na bauta maka yadda mahaifiyata ta yi.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.

hausa: Amma ina faɗa muku, Iliya ya riga ya zo, ba su kuwa gane shi ba, amma suka yi masa duk abin da suka ga dama. Haka ma Ɗan Mutum zai sha wahala a hannunsu.”
english: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”

hausa: Tushen da Solomon ya kafa don ginin haikalin Allah tsawonsa kamun sittin, fāɗinsa kamun ashirin ne (bisa ga tsohon ma’auni).
english: Now these are the foundations which Solomon laid for the building of God’s house: the length by cubits after the first measure was sixty cubits, and the width twenty cubits.

hausa: Ina gudu a kan hanyar umarnanka, gama ka ’yantar da zuciyata.
english: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free. HE

hausa: Ga yadda aka yi alkawarin nan, “A ƙayyadadden lokaci zan dawo, Saratu kuma za tă haifi ɗa.”
english: For this is a word of promise: “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”

hausa: Amma Ziffora ta ɗauki dutsen ƙanƙara mai ci, ta yanke loɓar ɗanta ta taɓa ƙafafun Musa da shi. Ta ce, “Tabbatacce kai angon jini ne a gare ni.”
english: Then Zipporah took a flint, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet; and she said, “Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me.”

hausa: Tana yin kuka mai zafi da dare, hawaye na gangara a kan kumatunta. A cikin masoyanta duka babu wanda ya yi mata ta’aziyya. Duk abokanta sun yashe ta; sun zama abokan gābanta.
english: She weeps bitterly in the night. Her tears are on her cheeks. Among all her lovers she has no one to comfort her. All her friends have dealt treacherously with her. They have become her enemies.

hausa: A cikinki mutane suna karɓan cin hanci don su yi kisankai; kina ba da rance da ruwa da ƙari, kina kuma cin riba a kan maƙwabcinki ta wurin ƙwace. Kina kuma manta da ni, in ji Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka.
english: In you have they taken bribes to shed blood. You have taken interest and increase, and you have greedily gained of your neighbors by oppression, and have forgotten me,” says the Lord Yahweh.

hausa: In an sassare waɗansu rassa, kai kuwa da kake kai zaitun jeji, aka ɗauke ka aka kuma yi muku aure, a yanzu kuwa kana shan ni’imar saiwar zaitun ɗin nan tare da sauran rassan,
english: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree,

hausa: Sai Bitrus ya ce, masa, “To, ga shi mun bar kome da muke da shi, don mu bi ka!”
english: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”

hausa: Suka tafi Ofir suka kuma dawo da talenti 420 na zinariya, wanda suka ba wa Sarki Solomon.
english: They came to Ophir, and fetched from there gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to King Solomon.

hausa: Kamar beyar da aka ƙwace mata ’ya’yanta, zan fāɗa musu in ɓarke su. Kamar zaki zan cinye su; kamar naman jeji zan yayyage su.
english: I will meet them like a bear that is bereaved of her cubs, and will tear the covering of their heart. There I will devour them like a lioness. The wild animal will tear them.

hausa: A yi duk abin da Allah na sama ya ce don haikalin Allah na sama, sai a yi shi da himma. Me zai sa a jawo wa sarki da ’ya’yansa fushin Allah?
english: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be done exactly for the house of the God of heaven; for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?

hausa: har ma ana kai hankicif da adikan da suka taɓa jikinsa wa marasa lafiya, suka kuwa warke daga cututtukansu mugayen ruhohi kuma suka rabu da su.
english: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out.

hausa: “In kuka ga mayaƙa sun kewaye Urushalima, za ku sani rushewarta ya yi kusa.
english: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.

hausa: Wannan shi ne wanda aka yi maganarsa ta wurin annabi Ishaya cewa, “Ga murya mai kira a hamada tana cewa, ‘Ku shirya wa Ubangiji hanya, ku miƙe hanyoyi dominsa.’ ”
english: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make the way of the Lord ready! Make his paths straight!”

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Ku masu ƙarancin bangaskiya, me ya sa kuke tsoro haka?” Sa’an nan ya tashi ya tsawata wa iskar da kuma raƙuman ruwan, sai wuri ya yi tsit gaba ɗaya.
english: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.

hausa: da safe kuma, ku ce, ‘Yau kam za a yi hadari, gama sararin sama ya yi ja, ya kuma ɓata fuska.’ Kun san yadda za ku fassara yanayin sararin sama, amma ba kwa iya fassarar alamun lokuta.
english: In the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can’t discern the signs of the times!

hausa: Waɗansu kuma har yanzu, suka fāɗi a ƙasa mai kyau, suka yi girma, suka ba da amfani riɓi ɗari-ɗari, fiye da abin da aka shuka.” Da faɗin haka sai ya ce, “Duk mai kunnen ji, yă ji.”
english: Some fell into the good ground and grew and produced one hundred times as much fruit.” As he said these things, he called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear!”

hausa: Mutuwa ta haura ta tagoginmu ta kuma shiga katangarmu; ta karkashe ’ya’ya a tituna ta kuma karkashe samari a dandali.
english: For death has come up into our windows. It has entered into our palaces to cut off the children from outside, and the young men from the streets.

hausa: Duk wanda ya nome gonarsa zai sami abinci a yalwace, amma shi da yake naushin iska marar azanci ne.
english: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.

hausa: Saboda haka Allah ya yashe su ga mugayen sha’awace-sha’awacen zukatansu ga fasikanci don a ƙasƙantar da jikunansu ga yin abin kunya.
english: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves;

hausa: To, fa, Irmiya ya sami ’yancin kai da kawowa a cikin mutane, gama ba a riga an sa shi a kurkuku ba.
english: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people, for they had not put him into prison.

hausa: Eliyel, Obed da Ya’asiyel mutumin Mezob.
english: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

hausa: Ko da yake mutanenka, ya Isra’ila, sun zama kamar yashin bakin teku, raguwa ce kurum za tă komo. A ƙaddara hallaka, mai mamayewa da mai adalci.
english: For though your people, Israel, are like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. A destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness.

hausa: Ya ce musu, “Har yanzu ba ku fahimta ba?”
english: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”

hausa: Duk wanda ya ce, “Ina ƙaunar Allah,” amma yana ƙin ɗan’uwansa, maƙaryaci ne. Gama duk wanda ba ya ƙaunar ɗan’uwansa da yake gani, ba zai iya ƙaunar Allah wanda ba ya gani ba.
english: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?

hausa: don kuma ku ƙaunaci Ubangiji Allahnku, ku saurari muryarsa, ku kuma manne masa. Gama Ubangiji shi ranku, zai kuwa ba ku shekaru masu yawa a ƙasar da ya rantse zai ba wa kakanninku, Ibrahim, Ishaku da Yaƙub.
english: to love Yahweh your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days, that you may dwell in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

hausa: Ba zato ba tsammani sai mala’ikan Ubangiji ya bayyana haske kuma ya haskaka a ɗakin. Ya bugi Bitrus a gefe ya kuma tashe shi ya ce, “Maza, ka tashi!” Sarƙoƙin kuwa suka zube daga hannuwansa.
english: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Stand up quickly!” His chains fell off his hands.

hausa: Manyan firistoci da Farisiyawa tuni sun riga sun yi umarni cewa duk wanda ya san inda Yesu yake, yă faɗa don su kama shi.
english: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.

hausa: Aminci zai ɓulɓulo daga ƙasa, adalci kuma yă duba daga sama.
english: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.

hausa: Ishaku, mai son ci naman jeji, ya ƙaunaci Isuwa, amma Rebeka ta ƙaunaci Yaƙub.
english: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he ate his venison. Rebekah loved Jacob.

hausa: Ya nemi Allah a kwanakin Zakariya, wanda ya koyar da shi a tsoron Allah. Muddin ya nemi Ubangiji, Allah ya ba shi nasara.
english: He set himself to seek God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the vision of God; and as long as he sought Yahweh, God made him prosper.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa game da Ahab ɗan Kolahiya da Zedekiya ɗan Ma’asehiya, waɗanda suke muku annabcin ƙarya da sunana. “Zan ba da su ga Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon, zai kuwa kashe su a gaban idanunku.
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and concerning Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who prophesy a lie to you in my name: “Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and he will kill them before your eyes.

hausa: Sa’an nan ta karkata yamma daga Ba’ala zuwa Dutsen Seyir, ta wuce ta gangaren Dutsen Yeyarim (wato, Kesalon), ta ci gaba zuwa Bet-Shemesh, ta bi zuwa Timna.
english: and the border turned about from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passed along to the side of Mount Jearim (also called Chesalon) on the north, and went down to Beth Shemesh, and passed along by Timnah;

hausa: A wannan rana za su dakata a Nob; za su jijjiga ƙarfinsu a dutsen Diyar Sihiyona, a tudun Urushalima.
english: This very day he will halt at Nob. He shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

hausa: Sai Musa ya koma wurin Yetro surukinsa, ya ce masa, “Bari in koma wurin mutanena a Masar, in ga ko da mai rai a cikinsu.” Yetro ya ce, “Tafi, ka kuma sauka lafiya.”
english: Moses went and returned to Jethro his father-in-law, and said to him, “Please let me go and return to my brothers who are in Egypt, and see whether they are still alive.” Jethro said to Moses, “Go in peace.”

hausa: Mutanen Gad suka gina Dibon, Atarot, Arower,
english: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,

hausa: Ku yi addu’a, kada gudunku yă zama a lokacin sanyi ko a ranar Asabbaci.
english: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter nor on a Sabbath,

hausa: Ya kuma ce mini, “Ɗan mutum, ka ci abin da yake a gabanka, ka ci wannan littafi; sa’an nan ka tafi ka yi magana wa gidan Isra’ila.”
english: He said to me, “Son of man, eat what you find. Eat this scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.”

hausa: Zukatansu suna kamar matoya; sukan kusace shi da wayo. Muguwar aniyarsu takan yi ta ci dukan dare; da safe sai ta ƙuna kamar harshen wuta.
english: For they have prepared their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait. Their anger smolders all night. In the morning it burns as a flaming fire.

hausa: Duk da haka, da yawa a cikin taron suka ba da gaskiya gare shi. Suka ce, “Sa’ad da Kiristi ya zo, zai yi abubuwan banmamaki fiye da na wannan mutum ne?”
