english: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”

hausa: biye da shi, Amasiya ɗan Zikri, wanda ya ba da kansa da yardar rai don hidimar Ubangiji, yana da sojoji 200,000.
english: and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself to Yahweh, and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valor.

hausa: Saboda wannan dalili ina aika muku Timoti, ɗana, wanda nake ƙauna, mai aminci kuma a cikin Ubangiji. Zai tunashe ku game da yadda za ku bi Kiristi Yesu da kuma yadda ya yi daidai da yadda nake koyarwa a ko’ina, a kowace ikkilisiya.
english: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.

hausa: Akan shirya abinci don jin daɗi, ruwan inabi kuwa don faranta zuciya, amma kuɗi ne amsar kome.
english: A feast is made for laughter, and wine makes the life glad; and money is the answer for all things.

hausa: Ba ku kuka zaɓe ni ba, a’a, ni ne na zaɓe ku na kuma naɗa ku ku je ku ba da ’ya’ya-’ya’yan da za su dawwama. Uba kuwa zai ba ku duk abin da kuka roƙa cikin sunana.
english: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.

hausa: Sarki ya kuma yi wannan waƙar makoki domin Abner ya ce, “Daidai ne Abner yă mutu, kamar yadda marasa bin doka suke mutuwa?
english: The king lamented for Abner, and said, “Should Abner die as a fool dies?

hausa: Kwanaki shida za ka yi aiki, ka kuma yi dukan aikinka,
english: You shall labor six days, and do all your work;

hausa: da Allah bai gane ba, da yake ya san asiran zuciya?
english: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.

hausa: Azariya firist tare da waɗansu firistoci tamanin na Ubangiji masu ƙarfin hali suka bi shi ciki.
english: Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him eighty priests of Yahweh, who were valiant men.

hausa: Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal da Mattaniya ɗan Mika, ɗan Zikri, ɗan Asaf;
english: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,

hausa: Na ga cewa ita ma ta ƙazantar da kanta; dukansu biyu sun bi hanya guda.
english: I saw that she was defiled. They both went the same way.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana cewa, “Ku sassare itatuwan ku tula ƙasa kewaye da Urushalima. Dole a hukunta wannan birni; saboda ya cika da zalunci.
english: For Yahweh of Armies said, “Cut down trees, and cast up a mound against Jerusalem. This is the city to be visited. She is filled with oppression within herself.

hausa: a filayen gidan Ubangiji, a tsakiyarki, ya Urushalima. Yabi Ubangiji.
english: in the courts of Yahweh’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise Yah!

hausa: Dukan ’yan Adam kuwa za su ga ceton Allah!’ ”
english: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’”

hausa: Ya ce, “Zan aika miki da ɗan akuya daga garkena.” Sai ta ce, “Za ka ba ni wani abu jingina, kafin ka aika da shi?”
english: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.” She said, “Will you give me a pledge, until you send it?”

hausa: “Hezekiya sarkin Yahuda ko kuwa wani a Yahuda ya kashe shi? Ashe, Hezekiya bai ji tsoron Ubangiji ya nemi tagomashinsa ba? Ubangiji kuwa bai yi juyayi ya kuma janye masifar da ya furta zai kawo a kansu ba? Muna gab da jawo wa kanmu muguwar masifa!”
english: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him to death? Didn’t he fear Yahweh, and entreat the favor of Yahweh, and Yahweh relented of the disaster which he had pronounced against them? We would commit great evil against our own souls that way!”

hausa: “Faɗa wa Isra’ilawa cewa, ‘A ranar farko ga wata na bakwai, za tă zama ranar hutu, rana ce ta tuni da yin taro mai tsarki na sujada da za a fara busar ƙaho.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be a solemn rest for you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa ba baƙo marar kaciya a zuciya da jiki da zai shiga wurina mai tsarki, kai, har ma da baƙin da suke zama a cikin Isra’ila.
english: The Lord Yahweh says, “No foreigner, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into my sanctuary, of any foreigners who are among the children of Israel.

hausa: Duk da haka, Haman ya cije, ya tafi gida. Sai ya kira abokansa da kuma matarsa, Zeresh,
english: Nevertheless Haman restrained himself, and went home. There, he sent and called for his friends and Zeresh his wife.

hausa: daga Mattana, suka tafi Nahaliyel, daga Nahaliyel, suka tafi Bamot,
english: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;

hausa: sai Sarki Solomon ya ba wa Hiram sarkin Taya garuruwa ashirin a yankin Galili, gama Hiram ya tanada masa da dukan katakai al’ul da na fir, da kuma zinariyar da ya bukaci domin aiki.
english: (now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and cypress trees, and with gold, according to all his desire), King Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

hausa: Za a durƙusar da su, su kuma fāɗi, amma mu za mu tashi mu tsaya daram.
english: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.

hausa: Sa’an nan Esta ta umarce Hatak yă ce wa Mordekai,
english: Then Esther spoke to Hathach, and gave him a message to Mordecai:

hausa: Sai na ce musu, Wane ɗakin tsafi kuke tafiya?’ ” (Ana ce da shi Bama har wa yau.)
english: Then I said to them, ‘What does the high place where you go mean?’ So its name is called Bamah to this day.”’

hausa: Sai Isra’ila ya ce wa Yusuf, “Kamar yadda ka sani, ’yan’uwanka suna kiwon garkuna kusa da Shekem. Zo, in aike ka gare su.” Ya ce, “To.”
english: Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” He said to him, “Here I am.”

hausa: Saboda haka dukanmu mun yarda mu zaɓi waɗansu mutane mu kuma aike su wurinku tare da ƙaunatattun abokanmu Barnabas da Bulus
english: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

hausa: Ina gaya muku, babu ko ɗaya daga cikin mutanen nan da aka gayyata da zai ɗanɗana bikina.”
english: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper. For many are called, but few are chosen.’”

hausa: da kuma daga ’yan’uwansu, mutanen Merari, a hannun hagunsa. Etan ɗan Kishi, ɗan Abdi, ɗan Malluk,
english: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

hausa: wanda kuma ya faɗa mana ƙaunar da kuke yi cikin Ruhu.
english: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

hausa: A ƙarshen kwana goma sai aka ga fuskokinsu suna sheƙi, sun kuma yi ƙiba fiye da samarin da suke cin abinci irin na sarki.
english: At the end of ten days, their faces appeared fairer and they were fatter in flesh than all the youths who ate of the king’s delicacies.

hausa: Waɗanda suke dubansa sukan haskaka; fuskokinsu ba sa rufuwa da kunya.
english: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Rago yana gani yana da hikima fiye da mutane bakwai da suke ba da amsa da dalilai a kan ra’ayinsu.
english: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion.

hausa: Ku yi biyayya da umarnin da na ba ka yau. Zan kora muku Amoriyawa, Kan’aniyawa, Hittiyawa, Ferizziyawa, Hiwiyawa da Yebusiyawa.
english: Observe that which I command you today. Behold, I will drive out before you the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

hausa: Gefen bisa ma murabba’i ne, tsawonsa kamu goma sha huɗu fāɗinsa kuma kamu goma huɗu, da da’ira da yake da fāɗin rabin kamu da magudanan ruwa kamu guda kewaye. Matakan bagaden suna fuskantar gabas.”
english: The ledge shall be fourteen cubits long by fourteen wide in its four sides; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and its bottom shall be a cubit around; and its steps shall look toward the east.”

hausa: Saboda sunan Yaƙub bawana, Isra’ila zaɓaɓɓena, na kira ka da suna na ba ka matsayin bangirma, ko da yake ba ka san ni ba.
english: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel my chosen, I have called you by your name. I have given you a title, though you have not known me.

hausa: Sai ɗaya daga cikin dattawan ya tambaye ni ya ce, “Waɗannan da suke saye da fararen tufafi su wane ne, daga ina kuma suka fito?”
english: One of the elders answered, saying to me, “These who are arrayed in the white robes, who are they, and where did they come from?”

hausa: Idanun Ubangiji na lura da sani, amma yakan ƙi kalmomin marar aminci.
english: Yahweh’s eyes watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.

hausa: Gama ban yi wata-wata a sanar muku dukan nufin Allah ba.
english: for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.

hausa: Zuwa ga tsarkaka da kuma amintattun ’yan’uwa cikin Kiristi da suke a Kolossi. Alheri da salama daga Allah Ubanmu, su kasance tare da ku.
english: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

hausa: Cikin dukan damuwarsu shi ma ya damu, mala’ikan da yake gabansa ya cece su. Cikin ƙauna da jinƙai ya fanshe su; ya kuma ɗaga su ya riƙe su dukan kwanakin dā
english: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them. In his love and in his pity he redeemed them. He bore them, and carried them all the days of old.

hausa: Idanun kowa yana dogara gare ka, kana kuma ba su abincinsu a lokacin da ya dace.
english: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.

hausa: Yanzu dai ina rubuta muku cewa kada ku haɗa kai da duk mai kiran kansa ɗan’uwa, amma yana fasikanci, ko kwaɗayi, ko bautar gumaka, ko ɓata suna, ko mashayi, ko mazambaci. Kada ku ko ci abinci da irin wannan mutum.
english: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortionist. Don’t even eat with such a person.

hausa: Bari su zama kamar yayi a gaban iska, mala’ikan Ubangiji kuma yana korarsu;
english: Let them be as chaff before the wind, Yahweh’s angel driving them on.

hausa: Yanzu fa Ibrahim ya tsufa, yana da shekaru masu yawa, Ubangiji kuma ya albarkace shi a kowace hanya.
english: Abraham was old, and well advanced in age. Yahweh had blessed Abraham in all things.

hausa: A lokacin Hanani mai duba ya zo wurin Asa sarkin Yahuda ya ce masa, “Don ka dogara ga sarkin Aram, ba kuwa ga Ubangiji Allahnka ba ne mayaƙan sarkin Aram sun kuɓuce daga hannunka.
english: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Judah, and said to him, “Because you have relied on the king of Syria, and have not relied on Yahweh your God, therefore the army of the king of Syria has escaped out of your hand.

hausa: Yayinda Yesu yake cin abinci a gidan Lawi, sai masu karɓar haraji da “masu zunubi” da yawa, suka zo suka ci tare da shi da almajiransa, gama akwai mutane da yawa da suka bi shi.
english: He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.

hausa: Suka tashi daga Dutsen Shefer, suka yi sansani a Harada.
english: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.

hausa: Sai ya ɗaga ido ya dubi tagan ya ce, “Wa yake gefena? Wane ne?” Sai bābānni biyu ko uku suka leƙo suka dube shi.
english: He lifted up his face to the window, and said, “Who is on my side? Who?” Two or three eunuchs looked out at him.

hausa: “Ba amfani! Ba amfani!” In ji Malami. “Gaba ɗaya ba amfani! Kome ba shi da amfani!”
english: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”

hausa: In mutum bai daɗe da aure ba, kada a sa yă je yaƙi, ko yă yi wani aiki. Gama zai huta shekara guda a gida, yă faranta wa matar da ya aura rai.
english: When a man takes a new wife, he shall not go out in the army, neither shall he be assigned any business. He shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer his wife whom he has taken.

hausa: Fitinannen mutum yakan zuga tashin hankali, mai gulma kuma yakan raba abokai na kusa.
english: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.

hausa: Yusuf ya ɗauki jikin ya nannaɗe shi da zanen lilin mai tsabta.
english: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth

hausa: Ba haka yake da mugaye ba! Su kamar yayi ne da iska take kwashewa.
english: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya ce musu, “Yaya suke cewa, ‘Kiristi ɗan Dawuda ne?’
english: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?

hausa: Bai kamata kowannenku yă kula da sha’anin kansa kawai ba, sai dai yă kula da sha’anin waɗansu ma.
english: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

hausa: Filin tare da kogon da yake ciki, an saya daga Hittiyawa.”
english: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.”

hausa: Tare da bijimin a miƙa hadaya ta gari na kashi ɗaya bisa goma na efa, na lallausan gari kwaɓaɓɓe, da mai; da rago guda, kashi biyu bisa goma na efa, na lallausan gari kwaɓaɓɓe, da mai;
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the one ram,

hausa: Suka kuwa kwana da ita. Kamar yadda maza suke kwana ta karuwa, haka suka kwana da waɗannan lalatattun mata, Ohola da Oholiba.
english: They went in to her, as they go in to a prostitute. So they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the lewd women.

hausa: Ku gai da Tiryifena da Tiryifosa, matan nan da suke aiki tuƙuru cikin Ubangiji. Ku gai da ƙaunatacciyata Fersis, wata matan da ta yi aiki tuƙuru cikin Ubangiji.
english: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

hausa: Bayan ya kira dukan manyan firistoci da malaman dokoki na mutane wuri ɗaya, sai ya tambaye su inda za a haifi Kiristi.
english: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.

hausa: Ya yi ta ƙara ƙarfi, gama Ubangiji Allah Maɗaukaki yana tare da shi.
english: David grew greater and greater, for Yahweh, the God of Armies, was with him.

hausa: daga kabilar Ruben a hayin Urdun a gabashi Yeriko suka sami Bezer a hamada, Yahza,
english: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasture lands, Jahzah with its pasture lands,

hausa: Daga baya ta haifi ɗan’uwansa, ta kuma ba shi suna Habila. Sa’ad da suka yi girma sai Habila ya zama makiyayin tumaki, Kayinu kuwa ya zama manomi.
english: Again she gave birth, to Cain’s brother Abel. Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

hausa: Allah yana duba daga sama a kan ’ya’yan mutane yă ga ko akwai wani wanda ya gane, wani wanda yake neman Allah.
english: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.

hausa: Faɗan ya yi zafi a ranar ƙwarai, mutanen Dawuda suka ci mutanen Abner da na Isra’ila.
english: The battle was very severe that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before David’s servants.

hausa: Mutum mai tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye yakan ruɗi maƙwabcinsa ya kai shi a hanyar da ba ta da kyau.
english: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.

hausa: Musa ya amsa musu ya ce, “Ku dakata sai na sami umarni daga wurin Ubangiji game da ku.”
english: Moses answered them, “Wait, that I may hear what Yahweh will command concerning you.”

hausa: Sa’an nan maharba suka yi ta harbi daga katanga har waɗansu mutanen sarki suka mutu. Ban da haka ma, Uriya mutumin Hitti bawan sarki ya mutu.”
english: The shooters shot at your servants from off the wall; and some of the king’s servants are dead, and your servant Uriah the Hittite is also dead.”

hausa: Ka marabce shi da yalwar albarka ka kuma sa masa rawanin zallan zinariya a kansa.
english: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.

hausa: Zan tanadar da ciyawa a filaye don shanunku, za ku ci, ku kuma ƙoshi.
english: I will give grass in your fields for your livestock, and you shall eat and be full.

hausa: Gama mun san cewa an gicciye halayenmu na dā tare da shi domin a kawar da jikin nan mai zunubi don kada mu ƙara zama bayi ga zunubi
english: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.

hausa: game da Ɗansa. Wanda bisa ga mutuntakarsa, zuriyar Dawuda ne.
english: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh,

hausa: Sai ya shiga, ya rufe ƙofa, daga shi sai yaron, ya kuma yi addu’a ga Ubangiji.
english: He went in therefore, and shut the door on them both, and prayed to Yahweh.

hausa: Daga firistoci akwai, Yedahiya ɗan Yohiyarib, da Yakin,
english: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,

hausa: Da Isra’ilawa suka gama kashe duk mutanen Ai a filaye da kuma a cikin jeji inda suka fafare su, kuma da aka karkashe kowane mutumin Ai da takobi sai dukan Isra’ilawa suka koma Ai suka karkashe duk waɗanda suke cikinsa.
english: When Israel had finished killing all the inhabitants of Ai in the field, in the wilderness in which they pursued them, and they had all fallen by the edge of the sword until they were consumed, all Israel returned to Ai and struck it with the edge of the sword.

hausa: Ni kaina zan tabbatar da lafiyarsa; na ɗauki lamuninsa, a hannuna za ka neme shi. In ban dawo da shi gare ka, in sa shi nan a gabanka ba, zan ɗauki laifin a gabanka dukan kwanakina.
english: I’ll be collateral for him. From my hand will you require him. If I don’t bring him to you, and set him before you, then let me bear the blame forever;

hausa: Ka kau da fuskarka daga gare ni, saboda in sāke yin farin ciki kafin in tafi in kuma rabu da nan.”
english: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”

hausa: Amma bari dukan waɗanda suke neman mafaka gare ka su yi murna; bari kullum su yi ta rerawa saboda farin ciki. Ka buɗe kāriyarka a bisansu, domin waɗanda suke ƙaunar sunanka su yi farin ciki a cikinka.
english: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.

hausa: Suna mutuwa tun suna matasa, cikin ƙazamar rayuwar karuwanci.
english: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.

hausa: Saboda haka Musa ya kawo maganarsu a gaban Ubangiji.
english: Moses brought their cause before Yahweh.

hausa: Masu aiki daga birnin waɗanda suka nome ta za su fito daga dukan kabilan Isra’ila.
english: Those who labor in the city, out of all the tribes of Israel, shall cultivate it.

hausa: Ka kiyaye kanka daga tatsuniyoyi na rashin tsoron Allah da labaru banza na tsofaffin mata; a maimako, ka hori kanka ga zama mai tsoron Allah.
english: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.

hausa: A wata na shida, sai Allah ya aiki mala’ika Jibra’ilu zuwa Nazaret, wani gari a Galili,
english: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,

hausa: A wannan rana Musa ya umarce mutane,
english: Moses commanded the people the same day, saying,

hausa: Da suka yi haka, sai suka kama kifi da yawa, har abin kamun kifinsu suka fara tsintsinkewa.
english: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.

hausa: Gama Musa ya ce, ‘Ubangiji Allahnku zai tasar muku wani annabi kamar ni daga cikin mutanenku; dole ku saurari duk abin da ya faɗa muku.
english: For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.

hausa: Yonatan ɗan Asahel, da Yazehiya ɗan Tikba su ne kaɗai ba su yarda da wannan shirin ba, sai Meshullam da Shabbetai Balawe kuma suka goyi bayansu.
english: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah stood up against this; and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.

hausa: Da zuciya ɗaya suka yi ƙulle-ƙulle tare; suka haɗa kai gāba da kai,
english: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.

hausa: Duk da haka, sai kowa yă kasance a rayuwar da Ubangiji ya sa shi da kuma wanda Allah ya kira shi. Umarnin da na kafa a dukan ikkilisiyoyi ke nan.
english: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.

hausa: Ubangiji ya duba daga sama a kan ’yan adam don yă ga ko akwai wani da ya gane, wani wanda yake neman Allah.
english: Yahweh looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.

hausa: da ƙaramin bijimi guda ɗaya, tunkiya ɗaya da rago, dukansu bana ɗaya-ɗaya domin hadaya ta ƙonawa;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

hausa: Gebal, Ammon da Amalek, Filistiya, tare da mutanen Taya.
english: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

hausa: daga Bani, Shelomit ɗan Yosifiya ne shugaba, tare da shi akwai mutum 160;
english: Of the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah; and with him one hundred sixty males.

hausa: suka ce wa Musa, “Mutane suna kawo fiye da abin da ake bukata domin aikin da Ubangiji ya umarta a yi.”
english: They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which Yahweh commanded to make.”

hausa: To, ni fa ba gudu nake yi kamar mai gudu ba wurin zuwa ba. Dambena kuma ba naushin iska nake yi ba.
english: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,

hausa: “Game da kai kuwa, in ka yi tafiya a gabana kamar yadda Dawuda mahaifinka ya yi, ka kuma yi dukan abin da na umarta, ka kiyaye ƙa’idodina da dokokina,
english: “As for you, if you will walk before me as David your father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my ordinances,

hausa: Haka zai faru da kai, ya Betel, domin muguntarka ta yi yawa. Sa’ad da wannan rana ta zo, za a hallaka sarkin Isra’ila ƙaƙaf.
english: So Bethel will do to you because of your great wickedness. At daybreak the king of Israel will be destroyed.

hausa: Sai Ishaya ya ce, “Ga alamar Ubangiji zuwa gare ka da za tă nuna cewa Ubangiji zai cika alkawarinsa. Kana so inuwa tă yi gaba da taki goma, ko tă koma baya da taki goma?”
english: Isaiah said, “This will be the sign to you from Yahweh, that Yahweh will do the thing that he has spoken: should the shadow go forward ten steps, or go back ten steps?”

hausa: Kada ma a ce murjani da duwatsu masu walƙiya; farashin hikima ya fi na lu’ulu’ai.
english: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

hausa: Saboda su ne na tsarkake kaina, domin su ma a tsarkake su da gaske.
english: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.

hausa: domin yă fanshi waɗanda suke a ƙarƙashin doka, saboda mu sami cikakken matsayin zaman ’ya’ya.
english: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.

hausa: A can tsuntsaye suke sheƙunnansu; shamuwa tana da gidanta a itatuwan fir.
english: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.

hausa: Ina godiya domin ban yi wa wani baftisma a cikinku ba, sai dai Kirisbus da Gayus kaɗai.
english: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,

hausa: Duk abokaina sun yashe ni; waɗanda nake ƙauna sun zama ba sa ƙaunata.
english: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.

hausa: Sai Hilkiya firist, da Ahikam, Akbor, da Shafan, da kuma Asahiya suka je don su yi magana da annabiya Hulda, matan Shallum ɗan Tikba, ɗan Harhas, mai ajiyar tufafi. Tana zama a Urushalima, a Yanki na Biyu.
english: So Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam, Achbor, Shaphan, and Asaiah went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe (now she lived in Jerusalem in the second quarter); and they talked with her.

hausa: Za ka dai gan da idanunka yadda ake hukunta mugaye.
english: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.

hausa: Almajiran suka yi mamaki ƙwarai, suka ce wa juna, “To, wa zai sami ceto ke nan?”
english: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”

hausa: Sun shimfiɗa raga don su kama ƙafafuna, damuwa ta sha ƙarfina. Sun haƙa rami a hanyata, amma su kansu suka fāɗa a cikinta. Sela
english: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves. Selah.

hausa: Ga ni a gabanku. Idan na yi wani abin da ba daidai ba sai ku faɗa a gaban Ubangiji, da gaban sarkin da ya keɓe. Ko na taɓa ƙwace saniya ko jakin wani? Ko na taɓa cuce wani, ko in danne hakkinsa? Ko na taɓa cin hanci daga hannun ɗayanku? Idan na taɓa yi ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan, sai ku faɗa mini, zan kuwa mayar masa.”
english: Here I am. Witness against me before Yahweh and before his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken? Whom have I defrauded? Whom have I oppressed? Of whose hand have I taken a bribe to make me blind my eyes? I will restore it to you.”

hausa: Yi kuka, ya itacen fir, gama itacen al’ul ya fāɗi; itatuwa masu daraja sun lalace! Ku yi kuka, ku itatuwan oak na Bashan; an sassare itatuwan babban kurmi!
english: Wail, cypress tree, for the cedar has fallen, because the stately ones are destroyed. Wail, you oaks of Bashan, for the strong forest has come down.

hausa: Magdiyel da Iram. Waɗannan su ne manyan Edom.
english: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.

hausa: “Ka saurari wannan Ayuba; ka tsaya ka dubi abubuwan al’ajabi na Allah.
english: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

hausa: Canjin nan a Dokar Allah ya ƙara fitowa fili da wani firist dabam wanda yake kamar Melkizedek ya bayyana.
english: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,

hausa: Suka fita, suna yi wa’azi, suna ce wa mutane su tuba.
english: They went out and preached that people should repent.

hausa: “Ga abin da mugaye za su samu gādon da azzalumi zai samu daga Maɗaukaki.
english: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

hausa: Kash, ya ke al’umma mai zunubi, mutane cike da laifi, tarin masu aikata mugunta, ’ya’yan da aka miƙa wa lalaci! Sun yashe Ubangiji; sun rena Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila suka juya masa baya.
english: Ah sinful nation, a people loaded with iniquity, offspring of evildoers, children who deal corruptly! They have forsaken Yahweh. They have despised the Holy One of Israel. They are estranged and backward.

hausa: Yaya za ka ce wa ɗan’uwanka, ‘Bari in cire maka ɗan tsinken nan daga idonka,’ alhali kuwa a kowane lokaci akwai gungume a naka ido?
english: Or how will you tell your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye,’ and behold, the beam is in your own eye?

hausa: Da Ammonawa suka ga Arameyawa suna gudu, sai su ma suka ruga da gudu a gaban Abishai, suka shiga cikin birni. Sa’an nan Yowab ya komo Urushalima daga wurin yaƙin da ya yi da Ammonawa.
english: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai, and entered into the city. Then Joab returned from the children of Ammon and came to Jerusalem.

hausa: (A wannan lokaci na tsaya tsakanin Ubangiji da ku, don in furta muku maganar Ubangiji, domin kun ji tsoron wutar, ba ku kuwa hau dutsen ba.) Ya ce,
english: (I stood between Yahweh and you at that time, to show you Yahweh’s word; for you were afraid because of the fire, and didn’t go up onto the mountain) saying,

hausa: “ ‘Ku kiyaye farillaina. “ ‘Kada ku sa dabbobin da ba iri ɗaya ba su yi barbara. “ ‘Kada ku yi shuki iri biyu a gonarku. “ ‘Kada ku sa rigar da aka saƙa da yadi iri biyu.
english: “‘You shall keep my statutes. “‘You shall not cross-breed different kinds of animals. “‘You shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed; “‘Don’t wear a garment made of two kinds of material.

hausa: Mai yiwuwa ni ba horarre ba ne a magana, amma ina da sani. Mun kuwa bayyana muku wannan a sarari, ta kowace hanya.
english: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.

hausa: Jimillar maza daga mutanen Issakar 54,400 ne.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa, ‘Domin Filistiyawa sun yi sakayya, suka ɗauki fansa da mugunta a zukatansu, da kuma daɗaɗɗen ƙiyayya sun nemi su hallaka Yahuda,
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Because the Philistines have taken revenge, and have taken vengeance with contempt of soul to destroy with perpetual hostility,”

hausa: sai Dawuda ya roƙi Allah ya ce, “In tafi in yaƙi Filistiyawa? Za ka ba da su gare ni?” Ubangiji ya amsa masa ya ce, “Ka tafi, zan ba da su gare ka.”
english: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” Yahweh said to him, “Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.”

hausa: Abokaina ƙaunatattu, da yake Allah ya ƙaunace mu haka, ya kamata mu ma mu ƙaunaci juna.
english: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

hausa: Dukan ayyukan Sarki Zerzes masu iko da masu girma tare da cikakken rahoton girmama Mordekai wanda sarki ya yi masa, ba a rubuce suke a cikin littafin tarihin sarakunan Mediya da na Farisa ba?
english: Aren’t all the acts of his power and of his might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king advanced him, written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

hausa: Gama waɗannan umarnai fitila ne, wannan koyarwa haske ne, kuma gyare-gyaren horo hanyar rayuwa ce,
english: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,

hausa: Kumatunki sun yi kamar rumman da aka tsaga biyu a cikin lulluɓinki.
english: Your temples are like a piece of a pomegranate behind your veil.

hausa: “ ‘In mai ɗiga ya tofa miyau a kan wani wanda yake tsarkakakke, dole tsarkakakken nan yă wanke rigunansa, yă kuma yi wanka, zai kuma ƙazantu har yamma.
english: “‘If he who has the discharge spits on him who is clean, then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

hausa: Waɗanda a dā suna da abinci sosai; yanzu suna ƙodago saboda abinci, masu fama da yunwa kuwa sun daina jin yunwa. Ita da take bakararriya, ta haifi ’ya’ya bakwai amma ita da tana da ’ya’ya da yawa, ta zama mai baƙin ciki.
english: Those who were full have hired themselves out for bread. Those who were hungry are satisfied. Yes, the barren has borne seven. She who has many children languishes.

hausa: Ya ce, “Bari yarjejjeniya ta kasance tsakanina da kai, kamar yadda ta kasance tsakanin mahaifina da mahaifinka. Duba, ina aika maka kyautai na azurfa da na zinariya. Yanzu fa sai ka janye yarjejjeniyarka da Ba’asha sarkin Isra’ila, don yă janye daga gare ni.”
english: “Let there be a treaty between me and you, like that between my father and your father. Behold, I have sent to you a present of silver and gold. Go, break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.”

hausa: Ka sa fuskarka ta haskaka a kan bawanka ka kuma koya mini ƙa’idodinka.
english: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.

hausa: Al’ummai suka yi fushi; fushinka kuwa ya zo. Lokaci ya yi don a shari’anta matattu, da kuma don sākawa wa bayinka annabawa da tsarkakanka da kuma su waɗanda suke girmama sunanka, ƙarami da babba, don kuma hallakar da waɗanda suka hallaka duniya.”
english: The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants the prophets, their reward, as well as to the saints and those who fear your name, to the small and the great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”

hausa: Saboda haka na yi rantsuwa cikin fushina, ‘Ba za su taɓa shiga hutuna ba.’ ”
english: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”

hausa: Ubangiji zai buge gwiwoyinku da ƙafafunku da marurai masu zafi da ba za a iya warkar da su ba, za su yaɗu daga tafin ƙafafu zuwa bisa kanku.
english: Yahweh will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.

hausa: Shugabannin taron suka ce, “Da matan Benyamin da aka hallaka, yaya za mu yi da mazan da suka ragu da ba su sami mata ba?”
english: Then the elders of the congregation said, “How shall we provide wives for those who remain, since the women are destroyed out of Benjamin?”

hausa: Bayan wannan, in ji Ubangiji, zan ba da Zedekiya sarkin Yahuda, fadawansa da kuma mutanen wannan birni waɗanda suka tsira daga annoba, takobi da kuma yunwa, ga Nebukadnezzar sarkin Babilon da kuma ga abokan gābansu waɗanda suke neman ransu. Zai kashe su da takobi; ba zai ji tausayinsu ko ya yi musu jinƙai ko ya yi juyayinsu ba.’
english: Afterward,” says Yahweh, “I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, his servants, and the people, even those who are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life. He will strike them with the edge of the sword. He will not spare them, have pity, or have mercy.”’

hausa: Ku tuna yadda Ubangiji Allahnku ya bishe ku a dukan hanya, a cikin hamada waɗannan shekaru arba’in, don yă ƙasƙantar da ku, yă kuma gwada ku don yă san abin da yake a zuciyarku, ko za ku kiyaye umarnansa, ko babu.
english: You shall remember all the way which Yahweh your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might humble you, to test you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments or not.

hausa: Ya Isra’ila, sa zuciya ga Ubangiji, gama tare da Ubangiji akwai ƙauna marar ƙarewa kuma tare da shi akwai cikakkiyar fansa.
english: Israel, hope in Yahweh, for there is loving kindness with Yahweh. Abundant redemption is with him.

hausa: Duk wanda ya zauna a inda wannan mai ɗiga ya zauna a kai, dole yă wanke rigunansa yă kuma yi wanka, zai kuwa ƙazantu har yamma.
english: He who sits on anything on which the man who has the discharge sat shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening.

hausa: “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, waɗansu da suke tsattsaye a nan ba za su ga mutuwa ba, sai sun ga mulkin Allah.”
english: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here who will in no way taste of death until they see God’s Kingdom.”

hausa: “Bayan ’yan shekaru da dama da ba na nan, sai na dawo Urushalima don in kawo wa mutanena kyautai saboda matalauta in kuma yi sadaka.
english: Now after some years, I came to bring gifts for the needy to my nation, and offerings;

hausa: “ ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa a ranar da na tsarkake ku daga dukan zunubanku, zan sāke zaunar da ku a garuruwanku, a kuma sāke gina kufai.
english: “‘The Lord Yahweh says: “In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited and the waste places will be built.

hausa: Sa’an nan waɗansu Farisiyawa da malaman dokoki suka zo wurin Yesu daga Urushalima suka yi tambaya suka ce,
english: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,

hausa: Saboda haka suka umarta a fitar da su daga Majalisar, sa’an nan suka yi shawara da juna.
english: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

hausa: Amma Isra’ilawa ba su kori mutanen Geshur da Ma’aka ba, saboda haka suka ci gaba da zama cikin Isra’ilawa har wa yau.
english: Nevertheless the children of Israel didn’t drive out the Geshurites, nor the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath live within Israel to this day.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Je wurin Fir’auna, gama na riga na taurare zuciyarsa da kuma zukatan fadawansa domin in aikata waɗannan mu’ujizai nawa a tsakiyarsu,
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go in to Pharaoh, for I have hardened his heart and the heart of his servants, that I may show these my signs among them;

hausa: Allah ya sa kome a ƙarƙashin ikonsa, ya kuma ba shi iko a kan kome don amfanin ikkilisiya.
english: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

hausa: To, daga cikin hare haren da mutanen Aram suke kaiwa, sai suka kama wata yarinya daga ƙasar Isra’ila, aka sa ta zama mai yi wa matar Na’aman aiki.
english: The Syrians had gone out in bands, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little girl, and she waited on Naaman’s wife.

hausa: Sai mutumin da yake tsaye cikin itatuwan ci-zaƙin ya yi bayani cewa, “Su ne waɗanda Ubangiji ya aika ko’ina a duniya.”
english: The man who stood among the myrtle trees answered, “They are the ones Yahweh has sent to go back and forth through the earth.”

hausa: Gama ni kaina mutum ne a ƙarƙashin iko, da kuma sojoji a ƙarƙashina. Nakan ce wa wannan, ‘Je ka,’ sai yă tafi; wancan kuma, ‘Zo nan,’ sai yă zo. Nakan ce wa bawana, ‘Yi wannan,’ sai kuwa yă yi.”
english: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and tell another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

hausa: Ya kawar da masujadan kan tudu da bagadan turare a kowane gari a Yahuda, masarautar kuwa ta zauna lafiya a ƙarƙashinsa.
english: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the sun images; and the kingdom was quiet before him.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ji kukata saboda jinƙansa; Ubangiji ya karɓi addu’ata.
english: Yahweh has heard my supplication. Yahweh accepts my prayer.

hausa: Shi ne wanda ya sāke gina Elot ya kuma mai da shi ga Yahuda bayan Amaziya ya huta tare da kakanninsa.
english: He built Eloth and restored it to Judah. After that the king slept with his fathers.

hausa: Sa’ad da na duba, sai na ga cewa kun yi zunubi wa Ubangiji Allahnku; kun yi wa kanku gunkin da kuka yi zubi a siffar ɗan maraƙi. Kun kauce da sauri daga hanyar da Ubangiji ya umarce ku.
english: I looked, and behold, you had sinned against Yahweh your God. You had made yourselves a molded calf. You had quickly turned away from the way which Yahweh had commanded you.

hausa: A matse muke a kowane gefe, sai dai ba a gurgunta mu ba. An rikitar da mu, amma ba mu fid da zuciya ba.
english: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;

hausa: Allah yana cikinta, ba za tă fāɗi ba; Allah zai taimake ta da safe.
english: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.

hausa: In wani bai kula da danginsa ba, musamman iyalinsa na kurkusa, ya mūsunta bangaskiya ke nan, ya kuma fi marar ba da gaskiya muni.
english: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

hausa: Mata biyu za su kasance suna niƙan hatsi tare, za a ɗauki ɗaya, a bar ɗayan.”
english: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken and the other will be left.”

hausa: ko tsayi ko zurfi, ko wani abu dabam cikin dukan halitta da zai iya raba mu da ƙaunar Allah wadda take cikin Kiristi Yesu Ubangijinmu.
english: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

hausa: Za a yi fele biyu, gaba da baya, sa’an nan a haɗa, a ɗinka a mahaɗinsu a kafaɗa.
english: It shall have two shoulder straps joined to the two ends of it, that it may be joined together.

hausa: Ina amfani ƙarfin hannuwansu gare ni, tun da ba su da sauran kuzari?
english: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?

hausa: Kada ka matsar da shaidar kan iyakar da kakanninka suka kafa.
english: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.

hausa: Ya ƙosar da masu yunwa da kyawawan abubuwa amma ya sallami mawadata hannu wofi.
english: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.

hausa: Sa’ad da aka faɗa wa Dawuda wannan, sai tattara dukan Isra’ila ya haye Urdun; ya tafi wurinsu ya kuwa ja dāgā ɗaura da su. Dawuda ya ja dāgārsa don yă sadu da Arameyawa a yaƙi, su kuwa suka yi yaƙi da shi.
english: David was told that, so he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, came to them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

hausa: Me ya sa kuke taƙama da kwarurukanku, taƙama da kwarurukanku masu amfani? Ya ke diya marar aminci, kin dogara a wadatarki kika kuma ce, ‘Wa zai iya fāɗa mini?’
english: Why do you boast in the valleys, your flowing valley, backsliding daughter? You trusted in her treasures, saying, ‘Who will come to me?’

hausa: Mutum saba’in da biyun nan suka dawo da murna, suka ce, “Ubangiji, har mun sha ƙarfin aljanu ma a cikin sunanka.”
english: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”

hausa: Taya ta gina wa kanta mafaka mai ƙarfi; ta tara azurfa kamar ƙasa, zinariya kuma kamar tarin shara a tituna.
english: Tyre built herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver like the dust, and fine gold like the mire of the streets.

hausa: “Bawana Musa ya mutu. Yanzu sai ka tashi tare da mutanen nan duka, ku yi shirin ƙetare kogin Urdun zuwa cikin ƙasar da zan ba su Isra’ilawa.
english: “Moses my servant is dead. Now therefore arise, go across this Jordan, you and all these people, to the land which I am giving to them, even to the children of Israel.

hausa: Ka yi turare mai ƙanshi yadda mai yin turare yake yi. A sa masa gishiri, yă zama tsabtatacce, tsarkakakke.
english: You shall make incense of it, a perfume after the art of the perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.

hausa: Duk wanda yake da shi, za a ƙara masa, duk wanda kuma ba shi da shi, ko abin da yake da shi ma, za a karɓe daga gare shi.”
english: For whoever has, to him more will be given; and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”

hausa: Gama marasa tsoron Allah za su zama marasa ba da ’ya’ya, wuta kuma za tă ƙona tenti na masu son cin hanci.
english: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.

hausa: Gama kamar yadda sammai suke can bisa duniya, haka girmar ƙaunarsa yake wa masu tsoronsa;
english: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.

hausa: Amma ga shi an gangara da kai zuwa kabari, zuwa zurfafan rami.
english: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol, to the depths of the pit.

hausa: A shekara ta biyar ta mulkin Yoram ɗan Ahab, sarkin Isra’ila, sa’ad da Yehoshafat yake sarautar Yahuda, Yoram ɗan Yehoshafat, ya fara mulkinsa a matsayin sarkin Yahuda.
english: In the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being king of Judah then, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.

hausa: A wannan rana kuka fita, wato, a watan Abib.
english: Today you go out in the month Abib.

hausa: Dukan doka an taƙaita a cikin umarni ɗaya ne cewa, “Ka ƙaunaci maƙwabcinka kamar kanka.”
english: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

hausa: Amma ku kam, sai ku juya, ku koma cikin hamada ta hanyar Jan Teku.”
english: But as for you, turn, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”

hausa: Ko da yake yayinda yake a raye ya ɗauka kansa mai albarka ne, mutane kuma sun yabe ka sa’ad da kake cin nasara,
english: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—

hausa: Gama ka ware su daga dukan al’umman duniya su zama abin gādonka, kamar yadda aka furta ta wurin bawanka Musa sa’ad da kai, ya Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ka fitar da kakanninmu daga Masar.”
english: For you separated them from among all the peoples of the earth to be your inheritance, as you spoke by Moses your servant, when you brought our fathers out of Egypt, Lord Yahweh.”

hausa: Ka wanke dukan kurakuraina ka tsarkake ni daga zunubina.
english: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.

hausa: Ya auna gefen gabas da karan awo; ya samu kamu ɗari biyar.
english: He measured on the east side with the measuring reed five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed all around.

hausa: Saboda haka matan biyu suka ci gaba da tafiya sai da suka isa Betlehem. Da suka isa Betlehem, sai dukan garin ya ruɗe saboda su, matan kuwa suka ce, “Na’omi ce wannan kuwa?”
english: So they both went until they came to Bethlehem. When they had come to Bethlehem, all the city was excited about them, and they asked, “Is this Naomi?”

hausa: Labudda, Allah shi ne shaidata cewa don kada in ƙara muku wahala ne ya sa ban koma Korint ba.
english: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn’t come to Corinth.

hausa: Kamar itacen gawasa a cikin itatuwan jeji haka ƙaunataccena yake a cikin samari. Ina farin ciki in zauna a inuwarsa, ’ya’yan itacensa suna da daɗin ɗanɗanon da nake so
english: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, his fruit was sweet to my taste.

hausa: “Ka haura zuwa Lebanon ka yi kuka, bari a ji muryarka a Bashan, yi kuka daga Abarim, gama an murƙushe dukan abokanka.
english: “Go up to Lebanon, and cry out. Lift up your voice in Bashan, and cry from Abarim; for all your lovers have been destroyed.

hausa: Wannan shawarar kuwa ta gamshi dukan ƙungiyar. Sai suka zaɓi Istifanus, mutumin da yake cike da bangaskiya da kuma Ruhu Mai Tsarki; da Filibus, Burokorus, Nikano, Timon, Farmenas, da Nikolas daga Antiyok, wanda ya tuba zuwa Yahudanci.
english: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,

hausa: Ya mai ta’aziyyata a cikin baƙin ciki, zuciyata ta ɓaci ƙwarai.
english: Oh that I could comfort myself against sorrow! My heart is faint within me.

hausa: Samari, ku ma, ku yi biyayya ga waɗanda suka girme ku. Dukanku, ku yafa sauƙinkai ga juna, domin, “Allah yana gāba da mai girman kai, amma yakan yi alheri ga mai sauƙinkai.”
english: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

hausa: To, ’yan’uwa, game da lokuta da ranaku, ba ma bukata mu rubuta muku,
english: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.

hausa: Duk da haka sa’ad da ta buɗe fikafikanta ta shara da gudu tana yi wa doki da mai hawansa dariya.
english: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.

hausa: Lokacin da kuka ƙwace birnin, sai ku sa masa wuta. Ku yi abin da Ubangiji ya umarta. Ku tabbata kun yi abubuwan da na ce.”
english: It shall be, when you have seized the city, that you shall set the city on fire. You shall do this according to Yahweh’s word. Behold, I have commanded you.”

hausa: “Ku manta da abubuwan da suka riga suka faru; kada ku yi tunanin abin da ya riga ya wuce.
english: “Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old.

hausa: Sa’ad da Bela ya mutu sai Yobab ɗan Zera daga Bozra ya gāje shi a matsayin sarki.
english: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.

hausa: In an zage ku saboda sunan Kiristi, ku masu albarka ne, gama Ruhun ɗaukaka da kuma na Allah yana bisanku.
english: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.

hausa: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiya da Yedahiya. Waɗannan su ne shugabannin firistoci da ’yan’uwansu a kwanakin Yeshuwa.
english: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, and Jedaiah. These were the chiefs of the priests and of their brothers in the days of Jeshua.

hausa: An ba da dokar don mu ga yadda laifi yake da girma. Amma da zunubi ya ƙaru, sai alheri ya ƙaru sosai,
english: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,

hausa: Sa’an nan ka ce masa, ‘Ubangiji, Allah na Ibraniyawa, ya aiko ni in faɗa maka, Ka bar mutanena su tafi domin su yi mini sujada a hamada. Amma har yanzu ba ka yi biyayya ba.
english: You shall tell him, ‘Yahweh, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to you, saying, “Let my people go, that they may serve me in the wilderness. Behold, until now you haven’t listened.”

hausa: na ɗauke ka daga iyakar duniya, daga kusurwoyi masu nesa na kira ka. Na ce, ‘Kai bawana ne’; na zaɓe ka ban kuwa ƙi ka ba.
english: you whom I have taken hold of from the ends of the earth, and called from its corners, and said to you, ‘You are my servant. I have chosen you and have not cast you away.’

hausa: Sa’an nan ka karɓe su daga hannuwansu, ka ƙone su a kan bagade tare da hadaya ta ƙonawa, domin ƙanshi mai daɗi ga Ubangiji, wato, hadaya ce da aka ƙone da wuta ga Ubangiji.
english: You shall take them from their hands, and burn them on the altar on the burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma before Yahweh: it is an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

hausa: Zan mai da ƙasarku kango har abokan gābanku da suke zama a wurin su yi mamaki.
english: I will bring the land into desolation, and your enemies who dwell in it will be astonished at it.

hausa: Sa’an nan za su iya su koya wa mata masu ƙuruciya su ƙaunaci mazansu da ’ya’yansu,
english: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,

hausa: Na yi wa waɗansu ikkilisiyoyi ƙwace ta wurin karɓar taimako daga wurinsu, domin in yi muku hidima.
english: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.

hausa: Suka kwashe garkunansu na shanu da jakuna, da kuma kome na mutanen a birnin da kuma cikin gonaki.
english: They took their flocks, their herds, their donkeys, that which was in the city, that which was in the field,

hausa: Akwai muguntar da na gani a duniya, irin kuskuren da yake fitowa daga masu mulki.
english: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, the sort of error which proceeds from the ruler.

hausa: dole a karkashe dukan waɗanda suke zama a wannan birni da takobi. Ku hallaka su ƙaƙaf, ku karkashe mutanen birnin da kuma dabbobinsa.
english: you shall surely strike the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, with all that is therein and its livestock, with the edge of the sword.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce, “Wannan zai sa su ba da gaskiya cewa Ubangiji, Allah na kakanninsu, Allah na Ibrahim, Allah na Ishaku, da kuma Allah da Yaƙub, ya bayyana gare ka.”
english: “This is so that they may believe that Yahweh, the God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has appeared to you.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Yesu ya gama ba da waɗannan misalai, sai ya ci gaba daga can.
english: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.

hausa: Kuma ba za su sāke mutuwa ba, gama su kamar mala’iku ne. Su ’ya’yan Allah ne, tun da su ’ya’yan tashin matattu ne.
english: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

hausa: Bayan ’yan kwanaki sai Sarki Agiriffa da Bernis suka iso Kaisariya don su yi wa Festus gaisuwar bangirma.
english: Now when some days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea and greeted Festus.

hausa: Wannan ita ce dokar da Musa ya sa a gaban Isra’ilawa.
english: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.

hausa: Kifin da suke cikin Nilu suka mutu, kogin kuwa ya yi wari sosai yadda Masarawa ba su iya shan ruwan ba. Jini ya bazu ko’ina a Masar.
english: The fish that were in the river died. The river became foul. The Egyptians couldn’t drink water from the river. The blood was throughout all the land of Egypt.

hausa: Ishmayel ya mai da dukan sauran mutanen da suke Mizfa bayi ’ya’yan sarki mata tare da dukan sauran da aka bari a can, waɗanda Nebuzaradan shugaban matsaran sarki ya bari a hannun Gedaliya ɗan Ahikam. Ishmayel ɗan Netaniya ya kwashe su ganima, ya tashi don yă haye zuwa wurin Ammonawa.
english: Then Ishmael carried away captive all of the people who were left in Mizpah, even the king’s daughters, and all the people who remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam. Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the children of Ammon.

hausa: Wane ne yake bi na bashi da dole in biya? Duk abin da yake ƙarƙashin sama nawa ne.
english: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.

hausa: Saboda haka Yahuda ya zo cikin lambun, yana jagoranta ƙungiyar sojoji da waɗansu ma’aikata daga wurin manyan firistoci da Farisiyawa. Suna riƙe da toci, fitilu da kuma makamai.
english: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.

hausa: Gama duniya da ba tă san Allah ba, tana faman neman dukan waɗannan abubuwa, Ubanku na sama kuwa, ya san kuna bukatarsu.
english: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.

hausa: Shi ya sa, saboda ku sammai sun ƙi saukar da raɓa, ƙasa kuma ta ƙi ba da amfani.
english: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholds its fruit.

hausa: Manyan sojojin Filistiyawa suka yi ta fita suna yaƙi da Isra’ilawa, amma kullum Dawuda yakan sami nasara fiye da sauran manyan sojojin Shawulu. Ta haka ya yi suna ƙwarai.
english: Then the princes of the Philistines went out; and as often as they went out, David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul, so that his name was highly esteemed.

hausa: Amma Isra’ilawa ba su yi aminci game da kayan da aka hallaka ba; Akan ɗan Karmi, ɗan Zabdi, ɗan Zera, na kabilan Yahuda ya kwashi waɗansu abubuwa, saboda haka fushin Ubangiji ya sauka a kan Isra’ilawa.
english: But the children of Israel committed a trespass in the devoted things; for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of the devoted things. Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against the children of Israel.

hausa: Ga sauran kuwa (ni ne fa na ce ba Ubangiji ba), in wani ɗan’uwa yana da mata wadda ba mai bi ba ce, kuma tana so ta zauna tare da shi, kada yă sake ta.
english: But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yesu ya furta cewa, “Ni ne burodin rai. Wanda ya zo wurina ba zai taɓa jin yunwa ba, wanda kuma ya gaskata da ni ba zai taɓa jin ƙishirwa ba.
english: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

hausa: Yesu kuwa ya san cewa, Uba ya sa dukan abubuwa a ƙarƙashin ikonsa, ya kuma san cewa daga Allah ya zo, zai kuma koma wurin Allah;
english: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,

hausa: Yanzu ya zage ta cewa, ‘Ban sami ’yarku budurwa ba.’ Amma ga shaidar budurcin ’yata.” Sa’an nan iyayenta za su shimfiɗa zanen a gaban dattawan garin,
english: Behold, he has accused her of shameful things, saying, ‘I didn’t find in your daughter the tokens of virginity;’ and yet these are the tokens of my daughter’s virginity.” They shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city.

hausa: Idanun da suke ganina yanzu ba za su sāke ganina ba; za ku neme ni amma ba za ku same ni ba.
english: The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.

hausa: Ko da yake ka sa na ga wahaloli, masu yawa da kuma masu ɗaci, za ka sāke mayar mini da rai; daga zurfafan duniya za ka sāke tā da ni.
english: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

hausa: Mutanen Isra’ila da Yahuda waɗanda suke zama a garuruwan Yahuda, su ma suka kawo zakan shanu da na tumaki da kuma zakan abubuwa masu tsarki da aka keɓe ga Ubangiji Allahnsu, suka jibge su tsibi-tsibi.
english: The children of Israel and Judah, who lived in the cities of Judah, also brought in the tithe of cattle and sheep, and the tithe of dedicated things which were consecrated to Yahweh their God, and laid them in heaps.

hausa: Yusuf ya tattara dukan abincin da aka samu a waɗannan shekaru bakwai na yalwa a Masar, ya kuma yi ajiyarsu a cikin birane. A kowane birni, ya sa abincin da aka nome a kewayensa.
english: He gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities. He stored food in each city from the fields around that city.

hausa: Ubangiji bai yi wata-wata wajen kawo mana bala’i ba, domin Ubangiji Allahnmu mai adalci ne a cikin dukan abin da yake yi; duk da haka ba mu yi masa biyayya ba.
english: Therefore Yahweh has watched over the evil, and brought it on us; for Yahweh our God is righteous in all his works which he does, and we have not obeyed his voice.

hausa: Game da ayyukan mutane kuwa, ta wurin maganar leɓunanka na kiyaye kaina daga hanyoyin tashin hankali.
english: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.

hausa: Da Hiridus ya ga Yesu, sai ya yi murna ƙwarai, don tun dā ma yana marmari ya gan shi a kan abin da ya ji game da shi. Ya yi fata ya ga Yesu, yă kuma yi waɗansu ayyukan banmamaki.
english: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.

hausa: Duk da haka ka ji addu’ar bawanka da kuma roƙonsa don jinƙai, ya Ubangiji Allahna. Ka ji kuka da addu’ar da bawanka yake yi a gabanka a wannan rana.
english: Yet have respect for the prayer of your servant and for his supplication, Yahweh my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer which your servant prays before you today;

hausa: Amma ga burodin da ya sauko daga sama, wanda mutum zai iya ci, ba zai kuma mutu ba.
english: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.

hausa: ka ji addu’arsu da roƙonsu daga sama, ka kuma biya musu bukatansu.
english: then hear in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

hausa: kullum suna koyo amma ba sa taɓa iya yarda da gaskiya.
english: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

hausa: Waƙar haurawa. Ta Dawuda. Da ba don Ubangiji ya kasance a gefenmu ba, bari Isra’ila yă ce,
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, let Israel now say,

hausa: Da wansa Eliyab, ya ji yana magana da mutanen, sai ransa ya ɓace ƙwarai saboda fushi, sai ya ce wa Dawuda, “Me ka zo yi a nan? Wa kuma ka bar wa ’yan tumakin a jeji? Na san ka da taurinkai, da kuma mugun hali. Ka zo nan ne don ka yi kallon yaƙi kawai.”
english: Eliab his oldest brother heard when he spoke to the men; and Eliab’s anger burned against David, and he said, “Why have you come down? With whom have you left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know your pride and the evil of your heart; for you have come down that you might see the battle.”

hausa: Idanuna za su kula da su don kyautatawarsu, zan kuma komo da su wannan ƙasa. Zan gina su ba zan rushe su ba; zan dasa su ba kuwa zan tumɓuke su ba.
english: For I will set my eyes on them for good, and I will bring them again to this land. I will build them, and not pull them down. I will plant them, and not pluck them up.

hausa: Adoniya ya haɗa baƙi da Yowab ɗan Zeruhiya da kuma Abiyatar firist, suka kuma ba shi goyon baya.
english: He conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah and with Abiathar the priest; and they followed Adonijah and helped him.

hausa: gama Ubangiji ya sa rundunar Arameyawa suka ji motsin kekunan yaƙi, da motsin dawakai, da na babban rundunar sojoji, saboda haka suka ce wa juna; “Duba, sarkin Isra’ila ya ɗauka hayar sarakuna Hittiyawa da sarakunan Masarawa don su yaƙe mu!”
english: For the Lord had made the army of the Syrians to hear the sound of chariots and the sound of horses, even the noise of a great army; and they said to one another, “Behold, the king of Israel has hired against us the kings of the Hittites and the kings of the Egyptians to attack us.”

hausa: Yadda Allah ya tumɓuke Sodom da Gomorra tare da maƙwabtan garuruwansu,” in ji Ubangiji “haka ma ba wanda zai zauna a can; ba wani da zai zauna a cikinta.
english: As when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and its neighbor cities,” says Yahweh, “so no man will dwell there, neither will any son of man live therein.

hausa: Mugaye suna yawo a sake sa’ad da ake girmama abin da ba shi da kyau a cikin mutane.
english: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.

hausa: Ta ce wa mala’ika na shida da yake da ƙahon, “Ka saki mala’iku huɗun nan da suke a daure a babban kogin Yuferites.”
english: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”

hausa: “Yanzu fa, sai ka faɗa wa mutanen Yahuda da waɗanda suke zaune a Urushalima, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa ga shi! Ina shirya muku masifa ina ƙirƙiro dabara a kanku. Saboda haka ku juya daga mugayen hanyoyinku, kowannenku, ku canja hanyoyinku da kuma ayyukanku.’
english: “Now therefore, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Yahweh says: “Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a plan against you. Everyone return from his evil way now, and amend your ways and your doings.”’

hausa: Wane ne mai hikima da fahimta a cikinku? Bari yă nuna ta ta wurin rayuwarsa mai kyau, ta wurin ayyukan da aka yi cikin tawali’un da suke fitowa daga hikima.
english: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

hausa: Wannan ya faru ne don a cika kalmomin da ya yi cewa, “Ban yar da ko ɗaya daga cikin waɗanda ka ba ni ba.”
english: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”

hausa: Duk sa’ad da sarki ya tafi wurin haikalin Ubangiji, matsara sukan riƙe garkuwoyinsu, daga baya kuma sai su mai da su ɗakin tsaro.
english: It was so, that as often as the king went into Yahweh’s house, the guard bore them, and brought them back into the guard room.

hausa: Suka fita da tsakar rana yayinda Ben-Hadad tare da sarakuna 32 masu goyon bayansa suke cikin tentunansu suna sha, suna buguwa.
english: They went out at noon. But Ben Hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty-two kings who helped him.

hausa: Zai yi magana da mutane a madadinka, zai zama kamar bakinka, kai kuwa kamar Allah a gare shi.
english: He will be your spokesman to the people. It will happen that he will be to you a mouth, and you will be to him as God.

hausa: Ba abin da zai warkar da rauninka; rauninka ya yi muni. Duk wanda ya ji labarinka zai tafa hannuwansa saboda farin cikin fāɗuwarka, gama wane ne bai ji jiki a hannunka ba?
english: There is no healing your wound, for your injury is fatal. All who hear the report of you clap their hands over you, for who hasn’t felt your endless cruelty?

hausa: Sai ya ce, “Kamar yadda kika sani, mulkin nan nawa ne. Dukan Isra’ila suna ɗaukana a matsayin sarki. Amma abubuwa suka canja, sai mulkin ya koma ga ɗan’uwana; gama ya zo masa daga Ubangiji ne.
english: He said, “You know that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign. However, the kingdom is turned around, and has become my brother’s; for it was his from Yahweh.

hausa: Za ka zura ido a kan irin wannan ne? Za ka kawo shi gaba don ka yi masa shari’a?
english: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?

hausa: Saboda haka ku tafi, ku mai da dukan al’umman duniya su zama almajiraina, kuna yi musu baftisma a cikinsunan Uba, da na Ɗa, da na Ruhu Mai Tsarki,
english: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

hausa: Bitrus ya ce masa, “Ubangiji, don me ba zan binka yanzu ba? Zan ba da raina saboda kai.”
english: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”

hausa: Da Ahab ya ji cewa Nabot ya mutu, sai ya tashi ya gangara don yă mallaki gonar inabin Nabot.
english: When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce, “Saboda zunubai uku na Edom, har guda huɗu ma, ba zan fasa hukunta shi ba. Don ya fafari ɗan’uwansa da takobi, babu tausayi, domin ya ci gaba da fusata bai yarda yă huce daga fushinsa ba.
english: Yahweh says: “For three transgressions of Edom, yes, for four, I will not turn away its punishment, because he pursued his brother with the sword and cast off all pity, and his anger raged continually, and he kept his wrath forever;

hausa: ka kuma yi rammuka arba’in da azurfar da za a sa wa katakan nan ashirin. Za a sa kawunan katakan da aka fiƙe a cikin rammukan.
english: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

hausa: Amma maganar Allah ta ci gaba da ƙaruwa ta kuma bazu.
english: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

hausa: Sai aka zuba wa mutanen faten, amma da suka fara ci, sai suka yi ihu suna cewa, “Ya mutumin Allah, akwai dafi a cikin tukunyan nan!” Suka kuwa kāsa ci.
english: So they poured out for the men to eat. As they were eating some of the stew, they cried out and said, “Man of God, there is death in the pot!” And they could not eat it.

hausa: Sa’ad da Yahuda ya fāɗa musu, Ubangiji kuwa ya ba da Kan’aniyawa da Ferizziyawa a hannunsu, suka kuwa kashe mutum dubu goma a Bezek.
english: Judah went up, and Yahweh delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. They struck ten thousand men in Bezek.

hausa: Sai almajiransa suka amsa suka ce, “Ina za mu sami isashen burodi a wannan wurin da babu kowa mu ciyar da irin taron nan?”
english: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”

hausa: “An yi wani mutum mai arziki wanda yakan sa tufafi masu ruwan shunayya, da kuma na lallausan lilin, yana kuma cikin rayuwar jin daɗi kullum.
english: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.

hausa: In na dubi rana cikin haskenta, ko kuma wata yana tafiyarsa,
english: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,

hausa: Kabilar Zebulun za su yi sansani biye da su. Shugabansu shi ne Eliyab ɗan Helon.
english: “The tribe of Zebulun: the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.

hausa: Zai sa tumaki a damansa, awaki kuma a hagunsa.
english: He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

hausa: Da ya koma sau na uku, sai ya ce musu, “Har yanzu kuna barci, kuna hutawa ba? Ya isa! Lokaci ya yi. Duba an ba da Ɗan Mutum a hannun masu zunubi.
english: He came the third time and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

hausa: Daga baya, kamar yadda kuka sani, sa’ad da ya nemi yă gāji wannan albarka, aka ƙi shi. Bai sami zarafin tuba ba, ko da yake ya nemi albarkan nan da hawaye.
english: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.

hausa: Ba mu faɗa maka a Masar ba, cewa ‘Ka bar mu mu bauta wa Masarawa’? Ai, da ya fi mana mu bauta wa Masarawa, da a ce mu mutu a hamada!”
english: Isn’t this the word that we spoke to you in Egypt, saying, ‘Leave us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians’? For it would have been better for us to serve the Egyptians than to die in the wilderness.”

hausa: kitsonsu, sarƙar da suke sa wa damatsansu da ɗamararsu, kwalabai turare da layu,
english: the headdresses, the ankle chains, the sashes, the perfume containers, the charms,

hausa: jakuna 30,500
english: thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,

hausa: Musa, da Eleyazar firist da dukan shugabannin jama’a, suka fito suka tarye su a bayan sansani.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest, with all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.

hausa: Kai da kake taƙama da doka, kana nuna rashin bangirma ga Allah ta wurin karya dokar?
english: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?

hausa: In maciji ya sari mutum kafin a ba shi makarin gardi, ina amfanin maganin?
english: If the snake bites before it is charmed, then is there no profit for the charmer’s tongue.

hausa: Wannan shi ne asalin tarihin sammai da duniya sa’ad da aka halicce su. Sa’ad da Ubangiji Allah ya yi duniya da sammai,
english: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that Yahweh God made the earth and the heavens.

hausa: Sai Ruhu ya sauko a kan Amasai, shugaban Talatin nan, sai ya ce, “Mu naka ne, ya Dawuda! Muna tare da kai, ya ɗan Yesse! Nasara, nasara gare ka, nasara kuma ga waɗanda suke taimakonka. Gama Allahnka zai taimake ka.” Saboda haka Dawuda ya karɓe su ya kuma mai da su shugabannin ƙungiyoyin maharansa.
english: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse. Peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them and made them captains of the band.

hausa: Yamma ta kasance, safiya kuma ta kasance, kwana ta huɗu ke nan.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

hausa: Yonadab ya ce wa Sarki, “Duba, ga ’ya’yan sarki maza sun zo; ya faru kamar dai yadda bawanka ya faɗa.”
english: Jonadab said to the king, “Behold, the king’s sons are coming! It is as your servant said.”

hausa: Ahab ya ce wa Iliya, “Wato, ka same ni kuma, abokin gābana!” Sai ya amsa ya ce, “Na same ka, domin ka sayar da kanka ga yin mugunta a gaban Ubangiji.
english: Ahab said to Elijah, “Have you found me, my enemy?” He answered, “I have found you, because you have sold yourself to do that which is evil in Yahweh’s sight.

hausa: Sammai na yabon abubuwan banmamakinka, ya Ubangiji, amincinka shi ma, a cikin taron tsarkakanka.
english: The heavens will praise your wonders, Yahweh, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

hausa: To, maciji dai ya fi kowane a cikin namun jejin da Ubangiji Allah ya yi wayo. Ya ce wa macen, “Tabbatacce ne Allah ya ce, ‘Kada ku ci daga kowane itace a lambu’?”
english: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which Yahweh God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden’?”

hausa: Ya nemi ka ba shi rai, ka kuwa ba shi, tsawo kwanaki, har abada abadin
english: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.

hausa: “Da Musa ya cika shekara arba’in da haihuwa, sai ya yanke shawara yă ziyarci ’yan’uwansa Isra’ilawa.
english: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.

hausa: To, mahaifinsa ya gangara don yă ga yarinyar. Samson kuwa ya shirya wata liyafa a can, yadda yake bisa ga al’adar angwaye.
english: His father went down to the woman; and Samson made a feast there, for the young men used to do so.

hausa: Saboda haka suka zauna su biyu suka ci suka sha tare. Bayan haka sai mahaifin yarinyar ya ce, “Don Allah ka kwana ka ji wa kanka daɗi.”
english: So they sat down, ate, and drank, both of them together. Then the young lady’s father said to the man, “Please be pleased to stay all night, and let your heart be merry.”

hausa: Yusuf kuwa ya ba wa mai yin masa hidima a gida, waɗannan umarnai cewa, “Cika buhunan mutanen nan da abinci iyakar yadda za su iya ɗauka, ka kuma sa kuɗin kowanne a bakin buhunsa.
english: He commanded the steward of his house, saying, “Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each man’s money in his sack’s mouth.

hausa: Absalom yakan tashi da sassafe yă tsaya a gefen hanyar shigar ƙofar birni. Duk sa’ad da wani ya zo da ƙara don a kai gaban sarki yă yi shari’a, Absalom yakan kira shi yă ce, “Daga wane gari ka fito?” Sai mutumin yă amsa yă ce, “Bawanka ya fito a ɗaya daga cikin kabilan Isra’ila.”
english: Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate. When any man had a suit which should come to the king for judgment, then Absalom called to him, and said, “What city are you from?” He said, “Your servant is of one of the tribes of Israel.”

hausa: Ubangiji kuwa ya sāke yin rubutu a waɗannan alluna abin da ya rubuta a allunan farko, wato, Dokoki Goma da ya furta a kan dutse a tsakiyar wuta, a ranar da mutane suka taru. Sai Ubangiji ya ba ni su.
english: He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which Yahweh spoke to you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly; and Yahweh gave them to me.

hausa: Fushi ya kama ni saboda mugaye, waɗanda suka keta dokokinka.
english: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.

hausa: Amma sa’ad da Sanballat mutumin Horon da Tobiya wakilin ƙasar Ammon da kuma Geshem mutumin Arab suka ji game da wannan, sai suka yi mana ba’a suka kuma yi mana dariya. Suka ce, “Me kuke tsammani kuke yi? Kuna so ku yi wa sarki tawaye ne?”
english: But when Sanballat the Horonite, Tobiah the Ammonite servant, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they ridiculed us and despised us, and said, “What is this thing that you are doing? Will you rebel against the king?”

hausa: in ka tabbata cewa kai jagora ne ga makafi, haske ga waɗanda suke cikin duhu,
english: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,

hausa: Dawuda kuwa ya damu ƙwarai domin mutanensa suna niyyar su jajjefe shi da duwatsu, kowannensu ransa ya ɓace saboda ’ya’yansa maza da mata, amma Dawuda ya sami ƙarfafawa a cikin Ubangiji Allahnsa.
english: David was greatly distressed, for the people spoke of stoning him, because the souls of all the people were grieved, every man for his sons and for his daughters; but David strengthened himself in Yahweh his God.

hausa: Meshelemiya yana da ’ya’ya maza. Zakariya ɗan fari, Yediyayel na biyu, Zebadiya na uku, Yatniyel na huɗu,
english: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

hausa: Suka yi mu’ujizansa a cikinsu, abubuwan mamakinsa a cikin ƙasar Ham.
english: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

hausa: yana sa al’ummai su zama manya, sai kuma yă hallaka su; yana sa al’ummai su ƙasaita, yă kuma watsar da su.
english: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.

hausa: Amma bijimin da fatarsa da namansa da kuma ƙashinsa ya ƙone su a bayan sansani, yadda Ubangiji ya umarce shi.
english: But the bull, and its skin, and its meat, and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

hausa: Ya kori dukan maza karuwai na masujadai daga ƙasar, ya kuma yi waje da dukan gumakan da mahaifinsa ya yi.
english: He put away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.

hausa: To, ana nan sai jakunan Kish mahaifin Shawulu suka ɓace. Kish ya ce wa ɗansa, “Tashi ka tafi tare da wani daga cikin bayi, ku nemo jakunan.”
english: The donkeys of Kish, Saul’s father, were lost. Kish said to Saul his son, “Now take one of the servants with you, and arise, go look for the donkeys.”

hausa: Sa’ad da hasken yini ya tafi, mai kisankai yakan tashi; yă je yă kashe matalauta da masu bukata; a cikin dare yake shigowa kamar ɓarawo.
english: The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.

hausa: Idanunka sun ga jikina marar fasali; dukan kwanakin da aka tsara mini a rubuce suke a littafinka kafin ɗayansu yă kasance.
english: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.

hausa: Game da tsarkakan da suke cikin ƙasar kuwa, su ne masu ɗaukakar da dukan farin cikina ya dangana.
english: As for the saints who are on the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.

hausa: Hasken masu adalci kan haskaka ƙwarai, amma fitilar mugaye mutuwa take.
english: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

hausa: Zan rufe shi da rigarka in kuma yi masa ɗamara in miƙa masa ikonka. Zai zama mahaifi ga waɗanda suke zama a Urushalima da kuma gidan Yahuda.
english: and I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your belt. I will commit your government into his hand; and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.

hausa: Bayan da Yaƙub da ’ya’yansa suka shiga Masar suka yi kukan neman taimako daga Ubangiji, Ubangiji kuwa ya aika musu da Musa da Haruna. Su ne suka kawo kakanni-kakanninku daga Masar suka zauna a nan.
english: “When Jacob had come into Egypt, and your fathers cried to Yahweh, then Yahweh sent Moses and Aaron, who brought your fathers out of Egypt, and made them to dwell in this place.

hausa: Wannan mai ɗaukan rana ɗaya da muhimmanci fiye da sauran, yana yin haka ne ga Ubangiji. Wannan mai cin nama, yana yin haka ne ga Ubangiji, gama yakan yi godiya ga Allah; wannan da ba ya ci kuwa, yana yin haka ne ga Ubangiji yana kuwa yin godiya ga Allah.
english: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

hausa: Bayana yana fama da zazzaɓi; babu lafiya a jikina.
