english: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.

hausa: Sa’ad da kuka haye Urdun zuwa cikin ƙasar da Ubangiji Allahnku yake ba ku, ku kakkafa waɗansu manyan duwatsu, ku yi musu shafe da farar ƙasa.
english: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, that you shall set yourself up great stones, and coat them with plaster.

hausa: Amma na ce, “Na yi aiki a banza; na kashe duk ƙarfina a banza da wofi. Duk da haka abin da yake nawa yana a hannun Ubangiji, ladana kuma tana a wurin Allahna.”
english: But I said, “I have labored in vain. I have spent my strength in vain for nothing; yet surely the justice due to me is with Yahweh, and my reward with my God.”

hausa: In ya gamshi sarki, bari a yi doka, don a hallaka su, zan kuma sa talenti dubu goma na azurfa a cikin ma’ajin fada saboda mutanen da suka aikata wannan sha’ani.”
english: If it pleases the king, let it be written that they be destroyed; and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver into the hands of those who are in charge of the king’s business, to bring it into the king’s treasuries.”

hausa: Zuwan mai tawayen nan zai zama ta wurin aikin Shaiɗan da aka bayyana cikin kowane irin ayyukan banmamaki, alamu da abubuwan banmamaki na ƙarya,
english: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

hausa: Abin da aka yabi kakanni na dā a kai ke nan.
english: For by this, the elders obtained approval.

hausa: Elisha ya ce wa Yehowash, “Ka samo baka da kibiyoyi,” ya kuwa yi haka.
english: Elisha said to him, “Take bow and arrows;” and he took bow and arrows for himself.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka, Mai Tsarkin nan na Isra’ila ya faɗa, “Cikin tuba da hutu ne kaɗai cetonku yake, cikin shiru da dogara gare ni ne za ku sami ƙarfinku, amma ba za ku sami ko ɗaya a cikinsu ba.
english: For thus said the Lord Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.” You refused,

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana cewa, “Bari su yi kalan raguwar Isra’ila a yi kalan sarai yadda ake yi wa inabi; ka sāke miƙa hannunka a kan rassan, kamar mai tattara inabi.”
english: Yahweh of Armies says, “They will thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel like a vine. Turn again your hand as a grape gatherer into the baskets.”

hausa: “Kai ɗan Iblis ne abokin gāban dukan abin da yake daidai! Kana cike da kowane irin ruɗi da munafunci. Ba za ka daina karkata hanyoyin da suke daidai na Ubangiji ba?
english: and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

hausa: Masu bi kuwa suka cika da farin ciki da kuma Ruhu Mai Tsarki.
english: The disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit.

hausa: in mai laifin ya cancanci bulala, alƙali zai sa yă kwanta a yi masa bulala a gabansa da yawan bulalan da ya dace da laifin,
english: It shall be, if the wicked man is worthy to be beaten, that the judge shall cause him to lie down and to be beaten before his face, according to his wickedness, by number.

hausa: Mikahiya ya amsa ya ce, “Za ka gane a ranar da ka je ka ɓuya a can cikin ɗaki.”
english: Micaiah said, “Behold, you shall see on that day, when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”

hausa: Ka tashi, ya Ubangiji, ka yi arangama da su, ka durƙusar da su; ka cece ni daga mugaye ta wurin takobinka.
english: Arise, Yahweh, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword,

hausa: Bulus da Timoti, bayin Kiristi Yesu, Zuwa ga dukan tsarkaka cikin Kiristi Yesu a Filibbi, tare da masu kula da Ikkilisiya da kuma masu hidima.
english: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:

hausa: “Kai kuma, ya Fir’auna, za a kakkarye ka za ka kuma kwanta a cikin marasa kaciya, tare da waɗanda aka kashe da takobi.
english: “But you will be broken among the uncircumcised, and will lie with those who are slain by the sword.

hausa: annabawan ƙarya da yawa za su firfito su kuma ruɗi mutane da yawa.
english: Many false prophets will arise and will lead many astray.

hausa: Sai Fir’auna ya aika a kawo Yusuf, aka kuwa kawo shi da sauri daga kurkuku. Sa’ad da ya yi aski, ya kuma canja tufafinsa, sai ya zo gaban Fir’auna.
english: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon. He shaved himself, changed his clothing, and came in to Pharaoh.

hausa: Ya bauta, ya kuma yi wa Ba’al sujada, ya tsokane Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila yă yi fushi, kamar yadda mahaifinsa ya yi.
english: He served Baal and worshiped him, and provoked Yahweh, the God of Israel, to anger in all the ways that his father had done so.

hausa: gama su kansu su suke ba da labari irin karɓar da kuka yi mana. Suna faɗin yadda kuka juyo ga Allah daga gumaka don ku bauta wa Allah rayayye da kuma na gaskiya,
english: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,

hausa: In abin da ya yi alkawari dabba ce marar tsarki, wadda ba yardajje ba ce, a matsayin hadaya ga Ubangiji, dole a kai dabbar wa firist,
english: If it is any unclean animal, of which they do not offer as an offering to Yahweh, then he shall set the animal before the priest;

hausa: Sai Musa da Haruna suka shiga cikin Tentin Sujada. Da suka fita, sai suka sa wa mutane albarka; sai ɗaukakar Ubangiji ta bayyana ga dukan mutane.
english: Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting, and came out, and blessed the people; and Yahweh’s glory appeared to all the people.

hausa: Suka ce, “Ka faɗa mana, ko kai ne Kiristi?” Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Ko na gaya muku, ba za ku gaskata ni ba,
english: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them, “If I tell you, you won’t believe,

hausa: A lokacin hadaya, sai annabi Iliya ya zo gaba ya yi addu’a, ya ce, “Ya Ubangiji Allah na Ibrahim, na Isra’ila da kuma na Yaƙub, bari a sani a yau cewa kai Allah ne a cikin Isra’ila, a kuma san cewa ni bawanka ne, na kuma yi dukan waɗannan abubuwa bisa umarninka.
english: At the time of the evening offering, Elijah the prophet came near and said, “Yahweh, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, let it be known today that you are God in Israel and that I am your servant, and that I have done all these things at your word.

hausa: Kamar yadda ya faru a zamanin Nuhu, haka zai zama a dawowar Ɗan Mutum.
english: As the days of Noah were, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

hausa: Takan taso daga ƙarshen sammai ta kewaye zuwa wancan; babu abin da yake ɓuya wa zafinta.
english: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.

hausa: Azuminku yakan ƙare a faɗa da kuma hargitsi, kuna ta naushin juna da mugayen naushe-naushe. Ba za ku iya azumi kamar yadda kuke yi a yau ku zaci za a ji muryarku can sama.
english: Behold, you fast for strife and contention, and to strike with the fist of wickedness. You don’t fast today so as to make your voice to be heard on high.

hausa: “Zebulun zai zauna a bakin teku, yă zama tasar jiragen ruwa; iyakarsa za tă nausa zuwa Sidon.
english: “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.

hausa: Ku jimre shan wahala a matsayin horo; Allah yana yi da ku kamar ’ya’ya. Gama wane ɗa ne mahaifinsa ba ya horonsa?
english: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?

hausa: Efraim zai sami rabo; zai yi iyaka da yankin Manasse daga gabas zuwa yamma.
english: “By the border of Manasseh, from the east side to the west side, Ephraim, one portion.

hausa: ko da ma ya ci gaba cikin ’yan’uwansa. Iskar gabas daga Ubangiji za tă zo, tana hurawa daga hamada; maɓulɓularsa za tă kafe rijiyarsa kuma ta bushe. Za a kwashi kaya masu daraja na ɗakin ajiyarsa ganima.
english: Though he is fruitful among his brothers, an east wind will come, the breath of Yahweh coming up from the wilderness; and his spring will become dry, and his fountain will be dried up. He will plunder the storehouse of treasure.

hausa: Da zaran maigidan ya tashi ya rufe ƙofar, za ku tsaya a waje kuna ƙwanƙwasawa, kuna roƙo cewa, ‘Ranka yă daɗe, buɗe mana ƙofa.’ “Amma shi zai amma ya ce, ‘Ni ban san ku, ko inda kuka fito ba.’
english: When once the master of the house has risen up and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’

hausa: Amma mutanen suka ƙi jin Sama’ila, sai suka ce, “A’a, mu dai, muna son sarki yă bi da mu.”
english: But the people refused to listen to the voice of Samuel; and they said, “No, but we will have a king over us,

hausa: Ubangiji ya sāke kiransa ya ce, “Sama’ila!” Sama’ila ya tashi kuma ya je wurin Eli ya ce, “Ga ni, gama ka kira ni.” Amma Eli ya ce, “Ban kira ka ba, ɗana koma ka kwanta.”
english: Yahweh called yet again, “Samuel!” Samuel arose and went to Eli and said, “Here I am; for you called me.” He answered, “I didn’t call, my son. Lie down again.”

hausa: Allahn mutanen Isra’ila ya zaɓi kakanninmu; ya kuma sa mutanen suka yi bunkasa yayinda suke zama a ƙasar Masar, da iko mai girma ya fitar da su daga ƙasar,
english: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.

hausa: In kun ɗauki wannan daga wurina shi ma wani abu ya same shi, za ku kawo furfura kaina zuwa kabari cikin baƙin ciki.’
english: If you take this one also from me, and harm happens to him, you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.’

hausa: Kowane mai azanci yakan nuna sani, amma wawa yakan yi tallen wawancinsa.
english: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.

hausa: Sa’ad da Ahaz ɗan Yotam, ɗan Uzziya, yake sarkin Yahuda, Sarki Rezin na Aram da Feka ɗan Remaliya sarkin Isra’ila suka haura don su yaƙi Urushalima, amma ba su iya cinta da yaƙi ba.
english: In the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.

hausa: Saboda haka Musa ya ce wa mutane, “Ku shirya waɗansu daga cikin mazanku, su tafi su yi yaƙi da Midiyawa don su ɗaukar wa Ubangiji fansa a kansu.”
english: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Yahweh’s vengeance on Midian.

hausa: Kada ku ji tausayi, rai yă zama a maimakon rai, ido a maimakon ido, haƙori a maimakon haƙori, hannu a maimakon hannu, ƙafa a maimakon ƙafa.
english: Your eyes shall not pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

hausa: sai lokacin da Ubangiji ya kori kowa aka kuma yashe ƙasar gaba ɗaya.
english: and Yahweh has removed men far away, and the forsaken places are many within the land.

hausa: Amma waɗansunsu suka je wurin Farisiyawa suka gaya musu abin da Yesu ya yi.
english: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.

hausa: duk da haka ina tsoron duk wahalata, domin na san ba za ka ɗauke ni marar laifi ba.
english: I am afraid of all my sorrows. I know that you will not hold me innocent.

hausa: Na ce, “Kash, da a ce ina da fikafikan kurciya mana! Ai, da na yi firiya na tafi na huta,
english: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.

hausa: Saboda haka dangin nan mai fansa ya ce wa Bowaz, “Saye shi wa kanka.” Sai ya cire takalminsa.
english: So the near kinsman said to Boaz, “Buy it for yourself,” then he took off his sandal.

hausa: Ba ni da ikon yin abin da na ga dama da kuɗina ne? Ko kana kishi saboda ni mai kyauta ne?’
english: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’

hausa: Gama Ɗan Allah, Yesu Kiristi, wanda ni da Sila da Timoti muka yi muku wa’azinsa, ai, ba “I” da “A’a” ba ne, amma a cikin Kiristi, “I” ne kullum.
english: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”

hausa: kafin in koma inda na fito, ƙasa mai duhu da inuwa sosai,
english: before I go where I will not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;

hausa: Ya kasance a cikin taron nan a hamada, tare da mala’ikan da ya yi magana da shi a Dutsen Sinai, da kuma tare da kakanninmu; ya kuma karɓi kalmomi masu rai don yă miƙa mana.
english: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,

hausa: Sa’ad da maigidanta ya tashi da safe ya buɗe ƙofar gidan don yă fita ya ci gaba da tafiyarsa, sai ga ƙwarƙwararsa, ta fāɗi a bakin ƙofar gidan da hannuwanta a madogarar ƙofar.
english: Her lord rose up in the morning and opened the doors of the house, and went out to go his way; and behold, the woman his concubine had fallen down at the door of the house, with her hands on the threshold.

hausa: “Amma da ’yan hayan suka gan shi, sai suka tattauna zancen, suka ce, ‘Wannan shi ne magājin, mu kashe shi sa’an nan gādon zai zama namu!’
english: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’

hausa: A shekara ta goma sha biyu ta Sarki Zerzes, a wata na farko, watan Nisan, sai suka jefa fur (wato, ƙuri’a) a gaban Haman don a zaɓi rana da watan da zai dace da ƙulle-ƙullen. Sai ƙuri’a ta fāɗa a kan wata na goma sha biyu, wato, watan Adar.
english: In the first month, which is the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of King Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is, the lot, before Haman from day to day, and from month to month, and chose the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

hausa: Amma ku tabbata ba ku ci jinin ba, domin jini ne rai, ba kuwa za ku ci rai cikin naman ba.
english: Only be sure that you don’t eat the blood; for the blood is the life. You shall not eat the life with the meat.

hausa: “Tabbatacce na ji gurnanin Efraim yana cewa, ‘Ka hore ni kamar ɗan maraƙi mai ƙin ji, na kuwa horu. Ka mayar da ni, zan kuwa dawo, domin kai ne Ubangiji Allahna.
english: “I have surely heard Ephraim grieving thus, ‘You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as an untrained calf. Turn me, and I will be turned, for you are Yahweh my God.

hausa: A kan wannan kuke cike da farin ciki ƙwarai, ko da yake yanzu na ɗan lokaci kuna fuskantar baƙin ciki daga gwaje-gwaje iri-iri.
english: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, za ka shari’anta ta? Za ka shari’anta wannan birni mai kisankai? To, sai ka kalubalance ta da dukan ayyukanta na banƙyama
english: “You, son of man, will you judge? Will you judge the bloody city? Then cause her to know all her abominations.

hausa: Yakan aiki maganarsa ta kuwa narkar da su; yakan tā da iskarsa, ruwaye kuwa su gudu.
english: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

hausa: A cikin ikkilisiya, da farko dai Allah ya zaɓa waɗansu ya naɗa su su zama manzanni, na biyu annabawa, na uku malamai, sa’an nan masu yin ayyukan banmamaki, sai masu baiwar warkarwa, da masu taimakon waɗansu, da masu baiwar gudanarwa, sa’an nan kuma masu magana da harsuna iri-iri.
english: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.

hausa: Gama Ubangiji Allah mai girma ne, babban Sarki a bisa dukan alloli.
english: For Yahweh is a great God, a great King above all gods.

hausa: Firistocin kuwa ba su iya yin hidimarsu ba saboda girgijen, gama ɗaukakar Ubangiji ta cika haikalinsa.
english: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house.

hausa: “Wannan shi ne mafarkin, yanzu kuma za mu fassara ta wa sarki.
english: “This is the dream; and we will tell its interpretation before the king.

hausa: Sai maganar Ubangiji ta zo wa Iliya mutumin Tishbe, ta ce,
english: Yahweh’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

hausa: duk wani kayan zare, ko saƙa na lilin, ko ulu, duk wani kayan fata, ko wanda aka yi da fata,
english: whether it is in warp or woof; of linen or of wool; whether in leather, or in anything made of leather;

hausa: Yesu ya ce mata, “Da farko, bari ’ya’ya su ci su ƙoshi tukuna, gama ba daidai ba ne, a ɗauki burodin yara a jefa wa karnukansu.”
english: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

hausa: Dā ku ba mutane ba ne, amma yanzu ku mutanen Allah ne; Dā ba ku karɓi jinƙai ba, amma yanzu kun karɓi jinƙai.
english: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

hausa: Ya sa ƙungiyoyin sojoji a Edom, dukan mutanen Edom kuwa suka zama bayin Dawuda. Ubangiji ya ba Dawuda nasara a ko’ina da ya tafi.
english: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.

hausa: yakan kawo hallaka a mafaka mai ƙarfi yakan kuma mai da birnin mai katanga ya zama kufai).
english: who brings sudden destruction on the strong, so that destruction comes on the fortress.

hausa: Saboda wannan, jita-jita ta bazu a cikin ’yan’uwa cewa wannan almajirin ba zai mutu ba. Amma fa Yesu bai ce ba zai mutu ba; shi dai ya ce, “In na so yă kasance da rai har in dawo, mene ne naka a ciki?”
english: This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”

hausa: Sa’an nan hakimai, da wakilai, da gwamnoni da masu ba wa sarki shawara suka kewaya su. Suka ga wutar ba tă yi musu wani lahani a jikinsu ba, babu ko gashin kansu da ya ƙuna; ko warin wuta ma ba su yi ba.
english: The local governors, the deputies, and the governors, and the king’s counselors, being gathered together, saw these men, that the fire had no power on their bodies. The hair of their head wasn’t singed. Their pants weren’t changed. The smell of fire wasn’t even on them.

hausa: Ya amsa ya ce, “Kina magana kamar wawiya. Alheri kaɗai za mu dinga samu daga Allah ban da wahala?” A cikin wannan duka Ayuba bai yi zunubi ba cikin maganarsa.
english: But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this Job didn’t sin with his lips.

hausa: Yesu ya faɗi wannan ne, don yă nuna irin mutuwar da Bitrus zai yi yă ɗaukaka Allah. Sa’an nan ya ce masa, “Bi ni!”
english: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”

hausa: Bilha, Ezem, Tolad
english: at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,

hausa: Sa’an nan za su san cewa ni ne Ubangiji, sa’ad da suka ga na sa wuta wa Masar aka kuma ragargaza masu taimakonta.
english: They will know that I am Yahweh when I have set a fire in Egypt, and all her helpers are destroyed.

hausa: Ben-Deker, shi ne a Makaz, Sha’albim, Bet-Shemesh da Elon Bet-Hanan;
english: Ben Deker, in Makaz, in Shaalbim, Beth Shemesh, and Elon Beth Hanan;

hausa: Ku faɗa wa Arkiffus yă tabbata ya ƙarasa aikin da ya karɓa cikin Ubangiji.
english: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”

hausa: Ku tuna dā ku bayi ne a Masar, Ubangiji Allahnku kuwa ya fisshe daga can. Shi ya sa na umarce ku ku yi wannan.
english: but you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and Yahweh your God redeemed you there. Therefore I command you to do this thing.

hausa: Manasse yana da shekara ashirin sa’ad da ya zama sarki, ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima shekara hamsin da biyar.
english: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.

hausa: Babban bijimin jeji zai fāɗi tare da su, maruƙan bijimi da manyan bijimai. Ƙasarsu za tă cika da jini, ƙura kuma zai cika da kitse.
english: The wild oxen will come down with them, and the young bulls with the mighty bulls; and their land will be drunken with blood, and their dust made greasy with fat.

hausa: “Ga abin da Ubangiji, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa ka tafi wurin Zedekiya sarkin Yahuda ka faɗa masa, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji yana cewa, ina gab da ba da wannan birni ga sarkin Babilon, zai kuwa ƙone ta.
english: “Yahweh, the God of Israel, says, ‘Go, and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell him, Yahweh says, “Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon and he will burn it with fire.

hausa: Ka kau da dukan fushinka ka kuma juye daga hasalar fushinka.
english: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.

hausa: Yaya aka yi ka fāɗo daga sama Ya tauraron safiya, ɗan hasken asuba! An fyaɗa ka da ƙasa, kai da ka taɓa ƙasƙantar da al’ummai!
english: How you have fallen from heaven, shining one, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low!

hausa: Bayan Lot ya rabu da Abram, sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Abram, “Ɗaga idanunka daga inda kake, ka dubi arewa da kudu, gabas da yamma.
english: Yahweh said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, “Now, lift up your eyes, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,

hausa: Birnin da yake harka ke nan da take zaune lafiya. Ta ce wa kanta, “Ni ce, kuma babu kamata.” Dubi irin kangon da ta zama mana, mazaunin namun jeji! Duk wanda ya wuce ta sai ya yi mata tsaki yana kaɗa kai.
english: This is the joyous city that lived carelessly, that said in her heart, “I am, and there is no one besides me.” How she has become a desolation, a place for animals to lie down in! Everyone who passes by her will hiss and shake their fists.

hausa: Bayan ya ɗauki kwaf ruwan inabi, ya yi godiya, sai ya ce, “Ku karɓa, ku rarraba wa junanku.
english: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, “Take this and share it among yourselves,

hausa: Isra’ila dai ya fi ƙaunar Yusuf fiye da kowanne a cikin sauran ’ya’yansa maza, gama an haifa masa shi a cikin tsufansa. Sai ya yi masa riga mai gwanin kyau.
english: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age, and he made him a tunic of many colors.

hausa: Allah ya ce wa Musa, “NI NE wanda NINE. Abin da za ka faɗa wa Isra’ilawa ke nan cewa, ‘NI NE, ya aiko ni wurinku.’ ”
english: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM,” and he said, “You shall tell the children of Israel this: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’”

hausa: Ku ɗauki karkiyata a kanku, ku kuma yi koyi da ni, gama ni mai tawali’u ne marar girman kai, za ku kuwa sami hutu don rayukanku.
english: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.

hausa: Da muka sami almajirai a can, sai muka zauna da su kwana bakwai. Ta wurin Ruhu, suka yi ƙoƙari su hana Bulus wucewa zuwa Urushalima.
english: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit that he should not go up to Jerusalem.

hausa: “Kun faɗi mugayen abubuwa a kaina,” in ji Ubangiji. “Duk da haka kuka ce, ‘Me muka faɗa a kanka?’
english: “Your words have been harsh against me,” says Yahweh. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against you?’

hausa: Mutumin da ya karɓi talenti biyar, nan da nan ya tafi ya yi kasuwanci da su har ya sami ribar talenti biyar.
english: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.

hausa: A wannan lokaci na kuma ce wa mutane, “A sa kowane mutum da mataimakinsa su zauna a Urushalima da dare, domin a yi tsaro da dare, da safe kuma a kama aiki.”
english: Likewise at the same time I said to the people, “Let everyone with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and may labor in the day.”

hausa: Kana jin daɗin ba ni wahala, don me ka yashe ni, abin da ka halitta da hannunka, yayinda kake murmushi game da shirye-shiryen mugaye?
english: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?

hausa: Gama in, ta wurin laifin mutum ɗaya, mutuwa ta yi mulki ta wurin mutum ɗayan nan, ashe, waɗanda suka sami kyautar alherin Allah a yalwace da kuma kyautar adalci za su yi mulki a wannan rayuwa ta wurin mutum ɗayan nan, Yesu Kiristi.
english: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

hausa: Sai babban firist da dukan abokan aikinsa, waɗanda suke na ƙungiyar Sadukiyawa suka cika da kishi.
english: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy

hausa: domin ba su iya jimrewa da abin da aka umarta cewa, “Ko da ma dabba ce ta taɓa dutsen, dole a jajjefe ta da duwatsu.”
english: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”.

hausa: Garuruwan kabilar Yahuda da suke kudu cikin Negeb zuwa iyakar Edom su ne. Kabzeyel, Eder, Yagur,
english: The farthest cities of the tribe of the children of Judah toward the border of Edom in the South were Kabzeel, Eder, Jagur,

hausa: Dubi yadda masu aikata zunubi suka fāɗi, a zube, ba za su kuwa iya tashi ba!
english: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.

hausa: “Duk wanda ya gudu daga razana zai fāɗa cikin rami, duk wanda ya haura daga rami zai fāɗa cikin tarko; gama zan kawo wa Mowab shekarar hukuncinta,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: “He who flees from the terror will fall into the pit; and he who gets up out of the pit will be taken in the snare, for I will bring on him, even on Moab, the year of their visitation,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Ku tuna da wannan, kada kuma ku manta yadda kuka tsokane Ubangiji Allahnku, har ya yi fushi a hamada. Daga ranar da kuka bar Masar har sai da kuka isa nan, kuna ta tawaye wa Ubangiji.
english: Remember, and don’t forget, how you provoked Yahweh your God to wrath in the wilderness. From the day that you left the land of Egypt until you came to this place, you have been rebellious against Yahweh.

hausa: Kamar ruwan da ya zuba a ƙasa, wanda ba a iya kwasa, haka dole mu mutu. Amma Allah ba ya ɗaukan rai; a maimako, yakan ƙirƙiro hanyoyi domin mutumin da aka kora kada yă kasance yasasshe daga gare shi.
english: For we must die, and are like water spilled on the ground, which can’t be gathered up again; neither does God take away life, but devises means, that he who is banished not be an outcast from him.

hausa: “Amma ya tsaya shi kaɗai, kuma wa ya isa yă ja da shi? Yana yin abin da yake so.
english: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.

hausa: Kowane abu mai kyau da kuma kowace cikakkiyar kyauta daga sama suke, sun sauko ne daga wurin Uban haskoki, wanda ba sauyawa ko wata alamar sākewa a gare shi faufau.
english: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “Wani mutum yana shirya wani babban biki, ya kuma gayyaci baƙi da yawa.
english: But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.

hausa: Amma Solomon bai mai da Isra’ilawa bayi don aikinsa ba; su ne mayaƙansa, shugabannin hafsoshinsa, da shugabannin keken yaƙinsa da kuma mahayan keken yaƙinsa.
english: But of the children of Israel, Solomon made no servants for his work, but they were men of war, chief of his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.

hausa: Sa’ad da dukan dattawan Isra’ila suka iso, Lawiyawa suka ɗauki akwatin alkawarin,
english: All the elders of Israel came. The Levites took up the ark.

hausa: Idan baƙon da yake baƙunci a cikinku, ko kowane ne da yake tare da ku a dukan zamananku, yana so yă ba da hadayar da akan yi da wuta don a yi ƙanshi mai daɗi ga Ubangiji, dole yă yi kamar yadda kuke yi.
english: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, as you do, so he shall do.

hausa: Kada zuciyarku tă yi suwu ko ku ji tsoro sa’ad da aka ji labarin a ƙasar, labari guda a wannan shekara, wani kuma a ta biye, labarin hargitsi a ƙasar mai mulki ya tasar wa mai mulki.
english: Don’t let your heart faint. Don’t fear for the news that will be heard in the land. For news will come one year, and after that in another year news will come, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.

hausa: “Ka ga wahalar kakanninmu a Masar; ka kuwa ji kukansu a Jan Teku.
english: “You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red Sea,

hausa: Ta haka Solomon da dukan Isra’ila, wato, babban taro, suka yi bikin a lokacin. Mutane suka zo, tun daga Lebo Hamat har zuwa Rafin Masar. Suka yi biki a gaban Ubangiji Allahnmu, kwana bakwai. Suka kuma ƙara kwana bakwai, kwanaki goma sha huɗu gaba ɗaya.
english: So Solomon held the feast at that time, and all Israel with him, a great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt, before Yahweh our God, seven days and seven more days, even fourteen days.

hausa: Mai girmankai da kuma mai fariya, “Mai ba’a” ne sunansa; yana yin abubuwa da girmankai ainun.
english: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.

hausa: Zuriyar surukin Musa, Keniyawa, suka haura daga Birnin dabino tare da mutanen Yahuda don su zauna cikin mutanen Hamadan Yahuda a cikin Negeb kusa da Arad.
english: The children of the Kenite, Moses’ brother-in-law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the south of Arad; and they went and lived with the people.

hausa: Bitrus ya amsa ya ce, “Ko da duka sun ja da baya saboda kai, ba zan taɓa ja da baya ba.”
english: But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”

hausa: Shawulu ya ce masa, “Don me ka gama baki da ɗan Yesse a kaina har ka ba shi burodi da takobin (Goliyat), ka kuma roƙi Allah don yă tayar mini, yă kuma yi fakona kamar yadda yake yi yau?”
english: Saul said to him, “Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, in that you have given him bread, and a sword, and have inquired of God for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as it is today?”

hausa: Ya kama Agag sarkin Amalekawa da rai. Ya kuma hallaka dukan mutanensa da takobi.
english: He took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive, and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword.

hausa: “Ka yi kira in kana so, amma wa zai amsa maka? Wurin waɗanne tsarkaka za ka juya?
english: “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?

hausa: Ubangiji Maɗaukaki yana tare da mu; Allah na Yaƙub ne kagararmu. Sela
english: Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

hausa: Sau uku a shekara dukan maza su bayyana a gaban Ubangiji Allahnku a wurin da ya zaɓa; a Bikin Burodi Marar Yisti, da a Bikin Makoni, da kuma a Bikin Tabanakul. Babu wani da zai bayyana a gaban Ubangiji hannu wofi.
english: Three times in a year all of your males shall appear before Yahweh your God in the place which he chooses: in the feast of unleavened bread, in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of booths. They shall not appear before Yahweh empty.

hausa: Yayinda sarki yake wucewa, sai annabin ya yi kira da ƙarfi gare shi ya ce “Ni bawanka na tafi yaƙi, sai ga wani ya kawo mini wani mutum, ya ce, ‘Ka riƙe wannan mutum, kada ka bar shi yă kuɓuta ko da ƙaƙa, idan ka bari ya kuɓuta, a bakin ranka, ko kuwa ka biya talanti ɗaya na azurfa.’
english: As the king passed by, he cried to the king, and he said, “Your servant went out into the middle of the battle; and behold, a man came over and brought a man to me, and said, ‘Guard this man! If by any means he is missing, then your life shall be for his life, or else you shall pay a talent of silver.’

hausa: Kada ku ci abin da kun samu ya riga ya mutu. Za ku iya ba wa baren da yake zama a cikin wani daga biranenku, zai kuwa iya cinsa, ko kuwa za ku iya sayar da shi wa baƙo. Amma ku jama’a ce mai tsarki ga Ubangiji Allahnku. Kada ku dafa ɗan akuya a cikin madara mamansa.
english: You shall not eat of anything that dies of itself. You may give it to the foreigner living among you who is within your gates, that he may eat it; or you may sell it to a foreigner; for you are a holy people to Yahweh your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.

hausa: Sa’an nan suka yi rammuka hamsin a gefen labule na kashe na farko, haka kuma a gefen labule na ƙarshen na kashi biyar.
english: He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling.

hausa: Mutumin kirki kan sami tagomashi daga Ubangiji, amma Ubangiji yakan hukunta mai son yin wayo.
english: A good man shall obtain favor from Yahweh, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.

hausa: Amma duk wanda ya kāsa samuna ya cuci kansa; dukan waɗanda suke ƙina suna ƙaunar mutuwa ke nan.”
english: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”

hausa: Gama wannan Allah shi ne Allahnmu har abada abadin; zai zama jagorarmu har zuwa ƙarshe.
english: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.

hausa: Ga rahoton da suka aika masa. Zuwa ga Sarki Dariyus. Gaisuwa da fatan alheri.
english: They sent a letter to him, in which was written: To Darius the king, all peace.

hausa: Ba haka kawai ba, amma muna kuma da farin ciki cikin shan wuyanmu, gama mun san cewa shan wuyan nan takan haifi jimiri;
english: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;

hausa: Ya gina masujadan kan tudu a tuddan Yahuda, ya kuma sa mutanen Urushalima suka yi karuwanci, ya sa Yahuda suka kauce.
english: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah, and made the inhabitants of Jerusalem play the prostitute, and led Judah astray.

hausa: Zuriyar Salma su ne, Betlehem, Netofawa, Atrot Bet Yowab, rabin Manahatiyawa, Zoriyawa,
english: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.

hausa: Ba za mu iya ba su ’yan matanmu su zama matansu ba, da yake mu Isra’ilawa mun riga mun yi wannan rantsuwa cewa, ‘La’ananne ne wanda ya ba da ’yarsa aure ga mutum Benyamin.’
english: However, we may not give them wives of our daughters, for the children of Israel had sworn, saying, ‘Cursed is he who gives a wife to Benjamin.’”

hausa: Ki sha kunyarki, gama kin yi rangwame wa ’yan’uwanki mata. Saboda zunubanki sun yi muni fiye da nasu, sai suka zama kamar sun fi ki adalci. Saboda haka, ki sha kunya ki kuma sha ƙasƙancinki, gama kin sa ’yan’uwanki mata suka zama kamar su masu adalci ne.
english: You also bear your own shame yourself, in that you have given judgment for your sisters; through your sins that you have committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous than you. Yes, be also confounded, and bear your shame, in that you have justified your sisters.

hausa: Yesu ya amsa ya ce, “In ma na ɗaukaka kaina, ɗaukakata ba kome ba ce. Ubana, wanda kuke cewa shi ne Allahnku, shi ne wanda yake ɗaukaka ni.
english: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.

hausa: Yana tare da Dawuda a Fas Dammim sa’ad da Filistiyawa suka taru can don yaƙi. A wani wuri inda akwai gona cike da sha’ir, sojoji suka gudu daga Filistiyawa.
english: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

hausa: Saboda haka, “suna a gaban kursiyin Allah suna masa hidima dare da rana a cikin haikalinsa; kuma wannan mai zaune a kursiyin zai shimfiɗa tentinsa a bisansu.
english: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.

hausa: Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki, Allah na Isra’ila, yana cewa, “Zan hukunta sarkin Babilon da ƙasarsa yadda na hukunta sarkin Assuriya.
english: Therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.

hausa: Saboda haka, duk wanda ya yi tawaye ga hukuma yana yin tawaye da abin da Allah ya naɗa ne, waɗanda kuwa suke aikata haka, za su jawo wa kansu hukunci.
english: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne kabilan Benyamin, jimillarsu ta kai 45,600.
english: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.

hausa: da za ka neme ni da laifi ka hukunta ni?
english: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?

hausa: Sa’an nan Yowab da rundunar da take tare da shi suka ci gaba don su gabza da Arameyawa, Arameyawa kuwa suka gudu a gabansa.
english: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the battle against the Syrians, and they fled before him.

hausa: Dukan yini da dukan dare da kuma kashegari, mutane suka fito suka tattara makware. Ba wanda ya kāsa tara ƙasa da garwa goma. Sai suka shanya abinsu kewaye da sansanin.
english: The people rose up all that day, and all of that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers; and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp.

hausa: Suka kuma kama Lot ɗan ɗan’uwan Abram, wanda yake zaune a Sodom, da kayayyakinsa, suka yi tafiyarsu.
english: They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

hausa: Kada ku zama kamar kakanninku, waɗanda annabawa na dā suka ce musu, ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, ‘Ku juya daga mugayen hanyoyinku da mugayen abubuwan da kuke yi.’ Amma ba su saurara ba, ko ma su kula da ni, in ji Ubangiji.
english: Don’t you be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying: Yahweh of Armies says, ‘Return now from your evil ways and from your evil doings;’ but they didn’t hear nor listen to me, says Yahweh.

hausa: Ya ce musu, “Ba naku ba ne ku san lokuta ko ranakun da Uban ya shirya cikin ikonsa.
english: He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.

hausa: Isra’ilawa duka suka taru a Shilo suka kafa tenti inda za su dinga taruwa. Yanzu ƙasar tana ƙarƙashin mulkinsu,
english: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The land was subdued before them.

hausa: “A ranan nan kowane annabi zai ji kunyar annabcin wahayinsa. Ba zai sa rigar annabci mai gashi ba don yă yi ruɗu.
english: It will happen in that day that the prophets will each be ashamed of his vision when he prophesies; they won’t wear a hairy mantle to deceive,

hausa: “ ‘Saboda haka sai ku bambanta tsakanin dabbobi masu tsarki da marasa tsarki, da kuma tsakanin tsuntsaye masu tsarki da marasa tsarki. Kada ku ƙazantar da kanku ta wurin wata dabba, ko tsuntsu, ko wani abin da yake rarrafe a ƙasa, waɗanda na keɓe a matsayi marasa tsarki a gare ku.
english: “‘You shall therefore make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean. You shall not make yourselves abominable by animal, or by bird, or by anything with which the ground teems, which I have separated from you as unclean for you.

hausa: Zai sha daga rafin da yake kusa da hanya; saboda haka zai ɗaga kansa sama.
english: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.

hausa: A jeri na biyu, a sa turkuwoyis, da saffaya, da emeral.
english: and the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;

hausa: “Ka rufe kanka da fushi, ka fafare mu; ka karkashe mu ba tausayi.
english: “You have covered us with anger and pursued us. You have killed. You have not pitied.

hausa: A cikinsa zukatanmu na farin ciki, gama mun dogara cikin sunansa mai tsarki.
english: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

hausa: ya kuma yi mulki a Urushalima shekaru uku. Sunan mahaifiyarsa Mikahiya ce, ’yar Uriyel na Gibeya. Aka kasance da yaƙe-yaƙe tsakanin Abiya da Yerobowam.
english: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

hausa: Sa’an nan na ga dabbar da sarakunan duniya da mayaƙansu sun taru don su yi yaƙi da wannan wanda yake kan farin dokin da kuma mayaƙansa.
english: I saw the beast, the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him who sat on the horse and against his army.

hausa: Zan aika da takobi, yunwa da annoba a kansu sai an hallaka su sarai daga ƙasar da na ba su da kuma kakanninsu.’ ”
english: I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence among them, until they are consumed from off the land that I gave to them and to their fathers.’”

hausa: Dukan mutane suka lura suka kuma ji daɗi ƙwarai, tabbatacce kome da sarki ya yi, ya gamshe su.
english: All the people took notice of it, and it pleased them, as whatever the king did pleased all the people.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Ka tattaro mini dattawa saba’in daga cikin mutanen Isra’ila, waɗanda aka sani su ne dattawa da kuma shugabanni a cikin jama’a. Ka sa su zo Tentin Sujada, su tsaya a can tare da kai.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.

hausa: Ko da yake zunubanmu suna ba da shaida a kanmu, Ya Ubangiji, ka yi wani abu saboda sunanka. Gama jan bayanmu ya yi yawa; mun yi maka zunubi.
english: Though our iniquities testify against us, work for your name’s sake, Yahweh; for our rebellions are many. We have sinned against you.

hausa: Ku ƙone siffar allolinsu da wuta. Kada ku yi ƙyashin azurfa ko zinariyar da aka rufe allolin da ita, Kada ku kwashe su, don kada su zamar muku tarko, gama abin ƙyama ne ga Ubangiji Allahnku.
english: You shall burn the engraved images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or the gold that is on them, nor take it for yourself, lest you be snared in it; for it is an abomination to Yahweh your God.

hausa: Almajiran suka tambaye shi suka ce, “To, me ya sa malaman dokoki suke cewa, dole sai Iliya ya fara zuwa?”
english: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

hausa: Cikin mutuncina ka riƙe ni ka sa ni a gabanka har abada.
english: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.

hausa: Yesu ya ce musu, “Gaskiya nake gaya muku, a lokacin sabunta dukan kome, sa’ad da Ɗan Mutum ya zauna a kan kursiyinsa mai daraja, ku da kuka bi ni, ku ma za ku zauna a kan kursiyoyi goma sha biyu, kuna yi wa kabilu goma sha biyu na Isra’ila shari’a.
english: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

hausa: Akwatin Alkawarin Allah ya zauna tare da iyalin Obed-Edom a gidansa wata uku, Ubangiji kuwa ya albarkaci gidan Obed-Edom da kome da yake da shi.
english: God’s ark remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months; and Yahweh blessed Obed-Edom’s house and all that he had.

hausa: A kwanakin nan sai Hezekiya ya kamu da ciwo ya kuma kusa ya mutu. Annabi Ishaya ɗan Amoz ya tafi wurinsa ya kuma ce, “Ga abin da Ubangiji ya ce ka shirya gidanka, domin za ka mutu; ba za ka warke ba.”
english: In those days Hezekiah was sick and near death. Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him, and said to him, “Yahweh says, ‘Set your house in order, for you will die, and not live.’”

hausa: Ahaziya ya tafi tare da Yoram ɗan Ahab don su yaƙi Hazayel sarkin Aram a Ramot Gileyad. Arameyawa suka yi wa Yoram rauni;
english: He went with Joram the son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead, and the Syrians wounded Joram.

hausa: Na rubuta musu abubuwa masu yawa na dokata, amma suka ɗauke su tamƙar wani baƙon abu ne.
english: I wrote for him the many things of my law, but they were regarded as a strange thing.

hausa: “In gobara ta tashi, ta kuma bazu cikin ƙayayyuwa, har ta cinye tarin hatsi, ko hatsin da ke tsaye, ko dukan gonar, dole wanda ya sa wutar, yă biya taran da aka yanka masa saboda ɓarnan da wutar ta yi.
english: “If fire breaks out, and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

hausa: Ya yarda da shi su gina jiragen ruwan kasuwanci. Bayan aka gina waɗannan a Eziyon Geber,
english: He joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish. They made the ships in Ezion Geber.

hausa: “Ɗan mutum, mutanen da suke zama a waɗannan kufai a ƙasar Isra’ila suna cewa, ‘Ibrahim mutum ɗaya ne kaɗai, duk da haka Ibrahim ya mallaki ƙasar. Amma mu da muke da yawa; lalle an ba mu ƙasar ta zama mallakarmu.’
english: “Son of man, those who inhabit the waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying, ‘Abraham was one, and he inherited the land; but we are many. The land is given us for inheritance.’

hausa: “ ‘Firistoci za su kiyaye umarnaina don kada su yi laifi su mutu saboda sun rena su. Ni ne Ubangiji, wanda ya mai da su masu tsarki.
english: “‘They shall therefore follow my commandment, lest they bear sin for it and die in it, if they profane it. I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.

hausa: “Ka yi magana da Isra’ilawa, ka kuma karɓi sanduna goma sha biyu daga wurinsu, sanda guda daga kowane shugaban gidan kakanninsu. Ka rubuta sunan kowa a sandansa.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and take rods from them, one for each fathers’ house, of all their princes according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods. Write each man’s name on his rod.

hausa: Wace riba ce mutum yake samu daga wahalar da yake fama a duniya?
english: What does man gain from all his labor in which he labors under the sun?

hausa: Amariya, Malluk, Hattush
english: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,

hausa: “ ‘Ku aske gashin kanku ku zubar; ku yi makoki a filayen tuddai, gama Ubangiji ya ƙi ’yan zamanin nan ya kuma rabu da su saboda fushin da suka ba shi.
english: Cut off your hair, and throw it away, and take up a lamentation on the bare heights; for Yahweh has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.

hausa: Wa zai kawo ni birnin katanga? Wa zai bishe ni zuwa Edom?
english: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?

hausa: Yesu ya amsa musu ya ce, “Ai, masu lafiya ba sa bukatar likita, sai dai marasa lafiya.
english: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

hausa: Ka ce wa kanka cewa ka ci Edom da yaƙi, yanzu kuwa kana fariya da ɗaga kai. Amma tsaya dai a gida! Me ya sa kake neman faɗa kana neman fāɗuwarka da ta Yahuda?”
english: You say to yourself that you have struck Edom; and your heart lifts you up to boast. Now stay at home. Why should you meddle with trouble, that you should fall, even you and Judah with you?’”

hausa: “Har wa yau, ina gaya muku cewa in mutum biyu a cikinku a duniya suka yarda su roƙi wani abu, Ubana da yake cikin sama zai yi muku.
english: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.

hausa: Suka tashi, suka fitar da Yesu bayan gari, suka kai shi goshin tudun da aka gina garin, don su ture shi ƙasa,
english: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.

hausa: Amma wannan maganar Ubangiji ta zo mini, ‘Ka zub da jini mai yawa ka kuma yi yaƙe-yaƙe masu yawa. Ba za ka gina gida domin Sunana ba, domin ka zub da jini da yawa a duniya a idona.
english: But Yahweh’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.

hausa: Wannan ne zai zama hukuncin Masar da kuma na dukan al’umman da ba su haura sun yi Bikin Tabanakul ba.
english: This will be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.

hausa: Ga su, tsoro ya sha kansu, gama Allah yana cikin ƙungiyar adalai.
english: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.

hausa: Mutumin da yake bakin mutuwa ya sa mini albarka. Na faranta wa gwauruwa zuciya.
english: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

hausa: Za su ba ku bashi, amma ba za ku ba su bashi ba. Za su zama kai, ku kuwa za ku zama wutsiya.
english: He will lend to you, and you won’t lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.

hausa: “In za ka komo, ya Isra’ila, ka komo gare ni,” in ji Ubangiji. “In ka kau da gumakanka masu banƙyama daga gabana ba ka ƙara karkace ba,
english: “If you will return, Israel,” says Yahweh, “if you will return to me, and if you will put away your abominations out of my sight; then you will not be removed;

hausa: Amma Ubangiji Maɗaukaki zai sami ɗaukaka ta wurin aikata gaskiya, kuma Allah mai tsarki zai nuna kansa ta wurin adalcinsa.
english: but Yahweh of Armies is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness.

hausa: A Bikin kuwa, Yahudawa suka yi ta nemansa, suna cewa, “Ina mutumin yake?”
english: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”

hausa: ɗan fari shi ne Uz, ɗan’uwansa kuma Buz, Kemuwel (shi ne mahaifin Aram),
english: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,

hausa: Hadad, Tema, Yetur, Nafish da Kedema.
english: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.

hausa: Gama ya yi mulki a bisa dukan masarautai yamma da Kogi, daga Tifsa zuwa Gaza, aka kuwa sami zaman lafiya a kowane gefe.
english: For he had dominion over all on this side of the River, from Tiphsah even to Gaza, over all the kings on this side of the River; and he had peace on all sides around him.

hausa: Mun dai san inda mutumin nan ya fito; amma sa’ad da Kiristi ya zo ba wanda zai san inda ya fito.”
english: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”

hausa: Ta wurin bangaskiya ya kiyaye Bikin Ƙetarewa ya kuma yayyafa jini, domin kada mai hallakar ’ya’yan fari yă taɓa ’ya’yan fari na Isra’ila.
english: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.

hausa: Yesu ya tsawata masa da ƙarfin cewa, “Yi shiru! Ka fita daga cikinsa!” Sai aljanin ya fyaɗa mutumin da ƙasa a gabansu duka, sa’an nan ya fita, ya bar shi ba wani rauni.
english: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent and come out of him!” When the demon had thrown him down in the middle of them, he came out of him, having done him no harm.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya kuma yi magana da Musa ya ce,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: Ikonsa na Allahntaka ya ba mu kome da muke bukata don rayuwa da kuma tsoron Allah ta wurin sanin wanda ya kira mu ta wurin ɗaukakarsa da nagartarsa.
english: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,

hausa: Bayi suna mulki a kanmu, kuma ba wanda zai ’yantar da mu daga hannuwansu.
english: Servants rule over us. There is no one to deliver us out of their hand.

hausa: Mutum hamsin na ƙungiyar annabawa suka je suka tsaya da nisa, suna fuskantar inda Iliya da Elisha suka tsaya a Urdun.
english: Fifty men of the sons of the prophets went and stood opposite them at a distance; and they both stood by the Jordan.

hausa: Amma Yehoshafat ya kuma ce wa sarkin Isra’ila, “Da fari mu nemi bishewar Ubangiji.”
english: Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, “Please inquire first for Yahweh’s word.”

hausa: Sai wanda ba shi da laifi kuma yana yin abin da yake daidai, wanda yake faɗin gaskiya daga zuciyarsa
english: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;

hausa: Amma fa, ga kai, zan ɗauke ka, za ka kuwa yi mulki bisa dukan abin da zuciyarka take so; za ka zama sarki a bisa Isra’ila.
english: I will take you, and you shall reign according to all that your soul desires, and shall be king over Israel.

hausa: Bugu da ƙari, Yahudawa da shugabanni ɗari da hamsin suna ci daga teburina, haka ma waɗanda suka zo wurinmu daga ƙasashen da suke kewaye.
english: Moreover there were at my table, of the Jews and the rulers, one hundred fifty men, in addition to those who came to us from among the nations that were around us.

hausa: Ya nemi nufin Ubangiji amma bai sami amsa daga wurin Ubangiji ko ta wurin mafarki, ko ta wurin Urim, ko ta wurin annabawa ba.
english: When Saul inquired of Yahweh, Yahweh didn’t answer him by dreams, by Urim, or by prophets.

hausa: Midiyawa suka talauce Isra’ilawa ƙwarai, har ya sa suka yi kuka ga Ubangiji don taimako.
english: Israel was brought very low because of Midian; and the children of Israel cried to Yahweh.

hausa: Sarki Yehohiyakim ya aiki Elnatan ɗan Akbor zuwa Masar, tare da waɗansu mutane.
english: Then Jehoiakim the king sent Elnathan the son of Achbor and certain men with him into Egypt.

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Yehu, “Tun da yake ka aikata abin da yake mai kyau a idanuna, ka kuma yi wa gidan Ahab dukan abin da yake a zuciyata, ina yin maka alkawari cewa zuriyarka za su yi mulkin Isra’ila har tsara ta huɗu.”
english: Yahweh said to Jehu, “Because you have done well in executing that which is right in my eyes, and have done to Ahab’s house according to all that was in my heart, your descendants shall sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation.”

hausa: “Na bar ku da yunwa a kowace birni, da kuma rashin abinci a kowane gari, duk da haka ba ku juyo gare ni ba,” in ji Ubangiji.
english: “I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and lack of bread in every town; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.

hausa: Tun da yake muna ƙarƙashin fada, bai kyautu mu bari a rena sarki ba, Saboda haka muke sanar da sarki,
english: Now because we eat the salt of the palace and it is not appropriate for us to see the king’s dishonor, therefore we have sent and informed the king,

hausa: Sai Yusuf ya sāke yin wani mafarki, ya faɗa wa ’yan’uwansa. Ya ce, “Ku saurara, na sāke yin wani mafarki, a wannan lokaci, na ga rana da wata da taurari goma sha ɗaya suna rusuna mini.”
english: He dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brothers, and said, “Behold, I have dreamed yet another dream: and behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.”

hausa: Sai wani daga cikin bayin babban firist dangin wanda Bitrus ya sare wa kunne, ya tambaya shi ya ce, “Kana tsammani ban gan ka tare da shi a gonar zaitun ba?”
english: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”

hausa: Ni ne Ubangiji Allahnku wanda ya fitar da ku daga Masar. Ku buɗe bakinku zan kuwa cika shi.
english: I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

hausa: Mutum ba zai ƙara koya wa maƙwabcinsa ba, balle mutum yă ce wa ɗan’uwansa, ‘Ka san Ubangiji,’ domin dukansu za su san ni, daga ƙaraminsu zuwa babba.
english: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.

hausa: Yahudawa da yawa suka karanta wannan sanarwa, gama inda aka gicciye Yesu yana kusa da birni. An kuwa rubuta sanarwar da Arameyanci, Romanci da kuma Girik.
english: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.

hausa: Ubangiji Allah mai kishi ne, mai sakayya kuma. Ubangiji Allah mai kishi ne, mai ɗaukar fansa kuma. Ubangiji yakan ɗauki fansa a kan maƙiyansa, yakan ci gaba da fushi a kan abokan gābansa.
english: Yahweh is a jealous God and avenges. Yahweh avenges and is full of wrath. Yahweh takes vengeance on his adversaries, and he maintains wrath against his enemies.

hausa: Waɗannan umarnai da nake ba ku a yau, za su kasance a zukatanku.
english: These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;

hausa: In na yi zunubi kana kallo na kuma ba za ka fasa ba ni horo ba don laifin da na yi.
english: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.

hausa: Yakan ce wa dusar ƙanƙara, ‘Fāɗo a kan duniya,’ ya kuma ce wa ruwa, ‘Zubo da ƙarfi.’
english: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.

hausa: “Ki tashi ki yi sussuka, ya Diyar Sihiyona, gama zan ba ki ƙahonin ƙarfe; zan ba ki kofatan tagulla domin ki ragargaje al’ummai masu yawa.” Za ki ba Ubangiji dukan dukiyarsu da suka tara ta hanyar zamba, wadatarsu kuma ga Ubangiji dukan duniya.
english: Arise and thresh, daughter of Zion, for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hoofs bronze. You will beat in pieces many peoples. I will devote their gain to Yahweh, and their substance to the Lord of the whole earth.

hausa: Ku yi haka in kun sami jakin ɗan’uwanku, ko rigarsa, ko kowane abin da ya ɓace. Kada ku ƙyale shi.
english: So you shall do with his donkey. So you shall do with his garment. So you shall do with every lost thing of your brother’s, which he has lost and you have found. You may not hide yourself.

hausa: Amma Yowash sarkin Yahuda ya kwashe tsarkakan kayan da kakanninsa, Yehoshafat, Yehoram da Ahaziya, sarakunan Yahuda suka keɓe, da kyautai da shi kansa ya keɓe, da kuma dukan azurfan da aka samu a ɗakunan ajiya haikalin Ubangiji da na fada, ya aika da su wa Hazayel sarkin Aram, shi kuma ya janye daga Urushalima.
english: Jehoash king of Judah took all the holy things that Jehoshaphat and Jehoram and Ahaziah, his fathers, kings of Judah, had dedicated, and his own holy things, and all the gold that was found in the treasures of Yahweh’s house, and of the king’s house, and sent it to Hazael king of Syria; and he went away from Jerusalem.

hausa: In ba haka ba, ƙasar da ka fitar da mu, za tă ce, ‘Domin Ubangiji bai iya kai su cikin ƙasar da ya yi musu alkawari ba ne, kuma domin ya ƙi su, shi ya sa ya fitar da su ya kashe su a hamada.’
english: lest the land you brought us out from say, ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring them into the land which he promised to them, and because he hated them, he has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.’

hausa: Saboda haka Uriya firist ya gina bagaden bisa ga tsarin da Sarki Ahaz ya aika masa daga Damaskus, ya kuma gama shi kafin Sarki Ahaz yă dawo.
english: Urijah the priest built an altar. According to all that King Ahaz had sent from Damascus, so Urijah the priest made it for the coming of King Ahaz from Damascus.

hausa: Dukan al’ummai su taru mutane kuma su tattaru. Wane ne a cikinsu ya yi faɗar wannan ya kuma yi mana shelar abubuwan da suka riga suka faru? Bari su kawo shaidunsu don su tabbatar cewa sun yi daidai, don waɗansu su ji su kuma ce, “Gaskiya ne.”
english: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the peoples be assembled. Who among them can declare this, and show us former things? Let them bring their witnesses, that they may be justified, or let them hear, and say, “That is true.”

hausa: Za a ajiye su waje da labulen Wuri Mafi Tsarki a Tentin Sujada, Haruna zai riƙa kula da fitilun a gaban Ubangiji, daga yamma zuwa safiya. Wannan za tă zama dawwammamiyar farilla wa tsararraki masu zuwa.
english: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before Yahweh continually. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

hausa: Ba za a taɓa rufe ƙofofin birnin da rana ba, gama ba za a yi dare a can ba.
english: Its gates will in no way be shut by day (for there will be no night there),

hausa: Allah ya yi magana daga wurinsa mai tsarki, “Da nasara zan rarraba Shekem in kuma auna Kwarin Sukkot.
english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

hausa: Ashe, shanunsu, dukiyarsu da dukan sauran dabbobinsu, ba za su zama namu ba? Saboda haka mu yarda, za su kuwa zauna a cikinmu.”
english: Won’t their livestock and their possessions and all their animals be ours? Only let’s give our consent to them, and they will dwell with us.”

hausa: Waɗannan mugayen mutane, waɗanda suka ƙi saurari maganata, waɗanda suka biye wa taurin zuciyarsu suka bi waɗansu alloli don su bauta su kuma yi musu sujada, za su zama kamar wannan abin ɗamara gaba ɗaya marasa amfani!
english: This evil people, who refuse to hear my words, who walk in the stubbornness of their heart, and have gone after other gods to serve them and to worship them, will even be as this belt, which is profitable for nothing.

hausa: Amma in wani wanda ya fi shi ƙarfi, ya faɗa masa ya kuma sha ƙarfinsa, yakan ƙwace makaman da mutumin ke dogara da su, ya kuma rarraba ganima.
english: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.

hausa: Manzannin suka bar Majalisar, suna farin ciki domin an ga sun cancanta a kunyata su saboda Sunan nan.
english: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.

hausa: Fir’auna ya ce, “Wane ne Ubangiji da zan yi biyayya da shi, har in bar Isra’ila su tafi? Ban san Ubangiji ba, kuma ba zan bar Isra’ila su tafi ba.”
english: Pharaoh said, “Who is Yahweh, that I should listen to his voice to let Israel go? I don’t know Yahweh, and moreover I will not let Israel go.”

hausa: Gama daga zuciya ne mugayen tunani, kisankai, zina, fasikanci, sata, shaidar ƙarya, ɓatan suna, suka fitowa.
english: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.

hausa: Raina yana baƙin ciki a cikina; saboda haka zan tuna da kai daga ƙasar Urdun, a ƙwanƙolin Hermon, daga Dutsen Mizar.
english: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.

hausa: Maganarka ta ƙarfafa waɗanda suka yi tuntuɓe; ka ƙarfafa gwiwoyin da suka rasa ƙarfinsu.
english: Your words have supported him who was falling, you have made the feeble knees firm.

hausa: Sai mala’ikan da yake magana da ni ya ce, “Ka yi shelar maganan nan, ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, ‘Ina kishi domin Urushalima da Sihiyona,
english: So the angel who talked with me said to me, “Proclaim, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.

hausa: Sawunsa sun yi kamar tagullar da take haske cikin matoya, muryarsa kuma ta yi kamar muryar ruwaye masu gudu.
english: His feet were like burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace. His voice was like the voice of many waters.

hausa: Sarakunan duniya sun ja dāgā, masu mulki kuma sun taru gaba ɗaya, suna gāba da Ubangiji da kuma Shafaffensa.’
english: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers plot together, against the Lord, and against his Christ.’

hausa: Ya ta da ginshiƙai a shirayin haikali. Ya ba wa ginshiƙi na wajen kudu sunan Yakin, na wajen arewa kuma ya kira Bowaz.
english: He set up the pillars at the porch of the temple. He set up the right pillar and called its name Jachin; and he set up the left pillar and called its name Boaz.

hausa: Na sayi bayi mata da maza, ina kuma da waɗansu bayin da aka haifa a gidana. Ina da garkunan shanu da na tumaki da na awaki fiye da duk wanda ya taɓa zama a Urushalima kafin ni.
english: I bought male servants and female servants, and had servants born in my house. I also had great possessions of herds and flocks, above all who were before me in Jerusalem.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji Allah ya ce wa matar, “Me ke nan kika yi?” Matar ta ce, “Macijin ne ya ruɗe ni, na kuwa ci.”
english: Yahweh God said to the woman, “What have you done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”

hausa: ’Ya’yan Izhar maza, su ne, Kora, Nefeg da Zikri.
english: The sons of Izhar: Korah, and Nepheg, and Zichri.

hausa: Sa’ad da hadiri ya taso, yakan watsar da mugaye, amma adalai za su tsaya daram har abada.
english: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.

hausa: Ƙauna ba ta ƙarewa. Amma in akwai annabci zai shuɗe, harsuna su ɓace, ilimi kuma zai ƙare.
english: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

hausa: Dutse yana da nauyi yashi kuma wahala ce, amma tsokanar wawa ta fi su duka nauyi.
english: A stone is heavy, and sand is a burden; but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.

hausa: Sai masanan taurarin suka amsa wa sarki da Arameyanci “Ran sarki yă daɗe! Ka faɗa wa bayinka mafarkin, mu kuma sai mu fassara.”
english: Then the Chaldeans spoke to the king in the Syrian language, “O king, live forever! Tell your servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.”

hausa: Ranka yă daɗe, sarki, ko ka tabbatar da haka, amma ba ka ko faɗa wa fadawanka, cewa ga wanda zai gāje Ranka yă daɗe, sarki ba?”
english: Was this thing done by my lord the king, and you haven’t shown to your servants who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him?”

hausa: Bala’am ya ce, “Ka gina mini bagadai bakwai a nan, ka kuma shirya mini bijimai bakwai da raguna bakwai.”
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”

hausa: Kai Kora da ƙungiyarka, gobe, za ku ɗauki farantai,
english: Do this: have Korah and all his company take censers,

hausa: Ya gidan Haruna, ku dogara ga Ubangiji, shi ne mai taimakonsu da garkuwarsu.
english: House of Aaron, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.

hausa: kafin a tone muguntarki. Ko da ma haka, yanzu ’ya’yan Arameyawa mata da dukan maƙwabtanta da kuma ’ya’yan Filistiyawa mata suna miki dariyar, dukan waɗanda suke kewaye da ke da suka rena ki.
english: before your wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all who are around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you all around.

hausa: ta kuma tsaya daga bayansa, wajen ƙafafunsa tana kuka, sai hawayenta sun fara zuba a ƙafafunsa. Sai ta goge su da gashin kanta, ta sumbace su, sa’an nan ta shafa musu turare.
english: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

hausa: Ku ƙi mugunta, ku ƙaunaci nagarta; ku dinga yin shari’ar gaskiya a ɗakunan shari’a. Mai yiwuwa Ubangiji Allah Maɗaukaki zai ji tausayin raguwar Yusuf.
english: Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.”

hausa: Amma sa’ad da Elihu ya ga mutanen nan uku ba su da abin cewa, sai ya fusata.
english: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

hausa: Da yake Yesu ya san tunaninsu, sai ya ɗauki wani ƙaramin yaro, ya sa ya tsaya kusa da shi.
english: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

hausa: gama abin da ana iya sani game da Allah a bayyane yake a gare su, domin Allah ya bayyana musu shi.
english: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.

hausa: Gara abin da ido ya gani da kwaɗayin da bai sami biyan bukata ba. Wannan ma ba shi da amfani, naushin iska ne kawai.
english: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

hausa: Allah ya ga hasken yana da kyau, sai ya raba tsakanin hasken da duhu.
english: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.

hausa: ’Ya’yanki maza su komo da gaggawa, waɗanda suka lalatar da ke kuwa za su bar ki.
english: Your children hurry. Your destroyers and those who devastated you will leave you.

hausa: Sa’an nan Yowab ya aika manzanni wurin Dawuda yana cewa, “Na yaƙi Rabba na kuma ƙwace hanyar samun ruwanta.
english: Joab sent messengers to David, and said, “I have fought against Rabbah. Yes, I have taken the city of waters.

hausa: Game da mata, yara, dabbobi da kuma sauran abubuwan da suke cikin birnin, za ku iya kwasa waɗannan a matsayin ganima wa kanku. Za ku kuma yi amfani da ganimar da Ubangiji Allahnku ya ba ku daga abokan gābanku.
english: but the women, the little ones, the livestock, and all that is in the city, even all its plunder, you shall take for plunder for yourself. You may use the plunder of your enemies, which Yahweh your God has given you.

hausa: ba su kuwa san abin da yake faruwa ba sai da ruwan tsufana ya zo ya share su tas. Haka zai zama a dawowar Ɗan Mutum.
english: and they didn’t know until the flood came and took them all away, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

hausa: a shekara ta ashirin da uku ta sarautarsa, Nebuzaradan shugaban matsara ya tafi da Yahudawa 745. Jimillarsu duka 4,600 ne.
english: in the twenty-third year of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty-five people. All the people numbered four thousand six hundred.

hausa: Dawuda ya ce wa saurayin da ya kawo labarin, “Daga ina ka fito?” Ya ce, “Ni ɗan wani baƙo ne, mutumin Amalek.”
english: David said to the young man who told him, “Where are you from?” He answered, “I am the son of a foreigner, an Amalekite.”

hausa: Dole mutumin da ya ƙone su yă wanke rigunansa yă kuma yi wanka, bayan haka zai iya shiga sansani.
english: He who burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

hausa: A gefen kudu kuwa, iyakar ta fara daga ƙauyukan Kiriyat Yeyarim wajen yamma sai ta miƙe zuwa maɓuɓɓugar ruwan Neftowa.
english: The south quarter was from the farthest part of Kiriath Jearim. The border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.

hausa: “Bai taɓa yin laifi ba sam, ba a kuma sami ƙarya a bakinsa ba.”
english: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”

hausa: ’Ya’yan Haruna za su ƙone shi a kan bagade a bisa hadaya ta ƙonawa wadda take a kan itacen da yake cin wuta, kamar hadayar da ka yi da wuta, mai daɗin ƙanshi ga Ubangiji.
english: Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

hausa: A wata ranar Asabbaci kuma, Yesu ya shiga majami’a yana koyarwa. To, a nan kuwa akwai wani mutumin da hannun damansa ya shanye.
english: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.

hausa: Fito, ku ’yan matan Sihiyona, ku ga Sarki Solomon yana saye da rawani, rawanin da mahaifiyarsa ta naɗa masa, a ranar aurensa, a ranar da zuciyarsa ta yi farin ciki.
english: Go out, you daughters of Zion, and see King Solomon, with the crown with which his mother has crowned him, in the day of his weddings, in the day of the gladness of his heart.

hausa: To, waɗansu malaman dokoki da suke zaune a wurin, suka yi tunani a zuciyarsu, suna cewa,
english: But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,

hausa: Dukan abubuwa suna kawo gajiya, gaban magana. Ido ba ya gaji da gani, haka ma kunne yă ƙoshi da ji.
english: All things are full of weariness beyond uttering. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

hausa: Don haka, sai suka amsa cewa, “Ba mu san inda ta fito ba.”
english: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.

hausa: Da suka ji wannan motsi, taro ya haɗu wuri ɗaya a ruɗe, domin kowannensu ya ji suna magana da yarensa.
english: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.

hausa: Amma ka ɗibi gashi kaɗan ka daure a shafin rigarka.
english: You shall take a small number of these and bind them in the folds of your robe.

hausa: Saboda haka, in da hali, bari mu aikata nagarta ga dukan mutane, musamman ga waɗanda suke na iyalin masu bi.
english: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

hausa: Sa’an nan Dawuda ya aiki manzanni su kawo masa ita. Ta zo wurinsa shi kuma ya kwana da ita (A lokacin kuwa ta gama tsarkake kanta ke nan daga jinin haila.) Sa’an nan ta tafi gida.
english: David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in to him, and he lay with her (for she was purified from her uncleanness); and she returned to her house.

hausa: Saboda haka sai na aika a kira Eliyezer, da Ariyel, da Shemahiya, da Elnatan, da Yarib, da Natan, da Zakariya, da Meshullam waɗanda su ne shugabanni. Na kuma sa a kira Yohiyarib da Elnatan waɗanda masana ne.
english: Then I sent for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, for Elnathan, for Jarib, for Elnathan, for Nathan, for Zechariah, and for Meshullam, chief men; also for Joiarib and for Elnathan, who were teachers.

hausa: Yabi Ubangiji, dukanku ayyukansa ko’ina a mulkinsa. Yabi Ubangiji, ya raina.
english: Praise Yahweh, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise Yahweh, my soul!

hausa: a maimakon kawo shi a matsayin hadaya ga Ubangiji a gaban tabanakul na Ubangiji, za a ɗauki wannan mutum a matsayi mai laifin zub da jini, ya zub da jini, kuma dole a raba shi da mutanensa.
english: and hasn’t brought it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to offer it as an offering to Yahweh before Yahweh’s tabernacle: blood shall be imputed to that man. He has shed blood. That man shall be cut off from among his people.

hausa: “Zan kāre wannan birni in kuma cece shi, saboda girmana da kuma saboda sunan Dawuda bawana!”
english: ‘For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.’”

hausa: To, a cikin mazaunin masarauta a Shusha, akwai wani mutumin Yahuda, daga Kabilar Benyamin mai suna Mordekai, ɗan Yayir, ɗan Shimeyi, ɗan Kish,
english: There was a certain Jew in the citadel of Susa whose name was Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite,

hausa: Kashegari da sassafe, sai Abimelek ya tara dukan fadawansa, ya faɗa musu duk abin da ya faru, suka ji tsoro ƙwarai da gaske.
english: Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ear. The men were very scared.

hausa: An zubo mini alherin Ubangijinmu a yalwace, tare da bangaskiya da ƙaunar da take cikin Kiristi Yesu.
english: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

hausa: Ka juye wurina ka kuma yi mini jinƙai, gama na kaɗaice ina kuma wahala.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.

hausa: Sa’an nan sarki ya koma fadarsa ya kwana bai ci ba, kuma babu wata liyafar da aka kawo masa. Ya kuma kāsa barci.
english: Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting. No musical instruments were brought before him; and his sleep fled from him.

hausa: Yaya za mu rera waƙoƙin Ubangiji a baƙuwar ƙasa?
english: How can we sing Yahweh’s song in a foreign land?

hausa: Ka haɗa da waɗannan cuku guda goma, ka kai wa komandan rundunarsu. Ka ga lafiyar ’yan’uwanka, ka kawo mini labari daga wurinsu.
english: and bring these ten cheeses to the captain of their thousand; and see how your brothers are doing, and bring back news.”

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa, “Tafi wurin mutanen, ka tsarkake su yau da gobe, ka sa su wanke tufafinsu.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go to the people, and sanctify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments,

hausa: Isra’ilawa suka kama hanya, suka yi sansani a Obot.
english: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in Oboth.

hausa: Sarki kuma ya sa a ba su abinci da ruwan inabi kowace rana daga cikin abincin sarki. Za a koyar da su har shekaru uku, bayan haka kuma su shiga yin wa sarki hidima.
english: The king appointed for them a daily portion of the king’s delicacies and of the wine which he drank, and that they should be nourished three years, that at its end they should stand before the king.

hausa: Sai Yesu ya faɗa musu wannan misali ya ce,
english: He told them this parable:

hausa: Kowace shekara, kowa da ya zo wurinsa yakan kawo kyautai, kayayyakin azurfa da na zinariya, riguna, makamai, da kayan yaji, dawakai da alfadarai.
english: Year after year, every man brought his tribute, vessels of silver, vessels of gold, clothing, armor, spices, horses, and mules.

hausa: (Fir’auna sarkin Masar ya kai wa Gezer hari, ya kuma ci ta da yaƙi. Ya sa mata wuta, ya kashe Kan’aniyawanta mazaunan wurin, ya kuma ba da ita a matsayin kyautar aure ga ’yarsa, matar Solomon.
english: Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, taken Gezer, burned it with fire, killed the Canaanites who lived in the city, and given it for a wedding gift to his daughter, Solomon’s wife.

hausa: Yesu bai yardar masa ba, amma ya ce, “Ka tafi gida wurin iyalinka, ka gaya musu babban alherin da Ubangiji ya yi maka, da yadda ya yi maka jinƙai.”
english: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”

hausa: kuma sa’ad da suka yi wa’azi a Ferga, sai suka gangara zuwa Attaliya.
english: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.

hausa: Uba, ka ɗaukaka sunanka!” Sai wata murya ta fito daga sama ta ce, “Na riga na ɗaukaka shi, zan kuma ƙara ɗaukaka shi.”
