english: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it and will glorify it again.”

hausa: Bisa ga abin da yake a rubuce kuma, suka yi biki Bikin Tabanakul, suka miƙa hadayu kowace rana gwargwadon yawan hadayun da ake bukata.
english: They kept the feast of booths, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the ordinance, as the duty of every day required;

hausa: Ya Ubangiji, da hannunka ka cece ni daga irin mutanen nan, daga mutanen duniyan nan waɗanda ladarsu yana a wannan rayuwa ne. Kakan cika yunwan waɗanda kake so; ’ya’yansu suna da isashe suna kuma ajiyar wadata wa ’ya’yansu.
english: from men by your hand, Yahweh, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.

hausa: Za a bayar da su ga takobi su kuma zama abincin karnukan jeji.
english: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.

hausa: Sai Ubangiji ya ce wa Yoshuwa, “Yau na kawar muku da zargin Masar.” Saboda haka ake kiran sunan wurin Gilgal har wa yau.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you.” Therefore the name of that place was called Gilgal to this day.

hausa: Duk wanda ya ɗauki ɗaya daga cikin gawawwakinsu dole yă wanke rigunansa, zai kuma ƙazantu har zuwa yamma.
english: Whoever carries any part of their carcass shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening.

hausa: suna kiyaye ka daga mace marar ɗa’a daga sulɓin harshen mace marar aminci.
english: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.

hausa: Zan husata, in kuma kashe ku da takobi; matanku kuma, su ma su zama gwauraye, ’ya’yanku kuwa su zama marayu.
english: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

hausa: Muddin ina da rai a cikina kuma numfashin Allah yana cikin hancina,
english: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);

hausa: Ubangiji ya ce wa Sama’ila, “Har yaushe za ka yi ta makoki saboda Shawulu? Na riga na ƙi shi da zaman sarkin Isra’ila. Ka cika ƙahonka da mai, zan aike ka zuwa wurin Yesse na Betlehem. Na zaɓi ɗaya daga cikin ’ya’yansa maza yă zama sarki.”
english: Yahweh said to Samuel, “How long will you mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him from being king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil, and go. I will send you to Jesse the Bethlehemite, for I have provided a king for myself among his sons.”

hausa: Suka kira Lot, suka ce, “Ina mutanen da suka zo wurinka a daren nan? Fito mana da su waje domin mu kwana da su.”
english: They called to Lot, and said to him, “Where are the men who came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may have sex with them.”

hausa: Ƙauna ba ta cutar da maƙwabci. Saboda haka ƙauna cika Doka ce.
english: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

hausa: Ya yi bagaden tagulla mai tsawo kamu ashirin, fāɗinsa kamu ashirin, tsayinsa kuma kamu goma.
english: Then he made an altar of bronze, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.

hausa: Kamar yadda rijiya takan ba da ruwarta, haka birnin yake da muguntarsa. Ana jin labarin rikici da hallaka a cikinsa; ciwonsa da mikinsa kullum suna a gabana.
english: As a well produces its waters, so she produces her wickedness. Violence and destruction is heard in her. Sickness and wounds are continually before me.

hausa: wanda ya tabbatar da maganganun bayinsa ya kuma cika annabce-annabcen ’yan aikansa, “wanda ya ce game da Urushalima, ‘Za a zauna a cikinta,’ game da garuruwan Yahuda, ‘Za a gina su,’
english: who confirms the word of his servant, and performs the counsel of his messengers; who says of Jerusalem, ‘She will be inhabited;’ and of the cities of Judah, ‘They will be built,’ and ‘I will raise up its waste places;’

hausa: “A lokacin mulkin sama zai zama kamar budurwai goma waɗanda suka ɗauki fitilunsu suka fita don su taryi ango.
english: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

hausa: Mun san cewa mun riga mun ratsa daga mutuwa zuwa rai, domin muna ƙaunar ’yan’uwanmu. Duk wanda ba ya ƙauna matacce ne har yanzu.
english: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.

hausa: Mace mai halin kirki rawanin mijinta ne, amma mace marar kunya tana kama da ciwo a ƙasusuwansa.
english: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.

hausa: Saboda haka na ɗauko alluna biyun na jefar da su daga hannuwana, na farfashe su a idanunku.
english: I took hold of the two tablets, and threw them out of my two hands, and broke them before your eyes.

hausa: Ba a bar waɗansu Anakawa a harabar Isra’ila ba; sai dai a Gaza, Gat da Ashdod ne aka samu waɗanda suka ragu da rai.
english: There were none of the Anakim left in the land of the children of Israel. Only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, did some remain.

hausa: Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya ce wa waɗannan ƙasusuwa. Zan sa numfashi ya shiga muku, za ku kuwa rayu.
english: The Lord Yahweh says to these bones: “Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live.

hausa: Na kauce kamar ɓatacciyar tunkiya. Ka nemi bawanka, gama ban manta da umarnanka ba.
english: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.

hausa: Waɗansu kwanonin zinariya guda 30 Waɗansu kwanonin azurfa guda 410 da waɗansu kayayyaki guda 1,000
english: thirty bowls of gold, four hundred ten silver bowls of a second kind, and one thousand other vessels.

hausa: Zai sa waɗansu su zama shugabannin mutum dubu-dubu da kuma na hamsin-hamsin. Waɗansu za su yi masa noma da girbi. Waɗansu za su ƙera masa makaman yaƙi da kayayyaki don keken yaƙinsa.
english: He will appoint them to him for captains of thousands and captains of fifties; and he will assign some to plow his ground and to reap his harvest; and to make his instruments of war and the instruments of his chariots.

hausa: a can ne Ibrahim ya ce game da matarsa Saratu, “Ita ’yar’uwata ce.” Sai Abimelek sarkin Gerar ya aiko a kawo masa Saratu.
english: Abraham said about Sarah his wife, “She is my sister.” Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

hausa: Babu abin da ya ɓace, Dawuda ya dawo da kowa, manya da ƙanana, ’yan maza da ’yan mata duka, da dukan abubuwan da Amalekawa suka kwashe.
english: There was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither plunder, nor anything that they had taken. David brought them all back.

hausa: Dole yă iya tafiyar da iyalinsa da kyau, yă kuma tabbata cewa ’ya’yansa suna yin masa biyayya da ladabin da ya dace.
english: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;

hausa: Za tă zama masarauta mafi rarrauna cikin masarautai, ba kuwa za tă ƙara ɗaga kanta a kan sauran al’ummai ba. Zan sa tă zama marar ƙarfi ƙwarai, har da ba za tă ƙara yin mulkin a kan al’ummai ba.
english: It will be the lowest of the kingdoms. It won’t lift itself up above the nations any more. I will diminish them so that they will no longer rule over the nations.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne sunayen mutanen da Musa ya aika su binciki ƙasar. (Sai Musa ya ba Hosheya ɗan Nun, suna Yoshuwa.)
english: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.

hausa: Da suka iso, sai suka yi musu addu’a domin su karɓi Ruhu Mai Tsarki,
english: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;

hausa: sai Gehazi, bawan Elisha mutumin Allah, ya yi tunani a ransa ya ce, “Maigidana ya yi wa Na’aman mutumin Aram nan ƙaramci da bai karɓi duk abin da ya kawo ba. Muddin Ubangiji yana a raye, zan bi shi a guje in karɓi wani abu daga gare shi.”
english: But Gehazi the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, “Behold, my master has spared this Naaman the Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought. As Yahweh lives, I will run after him, and take something from him.”

hausa: Sa’ad da aka bincika labarin aka kuma iske gaskiya ne, sai aka rataye hafsoshin nan biyu a wurin rataye mai laifi. Aka rubuta dukan wannan a cikin littafin tarihi a gaban sarki.
english: When this matter was investigated, and it was found to be so, they were both hanged on a gallows; and it was written in the book of the chronicles in the king’s presence.

hausa: “Ka faɗa musu wannan, ‘Ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka yana cewa muddin ina raye, waɗanda aka rage a kufai za su fāɗi ga takobi, waɗanda suke bayan gari kuwa namun jeji za su cinye su, waɗanda suke a mafaka da kogwannin duwatsu annoba za tă kashe su.
english: “You shall tell them, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “As I live, surely those who are in the waste places will fall by the sword. I will give whoever is in the open field to the animals to be devoured, and those who are in the strongholds and in the caves will die of the pestilence.

hausa: Ta wurin bangaskiya ne aka ɗauki Enok daga wannan rayuwa, ta haka bai ɗanɗana mutuwa ba; ba a kuwa same shi ba, domin Allah ya ɗauke shi. Gama kafin a ɗauke shi, an yabe shi a kan ya gamshi Allah.
english: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.

hausa: Suka kawo Yesu a wurin da ake kira Golgota (wanda yake nufin Wurin Ƙoƙon Kai).
english: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”

hausa: Saboda haka kullum zan tuna muku da waɗannan, ko da yake kun sansu kun kuma kahu ƙwarai cikin gaskiyar da kuke da ita yanzu.
english: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.

hausa: Sa’ad da girman kai ya zo, sai shan kunya ta zo, amma hikima kan zo tare da ƙasƙantar da kai.
english: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.

hausa: Jimillar da sauran mutane suka bayar ta kai darik 20,000 na zinariya, minas 2,000 na azurfa, da riguna sittin da bakwai don firistoci.
english: That which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, plus two thousand minas of silver, and sixty-seven priests’ garments.

hausa: Kuma sai ka ce wannan bai isa ba a idonka, ya Allah, ka yi magana game da nan gaba na gidan bawanka. Ka dube ni sai ka ce ni ne mafi ɗaukaka cikin mutane, ya Ubangiji Allah.
english: This was a small thing in your eyes, O God, but you have spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have respected me according to the standard of a man of high degree, Yahweh God.

hausa: Kada ka bari in sha kunya, ya Ubangiji, gama na yi kuka gare ka; amma bari mugaye su sha kunya su kuma kwanta shiru a cikin kabari.
english: Let me not be disappointed, Yahweh, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.

hausa: An tare hanyar rago da ƙayayyuwa, amma hanyar mai aikata gaskiya buɗaɗɗiyar hanya ce.
english: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.

hausa: Sarki ya ce wa Haman, “Ka riƙe kuɗin, ka kuma yi da mutanen yadda ka ga dama.”
english: The king said to Haman, “The silver is given to you, the people also, to do with them as it seems good to you.”

hausa: Ba ya bukatar shaidar mutum game da mutum, don yă san abin da yake cikin zuciyar mutum.
english: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.

hausa: Kowane bugun da Ubangiji zai yi musu da bulalarsa na hukunci zai zama kiɗi ga ganguna da garaya, yayinda yake yaƙi da su da naushin hannunsa.
english: Every stroke of the rod of punishment, which Yahweh will lay on him, will be with the sound of tambourines and harps. He will fight with them in battles, brandishing weapons.

hausa: Ku je Kalne ku dube ta; ku wuce daga can zuwa Hamat-rabba, sa’an nan ku gangara zuwa Gat a Filistiya. Sun fi masarautunku biyu ne? Ƙasarsu ta fi taku girma?
english: Go to Calneh, and see. From there go to Hamath the great. Then go down to Gath of the Philistines. Are they better than these kingdoms? Is their border greater than your border?

hausa: To, ga abin da Ubangiji Maɗaukaki ya ce, “Ku lura da al’amuranku.
english: Now therefore this is what Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Consider your ways.

hausa: Ba shi da ’ya’ya ko zuriya cikin mutanensa, ba sauran wanda yake a raye a wurin da ya taɓa zama.
english: He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.

hausa: Da jin wannan, Yesu ya ce musu, “Ai, masu lafiya ba sa bukatar likita, sai dai marasa lafiya. Ban zo domin in kira masu adalci ba, sai dai masu zunubi.”
english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

hausa: Sa’an nan yă tuɓe waɗannan rigunan yă sa waɗansu, sa’an nan yă ɗauki tokar yă kai waje da sansani zuwa inda yake da tsabta.
english: He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

hausa: Da abin kamun kifi ya cika, masuntan suka jawo shi gaci. Sai suka zauna suka tattara kifi masu kyau a kwanduna, amma suka zubar da marasa kyau.
english: which, when it was filled, fishermen drew up on the beach. They sat down and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.

hausa: Gama Yohanna ya yi baftisma daruwa, amma a cikin ’yan kwanaki za a yi muku baftisma da Ruhu Mai Tsarki.”
english: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”

hausa: Saboda haka, mutane suke girmama shi, ko bai kula da waɗanda suke gani su masu hikima ba ne?”
english: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”

hausa: Noha na huɗu da Rafa na biyar.
english: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

hausa: Ubangiji ya sa suka ruɗe a gaban Isra’ilawa, Isra’ilawa kuwa suka yi babbar nasara a kansu a Gibeyon. Isra’ilawa suka fafare su a kan hanyar zuwa Bet-Horon suka karkashe su duka har zuwa Azeka da Makkeda.
english: Yahweh confused them before Israel. He killed them with a great slaughter at Gibeon, and chased them by the way of the ascent of Beth Horon, and struck them to Azekah and to Makkedah.

hausa: Ni da kaina zan yi yaƙi da kai da miƙaƙƙen hannu mai ƙarfi cikin fushi da hasala mai girma.
english: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation.

hausa: Sai suka ce wa sarki, “Daniyel ɗin nan, wanda yake ɗaya daga cikin waɗanda aka kwaso daga Yahuda, bai kula da kai ba, ya sarki, balle fa dokar da ka yi. Har yanzu yana addu’a sau uku a rana.”
english: Then they answered and said before the king, “That Daniel, who is of the children of the captivity of Judah, doesn’t respect you, O king, nor the decree that you have signed, but makes his petition three times a day.”

hausa: Saboda haka ga abin da Ubangiji Mai Iko Duka ya ce, “Abokin gāba zai ƙwace ƙasar, zai saukar da mafakarku, zai washe kagarunku.”
english: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “An adversary will overrun the land; and he will pull down your strongholds, and your fortresses will be plundered.”

hausa: Sa’ad da Isra’ilawa na bakin kwari da waɗanda suke hayin Urdun suka ga sojojin Isra’ila suna gudu, Shawulu da yaransa uku kuma duk sun mutu, sai suka bar mallakansu suka sheƙa da gudu. Filistiyawa kuwa suka zo suka mamaye wuraren.
english: When the men of Israel who were on the other side of the valley, and those who were beyond the Jordan, saw that the men of Israel fled and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned the cities and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

hausa: Don haka, saboda wannan, da kuma saboda mala’iku, dole mace ta ɗaura wani abu a kanta.
english: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.

hausa: Sai dai sa’ad da cikakken ya zo, sai wanda ba cikakke yă shuɗe.
english: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

hausa: Ta wurin bangaskiya ne Ishaku ya albarkaci Yaƙub da Isuwa game da nan gabansu.
english: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

hausa: Jiki yakan haifi jiki, amma Ruhu yana haifi ruhu.
english: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

hausa: Dawuda ya sāke nemi nufin Ubangiji, sai Ubangiji ya ce masa, “Tashi ka gangara zuwa Keyila, gama zan ba da Filistiyawa a hannunka.”
english: Then David inquired of Yahweh yet again. Yahweh answered him, and said, “Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into your hand.”

hausa: Rundunarsa ta zo da ƙarfi; suka kafa sansani kewaye da ni, suka zagaye tentina.
english: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.

hausa: Me ya sa ka janye hannunka, hannunka na dama? Ka fid da shi daga rigarka ka hallaka su!
english: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!

hausa: Amma ƙofar zuwa rai, ƙarama ce matsattsiya kuma, masu samunta kuwa kaɗan ne.
english: How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life! There are few who find it.

hausa: Sai suka yi masa sujada, suka koma Urushalima cike da murna sosai.
english: They worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

hausa: Kada ka bar wani yă rena ka domin kai matashi ne, sai dai ka zama gurbi ga masu bi cikin magana, cikin rayuwa, cikin ƙauna, cikin bangaskiya da kuma cikin zaman tsarki.
english: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

hausa: Amma da ya ji Arkelawus ne yake mulki a Yahudiya a matsayin wanda ya gāji mahaifinsa Hiridus, sai ya ji tsoron zuwa can. Bayan an gargaɗe shi a mafarki, sai ya ratse zuwa gundumar Galili,
english: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,

hausa: Ba su bukaci wani bayani daga waɗanda aka ba wa kuɗin don su biya ma’aikatan ba, domin sun yi aikinsu da aminci.
english: Moreover they didn’t demand an accounting from the men into whose hand they delivered the money to give to those who did the work; for they dealt faithfully.

hausa: Waɗannan su ne hoton abubuwan da za su zo; amma Kiristi ne ainihinsu.
english: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.

hausa: Ku hallaka su ƙaƙaf, wato, Hittiyawa, Amoriyawa, Kan’aniyawa, Ferizziyawa, Hiwiyawa da kuma Yebusiyawa, yadda Ubangiji Allahnku ya umarce ku.
english: but you shall utterly destroy them: the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, as Yahweh your God has commanded you;

hausa: Duk abin da aka kawo a gaban haske ana iya ganinsa, kuma duk abin da aka haskaka yakan zama haske.
english: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

hausa: Da Yesu ya zo cikin gidan Bitrus, sai ya ga surukar Bitrus tana kwance a gado tana da zazzaɓi.
english: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.

hausa: Ɗan Yediyayel shi ne, Bilhan. ’Ya’yan Bilhan maza su ne, Yewush, Benyamin, Ehud, Kena’ana, Zetan, Tarshish da Ahishahar.
english: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

hausa: A firgice, Yehoshafat ya yanke shawara yă nemi nufin Ubangiji, ya kuma yi shelar azumi a dukan Yahuda.
english: Jehoshaphat was alarmed, and set himself to seek Yahweh. He proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.

hausa: Ba zai auri matan da mijinta ya mutu, ko macen da mijinta ya rabu da ita, ko macen da ta ɓata kanta ta wurin karuwanci ba, sai dai yă auri budurwa daga cikin mutanensa,
english: He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin of his own people as a wife.
